qualifications are not required, but would be considered an asset. * Experience with JavaScript. * Experience with front\-end frameworks such as React and Vue. * Familiarity with Linux operating systems. * Experience with Bash and Python scripting. * Knowledge of or experience with Rust. * Experience with front\-end or full\-stack software development. * Experience integrating software and hardware solutions. * Understanding of software project management, including planning, execution, and delivery. **Why Us?** At 45Drives, we believe in recognizing and rewarding hard work and dedication. **Starting Annual Total Compensation:** $105,000\-$135,000 In addition, you can look forward to: **Training \& Growth:** We'll teach you the role from the ground up and provide opportunities to expand your skills and grow your career over time. **Comprehensive Health Care:** Medical, Dental, Life Insurance, and Group Insurance available after two months of full\-time employment. **Vacation:** Start with two weeks of paid vacation, increasing to three weeks after three years and four weeks after five years. **Community Discounts:** Access exclusive deals at local businesses. **Wellness Support:** Participate in wellness events and enjoy access to a gym membership. **Social Events:** As our Wilmington branch continues to grow, enjoy team lunches, seasonal parties, and social events with your coworkers. **Wilmington Lifestyle:** Embrace coastal living with stunning beaches, rich culture, historic charm, and a thriving innovation scene. **Apply Today!** We're looking for individuals who take initiative, enjoy solving challenges, and want to create products that make a meaningful difference for customers. If you're ready to take ownership of exciting projects, collaborate with a passionate team, and help shape the future of open\-source enterprise storage, we'd love to hear from you. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. **Job Specs – AI Engineer** **About this role** We are seeking an AI Engineer to build secure, production\-ready AI services and agentic workflows. You will use Python, FastAPI, Apache Airflow, RAG, LLM APIs, LangGraph, LangChain and MongoDB to deliver reliable capabilities from ingestion and retrieval through API deployment, evaluation and operational support. You will bring strong software\-engineering discipline, practical AI judgement and a clear understanding of security, responsible AI and production operations. **In This role you will*** Design and implement production\-grade AI applications, copilots and agentic workflows aligned to measurable business outcomes. * Build maintainable Python services and expose capabilities through secure, versioned FastAPI interfaces. * Design retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding, retrieval, reranking, citation and evaluation. * Integrate and invoke LLMs through provider SDKs or model gateways, applying structured outputs, tool/function calling, retries, rate limits, token controls and fallbacks. * Use LangGraph to implement stateful, controllable workflows and LangChain selectively for model, tool, retriever and prompt integrations. * Hands\-on understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and experience building or integrating MCP servers and MCP clients. * Ability to expose enterprise capabilities through MCP tools, resources and prompts, with appropriate schemas and controls * Create and operate Apache Airflow DAGs for scheduled ingestion, embedding refresh, evaluation, batch processing and data quality controls. * Design MongoDB document models, indexes and access patterns for application state, conversation history, metadata and operational records. * Implement automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure configuration, logging, tracing, monitoring and incident\-ready runbooks. * Partner with product owners, data engineers, security, architecture and subject\-matter experts to translate requirements into safe technical designs. * Document architecture decisions, model limitations, data lineage, controls and support procedures. **Required Qualifications:*** Typically 4\+ years of software, data or machine\-learning engineering experience, including at least 1 year delivering LLM\-enabled applications. Equivalent depth demonstrated through shipped products is acceptable. * Demonstrable ownership of at least one AI solution beyond proof of concept, with production evidence such as monitoring, security controls, evaluation, support and measurable outcomes. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * For a senior appointment: evidence of technical design leadership, mentoring, architecture decisions and cross\-team delivery * Experience with model gateways and providers such as Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or AWS Bedrock. * Vector\-search platforms or extensions such as MongoDB Vector Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch or Milvus. * MLOps/LLMOps tooling for prompt/version management, experiment tracking, evaluation and tracing, for example Galileo. * Cloud\-native delivery using RedHat OpenShift or equivalent infrastructure as code. * Knowledge\-graph, multimodal, fine\-tuning, synthetic\-data or advanced agent\-evaluation experience. * Experience in regulated or control\-focused environments with formal architecture, risk, privacy and change\-management processes. * Essential technical skills: Python, FastAPI \& APIs, Apache, RAG, LLM, LangGraph, LangChain, MongoDB **Kaleidoscope, an Infosys Company, is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.**

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI is a fast\-growing startup based in the San Francisco Bay Area, building the next generation of physical AI agents—intelligent, embodied systems that interact with people in real\-world environments. We combine cutting\-edge language models, multimodal AI, and custom hardware to power transformative AI experiences in airports, stadiums, conferences, and more. We’re trusted by top enterprises and city partners, and backed by renowned investors. **About the Role** ------------------ We're building realtime, interactive AI avatars that can see, listen, and respond with natural speech and expressive motion. As an AI Engineer, you'll help train, fine\-tune, and serve the generative models behind them—from data curation and training diffusion and video models to low\-latency inference for live streaming. You'll work closely with our backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar experiences used in the real world. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Generative avatar models:** Train and fine\-tune generative models for talking\-head synthesis, audio\-driven facial animation, and full\-body avatar video. * **Data pipelines:** Build data pipelines for large\-scale video, audio, and multimodal datasets. * **Realtime optimization:** Optimize models for realtime serving, targeting sub\-200ms end\-to\-end latency, using techniques such as distillation, quantization, and custom kernels. * **ML infrastructure:** Build and maintain training, evaluation, and deployment infrastructure on GPU clusters. * **Quality metrics:** Define and improve metrics such as lip\-sync accuracy, identity preservation, expression naturalness, latency, and throughput. * **Ship with the team:** Work with backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar features and iterate on user feedback, while keeping up with the latest in generative video, multimodal AI, and neural rendering. **Who You Are** --------------- **Must\-haves** * 3\+ years of hands\-on ML engineering experience, or strong research experience with production\-quality code. * Deep PyTorch expertise and the ability to reproduce and extend research papers. * Background in diffusion models, video generation, computer vision, multimodal AI, speech synthesis, or neural rendering. * Experience optimizing realtime inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, Triton, CUDA, mixed precision). * Strong Python skills and experience with multi\-GPU or multi\-node distributed training. * Comfort with ambiguity and fast\-changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership. **Bonus points** * Experience with talking\-head, lip\-sync, or digital human systems, or related areas such as 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, or face reenactment. * Publications at top venues (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, ICLR, ICML) or notable open\-source contributions. **Why Join LiveX AI?** ---------------------- * **World\-Stage Experiences:** Your work goes live in front of millions—at the Super Bowl, major airports, and NVIDIA GTC—not just inside an office. * **Full\-Real Scope:** AI, hardware, and real customers—you'll build a skill set most people don't reach until years into their careers. * **Silicon Valley, Front Row:** Work at the center of the physical AI movement, with the connections and momentum that come with it. * **Mentorship That Matters:** Work directly with founders and senior leaders who want to see you grow—not hand you busywork. * **Real Ownership \& Growth:** Top performers take on more scope fast—leading projects, owning customers, and shaping the product. * **Compute to Build With:** Access to GPU compute for training and experimentation, plus competitive salary, equity, and benefits. Ready to launch the next phase of your career and build the future of physical AI? Apply to join LiveX AI today.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: ABC \- Sr level Cybersecurity Engineer DAYS ON SITE: 3 days/week \*Deadline to submit: Tuesday, 11/ by 4 pm EST ABOUT THE ROLE ABC is looking for an Expert Cybersecurity Engineer (12\+ yrs) who can develop cyber defense solutions, perform network security analysis and preliminary incident response, and support IAM, vulnerability, patch, and monitoring operations and strategic initiatives. The Cybersecurity Engineer will work as a senior member of Virginia ABC’s In formation Security Operations team, splitting time between day\-to\-day security operations and longer\-term security improvement work. A typical day starts with reviewing security alerts and events from overnight in the SIEM and endpoint security tools. The engineer triages anything that needs attention, investigates suspicious activity, and conducts preliminary incident response when needed, including gathering evidence, recommending containment, and escalating according to established procedures. They review threat intelligence and security advisories to find new threats relevant to the agency’s environment. Through the rest of the day, the engineer works on reducing the team’s operational backlog. This includes analyzing vulnerability scan results, prioritizing findings by risk and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, and verifying that fixes are complete. They support patch and configuration management by reviewing compliance, helping resolve failed deployments, and working through exceptions for systems that can’t be patched right away. On the identity side, they review access and privileged account activity and support access governance tasks. The engineer also contributes to strategic security initiatives. This includes designing and implementing security controls and improvements, tuning and building detection rules, improving log coverage, and helping mature security processes. They perform in\-depth network and system security analysis to find weaknesses and recommend fixes. All work follows the agency’s change management process. The engineer writes and maintains technical documentation, including procedures, runbooks, and configuration standards, and works with IT infrastructure, endpoint, and application teams to put security changes in place. They work independently, manage several priorities at once, provide guidance to team members, and report progress to the Assistant Director of Information Security Operations. **Position Summary** Virginia ABC's Information Security Operations team is seeking an expert\-level Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen the agency's cyber defense posture. The engineer will design, implement, and support security solutions across the enterprise, perform in\-depth security analysis, and help the team carry out operational security work and strategic initiatives. The position calls for a highly skilled professional who can work independently in a complex, highly secure government environment and contribute across multiple security disciplines. \< \>Key Responsibilities * Design, implement, and maintain advanced cyber defense solutions and security changes across the enterprise infrastructure, making sure systems are built to specification and deployed successfully. * Safeguard the enterprise infrastructure against unauthorized intrusion and data exfiltration. * Design, maintain, and operate security controls within highly complex, highly secure network and communications environments. * Perform in\-depth network and system security analysis to find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and threats to the organization's security posture. * Monitor, review, and analyze security events and alerts, and conduct preliminary incident response, event analysis, and threat intelligence activities. * Support vulnerability management activities, including assessment, risk prioritization, remediation coordination, and validation. * Support patch and configuration management processes to keep enterprise endpoints and servers secure and compliant. * Support identity and access management security controls, including access governance, privileged access, and authentication practices. * Help improve security monitoring, detection capabilities, logging, and alerting. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, including procedures, runbooks, and security configurations, in line with change management and audit requirements. * Work with cross\-functional IT teams and stakeholders to put security improvements in place and reduce operational risk. \< \>Required Qualifications * 12\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or a closely related field * Demonstrated experience designing and operating security controls in complex, high\-security enterprise network environments * Strong knowledge of network security, threat analysis, incident response, and vulnerability management principles * Experience analyzing security events and producing actionable findings * Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences * Experience producing clear technical documentation in a change\-controlled environment \< \>Preferred Qualifications * Experience in a Microsoft\-centric enterprise environment (Entra ID, Intune, Configuration Manager, Microsoft 365\) * Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning, SIEM, and endpoint security platforms * Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800\- , or CIS Controls * Experience supporting state or local government agencies * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GSEC), CySA\+, or Security\+ **Required/Desired Skills** **Skill** **Required /Desired** **Amount** jobs.title: Director of Security
jobs.description: Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported. We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes. **Come Build with Us** ---------------------- We're an NYC\-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office\-first company that values in\-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life\-saving therapies. Patients trust us with their health information, and the pharma companies we serve trust us to protect it. That trust is what lets the mission scale. This role owns that. As Director of Security, you will report to the CTO and set direction for security across three surfaces: the Courier platform and the AI agents running on it, how our engineers build that platform, and how we run the company. IT Operations reports through you, and you will set the direction for security architecture across Courier. This is a build job. We are putting AI agents into patient workflows that touch PHI, and the playbook for securing that is still being written. You will write it. And you will use agents to run a security program that covers far more ground than its headcount suggests. **What You'll Build** --------------------- **A platform that earns a pharma security team's trust.** You will set the direction for security architecture of the Courier platform and our AI agents, threat\-modeling agent workflows for prompt injection, tool and permission boundaries, and data leakage before they ship. When customers run security reviews, questionnaires, RFPs, and audits, you are the voice across the table. Our platform's security should be a reason they choose us. **An engineering org that ships securely by default.** Threat modeling, CI guardrails, secrets management, dependency and infrastructure scanning, and a security champions program. You set the direction, and the secure path becomes the easy one. You will hold Courier's own AI use to the same standard: what coding agents and AI tools can access and commit, with frameworks like NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001 treated as engineering requirements, not paperwork. **Compliance that runs all year, not the week before the audit.** You will own SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA outcomes through continuous control testing and automated evidence. You will partner with Legal on privacy, compliance, and policy. Controls should be code, and evidence should generate itself. **A small team that covers a large surface.** IT Operations reports through you and owns identity, endpoints, Zero Trust access, and SaaS governance. You will own incident response and sit on the escalation path, and run vulnerability management and penetration testing measured by time to close. Agents will handle triage, evidence collection, control validation, and continuous testing, so your people spend their time on judgment. You will hire and develop the security and IT Operations team as we scale. **What Makes You Successful** ----------------------------- * 10\+ years in security engineering, product or application security, or cloud security, including 3\+ years leading security people or programs. * You have built, or substantially rebuilt, a security program at a fast\-growing software company. * You have protected regulated sensitive data (PHI, PII, or financial) in production. * Deep AWS security experience. Our stack is TypeScript/Node, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and largely serverless AWS. * Enough technical depth to review architecture and code, lead an incident, and set technical direction for engineers. * A clear point of view on securing LLM\-powered and agentic systems. * End\-to\-end ownership of incident response, vulnerability management, and penetration testing programs. * An engineering approach to compliance. You have automated controls and evidence instead of managing them by hand. * Clear communication with engineers, executives, our board, and customer security teams. You can explain the same risk to all of them. * Based in New York and in our NoMad office 4\+ days per week. Bonus points if: * You build with agents. You have designed and shipped agentic workflows, and used agents to scale security work such as triage, continuous pentesting, evidence generation, and security\-as\-code. * You have secured LLM or agentic features in production, ideally on AWS Bedrock or AgentCore. * You have healthcare, life sciences, or HIPAA experience. * You have led security at a venture\-backed company through rapid growth. * You have hands\-on experience with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001\). * You have done security work facing enterprise pharma or healthcare buyers. * You have worked with Cloudflare Zero Trust, Microsoft Entra ID, and MDM. **Benefits** ------------ * 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision) * 401(k) with employer funded match * Unlimited Vacation * Commuter Benefits * Paid parental leave * Catered lunch on Fridays * Wellness stipend **Compensation** ---------------- The annual salary range for the target level for this role is **$235,000 – $270,000** \+ equity \+ benefits, including medical, dental, and vision. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, interview performance, and internal equity. Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Please visit our DOTD Career Center for more information about our agency. jobs.title: Enterprise Technology Engineer
jobs.description: **About Daiwa Capital Markets America Inc.:** Incorporated in 1964, Daiwa Capital Markets America Inc. (“DCMA”) is a New York\-based registered securities broker\-dealer, a futures commission merchant, a primary dealer of U.S. Treasury securities, and a member of the New York Stock Exchange and other major U.S. exchanges. Our main focus is on the sales and trading of Japanese, Asian, and U.S. equities, fixed income instruments, financial futures, and investment banking for institutional customers. DCMA’s ultimate parent company is Daiwa Securities Group Inc., one of the largest brokerage and financial services groups in Japan. **Position Summary:** We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Engineer to join our IT Infrastructure team within a fast\-paced financial environment. This role involves the ongoing administration and maintenance of highly available corporate applications and systems. This role ensures optimal performance, security, and scalability while collaborating with IT teams and third\-party vendors. Key responsibilities include deploying and automating system processes, addressing critical issues, providing 24x7 support for line\-of\-business applications, leading server patching and vulnerability remediation efforts. The Enterprise Engineer will document system configurations, mentor team members and remain informed about the latest technology trends to recommend enhancements to the firm's technical platforms. Reporting to the Enterprise Technology Manager in the Information Technology Department, you will be an integral part of the Enterprise Technology group operating in an environment of high team collaboration with a strong desire to respond and resolve problems and requests in a prompt manner. **Core Responsibilities:** * Oversee and maintain hybrid environments, including on\-premises Windows Server infrastructure and cloud\-based services (e.g., Azure), ensuring seamless integration, service availability, and operating system interoperability across platforms. * Manage and support a wide range of enterprise applications and services such as Omnissa Horizon, Citrix XenApp, Informatica PowerCenter, Swift Alliance, IBM MQ, Automation tools (e.g., Redwood, Power Automate, ActiveBatch), Manage Engine Endpoint Central, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Web servers (e.g., Apache, IIS), and Office 365 services (e.g., Entra,Intune, SharePoint, Teams, Exchange). * Design, implement and automate system management processes using PowerShell and other automation tools. * Administer and maintain Windows Server and Windows 11 environments. * Develop solutions for capacity planning, system optimization, patch management, and issue remediation. * Monitor system performance, troubleshoot critical issues, and ensure compliance with security protocols. * Interface with enterprise application vendors in the areas of system onboarding and offboarding, contract negotiation, designing and implementing enterprise system interfaces (on and off premise API’s, etc.). * Conduct BCP testing of the firm’s critical systems and infrastructure components and report results to the firm’s BCM team. * Proficient in implementing and managing Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) solutions to ensure secure digital communication and data integrity. * Collaborate with IT functional teams (Security, Development, Service Desk) and external vendors to design and test enterprise solutions. * Assist in cloud adoption efforts by evaluating, deploying, and integrating cloud\-based applications and platforms. * Responsible for deploying product updates, identifying and resolving production issues, while maintaining the highest levels of security, resiliency and uptime. * Maintain detailed documentation and release notes for system changes, following strict change management processes. * Provide technical guidance to leadership and peer engineers. * Implement automated procedures for system maintenance and technical issues as required. * Stay updated with technology trends and recommend best practices to improve resiliency, security, and efficiency. * Address security related tasks / projects. * Provide rotational on\-call support after\-hours and on weekends. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required. * 7\-10 years of experience in systems engineering or cloud architecture roles. * Extensive experience with system automation and scripting tools (e.g., PowerShell) and infrastructure management platforms (e.g., Manage Engine, SCCM). * Expertise in managing hybrid environments and supporting cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Office 365\. * Proficiency in Omnissa Horizon support and management including thin/zero client deployment. * Ability to build strong relationships with team members, vendors, and non\-IT stakeholders. * Ability to work late in order to troubleshoot and perform upgrades and system maintenance outside of business hours. * Prior experience in training other staff members on technical systems and processes, showcasing leadership capabilities and team collaboration. * Ability to independently manage projects from research and testing to production deployment. * Exceptional server/systems troubleshooting skills and ability to resolve complex technical issues. * Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills (written and verbal) with a high focus on customer service. * Strong ability to work independently and under tight deadlines. * Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to handle both technical challenges and user interactions effectively. * Stay updated on emerging technologies, assess their potential impact, and recommend improvements to the current environment. **Preferred Qualifications**: * Possession of high\-level certifications in Microsoft Azure, Cloud Architecture, Windows Administration, VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or other industry / Microsoft certifications. * Skilled in disaster recovery and business continuity planning related to enterprise systems and platforms. * Proven experience in similar Enterprise technology roles within financial services environments, ensuring an understanding of industry\-specific security and compliance needs. **Company Culture and Benefits:** Daiwa Capital Markets America Inc. has a vibrant company culture made up of a diverse team of professionals. We seek to foster an atmosphere in which our employees understand, respect, and inspire each other. We will continue to build a culture that encourages everyone at DCMA to take pride in their work. How we work — individually, with each other, and with our communities — is just as important as what we do and shapes who we are as an organization. Our people are our most important asset, and as a result, we offer a competitive and robust total rewards package which includes, but is not limited to: * Competitive Benefits Package (Medical, Dental and Vision) * Ancillary Insurance (Basic Life Insurance, AD\&D Insurance, and Short \& Long\-term Disability) * Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts (FSA and HSA) * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits * Parental Leave * Family building benefits * 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off and holidays * Professional development, educational assistance and training programs * Community Engagement Programs DCMA has a hybrid work program in place, with opportunities for remote work depending on the nature of the role and needs of your department. This was implemented to provide operational efficiency while simultaneously giving employees flexibility. At a minimum, employees are expected to work in the office three days per week. *DCMA provides equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. We are committed to providing a work environment that is free of discrimination and harassment. DCMA prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability, military or veteran status, or other attributes protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your hat You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach.**Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process — just ask.* 2xzZRwQxlZ

jobs.title: Founding Engineer - Full-Stack
jobs.description: Vantheon is a research lab studying how AI will disrupt investing across economic classes. We believe the tools of wealth creation have been locked behind institutional walls for too long. We are here to change that. You are a full\-stack product engineer with 2–5 years of experience shipping fast, intuitive products at scale. You’ve built features end\-to\-end, from schema design to polished UI, and you care about performance at every level. You draw inspiration from products like Notion, Linear, and Cursor, and you have your own design sense. You don’t need a product designer to build something customers love. You start from what the user needs and own the feature until it ships, including the data model and services behind it. You do well in fast\-paced environments where you can experiment, iterate, and ship quickly. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and build a crisp, intuitive agent experiences from the UI down to the services that run and manage agents * Design the data models and services behind agents: runs, logs, versioning and background jobs * Build performance reporting dashboards with charts and key metrics, plus the APIs that power them * Integrate LLMs and agent frameworks into the product, including orchestration, streaming responses and cost and latency tuning * Build an onboarding flow that helps new users discover and adopt core features * Optimize performance across the stack, from code splitting and caching to query tuning and real\-time updates * Own deployment, monitoring and reliability for the features you ship * Work with product, research and engineering to turn user needs into clean, well\-built features * Build reusable components, design systems and internal tools that scale across the product **What We're Looking For:** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js * Experience building production APIs and backend services * Solid database skills with Postgres or similar, including schema design, query optimization and migrations * Hands\-on experience with complex state management and real\-time features (WebSockets, SSE, streaming) * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Vercel) and CI/CD * Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn * An eye for design and the ability to build polished interfaces from mockups or from scratch * Understanding of performance, security, accessibility and cross\-browser compatibility * The ability to balance innovation with pragmatism: shipping working solutions while pushing technical boundaries **Bonus:** * Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks or AI developer tools * Strong interest in the stock market * Has used Wall Street Bets or After Hours Vantheon is a small team building something that actually matters. If you think the tools of wealth creation should be accessible to everyone, you’ll fit in here. We move fast, take ownership seriously, and hold each other to a high standard. We take care of the people who build with us: 100% health insurance coverage (50% for dependents), unlimited PTO, a $2,000 annual AI learning stipend, 401k, and an on\-site chef for those working out of the office.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer / Proptech Venture
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * Competitive salary * Health insurance * Opportunity for advancement * Paid time off * Training \& development **Benefits/Perks** * Employee's health insurance premium is paid by the company. Coverage for dependents is available. * Retirement plan * 12 paid holidays * Paid vacation and sick time * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * Referral bonus * Room to grow Structure Properties is a fast\-growing San Francisco property management company expanding into new markets. Like most of the industry, we run on AppFolio. Unlike most, we’ve built our own tools on top of it. Now we’re turning those tools into a product: an AI layer that sits on top of the property management systems operators already use, starting with AppFolio, sold to property management companies like ours. **The Role** You’ll be the first engineer on this venture. Until there’s a team, you own the product end to end: architecture, code, AI, and security, with a real voice in what gets built and how it’s priced. Your job is to take a working internal prototype and turn it into a product outside customers pay for. **What’s Already Built** A platform in daily use that connects our AppFolio data with email, calls, calendars, and files in one searchable place. Internal apps for utility bill tracking, new property onboarding, and work order and compliance tracking. **What You’ll Own** * Architecture: How data is stored, how we integrate with AppFolio (including working around its API limits and gaps), and how the platform scales and stays secure. We handle tenant personal information and owner financials, so security and a path to SOC 2 are part of the job from day one. * Full\-stack development: User\-facing screens, back\-end services, databases, and integrations. * AI in production: Language models working on real property data to extract documents (leases, invoices, utility bills, inspection reports), draft tenant, owner, and vendor communications, forecast delinquency, turnover, and maintenance spend, and answer financial questions in plain English. You’ll own evals, cost, guardrails, and where a human stays in the loop. * Prototype to market: Onboarding outside customers, instrumenting usage, and turning what we learn into the roadmap. **What We’re Looking For** * You’ve built and shipped software people actually use, and you can build the whole thing yourself, front end to back end. * You’ve put LLM features into production and can show how you measured whether they worked. * You’ve integrated with messy third\-party systems and know how to work around rate limits, partial data, and undocumented behavior. * You write clearly and want to work side by side with the nontechnical operators who will use what you build. * You’re ambitious, you move fast, and you want ownership of something real. **Preferred** * Startup experience, especially as an early or founding engineer. * A background in proptech, fintech, or vertical SaaS. * Familiarity with AppFolio, Yardi, Buildium, or similar platforms. * Experience with multi\-tenant B2B SaaS and SOC 2\. * A degree in computer science or computer engineering. **Compensation and Benefits** * Base salary of $225,000 to $250,000 per year. * Milestone bonuses tied to product delivery and revenue. * Long\-term upside tied to the venture’s success. * Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off. * Company laptop and a monthly budget for AI and software tools. **Location** San Francisco, hybrid. You’ll work from our office at least 3 days a week. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Founding Robotics Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About Somm** ============== Somm is building the robot learning operating system that makes it possible for any business to put robots to work. We turn real\-world jobs into robotic capabilities, from understanding the work and deploying robots to helping them learn and improve on the job. Our ambition is to make deploying a robot as natural as hiring for a role: identify the work, get started and keep improving performance. We’re building for the messy, unpredictable reality of businesses where robots need to do useful work, not just impressive demos. Our founding team brings experience from Dyna, Physical Intelligence, Instacart and Twitter, and includes former Highstock founders. Every role at Somm is a founding role. You’ll help build your function, shape how we work and make decisions that define the company. We’re looking for people who care deeply about customers and take ownership beyond their job description to make robots useful in the real world, without compromising safety or quality. **The role** ============ Turn progress in robot learning into progress on a customer’s actual job. As a founding research engineer, you’ll build the training and evaluation loop across robot data, vision\-language\-action models, fine\-tuning and on\-robot experiments. You’ll help set the research agenda, test ideas on hardware and use failures to decide what to try next. The goal is not just a better benchmark result, but more reliable capabilities in the situations businesses encounter. **What you’ll do** ================== * Adapt and fine\-tune robot policies, including VLA models, for specific tasks and robot embodiments. * Build reproducible training, inference and evaluation workflows, with clear dataset and model versioning. * Study data quality, task coverage, recovery examples and intervention data to identify what improves policy performance. * Design on\-robot experiments and analyze failures across perception, action representation, control, task variation and distribution shift. * Work with controls engineers to integrate policy outputs with safe, reliable robot execution. * Develop evaluation suites that measure task success, intervention burden, throughput and regressions before deployment. * Translate current robot learning research into practical experiments and help shape the early research roadmap. **What you’ll bring** ===================== * Strong practical experience in robot learning, embodied AI or closely related machine learning, including training and evaluating models. * Working familiarity with VLA architectures, imitation learning, multimodal models and the challenges of deploying policies on physical robots. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with experience debugging training, inference and data pipelines. * Understanding of robot observations/actions, coordinate frames, temporal alignment and how hardware/control choices affect learning. * Ability to design rigorous experiments, distinguish model issues from data or system issues and communicate results clearly. * Evidence of substantial technical work through deployed systems, research projects, publications, open\-source contributions or equivalent experience; a PhD is not required. **Nice to have** ================ * Hands\-on robot policy deployment, cross\-embodiment adaptation or manipulation research. * Distributed training, GPU profiling, efficient inference or large\-scale multimodal datasets. * Intervention\-based learning, recovery data, reinforcement learning or evaluation under distribution shift. **What success looks like** =========================== * Reproducible task\-specific training and evaluation baselines. * Measured improvements in robot performance with regression checks. * A clear connection between collection priorities, model experiments and deployment outcomes. **Why join Somm** ================= * Meaningful early\-stage equity and the opportunity to help shape the company from the beginning. * Full benefits, including healthcare and lunch. * Close collaboration with the founding team and direct ownership of work that matters. This role is based in person in San Francisco. We value evidence of ability, sound judgment and curiosity. If your experience is nontraditional but you can show relevant work, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Founding Senior Product Engineer (React Native, Full-Stack & AI-Native Development)
jobs.description: **Compensation:** Equity\-Based (Founding\-level equity stake with milestone\-based transition to cash salary upon funding) **Company Description** MoneyKeel is a growing fintech company focused on building intuitive, zero\-knowledge, and scalable financial solutions for everyday users. The team values thoughtful product design, robust engineering practices, and a collaborative approach to solving complex problems in personal wealth management. MoneyKeel emphasizes user\-centric development, leveraging data and research to create products that are easy to use and reliable. Team members are encouraged to take true ownership of their work, experiment with new ideas, and shape the company's long\-term product and technical vision. **Role Description** As our Founding Senior Product Engineer, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of designing, stabilizing, and scaling MoneyKeel's mobile and backend product experiences—from early prototyping to production\-quality deployment. Collaborating directly with product leadership, you will craft refined user interfaces, architect resilient backend services, and champion AI\-native development workflows across our engineering lifecycle. Our execution follows a two\-phase roadmap: * **Phase 1 (Launch \& Stabilization):** Harden and ship our v1 iOS app built on React Native (Expo/TypeScript) and encrypted Firebase—decoupling monolithic stores in our 111k\+ line codebase, integrating subscription billing (RevenueCat), and enforcing automated security guardrails. * **Phase 2 (Scale \& Architecture Evolution):** Lead the technical evolution toward a high\-scale, enterprise\-grade production architecture (migrating to hardened backend APIs, relational ledgers, and multi\-tenant data models). **Key Responsibilities** * **End\-to\-End Product Engineering \& UI Craft:** Translate user needs into clear, pixel\-accurate mobile interfaces, balancing strong UX sensibility with clean, maintainable TypeScript. * **AI\-Native Engineering \& Agent Workflows:** Leverage AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) alongside custom agent skills, prompt guardrails (CLAUDE.md), and automated test loops to accelerate feature velocity without introducing regressions. * **Phase 1 Stabilization \& Phase 2 Scaling:** Refactor tightly coupled state into modular slices for immediate App Store launch, then architect our next\-generation backend infrastructure. * **R\&D \& Data\-Driven Iteration:** Prototype new wealth and cash\-flow features, validate concepts with early users, and maintain high standards in automated testing (Jest, Maestro) and security. **Qualifications** * Strong product engineering background with hands\-on experience in full\-stack mobile development (React Native, Expo, TypeScript) and end\-to\-end product delivery. * Proven experience developing production software using AI coding agents and structured agent skills/workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, automated PR review bots, and TDD agent loops). * Demonstrated expertise in product design and UX, with the ability to translate complex financial data into calm, intuitive interfaces. * Familiarity with cloud services (Firebase, AWS/GCP), secure APIs, databases (Firestore, PostgreSQL), and CI/CD pipelines. * Entrepreneurial mindset comfortable with early\-stage ownership, rapid R\&D prototyping, and equity\-driven upside. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; fintech or consumer wealth experience is a strong plus. Pay: From $250,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer for Client-Facing SaaS Projects
jobs.description: We’re looking for a full\-stack developer who is comfortable building software and communicating directly with clients. jobs.title: Product Designer II, I/O
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance. Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform. ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls. We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2\.3 billion valuation joined by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others. **The Design Team at Valon** ---------------------------- Valon's Design team is a tight\-knit and ambitious team. We are a user\-centered design team that creates meaningful, intuitive experiences and sets the industry bar. Today, our core products include a mortgage servicing platform that empowers our servicing agents and a homeowner console that makes managing everything mortgage\-related easy. We are at the stage where you can help shape the core experiences of the homeowners we serve and the teams who serve them. Sitting inside the product organization, you will work closely with world\-class cross\-functional teams to build products that deliver value to homeowners, servicing agents, and mortgage lenders. A portfolio is required for consideration. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Product Designer to join our I/O team. I/O owns how loans move in and out of Valon: onboarding loans onto our servicing platform and offboarding them to the next servicer. It covers data intake, mapping, validation, conflict resolution, transfer arrangements, and the document packages and borrower letters that go with them. Every loan Valon services passes through this work, so the experience has to be accurate, reliable, and fast, often across thousands of loans at a time. Your users are mostly operations teams and specialists who manage transfers and boarding day to day, both at Valon and at the servicers we work with. You will design the I/O Console and the surrounding tools so they can ingest messy data, spot and fix problems early, and track a transfer from start to finish with confidence. As we bring in more automation and AI\-assisted data parsing, you will help decide how that work is surfaced, reviewed, and trusted. The work is data and detail\-heavy. Transfers involve edge cases, strict timelines, and many handoffs between systems and parties. You will need to be comfortable with ambiguity, and you will work closely with product, engineering, and operations to turn that complexity into clear, simple workflows. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design end\-to\-end experiences for loan onboarding and offboarding, from research and prototyping through testing and delivery. * Build expertise in how loans are boarded and transferred, and switch context quickly across workstreams in a fast, iterative environment. * Design batch\-oriented, data\-dense workflows in the I/O Console (intake, validation, conflict resolution, offboarding batches) that make high\-volume work fast and hard to get wrong. * Create user journeys, wireframes, and high\-fidelity designs that explain your solutions clearly and support business goals. * Partner with product managers, engineers, operations, and client\-facing teams to make sure designs are feasible, scalable, and accurate. * Design clear states, errors, and status tracking for long\-running, multi\-step processes that span many loans and parties. * Advocate for users at every stage of product development. * Work within and help evolve our design system, keeping the visual language and experience consistent across products and platforms. * Share your work early and often, and give and receive feedback with the rest of the Design team. **What This Role Means at Valon** --------------------------------- * **Intuitive flows despite complexity.** You create clear experiences even with complicated edge cases, tight timelines, and technical constraints. * **Ownership.** You take projects from problem to shipped design with growing independence, flag risks early, and know when to cut scope. * **Domain depth.** You learn the loan boarding and transfer process well enough to challenge assumptions and improve it. * **Collaboration.** You work easily with product, engineering, and operations partners, and you speak up when you are blocked. * **Systems thinking.** You look past the single screen and consider how a pattern could be reused across I/O and the rest of the platform. **Qualities We Value On the Design Team** ----------------------------------------- * User empathy and advocacy. * Strong communication and collaboration. * Critical thinkers and thought partners. * A humble, growth\-oriented mindset. * Caring about the big picture as much as the pixel\-perfect work. * Excitement about working in a startup environment. **Ideal Background** -------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in user\-centered product design * A solid portfolio * Experience designing digital products * Experience designing data\-dense, workflow\-heavy, or operational tools, such as enterprise or internal software * Ability to balance methodological rigor with scrappiness and creativity * Excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience with the following is not required but is a big plus: * Startup experience * Familiarity with the mortgage landscape, loan transfers, or other financial systems * Experience designing bulk actions, import or data\-validation flows, or status tracking for long\-running processes * Experience designing for AI\-assisted workflows **Benefits** ------------ * **Compensation:** competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401(k) plan. The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of experience and interview performance. * **Health \& well\-being:** we’ll invest in your physical and mental well\-being with comprehensive medical, dental, \& vision benefits. * **Free Food:** daily lunch, and dinner provided through Forkable for in\-office team members. * **Commuter benefits:** pre\-tax deductions for public transit, rideshares, and parking to simplify your daily commute. * **Grow together:** company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning \& development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360\-degree feedback. * **Play together:** quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners. * **Generous time off:** flexible paid time off with no annual limit, sick days, and 11 company holidays. * **Baby bonding time:** 12 weeks of fully paid leave for both birthing and non\-birthing parents, so you can spend uninterrupted time welcoming and caring for your newest family member. *Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from* *valon.com* *email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.* *Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Valon makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.* Compensation Range: $168K \- $197\.5K

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer & Product Owner
jobs.description: **Senior AI Engineer \& Product Lead** BroadPeak Investment Group is a private equity and family office firm headquartered in Atlanta building AI\-native platforms across its portfolio — property management, franchise operations, sports and entertainment, and more. We are hiring a Senior AI Engineer and Product Lead to own the design, development, and delivery of these systems from the ground up. This is not a maintenance role. You will be the architect and the builder. You will work directly with the CEO and division leadership to understand what the business needs, translate that into product, and ship it. A junior engineer will support you as your first hire under this role. We use the best tools available. We expect you to know what those tools are, stay ahead of what's coming, and make decisions accordingly. **What you will own:** You are building a property management platform as the first project — a full web application covering tenant management, lease tracking, vendor workflows, maintenance operations, financial reporting, and a public\-facing website with AI\-powered leasing inquiry. Claude AI is embedded throughout as an operational layer: answering inquiries, drafting communications, analyzing financial performance, handling inbound calls via voice AI, and serving each team member as a role\-specific assistant. After Properties, you will replicate and adapt this model across other BroadPeak divisions. * Architect and build full\-stack web applications with clean, scalable, maintainable code * Integrate Claude API and other LLM tools deeply into product workflows — not as a chatbot bolted on, but as a core operating layer * Design the AI behavior — prompts, workflows, guardrails, and output quality — so the system performs like a knowledgeable operator * Manage third\-party integrations including voice AI (Vapi/Bland.ai), payment processing (Stripe), document management, and financial data * Own the product roadmap, translate business requirements into specifications, and communicate clearly with non\-technical stakeholders * Lead and mentor the junior engineer on your team * Evaluate and adopt new tools continuously — if there is a better way to build something, you find it and use it **What we are looking for:** * You have 5 or more years of experience building and shipping production web applications, not prototypes. * You are equally comfortable designing a database schema, writing backend logic, building a clean frontend, and designing the AI workflows that connect everything. * You have shipped something real using Claude, OpenAI, or a comparable LLM API and can walk us through what you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. * You are current. You know what tools exist right now — Cursor, v0, Windsurf, Claude Code, or whatever has emerged since — and you use them to move faster without cutting corners. * You have opinions about the right stack for a given problem and can defend them. * You can sit across from a CEO who does not write code, explain what you are building, take business input, and push back when a requirement does not make sense. **Technical Requirements:** * Full\-stack proficiency — Python or Node.js backend, React or similar frontend * Database design and management — PostgreSQL preferred * LLM API integration in production — Anthropic Claude strongly preferred; include examples in your application * Cloud deployment and infrastructure — AWS or Vercel * Voice AI platform experience — Vapi, Bland.ai, or equivalent (strong plus) * Multi\-tenant application architecture — role\-based access, permissioning, security * API integrations — Stripe, DocuSign, or similar third\-party services * Proficiency with AI\-assisted development environments: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent **What this is not:** * This is not a corporate IT role. There is no existing system to maintain and no committee to approve your stack choices. * You will make decisions and own them. If you need a large team around you to do your best work, this is not the right fit. *We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer. Applicants for employment are considered without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer / Data Scientist / AIML Architect @ USA Remote

jobs.title: Senior Controls & SCADA Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Controls SCADA Engineer** **Company Overview** LG Energy Solution Vertech, Inc., a subsidiary of LG Energy Solution, is a leading provider of grid\-scale integrated energy storage systems, delivering safe, reliable, and high\-performance solutions to customers worldwide. Powered by our proprietary AEROS® energy operating system, we use advanced monitoring and controls to help customers optimize system performance and maximize the value of their energy storage assets. At LGES Vertech, you’ll be part of a collaborative, team\-oriented organization that aspires to be humble, hungry, and smart, working together to transform the energy landscape and create a more sustainable future. We value innovation, accountability, and growth, and offer competitive compensation along with comprehensive benefits, including 100% employer\-paid premiums for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. For more information about LGESVT, please visit www.lgensol\-vt.com. **Position Overview** We are seeking a Senior Controls SCADA Engineer with strong skills in design and development of Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Systems using industry\-grade programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and Data Acquisition Systems. In this role, you will be a key member in architecting, developing, and deploying a Power Plant Controller for Artificial Intelligence and Data Center (AIDC) applications. This role is pivotal in delivering industry\-grade, highly efficient, and customizable solutions for LG’s energy storage systems. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy power plant controller logic implemented in PLCs for controlling multiple generation resources (BESS, generators, PVs) feeding AIDC loads in grid\-connected and islanded operations * PLC\-based control system design using IEC 61131\-2\. * Interface with protection relays and switchgear for starting and operating the AIDC power plant. * Determine and implement SCADA cybersecurity measures in cooperation applications using Inductive Automation’s Ignition platform. * Perform system commissioning, testing, and validation. * Maintain excellent documentation capturing controller designs, project timelines, and presentations for stakeholder communication. * Interface with program management, project management, and project engineers to help deliver controls functionality and performance according to the project specifications. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering * 5 to 8 years of hands\-on industrial or utility controls experience * Strong experience with PLC programming (structured text, ladder logic) in power plant control or industrial automation * Demonstrated history of delivering quality products to market with understanding and respect for all phases of the product development process, especially requirements, specification development, and release control * Strong knowledge of industrial networking protocols (OPC UA, DNP3, Modbus, Goose) and database integration (SQL). * Experience configuring and controlling protection relays and switchgears * Experience with Ignition SCADA (Vision and/or Perspective modules) or similar platforms. * Knowledge of cybersecurity best practice in industrial environments. * Experience with single\-line diagrams, switchgear, and protection relays * Excellent Schweitzer RTAC devices * Experience using medium voltage equipment such as inverters and transformers. **Travel** Occasional travel may be required. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $180K – $250K **Senior Software Engineer, Packaging** Reports to: VP of Engineering **ABOUT FLOX** ============== Flox builds developer tools that help teams manage software environments securely and reproducibly. Powered by Nix, our platform brings together command\-line tools, cloud services, and build infrastructure for engineers who care about how software gets made. We’re also working on Secure Packages and an AI Release Engineer. **THE ROLE** ============ Secure Packages keeps a large set of open source packages current, patched, and built reproducibly, and delivers them to customers. Behind it is a distributed build system: a pipeline that watches upstream releases, updates packages, builds and tests them across many execution environments, and publishes the results. We’re looking for an engineer who knows how software gets packaged. You’ve maintained packages for an operating system or a language ecosystem, and you have good instincts about what a correct package and a sound fix look like. You’ll build and run the system that does this at scale, and when builds break, you’ll be the one who figures out why and fixes it. Much of the routine update work is automated, including with AI agents. Your packaging judgment is what tells a good change from one that only looks right. **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================= * Keep packages building, current, and patched: diagnose build failures, dependency conflicts, and regressions, and fix them properly. * Build and improve the pipeline that detects upstream releases, updates packages, tests them, and publishes them. * Operate and scale the distributed build infrastructure behind it, and share on\-call for the services you build. * Maintain our downstream package set on top of a fast\-moving upstream, including carrying, upstreaming, and retiring changes. * Review automated and AI\-generated package changes and improve the tooling that produces them. * Work with product, infrastructure, and security engineers on scope, architecture, and delivery. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** ========================== * Hands\-on packaging experience with OS package managers (RPM, deb, apk, Nix, or similar) and language ecosystems (npm, Cargo, PyPI, Go modules, or similar). * Working knowledge of build systems such as CMake, Autotools, Meson, or Bazel, and how to debug them. * Experience building or operating distributed build systems: build farms, remote builders, binary caches, or CI at scale. * Solid software engineering: you can design, build, and ship production services and pipelines. Our backend is Python. * Strong Linux fundamentals. * An understanding of how security vulnerabilities relate to packages and versions, and what it takes to ship a fix. * Clear communication and sound judgment about tradeoffs. **STRONG SIGNALS** ================== * Nix packaging experience: contributing to Nixpkgs and understanding how changes move through staging and channels. * Upstream maintainer or distribution work, for example at Red Hat, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu, Alpine, or Wolfi. * Experience with distribution build systems such as Koji, Open Build Service, Launchpad, or Hydra, or with self\-hosted CI and remote execution (GitHub Actions runners, Buildkite, Bazel). * Experience backporting security fixes. * Familiarity with vulnerability and supply\-chain data such as CVEs, OSV, VEX, SBOMs (SPDX, CycloneDX), or signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA). We don’t expect all of these. * Experience with workflow orchestration such as Temporal. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K
