jobs.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer, Data & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the role** Keebler Health builds AI\-driven risk adjustment and hospitalization\-prevention products for healthcare organizations. Over the next few quarters we’re tripling the volume of clinical data we manage, and the systems that got us here won’t get us there. We’re looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to own the scaling of our data and AI infrastructure: storage, retrieval, model throughput, and the compute and network underneath it. This isn’t a greenfield role. You’ll work on real systems under real load in a HIPAA\-regulated AWS environment, alongside a small, senior team. This is a US\-based remote position. We have a strong preference for candidates based in North Carolina or New York, where our team hubs are. **What you’ll build** We’re tripling the clinical data we manage over the next few quarters. You’ll work on the data and AI platform that makes that growth routine rather than heroic, working in a HIPAA\-regulated AWS environment alongside a small, senior team. * **A retrieval layer that scales with the data.** Our embedding store is 8TB today and heading toward \~25TB. You’ll decide how semantic search is built for that scale: index strategy, quantization, partitioning, tiering, or a different storage engine entirely. You’ll set the latency and recall targets and the cost model behind them. * **A model gateway for every LLM workload.** Today, high\-volume workloads can run into provider rate limits. You’ll design the shared layer that all model traffic goes through: queueing and backpressure, batching, caching, prioritization, and routing across providers and models. The goal is that product teams never think about quotas. * **Network and cluster foundations that scale with us.** You’ll evolve the AWS networking and compute foundations behind our data and AI workloads, partnering with our DevOps engineer to anticipate capacity limits and address bottlenecks before they affect delivery. That could mean improving network addressing, cluster capacity, or resource utilization. * **A data architecture that separates workloads by design.** Bulk ingestion, transactional traffic, and analytics currently share Aurora. You’ll define how each should be served, whether through staging pipelines, replicas, CDC into a warehouse or lakehouse, or something else, so that ingestion volume can grow without touching application performance. * **A self\-hosted inference platform**. We already serve OCR models on vLLM and are expanding into open\-weight LLMs. You’ll build the platform around them: benchmarking and model selection, GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, throughput tuning, and a clear framework for which workloads belong on self\-hosted models versus commercial APIs. **Experience that’s relevant** You don’t need to have solved these exact problems before. We care about adjacent experience and sound judgment about tradeoffs. Strong candidates will have several of the following: * **Large\-scale search or retrieval systems.** This could be vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch k\-NN, Pinecone, Turbopuffer, Milvus), but classic search infrastructure (Elasticsearch/Lucene), recommender candidate retrieval, or any work tuning latency on large indexes is directly applicable. You should understand the tradeoffs between ANN index types, memory footprint, recall, and cost. * **High\-throughput systems built on quota\-limited dependencies.** Work in payments, ad\-tech, data integrations, or anywhere you’ve had to push large volumes through third\-party APIs with hard limits. You know how to use token buckets, priority queues, idempotent retries, and graceful degradation. * **Postgres at scale.** Deep experience with query planning, partitioning, bulk ingestion (COPY, staging tables, batching), connection management, and replica strategy. Aurora\-specific experience is a plus. Experience separating OLTP from analytical workloads (CDC into a warehouse or lakehouse, for example) is especially valuable. * **AWS networking and Kubernetes.** You’re comfortable with VPC design, subnet planning, and EKS networking (VPC CNI behavior, prefix delegation, secondary CIDRs, IPv6\), or you have the equivalent depth on another major cloud. * **Capacity planning and cost modeling.** You can project how a system behaves at 3x, identify which components scale nonlinearly, and make a cost\-aware case for when to optimize and when to re\-architect. * **Observability.** You instrument before you optimize, and you’re comfortable with metrics, tracing, and profiling across application and database layers. * **Production model inference.** Experience serving models on GPUs in production, whether that’s LLMs on vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or TensorRT\-LLM, or earlier\-generation serving on Triton or TorchServe. You should understand the levers that matter for throughput and cost, including continuous batching, KV cache memory, quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, FP8\), tensor parallelism, and GPU instance selection. Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes (node pools, the NVIDIA device plugin, Karpenter or a similar autoscaler) is especially relevant. **Nice to have** * Experience in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar), including working under BAAs and data\-residency constraints * Familiarity with LLM application infrastructure: embedding pipelines, multi\-provider routing, Bedrock or OpenAI, batch inference APIs * Startup experience, where you were the person who both made the architectural decision and shipped it * Python and/or TypeScript fluency, plus infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CDK, Pulumi) **What success looks like in the first six months** Semantic search latency is well within product requirements at current volume, with a credible path to 3x. Model throughput is no longer a recurring incident category. Nightly loads complete without database alarms. The team has a capacity plan it trusts. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, equity options, and benefits package. * A fast\-paced, innovative environment. * Professional growth and development opportunities. * A collaborative and supportive team culture. * The chance to make a meaningful impact on the healthcare industry. Compensation Range: $190K \- $260K

jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Job Description** **Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. The Observability \& Insights group ensures that Disney Streaming’s distributed systems are reliable, performant, and transparent. We build the telemetry, dashboards, alerting, insights pipelines, and developer experience tooling that enable engineers across the organization to understand system health and take action quickly. **Job Summary:** As a Senior Software Engineer (P3\), you will lead the design and implementation of intelligent, AI\-driven systems that safeguard the reliability and performance of Disney’s global streaming ecosystem. You will be a technical leader in developing agentic systems, complex machine learning models, and high\-throughput real\-time pipelines that transform massive telemetry and log datasets into automated detection, root cause analysis, and proactive insights. In this role, you will own the architectural vision for autonomous agents capable of reasoning over complex system behaviors across Disney\+, Hulu, and ESPN. You will act as a bridge between engineering, product, and platform teams, translating high\-level business needs into scalable AI solutions that reduce operational overhead. As a P3 engineer, you are expected to deliver mission\-critical features, mentor junior engineers, and drive engineering excellence through rigorous design reviews and high\-quality, production\-ready code in a fast\-paced, AI\-native environment. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:** * Own the design and operation of production\-grade, intelligent systems leveraging real\-time signals and AI\-driven detection to ensure the health of critical services and premium customer experiences. * Lead the development of agentic AI systems powered by modern foundation models (e.g., Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT\-4\). You will define the strategy for automated reasoning, decisioning, and predictive modeling for global\-scale system reliability. * Oversee the creation of end\-to\-end data pipelines that process high\-volume telemetry and user signals into actionable, automated insights and root cause analysis. * Design and maintain scalable APIs and microservices that provide explainability and predictive signals to cross\-functional engineering and product stakeholders. * Partner with leadership and cross\-functional teams to embed intelligence into global workflows (incident response, release validation), significantly reducing Time\-to\-Detect (TTD) and Time\-to\-Resolve (TTR). * Promote engineering best practices, provide technical guidance through code and design reviews, and drive innovation in observability and developer productivity through applied AI. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of applicable experience in backend development, with a proven track record of building and scaling AI\-powered or data\-driven applications. * Advanced proficiency with modern models (GPT\-4/o1, Claude Opus/Sonnet, Bedrock), including deep experience in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and building complex agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. * Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience deploying and monitoring ML systems (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and large\-scale data processing (PySpark, Pandas) in production environments. * Strong experience with AWS ecosystem and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) at scale. * Proven ability to lead technical projects, mentor junior talent, and champion software development best practices (Git, CI/CD, Agile). * Expert level use of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to accelerate team velocity and maintain high code quality. * Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and explain complex AI/technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing observability and monitoring systems for high\-volume, low\-latency production environments. * Experience with modern databases and observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, Conviva, MongoDB) handling billions of events. * Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design patterns. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY Job Posting Statement The hiring range for this position in New York City, NY is $148,700 \- $199,400 per year, and in Glendale, CA is $141,900 \- $190,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs. We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

jobs.title: Sr Systems Engineer, Information Technology
jobs.description: **Location:** Allston, MA and Woburn, MA **About Terrestrial Bio, Inc.** Terrestrial is transforming the delivery of next\-generation therapies, starting with GLP\-1\. Terrestrial’s proprietary Tacterra microarray patch (MAP) and applicator platform consists of a patch resembling an adhesive bandage, which is applied with a preloaded applicator and removed after a few minutes. Once applied, each patch delivers bioactive tips into the skin, which dissolve quickly into the body, rapidly releasing their therapeutic payload. Designed for self\-administration, the temperature\-stable Tacterra platform enables precise, controlled delivery of a wide range of therapeutics without medical sharps or refrigeration. Terrestrial has generated strong clinical and in\-vivo proof of concept across multiple molecules. For more information, visit www.terrestrialbio.com. **Why this role** Terrestrial is growing quickly, and the technology behind our science needs to scale with it. As Senior Systems Engineer, Cloud \& Identity, you’ll be the senior hands\-on technical owner of our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, public cloud (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud), endpoint, SaaS and infrastructure environment, reporting to the Senior Director, Information Technology. Your signature project is an identity architecture in which HR data automatically drives account creation, access and offboarding across our business and scientific applications. On a lean team, you’ll own work from design and build through documentation and support, and the results will be felt by every scientist, engineer and leader at Terrestrial. **What you’ll do** * Run and continuously improve Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Intune: users, groups, admin roles, licensing and access policies. * Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including subscriptions, accounts and projects, virtual networking, compute, storage, IAM, monitoring, and security and cost governance, using infrastructure as code where it fits. * Own identity and access management: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access and role\-based access across Microsoft 365 and our cloud platforms, with integrations built on SAML 2\.0, SCIM 2\.0, OpenID Connect and OAuth 2\.0\. * Build automated joiner, mover and leaver processes that connect our HR system to Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and downstream applications. * Administer and integrate our SaaS portfolio (DocuSign, Adobe, Zoom, HR platforms, ELN/LIMS, lab and quality systems), and evaluate new applications for security, supportability and identity integration. * Automate routine administration with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions, with monitoring, error handling and source control built in. * Manage Windows and macOS endpoints as well as office and lab networking, wireless, firewalls and VPN. * Serve as the senior escalation point for complex issues while supporting executives, scientists, lab personnel and administrative teams directly. This is a hands\-on role: you might build an Entra/SCIM integration one day and troubleshoot a laptop the next. * Partner with the Senior Director on cybersecurity, audits and compliance, and with Quality on infrastructure and identity controls for GxP and other regulated systems. * Keep diagrams, runbooks, SOPs and configuration records current so our IT processes scale. * Provide technical direction to consultants, vendors and MSP resources, and help shape the IT team as it grows. **How you’ll impact** In your first 12–18 months, success looks like: * Operational ownership of core Microsoft 365, Entra, endpoint, SaaS and infrastructure services, with fewer routine escalations reaching the Senior Director. * A secure, well\-governed public cloud foundation with consistent identity, networking, logging and cost controls. * Onboarding, role changes and offboarding that are standardized and automated end to end. * An identity architecture moving toward HRIS Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft 365, business and scientific applications, with SSO and automated provisioning across far more of our application portfolio. * Stronger security across identity, endpoints, infrastructure and applications, and better endpoint deployment, inventory and lifecycle management. * Documentation and operational standards that let IT scale with Terrestrial’s clinical, scientific, manufacturing and organizational growth. You’ll bring deep, practical expertise in Microsoft cloud identity and automation to a company where getting access and systems right directly supports research and regulated work. **Who you are** ***Required*** * BS degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience and 7\+ years of progressively responsible experience in systems engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems administration or enterprise IT. * Strong hands\-on Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, including Enterprise Applications, authentication, SSO and access management. * Hands\-on experience engineering and operating cloud infrastructure in at least one major platform (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud), including virtual networking, compute, storage, IAM and security configuration. * Practical experience implementing and troubleshooting SAML\-based SSO, with working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect. * Strong PowerShell skills and experience with Microsoft Graph, REST APIs or similar integration technologies. * Microsoft Intune or comparable modern endpoint management, strong Windows administration and practical macOS support. * Solid networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, wireless, VPN and firewalls. * A track record of independently owning projects and operational issues from identification through resolution, including root\-cause analysis and clear written documentation. ***Preferred*** * Familiarity with, or previous experience working in, a GxP\-validated environment, such as supporting validated systems under change control, contributing to computer system validation (CSV/CSA) documentation, and applying data integrity and 21 CFR Part 11 principles. * SCIM\-based provisioning and HRIS\-to\-identity integration with ADP Workforce Now, BambooHR, Workday or a comparable platform. * Entra Lifecycle Workflows, Identity Governance, access reviews, entitlement management or Privileged Identity Management. * Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep/ARM, CloudFormation or similar, plus Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions and Git\-based source control. * Experience across more than one cloud platform, including federating AWS or Google Cloud access with Entra ID (e.g., AWS IAM Identity Center, Google Cloud Workforce Identity Federation) and organization\-level governance (Azure management groups and Policy, AWS Organizations, Google Cloud organization policies). * Apple Business Manager or enterprise macOS management. * Experience supporting Benchling or comparable scientific SaaS, and laboratory, manufacturing or quality environments. * Biotech, pharmaceutical, medical device or other regulated\-industry IT experience. * Microsoft certifications such as Identity and Access Administrator, Endpoint Administrator or Azure Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator, or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (valued, but not a substitute for hands\-on expertise). **Compensation:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $140,000 \- $160,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including experience, qualifications, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity and company benefits. **Onsite expectations:** The majority of our roles at Terrestrial are either onsite or hybrid, which allows us to meet both business and team needs. This is an onsite role, and candidates applying must be willing to be onsite 5 days per week. **Location:** Allston MA and Woburn MA At Terrestrial, we’re bringing together exceptional talent to drive our product development forward. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a dynamic work environment. We aim to recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Staff Compiler Engineer, CPU & ML Accelerators
jobs.description: Ricursive Intelligence is a frontier AI lab building self\-improving systems, starting with chip design. We are reinventing chip development and closing the loop between AI and the hardware that fuels it, recursively accelerating the path to artificial superintelligence. Backed by $335M from Sequoia, Lightspeed, DST, and NVIDIA Ventures, we are a growing, fast\-paced team where every hire shapes the work. The company has unmatched talent density, including IMO, IPhO, and IOAA gold medalists, pioneers who made prior breakthroughs in chip design: AlphaChip (Nature 2021\), ePlace (DAC Best Paper Nominee 2014\), RL\-CCD (DAC Best Paper 2023\), INSTA (DAC Best Paper 2025\), and C3PO (ASP\-DAC Best Paper 2026\), chip leads for Apple Silicon (multiple generations of iPhone and iPad) and Google (TPU, OpenTitan), and top researchers and engineers from Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Stanford, and MIT. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Every chip Ricursive designs is only as good as the software that targets it. The compiler is where architecture meets workload: it turns new vector units, matrix engines, and custom instructions into real speedups on real programs and ML models. We need a toolchain that keeps pace with an AI\-driven hardware design loop, one that can test proposed architecture features against real code within days and feed what it learns back into the chip. You will own the compiler toolchain for our CPU and accelerator cores end to end: backend code generation, support for new instructions, lowering ML models to hardware, and performance. As a Staff engineer you will set technical direction, make the key architectural calls, and raise the engineering bar for the team. This is a small and early team, so the methodology and infrastructure are still being defined. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Own the design and implementation of the compiler backend for our CPU and accelerator cores, including instruction selection, scheduling, register allocation, and target\-specific optimization. * Add support for standard and custom instruction set extensions (vector, matrix, bit\-manipulation, and domain\-specific) across the compiler, assembler, linker, intrinsics, and binutils. * Build the path from ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX) through MLIR to our hardware, covering dialects, tiling, data layout, vectorization, and kernel generation. * Lead hardware/software co\-design: evaluate proposed ISA and microarchitecture features by compiling real workloads against simulators and performance models, and report quantitative results to the architecture team. * Own performance and correctness infrastructure: benchmark suites, differential testing, fuzzing, and CI against simulators, FPGA, and silicon. * Apply ML to the compiler itself through learned cost models, autotuning, and ML\-guided optimization heuristics. * Set the technical roadmap for the compiler effort, mentor engineers, and upstream work to the open\-source projects we build on. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * 8\+ years of compiler development, including substantial hands\-on backend and code generation work for a CPU or accelerator target. * Expert C\+\+ and deep knowledge of LLVM (or GCC) internals. * A track record of shipping a production compiler toolchain for real hardware: new target bring\-up, support for new ISA extensions, or optimization work in a shipped compiler. * Experience leading multi\-quarter technical efforts across several engineers or teams. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * MS or PhD with a focus on compilers, programming languages, or computer architecture. * Experience with vector/SIMD ISAs, ML accelerators (TPUs, tensor cores, NPUs), or DSPs, and with open\-standard ISA ecosystems. * Hands\-on experience with MLIR, XLA, TVM, Triton, IREE, or torch.compile, and with kernel performance tuning. * Experience applying ML to compilers (e.g. MLGO, learned cost models, autotuning) or building ML systems. * Publications at PLDI, CGO, CC, ASPLOS, MICRO, ISCA, or MLSys. * Upstream contributions to, or code ownership in, LLVM, MLIR, GCC, or binutils. * Experience with architecture simulators (e.g. gem5\) and performance modeling. **Location** ------------ Palo Alto **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering

jobs.title: Technical Trainer - Agentic AI & Python Engineering (Contract)
jobs.description: **Role Summary** We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), or Staff Python Engineer to lead an intensive, 11\-week in\-person Associate FDE training cohort in New Jersey. This is a hands\-on, code\-first engineering program where trainees build every weekly deliverable from scratch with no starter repositories or pre\-built containers. **Engagement Details** * **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor (1099 or Corp\-to\-Corp) * **Duration:** 11 Weeks Full\-Time Onsite *(Open to splitting the contract into Weeks 1–3 Foundations and Weeks 4–11 Agentic AI for specialized instructors)* * **Location:** New Jersey (Onsite — exact facility location near major NJ transit finalizing shortly) **Curriculum \& Delivery Responsibilities** * **Weeks 1–3 (Software Engineering \& Python Crash Course):** Facilitate daily hands\-on labs covering SDLC, Git/PR workflows, GitLab CI, Python (.venv, pytest/TDD, pydantic, mypy), Docker, and AWS deployment (ECR \+ ECS/Fargate) through a cumulative Personal Finance Manager build. * **Weeks 4–5 (Agentic Dev Workflows \& LLM Fundamentals):** Teach Claude Code workflows (with Cursor comparison), parallel git worktrees, GitHub Actions, architectural separation of deterministic vs. non\-deterministic logic, and multi\-model API prompting (Claude, GPT, Gemini). * **Weeks 6–8 (RAG, MCP \& Multi\-Agent Orchestration):** Guide trainees in building an end\-to\-end RAG system from scratch (sentence\-transformers, chromadb, hybrid retrieval, reranking, evaluation harnesses, Amazon DynamoDB lineage), custom MCP servers using the Python SDK, ReAct/reflection agents, and a 4\-agent insurance underwriting pipeline with tracing and cost/latency budgeting. * **Weeks 9–11 (Cloud/On\-Prem Infrastructure, Capstone \& Guardrails):** Cover AWS IAM least privilege, VPCs, Amazon Bedrock, local open\-weight serving (Ollama/vLLM), reliability/SLOs, prompt injection defense, guardrails, and mentor 2–3 person pods through a Banking/Financial Services (BFS) \& Insurance capstone project. * **Weekly Cadence:** Conduct mandatory weekly 1:1 progress reviews with Associates and grade weekly from\-scratch lab rubrics and proctored assessments. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of production software engineering experience in Python, Git, Docker, and AWS (IAM, VPC, ECR, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB). * Hands\-on experience building production agentic AI systems, including tool calling, custom MCP servers, RAG pipelines with evaluation harnesses, and multi\-agent workflows. * Strong live\-coding ability and experience mentoring junior developers, leading engineering bootcamps, or delivering technical workshops. * Ability to work onsite in New Jersey Monday through Friday for the duration of the contract. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience delivering technical solutions in Banking, Financial Services (BFS), or Insurance environments. * Familiarity with Claude Code, Ollama, vLLM, and LLM observability/evaluation frameworks. Pay: $60\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: *7\-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7\-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.* 7\-Eleven is looking for a Platform Engineer to join the Enterprise Data Platform Engineering / DevOps team. At 7\-Eleven, Enterprise Data brings together large\-scale data from across the company. The Enterprise Data Platform team supports the tools, cloud services, and automation that help Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists build and run their work. This role helps keep those platforms reliable, secure, and easier for teams to use. **Responsibilities** -------------------- As part of the Platform Engineering team, you will help support cloud infrastructure and platform tools used by the Enterprise Data team. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** A2Z Sync runs the deal for dealership rooftops across the United States: digital retail, desking, F\&I, and in\-store operations on one platform. Every one of those transactions, and every integration with the DMS, CRM, and lender systems around it, produces data. Today that data runs on AWS, from dealer system integrations through an Athena semantic layer to the reports our teams and partners rely on every day. Now we are building A2Z 2\.0, an AI\-driven data and intelligence platform for dealers, on a new lakehouse. The agents and insights it delivers are only as good as the data underneath them: fresh, modeled, governed, and fast. That is the Data Engineer's job. You will architect, build, and operate the analytical data ecosystem that feeds reporting today and the intelligence platform tomorrow, with the reliability that a showroom floor demands. This is a builder's role on a small team. You will own pipelines end to end, from ingestion to the models analysts and agents query, and you will be in the room when the platform's data decisions get made. ### **Scope \& Scale** * Thousands of dealer tenants on the platform, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi\-protocol vendor connectivity (REST, SOAP, event\-driven). * An Athena semantic layer of 40\+ views feeding Power BI reports and the A2Z Insights self\-serve app, used by Product, Ops, Engineering, IT, Finance, and strategic partners. * A new dealer lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold on Iceberg) coming online for A2Z 2\.0, with Beta this fall and general availability early next year. * Production AI agents whose tools and context depend on the data you serve. ### **What You'll Own** * **Data workloads on AWS.** Architect, build, and operationalize pipelines and storage using Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and, where the workload calls for it, Timestream, Flink, and Kafka. * **The lakehouse.** Bronze, silver, and gold layers on Iceberg: table design, partitioning, compaction, and the storage\-format decisions (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC) that keep queries fast as data grows. * **Data models and access.** Models that analysts, reports, and agents can trust; secure data access APIs in Java and/or Python; real\-time streaming where the use case earns it. * **Pipeline reliability.** Monitoring, alerting, logging, and freshness and completeness checks, so breaks are caught before the Data and BI Analyst or a dealer sees them. * **Anomaly detection and data quality.** Statistical and ML\-based monitoring of data quality and integration call volumes, so a spike, drop, or silent failure surfaces early. * **Forecasting and predictive features.** Model development in Python (scikit\-learn, pandas, numpy) for forecasting and predictive analytics that feed A2Z 2\.0 insights. * **Governance and security.** SSL/TLS, client authentication, access auditing, and the controls that keep dealer data inside its tenant. * **Cross\-functional delivery.** Working with engineers, product managers, and the Data and BI Analyst to turn data requirements into scalable, secure, high\-quality solutions. ### **First 90 Days / First Year** **First 90 Days:** Learn the platform, the integration domains, and the semantic layer well enough to trace any reported number to its source. Take ownership of the pipelines feeding reporting and add freshness and completeness checks where they are missing. Ship your first production change to the lakehouse. Publish a point of view on the ingestion and modeling patterns A2Z 2\.0 should standardize on. **First Year:** The A2Z 2\.0 lakehouse is in production with bronze, silver, and gold layers you built or hardened, serving reports and agents at GA. Pipeline incidents are caught by your monitoring before users report them. At least one forecasting or anomaly\-detection model is live and used in the product or in operations. The patterns you set are the ones the next data engineer inherits. ### **Hands\-On Expectations** Roughly 70% building and operating (pipelines, models, APIs, monitoring), 20% design and architecture with the platform and AI teams, and 10% working with analysts and product on requirements and enablement. You write and ship code every week. ### **Tech \& Tools** * **Data platform:** Amazon Athena (Presto/Trino SQL), AWS Glue, S3, Apache Iceberg lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions. * **Streaming and time series:** Timestream, Flink, Kafka (where the workload calls for it). * **Languages and ML:** Python (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn), Java, SQL. * **Reliability and governance:** CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, freshness and completeness checks, SSL/TLS, access auditing. * **Downstream:** Power BI, Amazon Quick (under evaluation), A2Z Insights, AgentCore\-based agents. ### **How You'll Use AI** This is not a "we are AI\-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role: * Draft and test pipeline code, SQL, and data\-quality checks with Claude, then verify against known\-good numbers before anything ships. * Generate lineage and documentation from the models themselves so the map from source to report to agent stays current. * Summarize pipeline incidents into root\-cause notes and runbook entries the on\-call engineer can act on. * Build the data foundations the A2Z 2\.0 agents stand on: the tables, APIs, and context they query, held to the standard that the same question returns the same number. * Prototype forecasting and anomaly\-detection approaches faster, so you spend your time on evaluating them against dealer outcomes. **You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the Data Engineer who builds the data the AI runs on.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering * **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * Extensive experience architecting, building, and operationalizing data workloads on AWS (Athena, Glue, S3, DynamoDB; Timestream, Flink, or Kafka a plus). * Deep understanding of high\-performance analytical data platforms, distributed systems, and modern data file formats (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC). * Expertise building services and APIs on top of data platforms in Java and/or Python. * Strong background in data modeling, data access API design, and production monitoring and alerting. * Python for analytics and ML (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn), including anomaly detection with statistical or ML methods. * Clear writing: pipeline documentation, data definitions, and incident summaries that engineers and business users both understand. * Problem\-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement in a fast\-paced, small\-team environment. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Lakehouse experience with Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi) and medallion\-style layering. * Real\-time streaming in production (Flink, Kafka, Kinesis). * Experience serving data to LLM agents or AI features: tool\-facing APIs, retrieval, feature stores. * Multi\-tenant SaaS data architecture: tenant isolation, row\-level security, per\-tenant configuration. ### **Nice to Have** * Automotive retail, fintech, or dealer\-tech experience, including DMS or CRM data. * Power BI or Amazon Quick semantic modeling, or dbt\-style transformation workflows. * Infrastructure as code (CDK or CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data pipelines. **Benefits** We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well\-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family. **Here's what we offer:** * **Base Salary:** $160,000 – $175,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant. * **Employer\-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one. * **Flexible Work:** Denver hybrid (2 days/week in office) or fully remote anywhere in the US. * **401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match:** Build your future with our competitive matching program. * **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):** Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays. * **Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage:** Fully employer\-paid. * **Life and AD\&D Insurance:** Employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. * **Free Mental Health Support:** Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp. * **Pet Insurance Options:** Affordable plans for your furry family members. * **Identity Theft Protection:** Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information. * **Other Cool Stuff:** On\-site gym in Denver, great co\-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, AI/ML
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** We operate a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions. That platform works. Now we are making it think: production agentic AI systems built code\-first and deployed on AWS Bedrock AgentCore, connected to real systems, making decisions and executing workflows against real dealer data and real money. This is a hands\-on builder role. Expect the large majority of your time in code. But we are not hiring a pair of hands. Every agent you ship makes decisions that touch dealer revenue, so we need an engineer who understands the business problem before writing the technical solution: someone who asks what a workflow is worth, weighs build cost against dealer impact, and knows when the right answer is a simpler tool, or no agent at all. ### **Scope \& Scale** * 5,000\+ destination dealer tenants, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * Agent workflows that touch production transaction data: real dealer money, not a sandbox. * Tens of thousands of API requests across REST, SOAP, and event\-driven integration surfaces that your agents' tools will call into. * A growing portfolio of production agents, each with its own cost, latency, and evaluation budget. ### **What You'll Own** * **Production agents on AgentCore.** Agent logic, tool orchestration, and multi\-agent workflows built in Strands or LangGraph and deployed on AgentCore Runtime with Memory, Identity, and Gateway. * **Tool interfaces.** Framework\-agnostic Python tools, MCP servers, and AgentCore Gateway targets that let agents safely call production APIs. * **Evaluation harnesses.** Offline and online eval pipelines and LLM\-as\-judge CI/CD gates that catch regressions before dealers do. * **Guardrails and safe failure.** Approval gates and rollback paths that determine whether an agent fails safe or fails loud. * **Cost and latency management.** Per\-agent cost tracking and multi\-model routing so each workflow earns more than it costs. * **Production observability.** AgentCore session tracing, OpenTelemetry, and CloudWatch dashboards for every agent you ship. You work within the platform's established architectural patterns, and produce deliverables using agentic frameworks, AWS serverless core, MCP and tool design, and observability without someone looking over your shoulder. Prompt engineering and tool\-use design are core engineering disciplines here, not an afterthought. ### **First 90 Days / First Year** **First 90 Days:** Ramp on the platform architecture, existing agents, and integration surfaces, and on the dealer workflows behind them, so you know what the agents are for, not just how they run. Ship your first tool integration (MCP server or Gateway target) to production in month one. By month three, own end\-to\-end agent workflows from design through production on AgentCore: Strands agent logic, tool interfaces, evaluation harness with CI gates, and guardrails. **First Year:** Running autonomously from month four: shipping new agents and tools with minimal oversight, with observability and cost tracking in place for everything you own. A portfolio of production agents in your name, each with an eval harness, guardrails, and a cost and latency budget it stays inside. You will be the engineer who builds the agents that do real work for real dealers.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering * **Reports To:** Head of Data Platform * **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on production experience building LLM agents in a code\-first framework. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Partner Integration
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** We operate a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions. That platform doesn't operate alone. It sits between dealer groups and the systems they already run: DMS platforms (CDK, Reynolds \& Reynolds, Tekion, DealerTrack, Procede), CRMs, digital retail tools, F\&I providers, and lenders. Over 40 partner platforms feed or consume our data today, and every one of them has its own auth model, its own schema, its own idea of what a "deal" is, and its own opinion about how much traffic you're allowed to send. That integration surface is the product. If a dealer's data doesn't land clean and on time, nothing downstream works: not the desking tool, not the reporting, not the AI. This role owns that surface end to end. You are the engineer who reads the partner's spec, gets on the call with their team when the spec is wrong, builds the ingestion in Python on AWS, and keeps it healthy in production. The engineering is only half of it. The other half is the partner's integration team: reading between the lines of their documentation, getting a straight answer about undocumented behavior, and pushing back on a bad contract before it becomes our problem. We want an engineer who does that work well and understands what dealer workflow the data serves, not one who moves JSON from A to B and calls it done. ### **Scope \& Scale** * Over 40 integrated partner platforms across DMS, CRM, Digital Retail, F\&I, and lending, each with distinct auth, rate limits, and data models. * 5,000\+ dealer tenants, each with isolated data and per\-tenant partner configuration. * Tens of thousands of API requests daily across REST, SOAP, webhook, and file\-based integration surfaces. * Partner outages, silent schema changes, and rate\-limit shifts are routine, not exceptional. The integrations you own have to survive them without a human in the loop. ### **What You'll Own** * **End\-to\-end partner integrations.** From spec review and sandbox access through production cutover. You write the Python, define the mapping, and own the result. * **The partner\-facing technical relationship.** You're the engineer on the call with their integration team: clarifying undocumented behavior, negotiating payload changes, driving certification, and escalating when their sandbox is down. * **Ingestion and normalization pipelines.** Webhook receivers, polling clients, and file\-based feeds landing into S3 and promoting through the medallion layers into the normalized model. * **Resilience under someone else's SLA.** Idempotency and deduplication, exponential backoff, rate\-limit handling, replay of missed events, and graceful degradation when a partner goes dark. * **Integration security.** Webhook signature verification, OAuth2/JWT credential lifecycles, KMS encryption, and credential storage in SSM/Secrets Manager. No secrets in code, ever. * **Contract testing and validation.** JSON Schema validation at the boundary, contract tests against partner sandboxes, and CI gates that catch a partner's breaking change before a dealer does. * **Observability and integration health.** CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, and structured logging per partner, so a 2 AM failure is diagnosable without guessing. * **Documentation that survives you.** Mapping specs, runbooks, and onboarding guides per partner. The next engineer should not have to re\-derive what you learned on a call. ### **First 90 Days / First Year** **First 90 Days:** Ramp on the partner catalog, the normalized data model, and the dealer workflows the data feeds, so you know what the fields are for. Ship your first partner\-facing change to production in the first few weeks. By day 90, own one full partner integration end to end: client, mapping, validation, tests, dashboards, runbook. **First Year:** Running independently across a portfolio of partners, and the primary technical contact for several of them. New partner onboarding is measurably faster and less bespoke because of the patterns and tooling you built. ### **Hands\-On Expectations** This is a building role, and the balance shifts with the calendar. Between onboardings you're heads\-down in code: clients, transformations, tests, instrumentation. During an active partner onboarding, expect several calls a week with their engineering team and real time spent in their documentation. Both modes are the job. ### **Tech \& Tools** * **Integration core:** Python (AWS Lambda Powertools), API Gateway, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS; REST, SOAP/XML, webhook, and SFTP surfaces. * **Cloud services (native AWS stack):** Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS Fargate, Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, KMS, CDK. * **Languages:** Modern Python. * **Data platform:** S3 data lake with medallion layering (landing, bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB single\-table design, endor API docs, WSDLs, and sample payloads into typed Python client skeletons and mapping code. * Using Claude Code to scaffold Lambda handlers, JSON Schemas, and unit tests from a partner spec. * Diffing a partner's new spec version against the old one to find the breaking change fast. * Drafting integration runbooks and mapping documentation from the code you just wrote. * Reasoning over production logs to isolate whether a failure is ours or theirs. **You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the engineer who onboards partners at a pace the rest of the industry can't match.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering (Data Platform Engineering) * **Reports To:** Head of Data Platform * **Location:** Remote (US). Denver HQ nice to have. * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with strong, current Python. * Judgment about scope: you start from what the integration is worth to the dealer, not from the most interesting way to build it, and you've shipped the boring version when the boring version was right. * Hands\-on production experience integrating third\-party APIs you don't control, including at least one integration you owned through spec, build, certification, and production support. * **Comfort across integration styles, not just modern REST: SOAP/XML, webhooks, and file\-based feeds are all in scope here.** * **Hands\-on AWS experience (Lambda, S3, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Secrets Manager/SSM).** * **Real experience mapping and normalizing inconsistent external schemas into a canonical model, and the judgment to know when the partner's data is simply wrong.** * **Ability to debug distributed, event\-driven systems from logs and traces and be able to put observability in place.** * Willingness to be the person on the partner call. Direct, clear, and unbothered by pushing back on someone else's engineering team. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Idempotency and deduplication patterns for at\-least\-once delivery (e.g., DynamoDB\-backed dedup). * Webhook security: HMAC signature verification, mTLS, replay protection. * OAuth2 / JWT credential flows and rotation for machine\-to\-machine integrations. * JSON Schema or comparable contract validation at system boundaries. * Infrastructure as code (CDK) and CI/CD (CircleCI). ### **Nice to Have** * Automotive retail, DMS/CRM, fintech, or multi\-tenant marketplace platform experience. * Experience standing up a partner integration program from scratch (templates, scorecards, onboarding runbooks). **Benefits** We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well\-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family. **Here's what we offer:** * **Base Salary:** $160,000 – $180,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant. * **Employer\-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one. * **Flexible Work:** Remote (US). Denver HQ nice to have. * **401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match:** Build your future with our competitive matching program. * **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):** Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays. * **Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage:** Fully employer\-paid. * **Life and AD\&D Insurance:** Employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. * **Free Mental Health Support:** Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp. * **Pet Insurance Options:** Affordable plans for your furry family members. * **Identity Theft Protection:** Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information. * **Other Cool Stuff:** On\-site gym in Denver, great co\-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with development teams to automate operations, make our services easier to observe, and push for engineering excellence across the stack. destination dealer tenants**, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * **Tens of thousands of API requests per minute** across REST, SOAP and event\-driven integration surfaces. * You will be the SRE who removes a team's worth of toil by treating Claude as your pairing partner.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering (Platform Team) * **Reports To:** Director of Platform Engineering * **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * **4\+ years** in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure engineering, with at least **2 years in AWS production environments**. * Hands\-on experience with **AWS** services including ECS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3 and CodePipeline. * Strong **Linux administration** skills, plus experience running **LAMP stacks and Nginx** in production. * Experience supporting **Java applications**, including JVM tuning, garbage collection analysis and troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of **Docker and Kubernetes**. * Scripting or programming skills in at least one of **Python, Bash or Go**. * Experience with **infrastructure as code and GitOps** workflows. * Solid grasp of **networking**: VPCs, DNS, load balancers, TCP/IP and HTTP. * Experience with **observability tools and incident management**. * Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to **stay calm under pressure**. * Clear written and spoken communication, and a habit of working with other teams. ### **Strongly Preferred** * AWS across REST, SOAP, and event\-driven integration surfaces. * Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi\-protocol vendor connectivity. * Every engineering team in the org, as the owner of standards, release governance, and SRE practice. ### **What You'll Own** * **Hands\-on agentic development.** Designing, building, and operating agentic AI systems (AWS Bedrock AgentCore, MCP servers) every day: agent code, tool interfaces, evaluation harnesses, and production AI workflows. * **Adoption of the agentic development harness.** Making agent\-assisted development a first\-class way the org ships, and measurably improving speed of delivery across teams. * **Security vulnerability management.** Continuously monitoring for vulnerabilities (dependencies, CVEs, container images, IAM/config drift), remediating quickly, and keeping frameworks, libraries, and runtimes patched and upgraded. * **Platform modernization.** Creating and driving initiatives to modernize existing Master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 8 years of experience in solution architecture, technical design, and enterprise technology delivery. * Minimum 3 years of Strong knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI systems, and AI operational frameworks preferred * Experience leading technical initiatives and architecting complex solutions, particularly within regulated or highly governed environments. * Experience working with AI orchestration platforms and frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Strands, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems including Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, GCP Gemini AI, M365 Copilot Studio, or comparable platforms. * Experience developing RAG solutions, vector databases, memory systems, prompt engineering strategies, and model optimization techniques. * Knowledge of modern AI development tools, coding assistants, and enterprise AI platforms. * Knowledge of integration protocols, tool\-calling frameworks, and API\-driven architectures. * Familiarity with responsible AI practices, governance principles, and regulatory frameworks. * Knowledge of LLM infrastructure concepts such as GPU utilization, token economics, and performance optimization. * Strong communication skills with an aptitude for translating technical concepts into business\-focused recommendations. * Success collaborating with cross\-functional teams in Agile and evolving technology environments. * Relevant AI, cloud, or architecture certifications preferred Compensation The anticipated pay range/scale for this position is commensurate with experience. jobs.title: AI Factory Customer Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. **About the Role** The AI Factory Customer Engineer plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between customer modular AI\-ready data center requirements and Armada's Product and Engineering teams. This role requires deep technical credibility, hands\-on infrastructure experience, and strong interpersonal skills to translate complex AI infrastructure and data center architectures into clear, practical solutions for customers looking to deploy sovereign AI infrastructure at speed. This role goes beyond traditional pre\-sales. The Customer Engineer acts as the technical interface between high\-profile customers and Armada Engineering, ensuring customer requirements, constraints, and feedback are accurately represented and incorporated into solution design and future platform evolution. Armada's AI Factory serves a broad and growing set of customers across enterprise, industrial, and infrastructure\-heavy verticals. A meaningful and growing subset of strategic targets includes AI\-focused datacenter co\-location providers and Neocloud operators which represent a primary segment where Armada's high\-density, liquid\-cooled modular solutions are a compelling fit for capacity expansion and rapid deployment. Additionally, renewable energy operators who own or control significant land, power, and stranded energy assets are increasingly positioned to host or operate AI compute infrastructure at scale. The ideal candidate brings an engineering and customer\-first mindset, strong data center and AI\-ready infrastructure expertise, particularly around AI, HPC, liquid\-cooling, modular data center solutions, Nvidia reference architectures, along with the energy, curiosity, and positivity required to operate in a fast\-moving, hyper\-growth environment. This role is instrumental in driving adoption, trust, and long\-term success for Armada's AI Factory modular solutions. **Location** United States (Remote) **What You'll Do — Key Responsibilities** **Core Technical Customer Engagement** * Act as the primary technical interface between customers and Armada's Product and Engineering teams, translating real\-world requirements into actionable technical inputs. * Provide expert technical guidance to Armada's AI Factory customers, including Modular Data Center (MDC)solutions, high\-density and liquid\-cooled designs, and GPU\-based reference architectures created with partners such as NVIDIA. * Understand customer workloads and objectives deeply and advise on solution details including rack\-level design, systems architectures, cooling and power draw advisory, and deployment strategy tradeoffs. * Lead technical demonstrations and workshops, tailoring content to customer constraints and operational realities. * Cultivate trusted\-advisor relationships with customer engineering, infrastructure, IT, OT, and security stakeholders and teams * Engage with solution partners and supply chain, including MEP, OEM, xPU vendors, in service to end\-to\-end customer solutions * Enable field and sales teams by simplifying complex technical concepts into clear, customer\-relevant narratives * Support RFI/P and ongoing customer\-facing technical documentation required to support lighthouse customer requirements * Bring a high\-ownership, self\-starting mindset with the energy and curiosity to fill gaps, solve problems, and drive outcomes end\-to\-end. **AI Datacenter Co\-Lo \& Neocloud Engagement** * Engage AI\-focused datacenter co\-location operators and Neocloud providers as a critical customer segment, positioning Armada's AI Factory as a solution for rapid capacity expansion, modular overflow deployments, and high\-density liquid\-cooled compute environments. * Develop sufficient familiarity with co\-lo and Neocloud operational models — GPU cluster economics, high\-density power and cooling requirements, multi\-tenant compute, and deployment velocity expectation ustomer engagements, technical scoping, and solution design across all target verticals. * Stay current on industry trends related to AI infrastructure, energy sector AI adoption, data center design, liquid cooling, and modular systems — and share insights internally to shape future product strategy. * Attend industry events and conferences, representing Armada with customers, partners, and industry insiders * Bring positive energy, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to every engagement — this role values technical excellence and having fun while building something meaningful. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on engineering experience). Advanced engineering degrees are a plus. * 10\-15\+ years of relevant experience in data center engineering, infrastructure engineering, pre\-sales, sales engineering, or solution architecture roles. * Strong understanding of compute, networking, and storage fundamentals, including AI and GPU\-based systems * Hands\-on experience with mechanical, electrical, thermal, advanced cooling and networking components of data center solutionsFamiliarity with modular data centers (MDCs) landscape * Engineering mindset with curiosity about what lives inside the rack, including openness to evolving beyond current AI and HPE reference designs (e.g., B300 / GB300\) as architectures evolve. * Familiarity with foundational cloud platforms, containerization, virtualization, and modern enterprise infrastructure. * Ability to navigate and build credibility with technical infrastructure buying personas at all levels * Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort operating in complex, live customer environments. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both highly technical engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * Willingness to travel as required. **Compensation \& Benefits** For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the **On\-Target Earnings (OTE)** for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed below, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits *(details available upon request)*. \#LI\-DA1 \#LI\-REMOTE **You're a Great Fit if You're** * A go\-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge * A detail\-oriented problem\-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get\-it\-done" attitude * Thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company * A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda * Highly organized and results\-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you **Equal Opportunity Statement** At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide. The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small\-to\-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. As part of the Measurement, AdTech, and Data Science (MADS) organization, you'll work across the full stack — from backend data infrastructure to advertiser\-facing measurement products — helping brands of all sizes make confident, data\-driven decisions about where to invest. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Robot Data Platform , Fauna
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer to build the data pipelines behind our robot learning models. In this role, you will turn recordings from robots and simulation into usable data for scientists across many domains. The ideal candidate has built and operated production data systems. They create systems that are easy to use for engineers and scientists: results that reproduce, jobs that are safe to re\-run, and failures that are easy to diagnose. They can improve a system that people already depend on without disrupting them. They professionalize research workflows, turning one\-off scripts into shared tools the whole team can use. Key job responsibilities * Build and operate software services that ingest, process, and prepare multimodal robot data for model training * Develop tools that let scientists add their own data processing steps and run them at scale * Make data fast and reliable to load into training jobs * Add monitoring so that failures and gaps in the data reach an owner quickly * Take part in on\-call for cloud services across the team * Protect sensitive data with access controls and auditing About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real\-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments.
