jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Commercial
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Commercial team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the companies that run the real economy, across software, financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and professional services, as they go from using Claude to building on it. Commercial is one of Anthropic's largest and fastest\-moving books of business, covering thousands of mid\-market and small companies. Some of these companies put Claude inside the product they sell, and others put agents to work inside their own engineering, operations, finance, and support teams, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with customer engineering teams to take their hardest agent builds from idea to production on the Claude API, the Agent SDK, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise. Many of these teams are lean, with years of existing systems and no dedicated AI function, and you will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to run it inside a business that already has customers depending on it. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll go deep where hands\-on engineering changes the outcome, then turn what you learn into something the rest of the book can use. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the reference implementations, tooling, and technical resources that enable Commercial customers to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential Commercial customers, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they run their own business, bringing them use cases worth building and pushing the boundaries of what agents can do in engineering, operations, finance, customer support, and more * Work hands\-on with customer engineering teams through build sprints, pair programming, and architecture reviews that move agents from idea to production, and understand their stack, data, and workflows end to end so that your guidance fits the systems, security requirements, and team they have today * Ship working code. Develop prototypes, near\-production examples, and technical documentation, including evaluation suites that become the customer's acceptance criteria, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable customers to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations, blueprints, and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example multi\-agent systems on the Agent SDK or Claude Managed Agents, MCP servers for common business systems, or Claude Code running across the software development lifecycle * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects and Account Executives to decide where engineering depth changes the outcome, and to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about running agents inside established companies such as legacy systems, messy data, permissions and security review, cost and latency at scale, and model migrations, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team * Build the demos, agents, and internal tooling that scale the Commercial Applied AI team itself, and pair with architects on their hardest technical problems * Create technical content for customer and partner engineering audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and customer events * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep software engineering experience, gained by designing, building, and operating production systems, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how established companies get work done * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, forward deployed engineer, ML engineer, product engineer, or technical founder, with production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, MCP, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, and the ability to work in  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: AIML - Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: Summary The Apple Foundation Models team builds large language models that power Apple Intelligence. The pre\-training group works on topics including model architecture, training recipe, optimization, and evaluation. As a senior software engineer on our team, you will be responsible for designing and building systems that support model training and pre\-training research. Description We build frontier foundation models that power intelligent experiences at Apple. Our team works across the full training lifecycle: including pre\-training foundation models, and developing mid\-training approaches that bridge general capability and task\-specific performance. What makes our work distinct is that we're engineering models specifically for Apple silicon and optimized for experiences that are private, personal, and deeply integrated into the OS. We're solving frontier problems in reward modeling to resist reward hacking, handling sparse and delayed rewards in agentic settings, and aligning models reliably across the spectrum from open\-ended creative tasks to precise, action\-taking workflows. If you're drawn to hard problems where the research and the product are inseparable, this is the team. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelors, Masters or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience * 2\+ years of experience in software development * Strong software development skills, with proven ability to make meaningful contributions in complex codebases, and proficiency in relevant languages (e.g. Python, Rust, C). * Familiarity with LLMs, such as: model training, evaluation, and/or agentic systems. * Desire to design and build simple, robust, and scalable systems that facilitate machine learning research. Preferred Qualifications * Masters or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience * 2\+ years of experience working with machine learning systems, LLMs and/or agent frameworks. * Experience building LLM training and/or evaluation infrastructure. * Experience with public cloud infrastructure like Kubernetes, Amazon EC2 and EKS, Google Cloud Platform. * Familiarity with GPUs, TPUs, or other ML accelerators in the context of LLM training and/or inference. * Experience developing AI\-based automation, including agentic workflows, AI\-driven CI/CD pipelines. At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.description: **Job Overview** As an Automation Engineer in pharmaceutical manufacturing, you’ll keep production equipment and control systems operating safely and reliably. Pay: $70\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Benefits: * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

Key Responsibilities 1\. Architectural Definition \& Detailed Specification * Own and author comprehensive, unambiguous system architecture specifications, micro\-architectural specs, and/or platform requirement documents. * Define rigorous system\-level hardware/software partition boundaries and map out register\-level interfaces for hardware blocks and low\-level software stacks. * Drive micro\-architecture specifications for high\-security, AI\-driven SoCs, including on\-chip interconnects (AXI/AHB), memory hierarchies, and standard I/O interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, SPI, eSPI, I3C, LTPI). 2\. Customer Interfacing \& Ecosystem Engagement * Serve as a primary technical point of contact for enterprise and hyperscaler customers to gather, analyze, and scope their next\-generation platform security needs. * Present Axiado’s system architecture roadmap and technical whitepapers to strategic customers, steering\-level partners, and standards committees. * Align Axiado’s technology with modern server deployment topologies and open\-source standards (such as OCP DC\-SCM / DC\-SCI). 3\. Server Infrastructure \& Board\-Level Integration * Architect platform\-level designs optimized for enterprise server motherboards, baseboard management systems, and cloud data center environments. * Guide hardware and SI/PI engineers on signal integrity, power delivery networks, and thermal/mechanical constraints for modular server building blocks. 4\. Software, Firmware \& Security Stack Partitioning * Specify secure platform boot flows, Root\-of\-Trust (RoT) architecture, and Platform Firmware Resiliency (PFR) frameworks. * Collaborate with firmware teams to define interfaces for BMC stacks (OpenBMC), Linux kernels, device drivers, and platform management protocols (MCTP, PLDM, Redfish). **Qualifications** ------------------ Required Qualifications * Experience: 10\+ years of dedicated system architecture experience spanning SoC design, board development, and software stacks. * Industry Focus: Proven track record of engineering and architectural success within the server, data center, or enterprise infrastructure industry. * Specification Ownership: Demonstrated ability to independently produce and maintain highly detailed, production\-grade technical specifications. * Customer Facing: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with comfort interfacing directly with sophisticated enterprise customers and technical stakeholders. * Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * Technical Breadth: * Silicon: Deep knowledge of SoC design flows, interconnects, and interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, DRAM, USB). * Board\-Level: Hands\-on experience with hardware platform design, schematic capture, and lab bring\-up tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers). * Software: Clear understanding of embedded firmware, RTOS, Linux device drivers, and low\-level C/C\+\+ programming. Preferred Qualifications * Active participation in open infrastructure communities like the Open Compute Project (OCP). * Deep understanding of hardware security concepts (cryptographic accelerators, HSM, TPM, Side\-Channel attack mitigations). * Experience with BMC firmware architecture (OpenBMC) and server management interfaces (MCTP, NVMe\-MI, LTPI). Qualifications * Experience \& Education: 10\+ years of hardware engineering experience with a leadership track record in server, data center, or semiconductor ecosystems. B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering (EE). * Production Track Record: Proven history of taking complex board designs to high\-volume production with excellent yields and resolving field RMA issues. * Hands\-on Technical Mastery: Deep, continuous experience with circuit design, schematic capture, laboratory equipment, and platform troubleshooting. * DC\-SCM \& Ecosystem Expertise: Strong knowledge of OCP DC\-SCM standard solutions (DC\-SCI interface, form factors) and a solid network across hyperscaler and OEM partners. * Supply Chain Agility: Demonstrated capability to execute rapid hardware redesigns, footprint compatibility strategies, and alternative component sourcing. * Tool \& Interface Proficiency: Expert familiarity with Cadence OrCAD/Allegro and server interfaces (PCIe, USB, I2C, SMBus, SPI, UART, USB, MCTP, eSPI, LTPI). * Architecture \& Software Knowledge: Solid understanding of modern CPU/GPU architectures and the Linux environment (including Python or Bash scripting). * Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to articulate hardware\-anchored security and supply chain strategy to enterprise stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. You'll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you'll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Qualifications** ------------------ **What we're looking for** * 5–7\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master's required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don't expect all five: * + **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work + **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software + **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints + **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness + **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security **Additional Information** -------------------------- Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer I, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. **Your Impact** --------------- Dedrone by Axon protects airspace from drone threats. Each deployment combines our software, our own and partner sensors, and a networking stack that connects the site to DedroneC2 in the cloud. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you are part of the team that owns the technical outcome at our most critical customer sites. This is a software and systems role. You work mostly through remote access to customer sites, and our installation teams and partners do the physical work. You take each problem from live triage to a fix in the field, then make sure the long\-term fix lands in the product. You have the authority to raise defects and to join design reviews with our product teams, based on what you see first\-hand. One question guides the work: how do we leave the product better than we found it, so nobody has to work this issue again? **What You'll Do** ------------------ Location: Hybrid. Up to 20% travel required, to customer sites, demonstrations, and exercises. Must be within commutable distance to one of our Hub locations listed below: Sterling VA) Reports to: Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering * Own complex site issues end to end: lead the incident, get the site working, and write the review afterwards. * Resolve live site problems that Support escalates, diagnosing failures across software, sensors, and networks with customers and installers. * Write the fixes, integrations, and automation that get a site working, and set the quality bar for field fixes through code reviews. * Leave no one\-off behind: move each site\-specific fix into the product or retire it, and follow the root cause with our product teams until the fix ships. * Set the standards for the runbooks, checklists, acceptance tests, and monitoring that make deployments repeatable. * Mentor engineers on the team, and coach Support and installers on what you learn. * Take part in the engineering on\-call rota. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools across your work, and help the team use them well. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability, or systems integration * Production ownership: you have been on call, led incidents, and debugged live systems from logs and metrics * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python or Java, with a record of shipping code to production * Clear communication with customers, installers, and engineers during live incidents * Experience mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted engineering tools and workflows * Deep experience in one of these: + Software: you have designed and owned production services, and you can find and fix a defect in a large codebase that you did not write. + Systems: you have deployed and troubleshot Linux systems and IP networks at production or customer sites, including integration with third\-party equipment. **Work Location** This role is based out of our Sterling Office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in\-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in\-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success. #### **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.* Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.* Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. jobs.title: Project Manager -Electrical & Automation Engineer

They will execute projects with efficiency and cost effectiveness and successfully deliver project packages that meet the Client objectives. The Embedded Project Manager is passionate and results oriented with a creative and analytical mind; they are experienced with advanced PM tools and processes and can effectively manage critical situations. Our Embedded Project Managers make it their number one priority to understand and manage the client’s expectations by monitoring and tracking project activities, and communicating to the project stakeholders the project status, risks and recommended mitigations. Qualified candidates must be capable of supporting onsite testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, documentation, and coordination with client engineering, operations, maintenance, OEMs, and system integrators. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of the BSI Embedded Services Team while serving in an onsite role working alongside our client. If you're energized by building strong client relationships and bringing technical projects to life, we'd love to meet you. **Project Scope \& Execution** * Meet with the client to assess, define and clarify the requirements of each project * Lead interactive planning sessions to establish the alignment of scope, schedule, budget and quality * Look for opportunities for added value through application of engineering principles and design inputs. * Create a detailed work plan which identifies and sequences the activities needed to successfully complete the project * Lead PC\&IS design and delivery from definition to commissioning while ensuring compliance with electrical and controls standards * Lead all PC\&IS design reviews with design vendors, and multi\-functional team * Lead the development of detailed E\&I construction execution plan * Ensure compliance with design \& construct against client checklist * Provide Electrical \& Instrumentation data to build as built PFS, P\&IDs, Panel drawing, etc. * Own Engineering Work Process for PC\&IS * Manage on\-site E\&I installation while leading the installation contractors * Ensure compliance with all client policies, procedures, technical standards and preferences * Ensure the project meets all health, safety, and environmental requirements of the client * Coordinate input from the disciplines, compile a cohesive proposal, and deliver final proposal to the client * Define project baselines and track the progress toward project plan and objectives; regularly review and analyze the project scope and take corrective actions to address project deviations * Create and manage schedule and ensure that the project deliverables are on time. * Ensure that project deliverables meet proposal deliverables and are consistent between disciplines * Utilize standard forms and reports to document project activities and project status * Ensure that all project information is appropriately distributed, documented and saved * Evaluate the status of the project as compared to the planning phase and determine causes of any deviations; Communicate and reach agreement on any change order needs with the client **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or higher in an Engineering discipline or a related technical field required. * 5\+ years of Automation and Electrical engineering experience required. * Demonstrated experience with HMI Systems: Rockwell, PanelView HMI and FactoryTalk Machine Edition including application development, modification, configuration and troubleshooting. Plantpax experience required. * Must have experience working onsite in a manufacturing plant or industrial environment. * PMP highly preferred, Professional Engineer (PE) a plus. * Knowledge and application of a disciplined project management process * Strong working knowledge of PLC platforms and programming such as CompactLogix, Micrologix and Rockwell. * Strong competencies in planning, project management * Ability to produce and present clear, concise, and professionally written communications and presentations. * Ability to lead and facilitate multiple activities and resources * Demonstrated work ethic, integrity, and professional conduct * Competency in Microsoft Project and Excel **Why Join BSI?** At BSI, our employees are more than team members. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer III, AI Products
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== **What we're building** ======================= We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start. Baker Tilly is the sixth\-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the screens practitioners use and the services behind them. You'll take well\-scoped features from frontend to production and learn from experienced engineers as you go. **What you'll work with** ========================= * Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm. * Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce. * Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build. * We work in partnership with frontier labs. * A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing. * Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure. **What you'll do** ================== * Build features for our AI agents end to end: the screens practitioners use, the services behind them, and the data they read. * Build the tools our experts use to review agent output and flag what's wrong. * Work directly with practitioners to understand how they do their jobs, then turn that into software. * Connect to firm systems and data through APIs, with the right access controls. * Write tested, readable code. Review other people's code, and have yours reviewed. * Watch what you ship: tests, tracing, user feedback, and fixing what breaks. * Use AI coding tools extensively to build and ship, and check their work. We ship through a code factory more and more, and you'll help us get there. **Who you are** =============== * You're a hands\-on technologist who has built things people actually use, ideally end to end, from the first conversation with users through production and after. * You're naturally curious, a strong problem solver, and a clear communicator. * You can take an objective, form an opinion, and move things forward on your own, even when the path is unclear. **What you bring** ================== * 5 years of experience preferred building and shipping production software, on both frontend and backend. * You use AI coding tools extensively, and you have opinions about what works. * TypeScript or JavaScript with a modern frontend framework, plus a backend language like Python, Node, Go, or Java. * Comfort with APIs, relational databases, and common authentication patterns. * Solid habits: debugging, automated tests, version control, secure coding. * You ask who should see the data before you ask how to show it. * Bachelor's Degree required **Nice to have** ================ * React, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, containers, or CI/CD tooling. * Some exposure to LLM apps, retrieval, agents, or evals. No AI background needed. * Experience with enterprise systems, specialist business users, or regulated data. **In a year** ============= * You've shipped features practitioners use every week. * You've improved a real workflow, and you can show it with feedback or numbers. * You're taking on bigger pieces, and the team is better for having you. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employee*s. *The national pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* *In California: pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* \#LI\-AC1

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW:** Balchem is committed to making the world a healthier place by delivering trusted, innovative, and science\-based solutions for the health and nutritional needs of the world. Balchem employs approximately 1,400 employees worldwide who provide the service, quality, and technology that enables our customers to win with their customers. We have built a reputation for delivering results to all of our stakeholders. Founded in 1967, Balchem, a Maryland corporation, became a publicly\-traded company in 1970 and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol “BCPC.” Our corporate headquarters is located in Montvale, New Jersey, and we have a broad network of sales offices, manufacturing sites, and R\&D centers, primarily located in the U.S. and Europe. The Company consists of three business segments: Human Nutrition and Health, Animal Nutrition and Health, and Specialty Products. **POSITION SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer will design, build, and deploy AI agents and AI\-enabled automations for Balchem's supporting functions (Finance, Operations, HR, Legal, etc.) and Business Segments. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on applying commercially available AI platforms and large language models to real business processes, not on building or training foundation models. Success in this role requires strong software development and integration skills, practical experience with generative AI and agent tooling, and the business acumen to turn a process problem into a working, reliable solution. The AI Engineer will collaborate with functional teams to understand how work gets done today, then build agents that connect to Balchem's systems and data and deliver measurable productivity gains. While working closely with specific business segments and functions to ensure each solution fits its context, the AI Engineer builds with an enterprise\-wide perspective, favoring reusable components, common standards, and secure, supportable designs that can scale across Balchem. The AI Engineer will work within Balchem's AI Governance Process, helping to execute the Corporate AI Strategy by delivering prioritized use cases and ensuring every solution meets the organization's AI guardrails for security, privacy, and responsible use. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** **AI Agent Design \& Development** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents, copilots, and assistants using existing AI platforms, large language models, and agent frameworks to automate and improve business processes across Balchem's functions and business segments. **Systems Integration \& Automation** * Integrate AI agents with Balchem's enterprise applications and data sources (ERP, CRM, collaboration, and data platforms) using APIs, connectors, and workflow tools. * Build AI\-driven automations that reduce manual steps, shorten cycle times, and improve the accuracy of routine work. **Solution Delivery \& Lifecycle Management** * Own the full delivery lifecycle for AI solutions, from requirements and prototyping through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and help prioritize the delivery backlog based on potential benefit and business objectives. * Ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact. **Use Case Discovery \& Prototyping** * Work with business stakeholders to identify and assess high\-value use cases for AI agents and automation across the organization. * Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility and value before committing to full development. **Prompt Engineering \& Knowledge Grounding** * Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and tool calling to ground agents in Balchem's data and knowledge, improving the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of their output. **User Enablement \& Adoption** * Support the rollout of new AI solutions with clear documentation, demonstrations, and hands\-on guidance for end users. * Partner with functional teams to gather feedback, resolve issues, and refine solutions so they are adopted and continue to deliver value. **Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI** * Build solutions that protect company data by applying appropriate access controls, data handling practices, and testing for accuracy and misuse. * Ensure all solutions comply with Balchem's AI Policy and IT security standards. **Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement** * Monitor the usage, quality, and cost of deployed agents, track KPIs, and continuously tune solutions to improve their performance and impact. **Collaboration \& Technology Awareness** * Work closely with IT, cybersecurity, and business teams, and stay current on emerging AI tools and practices to recommend those that fit Balchem's needs. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software development, automation, or systems integration, including at least a year of hands\-on work building generative AI solutions. * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM\-powered applications into production using existing platforms and APIs (for example, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable agent frameworks). * Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent orchestration, and solution evaluation. Experience training or building foundation models is not required. * Proficiency in Python or a similar language, REST APIs, and low\-code automation tools, with experience integrating solutions into enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and Microsoft 365\. * Understanding of data security, privacy, and responsible AI practices, with a commitment to continuous learning as AI technologies and best practices evolve. * Strong communication, collaboration skills and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and work effectively with business stakeholders. The expected salary range for this position is $150,000 \- $180,000 a year Balchem is committed to a workplace culture that values and promotes diversity, inclusion, equal employment opportunities, and a work environment free of harassment and hostility.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: ***Wenzel Industries*** is a solutions\-oriented contract machining operation serving the powersports and fluid power markets. We use advanced machining equipment and specialized processes to manufacture complex precision components. ***Wenzel Industries*** is seeking a hands\-on ***Manufacturing Engineer*** to develop, program, implement, and improve CNC machining and related manufacturing processes. Working closely with the Engineering Manager, Production, Quality, and other departments, this individual will support new\-product introduction, CNC programming, first article inspection, production troubleshooting, tooling and fixture development, and continuous improvement. This is a technical individual\-contributor position with significant shop\-floor involvement. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, program, prove out, and optimize CNC machining processes, including multi\-axis milling and mill\-turn operations. * Support machine setups, first article inspections (FAI), process validation, and successful transfer of new or revised jobs into production. * Design, evaluate, and improve cutting tools, fixtures, workholding, and machining methods to improve safety, quality, cycle time, and cost. * Troubleshoot machining, programming, setup, and dimensional issues; investigate root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions. * Create and maintain accurate manufacturing routings, bills of materials (BOMs), setup instructions, and related records in Plex ERP. * Interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, customer specifications, and inspection results to establish capable and repeatable processes. * Participate in Lean and continuous improvement projects focused on scrap reduction, throughput, setup time, and operational efficiency. * Collaborate with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, suppliers, and customers to resolve technical issues and support product quality and delivery. * Evaluate automation, equipment, and process\-improvement opportunities and provide technical recommendations to the Engineering Manager. * Follow applicable safety procedures, quality\-system requirements, and company standards. **Required Qualifications** * At least 4 years of relevant CNC machining, CNC programming, and manufacturing engineering experience. * Practical hands\-on experience with CNC machine setup, operation, programming, and production troubleshooting. Preferred Qualifications * Experience programming and setting up 4\+ axis mills and mill\-turn lathes. * Familiarity with Mazak, Okuma, and Makino equipment. * Experience with SolidWorks, Vericut, Plex ERP, Microsoft 365, or similar systems. * Working knowledge of SPC, APQP, PPAP, ISO 9001, and structured continuous improvement practices. * Degree or technical credential in manufacturing, mechanical engineering, machining, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience is valued. **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** The position involves both office/computer work and regular presence in an operating machine shop. jobs.title: Senior Mobile App Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. As a Senior Mobile App Engineer, you'll help power Beacon's mission by building cross\-platform apps that interface with our EEG headbands and other wearables to capture high\-fidelity data and enable seamless experiences for patients and clinicians. This isn't just another app. You'll be crafting tools that help unlock insights into neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders, with the potential to improve lives at scale. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs located in Boston and New York. For this position we will consider candidates based anywhere in the US Eastern time zone. ### **What success looks like:** As part of our small, mission\-driven Mobile Apps Team, you will: * Develop our React Native mobile applications and our native iOS and Android BLE device SDKs. * Design and implement UX workflows for clinical trial participants and at\-home diagnostic patients. * Own the user experience, app performance, reliability, and observability of the apps and features you develop, leveraging feedback from real users in a diverse set of use cases and environments. * Partner with our Devices team, other Platform teams, and product designers to develop user\-centric mobile app capabilities that are deeply integrated with the rest of Beacon's product ecosystem. * Help shape the roadmap and technical direction of our mobile platform. In your first 3–6 months, you might: * Build a new in\-app feature to validate EEG signal quality before data capture. * Improve BLE pairing and reconnection reliability across both iOS and Android. * Streamline onboarding for new patients and trial participants to help make our devices easier to use than ever. * Deploy new features to help our Clinical Operations team track compliance. ### **What you will bring:** You'll be a great fit if you have: * 5\+ years of experience in mobile development (native iOS/Android and/or React Native). * Experience working with BLE, sensor integration, or health data streams. * A product mindset — you care deeply about UX, edge cases, and performance. * Familiarity with our tech stack (TypeScript, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Expo, GitHub) * Strong communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative, async environment Bonus points if you've: * Worked with medical devices, EEG, or wearables. * Integrated BLE peripheral devices into iOS and/or Android applications. * Written native code extensively for either iOS or Android, in addition to React Native. * Worked on apps for clinical trials, patients, or in some other regulated environment. * Contributed to open source mobile or BLE projects. The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer** **Scottsdale, Arizona** **About the Role** LodgeLink is inviting senior software engineers in Scottsdale to join our team to be part of the creation of the future of workforce travel. We are looking for talented developers with a passion to create products that impact the industry, who enjoy learning about the latest technologies, strong critical thinking skills, and a user\-focused approach. As a part of the software engineering team, you will join an agile, audacious, inventive, collaborative, and dependable team with a bold and opinionated vision of how we use technology to solve business problems. You will influence and execute the technical vision and system design decisions on how the product is built, deployed, and operated on production. Specifically, you will collaborate with other software engineers and engineering leaders in designing new cloud\-native solutions and rearchitecting existing ones. As a Senior Software Engineer, you should be comfortable around both front\-end and back\-end coding languages, development frameworks, third\-party libraries, and modern system design patterns such as event driven, DDD, and microservices. Our current cloud stack includes GoLang, ReactJS, NodeJS, gRPC, GraphQL, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Docker, all fully running on Azure cloud, plus a few more things. This role is in Scottsdale and is in\-office with 20% flexibility to work from home. **Responsibilities:** * Your job \#1 is to make the software engineering team better through doing, mentoring, and sharing. You are a role model. * You will enforce the best coding practices while being a strong advocate and innovator for continual improvement. Your codebase will be better every sprint. * You will create the tools and templates so that all the other developers will say “wow, this is easy.” * In the next few years, you will scale our platform to manage over 1,000 times the current load while keeping the uptime at 100%. **Qualifications** * Beyond 10 years of progressive career in software development lifecycle experience and still have a curiosity and are malleability to learn new ways. * 10\+ years of mastery of SDLC, SOLID Principles, Data/Behavior/Test Drive Development, and a love of Clean Code and of clean architecture. * 5\+ years of experience with modern technologies such as GoLang, ReactJS, NodeJS, gRPC, microservices, and NoSQL are assets. It's okay not to know all of these technologies, we know you can learn fast because you know the principles and have strong software engineering foundations * 10\+ years of proven application of cloud development patterns and best practices with multiple years in different architectures and industries. * A proficiency in cloud\-based architecture and automated release pipelines because you have done this for more than 5 years. * 5\+ years focused on an API\-first approach expertise with loosely coupled systems, and domain driven. * An advocate for and experience in effectively managing and planning technical debt so that ours do not grow. * A commitment to leaving code/processes/people better than when you got there. * An attitude and pride in quality code and have multiple approaches towards testing. * Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering. **About LodgeLink** LodgeLink, a Black Diamond Group company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada is more than just a digital marketplace and ecosystem for crew travel; we’re a caring tech company on a mission to transform workforce travel. Our digital platform is the key to unlocking seamless solutions for finding, booking, and managing crew travel and accommodation needs. Powered by a growing network of hotel and lodge partners, we address the unique challenges of crew travel, applying technology to streamline the entire process from booking to management, payments, and cost reporting. At LodgeLink, we're not just saving our customers time and money; we're changing the future of workforce (crew) travel – for the better. United by our vision to be THE ecosystem for workforce travel, our values reflect our commitment to collaboration, agility, dependability, inventiveness, and audacity. As a diverse and inclusive team, we come together, sharing ideas, building disruptive technology, and tackling complex problems. Our relentless pursuit to deliver value and superior customer experiences is inspired by a collective passion to ‘*Create A Better Way’* for all. At LodgeLink, we're seeking exceptional team players with an entrepreneurial spirit to contribute to our rapid growth. If you crave a career, not just a job, we could be the perfect fit. **LodgeLink Total Rewards \|** Caring for our team is a priority, and we’re pleased to provide these benefits: * Building a diverse and inclusive team, supporting career growth and development. * Competitive base salaries. * Share Appreciation Rights program for salaried employees. * Paid vacation days and sick days. * An employee charitable donation program. * Hotel and travel discounts. * Comprehensive options for benefits, with cost\-sharing between the company and the employee. 401K Matching program. LodgeLink is a Black Diamond Group company. Learn more: www.lodgelink.com Black Diamond Group is a publicly traded company with 20 years of experience in modular space and workforce solutions, and operations across Canada, the United States, and Australia. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About BlinkRx:** BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life\-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that. We built RxOS, the first AI\-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script. Our teams solve complex, high\-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out\-of\-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month. BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80\+ billion category, with exceptional momentum: * **Built for scale:** Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale. * **Proven growth and economics:** We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands. * **Trusted with category\-defining programs:** Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer's direct\-to\-patient platform for its GLP\-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows. We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health. **Staff Site Reliability Engineer** ----------------------------------- ### **Responsibilities** * **Define and drive observability strategy** for IT system and process health, performance, and reliability, including alerting quality, dashboards, and service health indicators. * Design and implement **software\-driven solutions within the IT domain**, automating manual processes and eliminating operational complexity and toil. * Act as a **technical leader and force multiplier**, helping set priorities and influencing decision\-making across the entire IT team \- support, systems and networks. * Take ownership of **large, ambiguous initiatives**, driving them from concept to delivery while aligning stakeholders across IT, engineering and partner teams. * Proactively identify systemic risks and reliability gaps in both tools and processes, **recommending and leading platform upgrades** and architectural improvements before they become incidents. * Provide **technical mentorship**, architecture guidance, and high\-quality design and code reviews for engineers across IT teams. * Lead by example in **documentation and knowledge sharing**, ensuring systems and processes are well\-understood and not dependent on individual ownership. * Participate in and help mature **incident response**, escalation practices, and post\-incident learning across the organization. ### **Desired Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, with demonstrated impact at scale. #### **Reliability \& Troubleshooting** * Expert\-level, methodical troubleshooting across the **entire stack**, from application to kernel to network. * Strong command\-line proficiency and deep expertise in **Linux systems and operating system fundamentals**. * Advanced understanding of networking concepts including **load balancing, proxies, DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, and service\-to\-service communication**. #### **Software \& Automation** * Experience working across multiple languages (e.g., **Python, Go, Bash**, and familiarity troubleshooting application stacks such as React or similar). Strong proficiency in at least one. * Strong track record of **automating repetitive and complex operational work** to reduce toil and increase reliability. * Ability to design and build internal tools (Python or Go) that **standardize and scale IT practices**. * Comfortable operating in an **agile environment**, with disciplined testing and quality practices. #### **Cloud \& Platform Engineering** * Experience with cloud platforms (**AWS preferred**, GCP/Azure acceptable), particularly managed services and production\-grade architectures. * Expertise in **Kubernetes and container orchestration** (EKS, Helm), including lifecycle management and operational best practices. * Proven experience designing and implementing **observability systems**, including metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting. * Deep understanding of container technologies, security scanning, secrets management, dynamic configuration, and **microservices architectures**. * Familiarity with service meshes and advanced traffic management concepts. #### **Infrastructure as Code** * Experience designing and maintaining **company\-wide IaC codebases** using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Ansible. * Ability to think holistically about infrastructure design, cost, reliability, security, and long\-term maintainability. **Why Join Us:** It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description: **Company:** Bronco Wine Company **Reporting to:** Senior Vice President of Information Technology **Location:** Ceres, California \-hybrid or remote will be considered **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Employment Category:** Full\-Time Regular **Pay Range:** $91,000\.00\-$115,000\.00 **Work Schedule:** Monday\-Friday 8\-5PM PST. On\-call rotation and scheduled after\-hours or weekend maintenance windows as business needs may dictate. **Travel Requirements:** 7\-10% travel; travel to Ceres may be required depending on the final assigned work location Bronco Wine Company is seeking a System and Network Engineer based in Ceres, California, subject to confirmation of the final work arrangement.The System and Network Engineer designs, implements, and maintains the network and server infrastructure supporting winery, production, bottling, and distribution operations. The role supports the performance, security, and availability of LAN/WAN, wireless, data center, cloud, Microsoft 365, and related infrastructure environments, and partners with IT, security, and business teams to resolve complex issues, plan capacity, and improve infrastructure reliability. **Successful candidates will reside in CST or PST time zones.** Bronco Wine Company was founded in 1973\. Our family\-owned company strives to continue and improve upon being vertically integrated, from the vineyard to the table, focusing on crafting quality wines for every table. Our family's resilience and sustained growth will continue to be fostered through stewardship of family, valued employees, respected partners, and future generations. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** * Design, configure, and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless networks, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, web application firewalls, and access points. * Install, administer, patch, and support Windows servers, virtualization platforms such as VMware, and supporting storage systems. * Monitor network and system performance, availability, and capacity; proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks. * Serve as an escalation point for network and systems incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes. * Implement and maintain security controls, including firewall policies, network segmentation, access controls, and vulnerability remediation. * Manage core network and identity services, including DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, and identity and access management. * Support hybrid and Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, including virtual networks, connectivity, backup, monitoring, and cloud security. * Administer Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online and hybrid environments, including mailboxes, mail flow, user licensing, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Intune, and Microsoft Purview. * Maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions and participate in recovery testing. * Automate routine tasks and configuration management using approved scripting and infrastructure\-as\-code tools. * Create and maintain network diagrams, configuration records, standard operating procedures, and runbooks. * Evaluate new technologies and vendors and lead or support infrastructure upgrades and migration projects. * Participate in an on\-call rotation and perform scheduled after\-hours maintenance as needed. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the position's purpose and operational needs. **JOB REQUIREMENTS:** **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field; in lieu of a bachelor's degree, equivalent practical experience may be considered. * Five or more years of hands\-on network engineering and systems engineering experience. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing and switching, including OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP, subnetting, NAT, and QoS. * Experience configuring and managing enterprise network hardware such as Cisco, Aruba, Palo Alto, or Fortinet. * Proficiency administering Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. * Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft Azure, including virtual machines, VNets, VPN or ExpressRoute connectivity, network security groups, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Backup, and monitoring services. * Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online or hybrid environments, including the Microsoft 365 admin center, Exchange admin center, mail flow rules, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Intune, and Microsoft Purview. * Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere. * Familiarity with network monitoring and logging tools such as SolarWinds. * Knowledge of network security principles, firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and zero\-trust concepts. * Strong troubleshooting skills using tools such as Wireshark, traceroute, and packet capture. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation and scheduled after\-hours or weekend m sks. * Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation and/or appropriate material\-handling equipment or assistance, as applicable to the assigned task. * Additional role\-specific physical requirements are not established in the available source and require Operations/Safety validation. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** * Work is primarily performed in an office environment. * The position is tentatively assigned to Ceres, California; the final onsite or hybrid work arrangement requires confirmation. * The role requires approximately 7\-10% travel. Travel to Ceres may be required depending on the final assigned work location; specific destinations and transportation expectations require confirmation. * The position participates in an on\-call rotation and scheduled after\-hours or weekend maintenance windows. * Employees must follow applicable company, facility, information\-security, safety, equipment\-operation, and personal protective equipment requirements. **PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED:** * Role\- and site\-specific personal protective equipment requirements have not been established in the available source. * Additional task\-specific personal protective equipment may be required based on the assigned work area, activity, identified hazards, and applicable safety procedures. **WHAT WE OFFER** At Bronco Wine Company, we understand that our success is driven by our talented, committed workforce. jobs.description: **About the Role:** As a CBRE Principal Data Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the design, development, and evolution of CBRE's enterprise data platform and data products. jobs.title: Lead Advanced Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **About HCC/CCI** Henry Crown \& Company/CC Industries is a Chicago\-based, privately\-held company that manages business, philanthropic, and family interests on behalf of a multi\-generational family. The business ventures fall into broadly\-defined categories: wholly\-owned operating companies, public and private equity investments, and real estate. The enterprise also supports individual and collective giving through Crown Family Philanthropies and provides traditional family office services across generations. The enterprise employs approximately 350 professionals in the areas of investment management, corporate development, financial operations, tax, research and innovation, human resources, information technologies, and legal. **Why work for us?** We are a private enterprise with more than a 100\-year legacy and track record of financial success, supporting our communities, and taking care of our employees. We plan strategically with a long\-term time horizon and an integrated approach to access superior opportunities and optimize financial results. Integrity, collaboration, and dedication are cornerstones of our workplace culture that create rewarding professional experiences. **Position Description** At HCC, our systems automation researchers work directly with multi\-disciplinary project teams to understand key manufacturing challenges and determine how digital technologies can be used to solve them. Fabrication, welding, controls, and/or programming knowledge a plus. * Holistic approach to advanced manufacturing systems design \& implementation, including mechanical design, system analysis, inspection requirements, and control strategies. * Exposure to manufacturing automation systems, utilizing vision, robotics, sensors, and data analysis. * Experience implementing Industrial Internet of Things (IIOT) related technologies to develop adaptive processes utilizing actionable data\-based algorithms. (Industry 4\.0\) * Effective communicator with diverse teams and stakeholders. * Excels at problem definition; able to work effectively with open ended or ambiguous problem statements and/or applications and be comfortable in adapting strategies to achieve results. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills; clearly conveys ideas at both technical and non\-technical levels; must be an active listener, as well as experience in conflict resolution. * Exposure to factory automation and coordinated drive systems including hardware integration and programming using off the shelf industrial automation hardware and drives (Siemens, Rockwell, etc.). * Contribute to overall (systems, electrical \& mechanical) design and analysis using available technology tools (such as, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Excel, etc.) and analytical methods (brainstorming, thought experimentation, etc.). * Employ best engineering practices in the conception, design, and analysis of automated solutions. * Approaches work with a collaborative, team first mentality; proactive, positive with a can\-do attitude. * Be an effective steward of project budgets and schedules. Project Management experience and Capex planning are a plus. * Comfortable with travel 25% of the time. The Starting Salary Range: $154k \- $173k. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. To see an overview of all our benefits please go to our career portal here. *Don’t meet every single requirement? jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage B2B SaaS engineering team building AI agents for industrial ingredient manufacturers. You will work closely with the founding team, own products from customer discovery through launch, and shape software that supports complex compliance and food safety workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Speak with manufacturers to understand their workflows and turn customer needs into product decisions. * Build backend systems that ingest and process documents from customer ERPs and inboxes. * Develop LLM agents to complete complex, multi\-page compliance and food safety documents. * Own features across the full stack, from defining the problem and building backend services to shipping user\-facing interfaces. * Ship quickly, gather feedback from users, and iterate on the product. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 4 years of professional experience, including substantial hands\-on software engineering and production coding. * Experience as a product manager who moved into engineering, or as a sole or first product engineer with end\-to\-end ownership from discovery through iteration. * A track record of shipping products or major features used by real customers, with the ability to explain technical and product tradeoffs. * Strong full\-stack skills and backend experience, including data ingestion, processing, and relational database design. * Experience with Kotlin, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and GCP, or comparable technologies. * Production experience with LLMs, agents, RAG, search, or automation is a plus, as is experience with document processing and unstructured data. * Interest or experience in food manufacturing, supply chain, industrial ingredients, or other traditional industries is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $180,000 to $250,000 annually, plus 0\.5% to 1\.5% equity. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** Full\-time, on\-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build the product interfaces, backend systems, and internal tools that power reinforcement learning data workflows. You will work with research engineers and external partners to turn complex needs into polished tools for creating, evaluating, and improving training data. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior. * Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data. * Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health. * Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality review, and training infrastructure. * Collaborate with research, operations, and go\-to\-market teams to ship useful systems in ambiguous environments. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of full\-stack engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with a technical education or equivalent technical background. * Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js. * Hands\-on experience with AI, machine learning, or reinforcement learning, and ownership of products from design through deployment. * Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, along with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging. * Experience creating dashboards, observability interfaces, data inspection tools, review workflows, or quality assessment products. * Data collection, annotation, labeling, evaluation, developer tools, or partner\-facing workflow experience is valuable. Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or Grafana is also useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary range: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. jobs.title: Product Engineer
