jobs.title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build privacy and anonymization systems for an AI infrastructure team, helping make sensitive real\-world data safe and useful for model training and evaluation. You will develop end\-to\-end methods that protect sensitive information while preserving the structure and signal needed by downstream workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Build systems to detect PII, quasi\-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive information, and apply transformations suited to each data type and use case. * Develop and benchmark detection approaches combining rules, statistical models, classifiers, and LLM\-based methods. * Create production pipelines that anonymize raw data before processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data generation. * Develop evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained utility, including recall\-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re\-identification attempts. * Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields. * Work with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical safeguards. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of experience building production data or ML systems in Python, with strong proficiency in the language. * A background in a technical field and hands\-on experience detecting, removing, or transforming PII while preserving useful data characteristics. * Experience with information extraction, named\-entity recognition, classification, or related approaches for identifying rare or sensitive content. * Experience building end\-to\-end data processing pipelines and benchmarking methods across recall, precision, latency, cost, and data utility. * Knowledge of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation. * Experience handling schema drift, unusual data formats, and edge cases; familiarity with privacy\-enhancing techniques such as differential privacy, k\-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format\-preserving encryption is valuable. * Experience with low\-latency or high\-throughput ML systems and sensitive data in areas such as healthcare, finance, or security is beneficial. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $130K \- $225K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Model Evaluation

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Crusoe Managed Data Transfer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe's Managed Platform Services (MAPS) organization builds the managed services that make Crusoe Cloud easy to adopt and hard to leave, including Crusoe Container Registry, Cloud Monitoring and Managed Logs. Managed Data Transfer (MDT) is its newest service. MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data from AWS S3, and later other clouds, into Crusoe storage with a single API call: the service shards the work across a fleet of transfer workers, verifies every object, and asks the customer to run nothing. For AI labs and Physical AI companies whose data lives with a hyperscaler, it removes one of the biggest obstacles to training on Crusoe GPUs. We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the MDT control plane: the job API, scheduler and job state that turn a customer request into a coordinated, resumable transfer. You will join a new team at the beginning, take the service from first commit to its preview launch with design\-partner customers, and shape the API that new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers will plug into later. You will work closely with the Storage, Network, IAM and Cloud Console teams, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Job API and Lifecycle:** Design and build the data\-transfer API (create, list, get, cancel) with a provider\-neutral model for sources and destinations, so new clouds and storage types can be added without breaking customers. * **Scheduling and Job State:** Build the scheduler and state machine that split a bucket listing into units of work, place them on regional worker pools, and track progress, retries and resume across failures. * **Correctness at Scale:** Make petabyte\-scale jobs safe to retry and cancel, with end\-to\-end checksum verification and clear errors when a customer's permissions or destination are wrong. * **Cross\-Cloud Identity:** Implement secure access to customer buckets with short\-lived, least\-privilege credentials (AWS role assumption first, other clouds next), integrated with Crusoe IAM and audit logging. * **Customer Surfaces:** Ship the CLI and, with partner teams, the Terraform and Console experiences for creating and monitoring transfers. * **Operational Excellence:** Instrument the service with metrics, logs and alerts, write the runbooks, and take part in the team's on\-call rotation. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Agree the interfaces MDT depends on with Storage, Network, IAM and Console, and work with Product and Solutions Architects on early customer onboarding. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Backend Engineering Craft:** Experience designing and shipping production backend services and APIs, ideally in Go, with gRPC or REST, relational databases and Kubernetes. * **Professional Experience:** 5\+ years building cloud infrastructure or platform services, including taking a service from zero to general availability. * **Distributed Systems Judgment:** Comfort with long\-running, failure\-prone work: idempotency, retries with backoff, leases, checkpointing and partial failure. * **API Design:** Ability to design public APIs that customers automate against and that can grow without breaking changes. * **Security Mindset:** Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and least privilege, and care in handling customer credentials. * **Operational Ownership:** You have run services in production, been on call, and built the dashboards and alerts that keep incidents short. * **Collaboration and Writing:** You work well across teams with different priorities, and your design docs settle decisions. * **Educational Foundation:** A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Bonus Points** * Experience with large\-scale data movement, such as S3 multipart uploads, rclone, s5cmd, AWS DataSync or Google Storage Transfer Service. * Hands\-on experience with cross\-cloud identity: AWS IAM and STS, GCP service\-account impersonation, or Azure workload identity. * Experience with storage systems (object storage, NFS, parallel file systems) or high\-throughput networking. * Experience with job orchestration systems such as Temporal, Argo, or Kubernetes operators. * Experience building on GPU or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \- $205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Create an environment where it's safe to fail and set the team's reputation for being collaborative, responsive, and excellent. **What You’ll Bring to the Team:** * **Distributed Systems Depth:** Hands\-on expertise designing and operating distributed systems at scale — sharding, replication, consensus, load balancing, concurrency. You've resolved the hard problems, not just read about them. * **Range:** Comfort operating anywhere in the stack — from on\-prem infrastructure bring\-up to customer\-facing product features — and switching contexts as priorities shift. * **Prototyping Speed:** Proven ability to rapidly build high\-fidelity prototypes across a range of technologies, exploring multiple approaches in parallel and knowing when good enough is the right call. * **AI\-Augmented Development:** You use AI tools to accelerate development, research, and decision\-making — and you push their limits, building AI\-powered tooling for others rather than just consuming it. * **Performance \& Operational Excellence:** You benchmark, profile, and fix. Right level of context, concise, checks for understanding, keeps stakeholders informed without being asked. * **Professional Experience:** 10\+ years of software development experience with significant time at staff level or above. jobs.description: ### **This is a Cactus Wellhead position and is located in Houston, TX.** **Looking for local candidates.** **Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office; 1 day working from home** **JOB SUMMARY:** The Network Architect is a technical individual contributor who defines the architecture and technical direction of Cactus Companies’ enterprise networks across offices, data centers, cloud environments, manufacturing plants, and remote field locations. This hands\-on role leads complex network design and deployment, sets standards, and guides engineers through implementation and the transition to operations. Key priorities are SD\-WAN, multicloud routing, network fabric, network automation, and secure IT/OT connectivity. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, ROLES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** Essential duties and responsibilities include the following: * Own enterprise network architecture, reference designs, standards, and roadmaps for LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, cloud, and remote\-site connectivity. * Design resilient routing and switching architectures using BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, route filtering, and redundant paths. * Design, deploy, and support network switching fabric, including topology, segmentation, service provisioning, resiliency, and routed\-network integration. * Lead SD\-WAN architecture and multisite implementation, including underlay and overlay design, application\-aware routing, QoS, secure internet access, and carrier failover. * Design hybrid and multi cloud connectivity across at least two cloud platforms, including transit networks, private connections, VPNs, route propagation, and secure routing boundaries. * Develop network automation using Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and version\-controlled templates for provisioning, configuration management, validation, and repeatable deployments. * Lead network design reviews, proof\-of\-concept testing, migration planning, implementation, acceptance testing, and rollback preparation. * Partner with Cybersecurity on segmentation, firewalls, secure remote access, vulnerability remediation, and incident response. * Collaborate with manufacturing controls engineers to define IT/OT boundaries, approved traffic flows, and safe change windows that protect production availability. * Evaluate technology platforms, carriers, and vendors for reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost. * Maintain network diagrams, routing standards, IP plans, configuration baselines, architecture decisions, and operational documentation. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to network engineers and vendors; troubleshoot complex issues and lead root\-cause analysis. * Participate in change governance, scheduled maintenance, and an on\-call rotation as needed. **EDUCATION, TRAINING, EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of progressive network engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading architecture, design, or complex implementations. * Strong hands\-on routing and switching expertise, including BGP and OSPF. * Proven experience designing and implementing SD\-WAN in distributed, multisite enterprise environments. * Experience designing hybrid and multi cloud connectivity across at least two cloud platforms, including transit routing, VPNs, and private connections. * Practical experience with Ansible, Terraform, or comparable network automation tools, including version control and change validation. * General knowledge of OT segmentation and the safety, uptime, and change\-control needs of industrial environments. **CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:** * CCNP Enterprise, CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, or an equivalent advanced networking certification. * AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud networking certification. * Relevant SD\-WAN, Terraform, or network automation certifications. **JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:** * Ability to translate business needs into practical network architecture, standards, and phased delivery plans. * Advanced understanding of SD\-WAN, BGP, OSPF, routing policies, resiliency, segmentation, and network security. * Knowledge of cloud\-native networking across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud and integration with on\-premises environments. * Python scripting, API integration, or CI/CD experience for network automation is preferred. * Experience in oil and gas, energy, or heavy manufacturing is preferred. * Familiarity with the Purdue Model, ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82, and industrial network security is beneficial. * Strong collaboration, documentation, communication, problem\-solving, and technical mentoring skills. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** This role has no supervisory responsibilities. *Disclaimer: This job description is not designed to cover or contain jobs.title: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST I
jobs.description: Job Posting: Infrastructure Security Engineer Employment Development Department JC\-539388* Infrastructure Security Engineer INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST I $6,513\.00 \- $10,537\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **12/8/2026** ### **Job Description and Duties** THIS POSITION MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR A HYBRID WORK SCHEDULE. THE AMOUNT OF TELEWORK IS AT THE DISCRETION OF THE DEPARTMENT AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AS BUSINESS NEEDS ARISE. Are you looking for a challenging and rewarding position that provides hands\-on experience with enterprise infrastructure security, modern technologies, and a complex statewide IT environment? The Employment Development Department (EDD) is seeking a highly motivated and qualified Information Technology Specialist I (ITS I) to join the Infrastructure Security Engineering Group (ISEG) within the Information Technology Branch. The ITS I will play an important role in the engineering, implementation, maintenance, and operation of EDD’s statewide enterprise infrastructure security systems. This position provides an opportunity to work with a broad range of security technologies and gain valuable experience supporting critical enterprise systems, infrastructure, and sensitive information. Key Responsibilities The ITS I assists with the design and implementation of modern security infrastructure architectures, including cloud computing environments, virtual servers, and enterprise security platforms. The incumbent supports EDD’s infrastructure security engineering and operations activities, including the hardware, software, and security components necessary to protect EDD’s enterprise environment and confidential and sensitive information. Working under the direction of an Information Technology Manager I (ITM I), the incumbent performs a variety of high\-level technical assignments that require innovative problem\-solving, sound technical judgment, and the ability to work across multiple technologies and platforms. Responsibilities include: Assisting with the design, engineering, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise infrastructure security solutions. Supporting security architecture and engineering activities for complex infrastructure and technology projects. Assisting with the development and implementation of security strategies, standards, and technical solutions. Participating in security oversight activities for ongoing projects to ensure infrastructure and solutions align with EDD security requirements. Troubleshooting complex infrastructure security issues and developing effective technical solutions. Collaborating with infrastructure, networking, application, cloud, and cybersecurity teams to integrate security into enterprise solutions. Mentoring, training, and providing technical support to Infrastructure Security Operations Group (ISOG) staff to promote adherence to EDD security standards, processes, and methodologies. Supporting project teams to ensure infrastructure security deliverables are completed accurately and within established timelines. Evaluating emerging technologies and assisting with the adoption of modern security capabilities that support EDD’s evolving infrastructure and security requirements. Infrastructure Security Architecture The ITS I serves as a junior infrastructure security architect/engineer, contributing to the architecture and engineering of enterprise security solutions. The incumbent may work independently on assigned technical activities or under the direction of an ITM I on more complex infrastructure security initiatives. The position provides an opportunity to work closely with senior engineers and architects while gaining practical experience in enterprise security architecture, cloud security, infrastructure engineering, and security operations. The incumbent may also serve as a technical resource and security engineering team member on projects involving the design and implementation of EDD’s infrastructure security systems. This is an excellent opportunity for an IT professional who is interested in developing a career in enterprise infrastructure security engineering and architecture while working with a diverse range of technologies in a large, mission\-critical statewide environment. This position may be eligible for a hybrid work schedule. The amount of telework is at the discretion of the Department and is subject to change as business needs arise. jobs.title: Manager, Data Scientist (Deep Learning)
jobs.description: Manager, Data Scientist (Deep Learning) Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data * Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals **The Ideal Candidate is:** * Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. * A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. * Technical. You’re comfortable with open\-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands\-on experience developing data science solutions using open\-source tools and cloud computing platforms. * Statistically\-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. jobs.description: Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come. **Job Purpose and Impact** -------------------------- The Senior Software Engineer designs, develops and maintains software applications and systems. With minimal supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to define, design and implement new software features to meet user needs and business goals, and upgrade existing software to improve performance and functionality through writing clean, efficient and scalable code and troubleshooting and debugging complex issues. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** The IAM \& Automation Engineer is an ITSM automation developer, primarily on ServiceNow, responsible for designing, building, and continuously improving complex workflow automation for the business, with a strong focus on identity and access processes. This role modernizes the ITSM experience by building dynamic service catalog items, intuitive self\-service portals, and end\-to\-end automated workflows that replace manual, email\-based, and form\-driven processes. The engineer integrates ServiceNow with enterprise systems, such as HR, identity, and business applications, using APIs and integration tools. producers, and dynamic forms with conditional logic, validation rules, and reusable variable sets (primarily in ServiceNow). * Build complex, multi\-step ITSM workflows with approvals, tasks, notifications, and SLAs using Flow Designer, subflows, and custom actions. * Modernize and redesign outdated catalog items, forms, and self\-service portal experiences (e.g., Service Portal, Employee Center) to improve usability and adoption. * Replace manual, email\-based, and form\-driven processes with fully automated end\-to\-end workflows that reduce turnaround time and improve traceability. * Develop server\- and client\-side scripts and components, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and scheduled jobs. * Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems (e.g., HRIS, identity platforms, and business applications) using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration patterns. * Automate access\-related request, approval, fulfillment, and audit workflows, applying IAM principles such as least privilege and segregation of duties. * Create reusable components, templates, and standards so new forms and workflows can be delivered quickly and consistently. * Partner with business units to gather requirements, map current processes, and design automated solutions that improve efficiency and user experience. * Act as technical owner of workflow automation design standards and integration patterns for the team. * Identify and deliver automation opportunities across IT and Information Security processes (e.g., access reviews, offboarding, security intake, and exception requests). * Build reports and dashboards to measure workflow performance, SLA compliance, and automation impact. * Apply structured development practices, including Update Sets or source control, automated testing (e.g., ATF), peer code reviews, and the organization's standard change management process. * Design workflows that capture audit\-ready evidence (approvals, timestamps, and history) to support compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR). * Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across workflows, scripts, and integrations. * Support platform upgrades and releases by testing and remediating custom automations. * Provide operational support for the automations this role delivers, rather than day\-to\-day request fulfillment. * Assist with proofs of concept (POCs) for new platform capabilities, automation tools, and integration approaches. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and SOPs. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support critical workflow and integration issues. **Required Qualifications** * High School degree or equivalent. * 5\+ years of experience in ServiceNow or other ITSM platform development, software development, or workflow automation. * Hands\-on experience with ITSM platform development (ServiceNow strongly preferred), including: * + Service catalog, record producers, and dynamic forms + Complex, multi\-step workflows with approva  PowerShell. * Solid understanding of IAM concepts, including identity lifecycle, access requests and approvals, least privilege, role\-based access, and segregation of duties. * Familiarity with identity integration standards (e.g., SCIM, OAuth) and platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience with structured development and release practices (e.g., Update Sets, source control, automated testing, and change management). * Understanding of security and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and how they apply to workflow design. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex systems and integrations. * Proven ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high\-quality work with strong attention to detail. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to gather requirements from and explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * 2\+ years of experience supporting or automating IAM processes, such as joiner\-mover\-leaver provisioning, access requests, and access certifications. * Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Our Niagara Falls facility produces lightweight linerboard using 100% recycled fiber on a world\-class 328\-inch\-wide Valmet paper machine capable of producing more than 540,000 tons annually. Bring your expertise to a people\-first, dynamic environment where your ideas come to life and excellence shapes everything we do. Join AARON CUSHMAN's team as a **Process Engineer** in **Niagara Falls** and help build a more sustainable future. **What’s in it for you** Taking care of our people is in our nature \- so you’ll enjoy:* Annual base salary between **$94,000 \- $130,000** * *In addition, the following benefits are available subject to plan provisions and eligibility requirements:* * + Profit Sharing Bonus + Employee Share Purchase Plan + 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan With Company Match + Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage + 24/7 Access to Virtual Medical \& Counseling Services + Annual Lifestyle Spending Account (taxable benefit) + Wellness and Employee Assistance Programs + Life and Disability Insurance + Minimum of 3\-weeks Paid Vacation upon hire and 11 Company\-paid Holidays + Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable laws + Ongoing Learning and Professional Development Opportunities **Your Role** As **Process Engineer**, you’ll take on real challenges that bring out your full potential. If you bring the same care to who you are as to what you do, we’d love to meet you! Apply now and join our team as **Process Engineer** in **Niagara Falls.** *Cascades values diversity and inclusion and considers all applications equitably.* This posting is for an active vacancy within our organization. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Data Engineer who lives and breathes healthcare data end\-to\-end, understands how to make BigQuery purr across ML and Looker, and champions data as the fundamental lifeblood of our product. Operating on Google Cloud Platform, you will build unified models from multi\-source data while informing leadership of emerging trends and breathing the "art of the possible" into our products and processes. You understand the nuances, complexities, and operational realities of acquiring, ingesting, and transforming fragmented multi\-source data—from raw claims and clinical feeds to benefit designs and user telemetry. * **A Value\-Obsessed BigQuery Virtuoso:** To you, BigQuery isn't just a passive storage warehouse—it’s your ML engine, your clean room, and your business catalyst. Experience:** 8\+ years of data engineering experience with a focus on building distributed data platforms and pipelines at enterprise scale. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep hands\-on experience working with complex, multi\-source healthcare data domains (claims, clinical, eligibility, benefit structures, or HL7/FHIR formats). * **GCP \& BigQuery Value\-Centric Mastery:** Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform, specifically using BigQuery as a high\-performance engine to power ML workflows, analytics, and BI tools like Looker. * **Pipeline Orchestration:** Expert\-level capability in Python and Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer) for orchestrating complex batch and event\-driven data workflows. * **Data Modeling for Utility:** Proven track record of designing scalable schemas, into clear business strategy, inform leadership of key trends, and advocate for data\-driven product transformation across technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **What You'll Get:** * users. * **Work That Matters:** Build data systems where every pipeline directly enables personalized, actionable health insights for real people. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $144,368\.00 to jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI: Security Engineering
jobs.description: **About Cencora** ----------------- Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today! **Job Details** =============== **About the Role** Cencora is increasingly leveraging artificial intelligence to transform business operations, accelerate decision making, improve customer experiences, and drive innovation. As AI capabilities become embedded within enterprise workflows, the security challenge extends beyond protecting information. Security must protect the models, data, prompts, agents, actions, decisions, integrations, development pipelines, and operational platforms that enable AI. The Principal, AI Security serves as the senior\-most technical authority responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise AI security strategy. This role focuses on solving the most complex engineering and architecture problems associated with AI adoption. The position is intentionally an individual contributor role rather than a people\-management position. You will influence through technical depth, architecture, innovation, and thought leadership. **What You Will Own** * AI Security Architecture and reference standards * Agentic AI and autonomous action security * AI Data Protection and privacy\-by\-design controls * Secure AI Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC) * MLOps and AI platform security * Model and AI supply chain security * AI runtime protection, monitoring, and detection engineering * AI red teaming, assurance, and adversarial testing * Enterprise AI security tooling and strategy * Technical mentoring and organizational guidance **Core Responsibilities** Lead architecture reviews for Generative AI, copilots, machine learning platforms, autonomous agents, and AI\-enabled business applications. Design security controls to ensure AI systems operate safely, transparently, and within defined trust boundaries. Develop standards governing model deployment, prompt security, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, training data protection, model access controls, and agent authorization. Establish safeguards preventing data leakage, prompt injection, model abuse, unauthorized actions, and sensitive information exposure. Partner with Security Operations, Engineering, Cloud, Identity, Data Protection, Legal, Privacy, and Enterprise Architecture teams to operationalize AI security controls at enterprise scale. Evaluate and implement AI security technologies, including monitoring, attack detection, model validation, policy enforcement, and agent oversight capabilities. Perform threat modeling and adversarial security assessments focused on emerging attack vectors including prompt injection, indirect prompt attacks, model poisoning, model theft, jailbreak techniques, and agent privilege escalation. Establish assurance programs that continuously validate the effectiveness of AI security controls throughout development, deployment, and production operations. **Required Qualifications** * 12\+ years of cybersecurity, application security, cloud security, platform security, or related engineering experience. * Demonstrated expertise in multiple security domains including AI Security, Data Protection, Cloud Security, Application Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Engineering, and Security Operations. * Experience securing enterprise AI platforms, machine learning environments, Generative AI services, or AI\-powered business workflows. * Deep understanding of AI attack surfaces and adversarial techniques. * Strong background in cloud\-native architectures, APIs, automation, and security engineering. * Ability to influence executives and engineering leaders through technical expertise and written communication. **Preferred Qualifications** * CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, SC\-100, SC\-200, SC\-400 or equivalent certifications. * Experience with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, ISO 42001, and related AI governance frameworks. * Healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry experience. * Experience with AI agents, copilots, model serving platforms, and modern AI orchestration frameworks.. **What Cencora offers** ======================= We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit https://www.virtualfairhub.com/cencora Full time**Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law. The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non\-discriminatory. Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888\.692\.2272 or email hrsc@cencora.com. We will make accommodation determinations on a request\-by\-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned **Affiliated Companies** ======================== Affiliated Companies: AmerisourceBergen Services Corporation

jobs.description: Citian is a fast growing, venture backed SaaS technology company based in Washington, DC. Our engineers and data scientists apply the latest in emerging tech, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to build smarter, more advanced tools for our diverse client base. We work with clients across the United States, with global ambitions in the years ahead. **Who You Are:** As an AI Lead Engineer on Citian's Data Success team, you ensure our digital products meet the engineering\-level accuracy required by state and local government clients. Every agency's network has both common and unique features of geometry, structure, labeling, and management practices. You use AI, customized reasoning and logic, and mathematical models to convert these assets into clean, standardized data that powers our CRASH and ADAPT products. You plan and optimize the full lifecycle of digitalizing different assets to meet accuracy requirements. You build and run data cleaning, ingestion, and extraction pipelines; apply LLMs, computer vision, mathematical models, and reasoning where they accelerate the work; and design, improve, and execute evaluation plans that prove the output is correct. You work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff, and you can explain data issues clearly to both traffic engineers and software engineers. You are resourceful with mathematics and AI technologies, have strong engineering judgment, care about getting the details right, and want your work to have a direct impact on transforming transportation infrastructure. **Expected Duties:** * Own data accuracy for the digitalization of new and existing state and local government clients, from the initial data request through production\-ready data in Citian's products. * Work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff to understand their management needs and existing data sources, obtain access, and resolve gaps or inconsistencies. * Build, optimize, improve, and maintain pipelines that collect spatial and temporal data (such as 3D\-registered spherical images) and integrate data from other sensors and client systems, including databases, APIs, Esri/ArcGIS services, open data portals, and file transfers. * Own the accuracy of extracting roadway and infrastructure assets from point clouds, imagery, measurements, and other geospatial sources. * Apply AI\-assisted development, mathematical modeling, logical reasoning, and coding to map each agency's infrastructure data onto Citian's standard data model. * Build automated and rigorous QA/QC checks that validate digitalized results against ground truth, and design methods to collect or estimate ground truth. * Evaluate third\-party AI tools, APIs, and mathematical models for extraction work, and weigh build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs with Engineering. * Document data sources, mappings, and processes for each client so onboarding is repeatable and scalable. * Partner with Customer Success, Account Management, and Product to set data timelines, communicate data issues, and feed client needs back into the product roadmap. **Required Skills \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field. * 3\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related role. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and advanced mathematical models to real\-world data, ideally in a product environment. * Proficiency in Python and SQL for building data pipelines and transforming data. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs, mathematical models, and reasoning to digitalize physical environments at high accuracy. * Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and related data tools. * Experience building engineering\-based and computer\-based data validation and quality checks. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work directly with external clients and explain technical issues to non\-technical audiences. Salary Range: $150,000 \- 250,000 **Your Citian Advantage:** * Competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance and generous PTO. * 401(k) company match and monthly commuter transportation benefit * On\-site gym and free snacks in the office * High\-growth potential and opportunities for advancement within a fast growing, venture\-backed SaaS startup! jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI & Agents
jobs.description: **About Cloaked** Cloaked is a privacy startup dedicated to rebuilding consumer trust in how personal data is used. Nearly a million paying members use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them. That covers masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through. We've protected tens of millions of identities, screened hundreds of millions of calls, and removed billions of records from data brokers. Backed by a $375M Series B. **About the Role** This role is a **Senior Product Manager on the Agents and Automation team**. Our members trust us with high\-stakes tasks involving their most sensitive information. We build personalized AI that connects to their inbox, their incoming calls, and the apps they use, spots what needs attention, and handles it in the background: removing their data, screening spam, and acting on their behalf, all while ensuring they stay in control the whole way. You'll own the systems and experiences behind that work: what it can do, how well it does it, how it knows what to do, all the surfaces it protects, and how members come to trust it enough to let us do more. We're looking for people who find problems and solve them. You'll find where things break for members, own each problem until it's fixed, and make sure it stays fixed. **What will you do?** * Find the problems yourself: talk to members, dig into reports, chat transcripts, and data to see where the AI falls short * Own each outcome to the finish: prove it's fixed and leave monitors so we know if it breaks. Then push those numbers and make the case for where we invest next * Prototype new flows yourself with AI tools before asking for engineering time * Communicate progress, challenges, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders **What skills and experiences will help you?** * 5\+ years in product, with consumer products you owned end to end * You've shipped AI or automation features to real users and dealt with what happens when they fail * You can make something technical feel simple for consumers * You understand how AI agents use tools and act for people, and you know how to judge when an AI product is good enough to ship * You can name metrics you moved, how you moved them, and the data that proved it * Data skills: comfortable with SQL, and able to identify, interpret, visualize, and improve metrics that drive business goals * You're technical. You can read code and hold your own in a design review * You build with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, and you can show us something you built * Plus points for privacy, security, identity, or AI safety and governance * Plus points for eval experience, especially for multi\-step agent behavior and non\-deterministic outcomes outside of simple LLM outputs * Plus points for using agents in your free time **What do we like?** * A get\-it\-done mindset. You don't wait to be asked to solve problems. We are driven to create solutions and resolve problems in a fast\-paced environment * Comfort working with various teams across the org to determine the best solution * Passion for security and internet ethics with a commitment to service leadership * Startup or growth\-stage company experience * Interest in data and analytics * Care and respect for our members' privacy as if it were your own **What we offer** ----------------- Cloaked is a well\-funded Series B startup based out of NYC. We're a distributed company with a hybrid model for our NYC team. Our Union Square office has multiple fully stocked kitchens, gaming consoles and relaxation areas, a nap pod, plus we do regular team outings and socials. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * $200K to $250K base, plus bonus and equity * We offer above market rate pay and equity using the market's best commercially available data * 401K, as well as top of the line Health, Dental, and Vision benefits * A home office stipend and a new company laptop **Perks** --------- * Competitive PTO. We encourage employees to take a minimum number of vacation days per quarter * A monthly health stipend for physical, mental, or emotional care * A monthly meal stipend for days when there's no time to cook * A professional development fund, and support to attend conferences and industry events **Our Values** 1\. Do the impossible for everyday people. 2\. Use what we build, build what we would use. 3\. Prioritize value delivery. 4\. Stay curious and get better. 5\. Be candid and kind. 6\. Under one cloak toward one mission. Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Position Summary Quality Engineer provides hands\-on technical leadership for contract medical device manufacturing at Command Medical Products’ Florida facility. The role independently leads quality investigations and assigned improvement projects, supports maintenance and improvement of the ISO 13485 quality management system, and helps ensure products meet customer specifications, quality agreements, and applicable regulatory requirements. Quality Engineer works with Operations, Engineering, suppliers, customers, and Quality leadership to strengthen process controls, resolve quality issues, and support new product and process transfers. Essential Responsibilities · Develop, maintain, and improve procedures, work instructions, forms, inspection and sampling plans, and quality records supporting ISO 13485 and applicable FDA QMSR requirements. Implement customer requirements defined in quality agreements, identify gaps between requirements and actual practices, and complete assigned actions. · Provide daily quality engineering support for tubing extrusion, RF welding, bonding, cleanroom manufacturing, and medical device assembly. · Lead investigations of nonconforming materials and products, customer complaints, supplier corrective action requests (SCARs), and process failures. Establish containment, apply structured root cause analysis, coordinate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and verify effectiveness. Manage assigned customer quality communications and provide timely, complete investigation responses. · Support equipment, cleanroom, and process qualifications and validations, including IQ, OQ, and PQ as applicable. Define acceptance criteria, analyze results, resolve deviations, and assess revalidation needs. Lead assigned process risk assessments and process failure mode and effects analyses (PFMEAs). · Plan and conduct internal audits within assigned qualifications. Support customer and certification audits and regulatory inspections. · Support new product introductions, process transfers, and change control. Review customer requirements; establish inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and validation requirements; and verify completion of assigned quality activities before routine production release. · Review manufacturing records for completeness and accuracy. Support document control, training records, product identification, lot traceability, and product release within assigned authority. · Monitor defects, scrap, rework, complaints, SCARs, and CAPA status. Use statistical process control, capability studies, and trend analysis to prioritize improvements and report results to management. · Train and coach inspectors, operators, and other personnel on inspection methods, good documentation practices, applicable procedures, and ISO 13485 requirements. Mentor less experienced quality staff. · Independently manage assigned priorities and deadlines. Place suspect material or product on hold within delegated authority. Escalate product safety, compliance, and significant quality risks, and initiate or request production or shipment holds under established procedures. Approve disposition and release only within assigned authority. Required Qualifications · Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Biomedical, or another relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent experience. · Typically, five or more years of progressively responsible quality engineering or related manufacturing quality experience, including at least three years in medical device manufacturing. · Practical knowledge of ISO 13485 and applicable FDA QMSR requirements, with demonstrated experience applying them in medical device manufacturing and meeting customer quality requirements. · Demonstrated ability to independently lead investigations, CAPA, validation activities, and quality improvement projects. Working knowledge of manufacturing risk management and ISO 14971 principles. · Experience with medical device manufacturing processes such as tubing extrusion, RF welding, bonding, or assembly. Ability to interpret engineering drawings and apply dimensional inspection, statistical methods, process capability analysis, and measurement system analysis. Preferred Qualifications · ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent; ISO 13485 lead auditor certification. · ISO Class 7 or cleaner manufacturing experience, including ISO 14644 qualification and environmental monitoring. · Proficiency with statistical software such as Minitab and electronic QMS platforms. Working Conditions and General ExpectationsWork is performed in office, manufacturing, and cleanroom areas with exposure to operating equipment, noise, and process materials. Follow site safety rules, protective measures, product handling controls, and cleanroom gowning requirements. Occasional travel to other CMP facilities, suppliers, or customer locations may be required. Perform other related duties assigned by management. Responsibilities and approval authority are governed by company procedures and delegated authority. Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * A customer reports that two assemblies leaked during use and provides a lot number, but the samples are unavailable. What would you ask the customer for, and what would you review internally? * Production wants to move a customer’s product to a different machine that makes the same part to the same drawing. How would you determine whether customer notification or approval is needed before the move? * Your inspection plan calls for a random sample of 32 units, with an acceptance number of 1 and a rejection number of 2\. You find two nonconforming units. What is the lot’s status, and what would you do next? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Systems Engineer / IT Technician (MSP)
jobs.description: **Systems Engineer / IT Technician (MSP)** **Client Environment Owner** Computer Engineering Group · Napa, CA · Full\-time, on\-site · $35–45/hour DOE · Growth opportunity **About the role** Computer Engineering Group is a managed IT services provider (MSP) supporting small businesses across the Napa Valley. We're hiring a systems engineer / IT technician to take ownership of the technical health of a group of client networks — typically 20 to 100 users each. This is a hands\-on technical role, not sales and not customer success. We have a proven technology roadmap that defines where a healthy client environment should be. Your job is to get to know each client's environment, then propose, plan, and execute the projects that bring it into alignment with that roadmap — and do the hands\-on build and configuration work yourself. You won't be doing it alone. You'll be backed by experienced management, a dedicated account management team that owns the client relationship, and a senior engineer to learn from and escalate to. This is a genuine growth opportunity: a chance for a capable tech to step into real environment ownership with the structure and support to succeed at it. **What you'll do** * Take ownership of the technical health of a handful of small\-business client networks (20–100 users each). * Assess each environment against CEG's standard technology roadmap and identify the gaps. * Propose, plan, and execute the projects that bring each client into alignment — firewall and network deployments (UniFi / SonicWALL / Meraki), site\-to\-site and client VPN, VLAN segmentation, Entra ID and Microsoft 365 migrations, Intune/Autopilot device rollouts, backup/DR, and security cleanup. * Do the hands\-on build, configuration, and troubleshooting day to day. * Serve as the escalation point for the tougher, environment\-specific issues on your accounts (not the routine ticket queue), with a senior engineer above you when you need one. * Work alongside the account management team, who handle the client relationship and approvals so you can focus on the technical work. **What we're looking for** * 2–4 years in an MSP, IT services, or business IT environment, with real hands\-on infrastructure work. * Networking: hands\-on with business firewalls and switching — configuring firewall rules, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, and VPN (site\-to\-site and client). We run UniFi, SonicWALL, and Meraki day to day; deep experience in any one and willingness to learn the others is what matters. * Entra ID / Microsoft 365: managing users, groups, and licensing; Entra ID join; SSO and MFA/Conditional Access; and troubleshooting sign\-in and access issues. Exposure to Azure (VMs, basic resource management) and Purview/compliance is a plus. * Intune / endpoint management: enrolling and provisioning devices through Intune and Autopilot, pushing configuration and app policies, Company Portal, and Windows/Apple device management (Apple Business Manager a plus). * Windows Server, Active Directory, and backup/DR fundamentals. * Ready to take responsibility for client environments and plan work that holds up — and eager to grow into it with support. * Able to explain technical issues to non\-technical business owners without the jargon. * Experience with PSA/RMM and documentation tools (ConnectWise, IT Glue/Hudu, or similar) is a plus. * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to local client sites. **Nice to have** * RMM/automation tooling (Rewst or equivalent) and network monitoring (Auvik or similar). * Certifications: Microsoft (MD\-102, Azure/M365\), CompTIA Network\+/Security\+. * Experience with wine, hospitality, agriculture, or nonprofit clients. **Why this is a growth opportunity** * A clear roadmap to work toward, so you're never guessing what “good” looks like. * A senior engineer and experienced management to learn from and lean on. * An account team that handles the client relationship and sales side, so your energy stays on the technology. * Real ownership of environments and projects, with room to grow into deeper technical leadership as you prove yourself. **Benefits** * **Medical, dental, and vision insurance —** CEG covers 50% of the employee premium to start (coverage begins the first of the month after 60 days), stepping up with tenure: the company covers 99% of the employee premium after 2 years, and 99% of employee \+ family coverage after 5 years. * **Retirement plan —** 2% company contribution of your annual earnings. * **Paid time off —** vacation that accrues faster with tenure, 40 hours of paid sick leave per year, plus 8 paid holidays. * **On\-call stipend —** when you're in the on\-call rotation. * Company\-provided uniform and equipment. **This role is NOT** * A sales or account\-management role — you make the technical case, you don't chase leads or carry a quota. * A Tier 1 helpdesk seat — routine tickets live with the helpdesk. * A desk\-only advisory role — expect to be hands\-on in environments every day. Pay: $35\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Ability to Commute: * Napa, CA 94558 (Required) Work Location: In person

identify relevant data, and partner with engineering and data engineers to drive delivery. **Work Location**: Scottsdale, AZ – Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Responsibilities:** * Embed platform, defining data strategies and building the foundational data layer for organization\-wide data orchestration across diverse consumers. * Partner closely with business and product teams to understand the business domain, define use cases, and identify relevant data sources. * Collaborate with engineering and data engineering teams to drive execution and take accountability for system uptime in production. * Design, build, and manage lakehouse architectures using Databricks (Spark, Delta, Unity Catalog), Databricks Genie, and hands\-on ownership of bronze, silver, and gold data layers. * Architect and maintain scalable ingestion and streaming pipelines (Kafka, ETL/ELT at scale, blob storage) with self\-healing and automated alerting capabilities. * Build and optimize operational data stores, including production PostgreSQL, pgVector, embeddings, vector databases, and Redis caching strategies. * Design and tune search and retrieval solutions using Azure AI Search, covering index and schema design, indexers, hybrid retrieval, semantic reranking, and freshness/relevance tuning. * Develop semantic models and BI solutions leveraging Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. * Deliver machine learning models in production, owning the lifecycle from classifier training through serving, evaluation, drift detection, and retraining. * Build document intelligence and multi\-modal RAG pipelines capable of extracting and grounding information across unstructured, scanned, text, table, and image sources. * Establish MLOps and reliability practices, including CI/CD for data and models, observability, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call ownership. * Lead live platform migrations, moving data architectures from one platform to another with zero disruption to active consumers. * Manage Azure cloud infrastructure at depth, driving active cloud and data platform cost optimization. * Build query interfaces for AI agents, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and text\-to\-SQL tooling over governed data. **Requirements** * 12\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience building and maintaining production\-scale systems with direct accountability for uptime. * Proven ability to define data strategies and build foundational data layers from the ground up for organization\-wide orchestration. * Concrete, hands\-on experience across most of the following technical areas: * **Lakehouse \& Processing:** Databricks (Spark, Delta, Unity Catalog), Databricks Genie, and ownership of bronze, silver, and gold layers. * **Ingestion \& Streaming:** Redis caching strategies. * **Search \& Retrieval:** Azure AI Search (index and schema design, indexers, hybrid retrieval, semantic reranking, freshness and relevance tuning). * **Semantics \& BI:** Microsoft Fabric, semantic modeling, and Power BI. * **ML in Production:** End\-to\-end classifiers from training through serving, evaluation, drift detection, and retraining. * **Document Intelligence \& Multi\-Modal RAG:** Extraction from unstructured and scanned sources, grounded over mixed text, table, and image content. * **MLOps \& Reliability:** CI/CD for data and models, observability, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call ownership. * **Platform Migration:** Hands\-on experience migrating data architectures between platforms with live consumers. * **Cloud \& Cost Management:** Deep Azure expertise paired with active cloud and data platform cost management. * **Query Interfaces for Agents:** Building MCP servers and text\-to\-SQL tooling over governed data. * Willingness and ability to work in a hybrid model in **Scottsdale, AZ.** **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. * 12\+ years of hands\-on software, data, or machine learning engineering experience in production environments. **Good to Have:** * **Agentic AI \& Orchestration:** Familiarity with agentic AI patterns and orchestration engines such as LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, understanding how downstream agents consume data and ML platforms. * **Advanced RAG Architecture:** Deep understanding of retrieval strategies, grounding, context assembly, and failure modes beyond basic implementations. * **Workflow Architecture:** Ability to determine where deterministic workflows vs. jobs.description: Come join our team at DIS\-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery \- are our biggest assets. Your work will help teams turn information from across the organization into trusted data for reporting, analysis, and better decisions. In this role, you’ll develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, improve data quality, and optimize data workflows. You’ll also help establish the standards, ownership, and documentation that keep our data accurate, accessible, and secure. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys hands\-on technical work, solving business problems, and collaborating with the people who use the solutions they build. At DIS\-TRAN Steel, we believe the future is built by people who are inspired to grow, empowered to innovate, and committed to make a lasting impact. Together, we’re building stronger careers, stronger communities, and the infrastructure that powers them. ### **EXPECTATIONS:** * Performs quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision. * Interacts professionally with employees, customers, and business partners. * Works effectively as a team contributor while taking ownership of individual responsibilities. * Communicates progress, challenges, and priorities with their supervisor and other team members. * Looks for opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data reliability, and expand technical knowledge. ### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develops and maintains scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to collect, transform, and deliver data from structured and unstructured sources. * Connects data across manufacturing and business systems, including manufacturing execution systems (MES), supervisory control and data acquisition systems (SCADA), enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), and customer relationship management systems (CRM). * Collaborates with data architects to understand database models and improve data storage in SQL databases and cloud data warehouses. * Builds and maintains data quality checks to identify errors and ensure data is accurate, complete, and reliable. * Monitors and troubleshoots data pipelines, resolving issues and improving performance and cost efficiency. * Works with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver data that supports reporting and analytical solutions. * Maintains documentation, naming conventions, version control practices, and change management processes for data pipelines and infrastructure. ### **ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Helps develop and implement data governance standards, including data quality, metadata, master data, privacy, and access controls. * Works with department leaders to define data ownership, common business definitions, and how data moves between systems. * Coordinates requirements. * Performs other duties as assigned. ### **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Library and Information Science, Computer Science, Business Administration with a Data/IT focus, or a related field. * Five or more years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, data management, data quality, data governance, or a similar role. * Demonstrated experience building data products, using business data to solve problems, or implementing data governance frameworks. * Familiarity with SQL, cloud data warehouses, and enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, or CRM. * Familiarity with data integration and transformation tools such as dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, Apache NiFi, or custom\-built solutions. * Understanding of manufacturing processes, data compliance, and risk management practices. * Strong troubleshooting, organization, and communication skills. * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and work with both technical and business teams. * Experience implementing data governance practices is a plus. ### **WORKING CONDITIONS:** * Works indoors in an office and manufacturing jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Core
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Why You'll Love This Role** Cribl Search powers high\-speed investigations for security and IT teams at some of the world's largest enterprises. Whether data lives in Lakehouse Engines or is spread across Federated sources, Search unifies ingest, storage, and analysis into a single experience — no tool\-hopping, no complex orchestration. Teams collect once, search anywhere, and investigate with no blind spots. Now add agentic AI to the picture. AI\-driven workloads are exploding, autonomous agents are firing queries alongside human analysts, and the volume and complexity of concurrent searches is growing fast. The query engine at the heart of Cribl Search needs to be faster, more concurrent, and more resilient than ever — and that's where you come in. Cribl is looking for a backend\-focused Staff Software Engineer to join a remote\-first, diverse, inclusive, cross\-functional team of software developers focused on making search stupid fast. You will play a central role in evolving the query engine at the heart of Cribl Search – breaking through concurrency ceilings, optimizing query dispatching and execution, and tuning performance for workloads ranging from interactive analyst investigations to AI agents firing thousands of concurrent queries. This is an ideal role for anyone who is passionate about making Search blazing fast at a massive scale. On top of it all, you will have fun! Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will …** * Contribute to technical direction, bringing strong, loosely held, opinions to shape how Cribl Search evolves as a platform for multiple products * Own high\-impact changes to large\-scale systems, increasing performance and concurrency for both human and AI\-driven agentic workloads * Build and support a strong foundation for Cribl Search as a whole, collaborating across various teams and divisions * Champion improvements to performance, reliability, and operability * Drive clarity across multiple stakeholders and ambiguous requirements, communicating tradeoffs and risks of competing priorities * Partner with leadership to translate organizational needs from across the business into actionable plans on our roadmap * Lead projects end\-to\-end – from ideation, scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support * Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye toward observability and resilience * Share on\-call responsibilities as part of a team that embraces service ownership * Help define and refine the software development practices that make our team effective – everybody's feedback helps shape our process * We are a remote\-first company and work happens across many time\-zones – this position will require stand\-by, on\-call, or off\-hours duties **If You've Got \- We Want It** * Strong experience designing and operating multiple\-petabyte\-scale data systems, including object and distributed storage * Experience building search, query, and/or analytic systems working with structured and unstructured data * Deep understanding of how search tools work – indexing, inverted indices, query parsing, and execution (think Lucene/Solr, Elasticsearch) * Experience working on high\-performance, data\-intensive applications where concurrency, throughput, and latency matter * Familiarity with compilers, ASTs, and query language internals * Polyglot engineer – C\+\+ experience is highly desirable * Ability to problem\-solve from first principles and maintain focus on overarching objectives * Demonstrated ability to lead projects through ambiguity, driving technical decisions across team boundaries * Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – able to explain complex technical topics to stakeholders in remote, distributed environments * Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team * Experience with C\+\+, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you'll ever meet at cribl.io/about\-us.
