jobs.title: Manager - Data Strategy, Enterprise Reporting and Implementation
jobs.description: CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human\-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future. For CFOs, CIOs, and corporate leaders to cost\-effectively achieve strategic growth, real\-time data insights, competitive differentiation, and complete compliance, they need a robust digital architecture that maximizes technology investments and process efficiencies. Our data systems specialists design, build, and deploy leading data, analytics, and automation programs that generate rapid ROI across the enterprise. By joining our rapidly growing Data Transformation \& Analytics practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You will bring your first\-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver tailored integrated solutions that help our clients solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. As an Associate Director at CrossCountry Consulting you will be responsible for a mix of client delivery, leading teams and developing junior team members, and participating in business development activities. ### **What You’ll Do:** * Serve as a strategic thought partner to C\-suite executives on data initiatives, understanding client personas (CFO, CIO, CHRO, CAO) and advising on harnessing data to support strategic goals. * Advise clients on establishing a technology and data strategy program that democratizes data, leverages modern cloud platforms, promotes data management, uncovers critical control needs, monitors data quality, and more. * Enhance clients’ technology stack and serve as Solution Architect to implement, collect, store, transform, process, and analyze data in a single source of truth consistently, efficiently, and without siloes. * Architect and design scalable, secure, and high\-performance data solutions across multiple cloud platforms. * Lead end\-to\-end data solution implementation, including ingestion, storage, transformation, and visualization using tools like Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse Analytics, Fivetran, Talend, PowerBI, Tableau, and Sigma Computing. * Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and developers to define technical requirements and best practices. * Develop and enforce data governance, security, and compliance standards across data platforms. * Optimize data pipelines and ETL processes for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions to improve data infrastructure and analytics capabilities. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to data engineers and other team members. * Ensure seamless integration of data platforms within the enterprise architecture. * Support clients with the design and implementation of forecasting and predictive analytics models. * Interview clients to identify root causes of challenges; define and document business requirements. * Conduct current state / future state gap analysis for business and data processes. * Create executive level communications and presentations * Mentor team members by coaching colleagues, providing regular ongoing feedback and annual performance reviews, and helping project teams resolve complex issues. * Support business development by building relationships with key internal and external stakeholder * Contribute to go\-to\-market strategy and practice\-specific programs ### **What You’ll Bring:** * Prior experience managing client and/or internal teams by guiding performance against objectives, creating an atmosphere of trust and collaboration, and encouraging continuous improvement and innovation. * Experience and proficiency advising clients on modernizing their data architecture and using data analytics tools for cleansing and visualization (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx). * Knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Lean, Waterfall). * Understanding of key finance (and other) processes like Lead to Cash / Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, Hire to Retire. * Experience in supporting Large Enterprise organizations, Private Equity portfolio companies or Private Equity sponsors preferred. * Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and guiding project teams in resolving complex and multi\-faceted issues. * Passionate about building, developing, motivating, and leading others. ### **Qualifications:** * 9\+ years of professional experience leading initiatives or client engagements with a focus on data strategy, data architecture, data engineering, or cloud\-based analytics solutions, dealing with large data sets and interpreting data to draw meaningful insights and recommendations. * 5\+ years of experience in implementation of Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse Analytics. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * 5\+ years of experience managing technical teams focused on delivering analytical products and solutions * Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, data lake architectures, and real\-time data processing * Understanding of data security best practices, compliance standards, and access control. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced, agile environment. * Strong communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, or a similar discipline. * Proficiency in SQL * Understanding of Python programming language (emphasis on Pandas, NumPy, matplotlib packages) * MBA / CPA \[preferred]. * Certification in Snowflake / Alteryx / PowerBI / Tableau \[preferred]. * SnowPro Advanced Certification \[highly preferred]. * Willingness to travel based on client preferences. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-NB1 ***Benefits Summary*** *The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: CrowdVolt is on a mission to make going out effortless, starting with a fully automated ticket marketplace for raves and electronic music. We launched out of Y Combinator in 2024 and have since raised a $2\.5M seed round from Goodwater, Brickyard, Pioneer Fund and other top\-tier investors, along with angels including co\-founders of YouTube and Kickstarter. We're growing fast and staying small and elite. We're bringing on a Design Engineer to own how CrowdVolt looks, moves and feels. You'll work directly with our CTO, engineers and designers, and you'll ship your own designs to production. ### **What you'll do** * Design and build responsive, high\-performance interfaces, sweating the typography, motion, empty states and pixel\-level detail. * Own and evolve our design system across components, tokens and interaction patterns, keeping Figma and code in lockstep. * Own and ship features across our entire product, from idea and prototype through deployment. * Drive product and design decisions through direct user feedback and data analysis. ### **Our ideal candidate** * Intensely curious about design, software engineering, technology and learning generally. * Obsessed with craft and taste, and fanatical about polish, down to the pixel. * Has a portfolio (or projects) that shows both design sensibility and shipped frontend work, or experience owning large sections of a codebase. * Fluent in React, TypeScript, Tailwind and modern CSS, with a strong feel for motion and animation (Framer Motion, GSAP or similar) and Figma. * Biased toward action and rapid iteration; can go from a sketch to a working, interactive prototype in hours. * Uses, or can quickly adapt to, an AI\-native workflow: comfortable delegating work to models, writing code with AI and building agents, and always looking for ways to automate repetitive work. ### **Our values** * **Anything is possible.** People have solved much harder problems than ours. Stop making excuses and find a way to make it work. * **Not a playground.** We have a lot of fun, but we're dead serious about what we do and obsessed with winning. * **Overcommunicate.** Be direct. We all have positive intentions and want the best for each other. * **Ruthless prioritization.** Focus on what matters most, build incrementally and ship as fast as possible. * **AI\-focused.** Use AI every day to move faster, work smarter and do more with less. * **Fan first.** Fans are our number one stakeholder. We always go out of our way to give them the best experience possible. ### **What we offer** * **Salary.** $120,000 to $200,000 a year. * **Meaningful equity.** You own part of what you build. * **Comprehensive benefits.** Health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family. * **Unlimited PTO.** Recharge when you need to. * **Lots of food.** Costco deliveries and home\-cooked food. * **Paid dinner in the office.** If you're working late, it's on us. * **Off\-sites.** Dinners and trips away together. We're a scrappy startup, and we work incredibly hard. If you want to make a real impact, grow fast and help make going out effortless, we'd love to hear from you. Compensation Range: $120K \- $200K

jobs.description: ### **About CWILL** CWILL (pronounced 'quill') is a post\-purchase and retention suite built for Shopify brands. Reduce support tickets, recover lost revenue from returns, and turn one\-time buyers into loyal fans — with tools purpose\-built for every touchpoint that follows the sale. ### **About the Role** We're building AI agent capabilities for Shopify merchants across order tracking, AI chat and customer support workflows, supported by Shopify data integration, the merchant admin and reporting. As an R\&D Trainee, you'll learn through mentorship, hands\-on development and direct customer interaction. During your first three months, you'll help with customer support and small customizations to understand merchant needs, while building the skills to own full\-stack features independently. **Product Intro:** https://www.cwill.com/products/ai\-chat/ **Base location required:** Cary, NC (We are unable to hire in other states; relocation will be required.) Hybrid remote working setting ### **What You'll Do** **Customer Issue Support** * Investigate and resolve technical issues from user and support tickets, quickly finding the root cause across frontend and backend (data errors, API errors, display problems and more) * Classify issues by type and severity, respond quickly to urgent ones and drive fixes to completion * Document frequent issues as troubleshooting guides and FAQs to reduce repeat tickets * Work with support and product to reproduce problems, and provide data corrections or workarounds when needed * Work directly with merchants alongside the customer success team to understand their workflows, assist with product setup and resolve technical questions * With guidance from your mentor, deliver small customer\-specific customizations and turn recurring requests into reusable product improvements **Customer Collaboration and Customization** * Help clarify customer requirements, assess technical feasibility and implement scoped customizations with your mentor * Prioritize urgent customer issues with the team, communicate progress clearly and verify that fixes address the customer's problem **Product Improvements** * With guidance from your mentor, develop features across order tracking, AI chat, Shopify data integration, the merchant admin and reporting — from frontend and backend development through testing and release * Help build and improve AI agent capabilities such as order lookup, delivery\-status assistance, knowledge\-base responses and human handoff * Improve performance, refactor code and reduce technical debt to make the system more stable and responsive * Improve frontend interactions and page load speed, and optimize backend API performance and database queries * Join requirement reviews and give input on technical feasibility ### **Your Growth Path** * **Months 1–3:** Learn the product, architecture and main workflows. adoption. * Ability to travel 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data. * 8\+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on front\-end/UI engineering for high\-traffic, customer\-facing web applications. * Deep expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern component framework (Angular and/or React), including modernization work (control flow, signals, standalone components) and building or maintaining reusable component libraries / design systems. * Proven track record owning a critical domain or shared platform end\-to\-end — from architecture and design through production operations, feature flags, and release management — with cross\-team adoption. * Experience building or integrating AI/LLM and agentic capabilities — agent skills/harnesses, AI\-assisted developer tooling, or customer\-facing intelligent features (search, personalization, conversational/agent flows). * Experience with, or exposure to, AWS Kiro or similar AI\-powered development tools, and understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, agent patterns, or model integration. * Strong web performance (Lighthouse, CLS, lazy loading, bundling) and accessibility (WCAG) discipline. * Working proficiency in at least one back\-end/serverless language (Node.js, Python, or Java) and familiarity with AWS and cloud\-native delivery. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline) and automated release/documentation infrastructure. * Demonstrated technical leadership — high\-quality code review at scale, design guidance, authoring integration guides / architecture decision records, and mentoring. * Familiarity with DevOps practices and containerization concepts (Docker/Kubernetes). * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail; strong communication and collaboration, including partnering with UX designers. ### **What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications)** * Experience working in an airline technology environment. * AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. * Understanding of networking and security principles in cloud environments. * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related technical field. * Experience building agent frameworks, skills systems, CLIs, or AI\-assisted retrofit/generation tooling that accelerate other engineers. * Solid knowledge of AI agentic development and strong knowledge of Agent Harness concepts and how cloud providers implement them. * Exposure to the AWS AgentCore platform. * Experience with authentication/security surfaces (OAuth, MFA, risk\-based auth, vendor SDK integration) or checkout/payments on high\-traffic sites. * Experience owning a jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Network Engineer **Number of Positions:** 1 **Location:** Okemos, MI **Location Specifics:** Hybrid Position **Job Summary:** At Delta Dental of Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana we work to improve oral health through benefit plans, advocacy and community support, and we amplify this mission by investing in initiatives that build healthy, smart, vibrant communities. We are one of the largest dental plan administrators in the country, and are part of the Delta Dental Plans Association, which operates two of the largest dental networks in the nation. At Delta Dental, we celebrate our All In culture. It’s a mindset, feeling and attitude we wrap around all that we do – from taking charge of our careers, to helping colleagues and lending a hand in the community. **Position Description:** To implement, monitor, configure, and provide administration of the Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and other network infrastructure systems, including but not limited to Routers, Switches, Firewalls, and Load Balancers. **Primary Job Responsibilities:** * Administers switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, and VPN infrastructure across the Enterprise. * Primary administrator and Level 2 approver for all network change management activities or functions including the security/subnets/Vlans/cabling infrastructure to support eCommerce and other Internet or internal systems. Configures trunk groups and virtual switches for various virtual server systems. * Administers network\-based services such as wireless, workstation security agents/VPN, access control, intrusion detection, firewall, load balancer and SD\-WAN optimization services. * Administers TCP/IP on the network including design and tracking of the IP infrastructure and DHCP systems. Level 2 responder to Network related Incidents. * Performs administrative functions to ensure viable production environment including bandwidth monitoring, syslog, and content filtering. * Analyzes bandwidth monitoring, content filtering, and syslog monitoring data to assist with recommendations, incident response, and problem resolution. * Utilizes platform based hypervisors to monitor, tune and/or resolve data network anomalies. * Advocates and works with other teams to build teamwork. Provides input into needs for new processes, procedures, and Work Instructions. * Perform other related assigned duties as necessary to complete the Primary Job Responsibilities as described above. \#LI\-Hybrid **Minimum Requirements:** Position requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, network engineering, information systems or related field and three years' experience in network administration. An associate level networking certification (CCNA Data Center, Routing and Switching, Wireless or Cloud) is preferred. Will accept any suitable combination of education, training, or experience. Position requires knowledge of the following infrastructure components at varying levels depending on assignments: Network hardware including Cisco stackable switches, chassis switches, Enterprise routers, small remote routers; network communication protocols (BGP, TCP/IP, DHCP, etc.), network communication hardware (LAN, WAN, routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, cabling, etc.), network topologies (Ethernet, VLANs, MPLS, VPNs, ISDN, SD WAN, etc.), network security infrastructure (Cisco ASAs, Firewall Services Modules, Palo Alto firewalls, exploits, viruses, etc.), server operating systems (Windows, Linux, Ubuntu, Solaris, etc.), directory services, integration, network based printing systems, and telecommunications hardware and software (PBXs, IP phones, etc.); experience with network management systems including Cisco MARS, SolarWinds Orion, Panorama, Harmony and WebSense; ability to analyze and resolve complex problems; use independent judgment and communicate effectively with internal and external contacts. Position requires the ability to provide on\-call support twenty\-four hours a day, seven days a week. Occasional travel may be required to some enterprise sites. The company will provide equal employment and advancement opportunity within the context of its unique business environment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, familial status, citizenship, genetic information, disability, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, height, weight, military status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law or ordinance.

jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: Build something that matters. At Delta Star the work we do has a real impact. Every transformer we build helps deliver reliable electricity to homes, businesses, and communities across North America. As we continue to grow, we are looking for people who want more than just a job. We are looking for individuals who want to learn, contribute, solve challenges, and build a meaningful career alongside a team that is committed to delivering power at all times. Summary Delta Star Inc. is seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Systems Administrator to support and enhance our hybrid infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments. This role is responsible for maintaining the reliability, performance, and availability of our enterprise infrastructure, including Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft 365, Azure, storage, and backup platforms. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, implementing modern technologies, and working across both server and cloud environments, we’d like to hear from you. What You'll Do As the Systems Administrator, you will be responsible for administering Delta Star’s core infrastructure while supporting a hybrid Microsoft environment that spans on\-premises data centers and Azure. You’ll work closely with the IT Manager, Network Engineering, Cyber Security Manager, Service Desk, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable IT services. This role combines day\-to\-day operational support with infrastructure modernization projects, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. A Day in the Life Your day may include deploying new virtual servers, troubleshooting Microsoft 365 or Azure connectivity issues, maintaining virtual infrastructure, implementing PowerShell automation, supporting hybrid identity services, or assisting with disaster recovery planning. You’ll collaborate with the Network Engineer on hybrid networking initiatives and help ensure Delta Star’s infrastructure remains highly available, secure, and ready to support our growing business. Specific Duties * Manage, administer, and maintain: * On prem Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and certificate services. * Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, and hybrid identity environments. * VMware vSphere infrastructure, virtual machines, clusters, and storage resources. * Enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions and business continuity and disaster recovery testing. * Data center technologies: servers, interconnects, storage infrastructure, including SAN and NAS platforms. * Support Azure infrastructure, including Virtual Networks, Virtual Machines, storage accounts, SD\-WAN connectivity, monitoring, and hybrid services. * Configure, maintain, and perform and/or automate operating system, firmware, and infrastructure patch management. * Monitor infrastructure health, capacity, and performance while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement. * Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency. * Collaborate with and support Network Engineer team to troubleshoot network connectivity, hybrid cloud networking, IP, DNS, SD\-WANs, VPNs, and routing issues. * Lead and manage infrastructure design, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects. * Maintain infrastructure documentation, standards, and operational procedures. * Provide Tier III/IV technical support for complex infrastructure related issues. * Develop, create, and administer sandbox testing environments for major version, security patches, and bug fix updates along with configuration and architecture updates and changes. * Coordinate third\-party vendors, hardware suppliers, warranty providers, and managed service partners supporting. * Assist networking team with Wi\-Fi and Wired NAC and security services. What We're Looking For We’re looking for a collaborative infrastructure professional with strong technical skills across Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft cloud technologies, and hybrid infrastructure. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical problems, continuously learning new technologies, and working across multiple infrastructure disciplines while partnering closely with networking and cybersecurity teams. Position Requirements * Technology field related degree or certifications. * 5\+ years of enterprise systems administration experience. * Experience administering Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware, Microsoft 365, and hybrid environments. * Experience supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure. * Experience in enterprise storage platform administration. * Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions. * Experience automating administrative tasks using PowerShell. * Ability to travel up to 15% as needed. Skills and Competencies * Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration and Microsoft enterprise technologies. * Experience supporting Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, and hybrid identity. * Experience administering VMware virtualization platforms. * Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure services, including Virtual Networks, Virtual Machines, SDWAN, Azure Storage, and monitoring services. * Solid understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, and hybrid cloud networking. * Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure issues spanning servers, storage, virtualization, networking, and cloud services. * Experience with PowerShell scripting and/or related scripting languages and automation tools. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Lead the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of customer service. * Strong documentation and organizational skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across IT disciplines. Why Our Employees Join, Grow, and Stay At Delta Star, you will find more than a job. You will join a team that values people, supports growth, and trusts you to make an impact. Whether you're on the shop floor, in the field, or in the office, you will work alongside talented people to solve meaningful challenges, power communities, and build a rewarding career. With opportunities to learn, advance, and contribute, plus a culture built on respect, teamwork, and work\-life balance, Delta Star is a place where you can thrive for the long term Benefits That Support You We believe that a rewarding career starts with feeling supported both at work and at home. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, professional growth, and work\-life balance. Eligible employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement savings programs, paid time off, life and disability protection, wellness resources, employee assistance programs, and additional voluntary benefits that help you and your family thrive. Pay Transparency We are committed to fair and transparent pay practices. Compensation for this position will be determined within the posted salary range based on factors such as candidate qualifications, relevant experience, internal equity, market competitiveness, skills, and certifications. For union\-represented roles, pay is established by the applicable collective bargaining agreement. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. AAP/EEO Statement Delta Star is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: SCADA Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY/PURPOSE** The SCADA Engineer provides technical engineering support for gas measurement and SCADA systems across the company’s gas distribution and transmission networks. This position plays a key role in maintaining the accuracy, safety, and efficiency of the utility’s gas operations by overseeing system administration, troubleshooting field issues, and ensuring real\-time system performance. Based in New Orleans, the role supports 24/7 monitoring needs and collaborates closely with Gas Control and field measurement teams across Delta Utilities service territories in Louisiana and Mississippi. This individual will administer and maintain the company’s OSI monarch SCADA environment, configure and commission field communications and measurement devices, manage SCADA performance and data accuracy, provide specialized technical guidance, aid with the reporting needs of the Gas Control Center and contribute to research and development efforts for new gas measurement technologies. The role is expected to work independently across both host\-side SCADA and field device configuration. The role reports to the Gas Control Manager and supports safe, compliant, and efficient gas delivery to customers throughout the region. **ACCOUNTABILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **Gas Measurement \& Engineering Support** * Provide gas distribution and transmission engineering support across all Gas Operations areas. * Provide technical support for Gas High Pressure Measurement groups, including large industrial measurement, gas pressure regulation, and gas odorization equipment. * Maintain working technical expertise in AGA Reports No. 3, 7, 8, and 9 (orifice metering, turbine metering, compressibility and gas properties, and ultrasonic metering). * Ensure accurate measurement at Gas Supplier City Gate locations; perform daily/monthly review of Gas Control vs. Supplier volumes and flag anomalies for resolution. * Provide (as needed) gas measurement expertise for sizing specialized gas pressure regulating equipment for customers. * Perform R\&D testing of new gas measurement equipment to improve the safety, accuracy, or efficiency of gas operations personnel. **SCADA System Administration (OSI monarch)** * Serve as administrator of the Gas SCADA system, independently supporting Gas Control to ensure 24/7 monitoring of Gas Distribution, Transmission, and Generation systems. * Provide business\-as\-usual support for daily SCADA operations across Production and non\-Production environments, resolving incidents, service requests, and operational issues. * Independently create new SCADA points end\-to\-end for new assets, including database, alarm, telemetry, and display configuration. * Maintain SCADA configuration for existing commissioned assets and telemetry; implement, validate, and deploy approved database, alarm, telemetry, and display changes. * Assist Gas Control with host database queries, trend building, automated and ad hoc reporting, and alarm database management. * Maintain SCADA displays, one\-lines, pipeline overviews, and trends; implement approved operational display updates and corrections. * Maintain existing operational and regulatory reports and resolve report data and formatting issues. * Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot front\-end processor (FEP) and Chronus interfaces, and support configuration updates for existing integrations. * Maintain Chronus historian configuration and data collection; verify the historical database is functioning correctly and troubleshoot data quality issues. * Monitor SCADA system performance and backups and perform routine database management. * Execute approved production changes in accordance with Change Management procedures and support configuration promotion across environments. * Coordinate with Delta Utilities OT and IT groups to ensure host database and network changes are completed and SCADA software is updated on schedule. * Coordinate SCADA vendor support cases and product issue resolution; validate vendor fixes and support approved deployments. **Field Communications, RTU \& Device Programming** * Identify, troubleshoot, and repair SCADA/measurement\-related problems for the measurement groups, including field RTU programming, telecommunications issues, and PID control systems. * Program and configure Sierra Wireless AirLink RV50/RV55 cellular modems from initial setup, including ALEOS configuration, cellular/APN settings, TCP and serial passthrough, and static IP assignment. * Configure and program Emerson FloBoss 107 and FB3000 RTUs for new and existing installations, including Modbus connectivity to downstream devices. * Commission ultrasonic meters, including setup, verification, and turnover to production. * Configure and troubleshoot field devices, including Honeywell MiWi 350, Honeywell ERX 350, and Eagle ERX units. * Configure, troubleshoot, and support YZ NJEX odorizer systems in the field. * Work independently with associated field instrumentatio lity to work effectively across multiple functions and departments * SCADA administration experience * Gas Distribution/Transmission utility experience * Experience managing remote monitoring and control systems * Experience managing TCP/IP networks * Experience in instrumentation, calibration, transmitters, PLC logic * Basic understanding of various telecommunications technologies * Familiarity with Modbus (RTU/TCP) and/or other industrial communication protocols (e.g., DNP3\) * Familiarity with IT networks and equipment (routers, switches, etc.) * Experience with OSI monarch or a comparable SCADA platform, including point creation, display building, and historian administration * Experience programming RTUs and flow computers (e.g., Emerson FloBoss 107 and FB3000 using ROCLINK 800 or FBxConnect) * Experience configuring industrial cellular modems (e.g., Sierra Wireless AirLink/ALEOS) * Working knowledge of gas measurement, odorization, and pressure regulation equipment * Working knowledge of PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192 requirements, including Control Room Management (§192\.631\) * Familiarity with OT/ICS cybersecurity practices * Experience working within a formal change management process **Any certificates, licenses, etc. required for the position** * Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record, required for travel to field locations * Ability to obtain and maintain Operator Qualification (OQ) for applicable covered tasks under 49 CFR Part 192, Subpart N **Working Conditions** The Physical Demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the Accountabilities and Essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Perform other job\-related duties as assigned, within your scope of responsibilities. * Job duties are performed primarily in an office and control center environment with normal noise levels, with regular field work at regulator stations, city gates, meter sites, and other gas facilities. * Work is performed while sitting, standing, and walking; field work may include bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting or carrying equipment. * The ability to comprehend, document, calculate, visualize and analyze are required. * Field work involves outdoor exposure to heat, cold, rain, and other weather conditions and requires use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). * Regular travel within the service territory, including New Orleans and Baton Rouge, is required. * Must be available for after\-hours call\-outs, including nights, weekends, and holidays, during emergencies and system failures. **About Delta Utilities** Delta Utilities is a natural gas utility headquartered in New Orleans that provides safe, reliable natural gas service across Louisiana and Mississippi. We understand the value of dependable energy and our important role in building stronger, more resilient communities. Once all announced transactions are complete, Delta Utilities will be a $1\.7 billion organization representing 600,000 customers and among the top 40 natural gas utilities in the United States. Delta Utilities acquired CenterPoint Energy's natural gas utility operations in Louisiana and Mississippi in April 2025 and will acquire Entergy's natural gas utilities in Baton Rouge and New Orleans in summer 2025\. Delta Utilities is regulated by the Louisiana Public Service Commission, the Mississippi Public Service Commission, and the New Orleans City Council. We work closely with our regulatory agencies to deliver safe and reliable natural gas service and maintain fair rates for our customers. Learn more at https://deltautilities.com. Delta Utilities and associated entities are equal\-opportunity employers. We do not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis or any protected class under federal, state, or local law. \#LI\-TM1

jobs.description: The Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (DFPS) works to build on strengths of families and communities to keep children and vulnerable adults safe, so they thrive. We do this through investigations, services, and referrals. **What You Get Beyond Your Paycheck** When you join the State of Texas, your monthly paycheck is just one part of your real income. Our benefits provide extra value that many private employers simply don’t match—often adding hundreds of dollars each month to what you take home or save. Here’s what you get as a full\-time employee:* **100% paid health insurance** for you, and 50% paid for eligible family members—saving you hundreds every month in out\-of\-pocket medical costs * **Retirement plans** with lifetime monthly payments after five years of state service, plus options to save even more with 401(k) and 457 plans * **Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave** so you can recharge and take care of life outside work (that’s time off you’re actually paid for) * **Optional dental, vision, and life insurance**—at rates much lower than most private plans * **Flexible spending accounts** for added tax savings on health and dependent care * **Employee discounts** on things like gym memberships, electronics, and entertainment You also might qualify for Public Service Loan Forgiveness, which could help you pay off federal student loans faster. You can see all the details here: ERS recruitment brochure **Functional Title:** Enterprise Data Architect **Job Title:** Data Architect I **Agency:** Dept of Family \& Protectve Svc **Department:** Chief Technology Office\-Op **Posting Number:** 23007 **Closing Date:** 05/19/2027 **Posting Audience:** Internal and External **Occupational Category:** Computer and Mathematical **Salary Range:** $7,716\.66\- $13,051\.00 **Pay Frequency:** Monthly **Salary Group:** TEXAS\-B\-28 **Shift:** Day **Additional Shift:** **Telework:** Eligible for Telework **Travel:** Up to 10% **Regular/Temporary:** Regular **Full Time/Part Time:** Full time **FLSA Exempt/Non\-Exempt:** Exempt **Facility Location:** **Job Location City:** AUSTIN **Job Location Address:** 4900 N LAMAR BLVD **Other Locations:** Austin **MOS Codes:** No military equivalent **BRIEF JOB DESCRIPTION** Performs highly advanced (senior\-level) enterprise data architecture work supporting the agency's operational, analytical, and information management needs. Serves as the lead architect for enterprise information architecture, data modeling, data standards, metadata management, master data management, and data interoperability across systems. Establishes enterprise data principles, reference architectures, technology standards, and integration patterns that promote consistent, secure, and trusted use of data throughout the organization. Provides architectural leadership for enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouse solutions, integration frameworks, and data movement strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and agency technology standards. Works under limited supervision with considerable latitude for initiative and **This position offers the opportunity to shape the agency's enterprise data strategy and architecture, influence technology decisions, and establish the standards and patterns that support operational systems, analytics, reporting, data sharing, and emerging AI capabilities. The role focuses on architecture, standards, governance, and strategic direction rather than day\-to\-day development, administration, or operational support activities. Works under limited supervision with considerable latitude for initiative and independent judgment.** **DFPS is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, including those with H1B visas or those currently on student or postgraduate visas \- CPT, OPT, STEM, AT, J\-1\. M\-1\. You must be a Texas resident or work for DFPS or be willing to relocate to Texas.** **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS (EJF)** * Lead the development, maintenance, and governance of the agency's enterprise data architecture across operational, analytical, integration, and data\-sharing environments. * Define enterprise data architecture principles, reference architectures, technology standards, and design patterns to ensure consistency, interoperability, scalability, security, and reuse across systems. * Evaluate, recommend, and govern enterprise data technologies, platforms, and services supporting transactional (OLTP), analytical (OLAP), reporting, business intelligence, data science, and AI\-en maps, and drive adoption of architectural standards and best practices. * Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and architecture trends and recommend their application to support agency business objectives and innovation initiatives. **Registrations, Licensure Requirements or Certifications:** N/A **Initial Screening Criteria:** Graduation from a four\-year college or university with major coursework in computer engineering, computer science, information systems, information technology or a STEM related field. Minimum **12 years** of progressively responsible combined experience in enterprise data architecture, data platform architecture, data warehousing architecture, information architecture, or enterprise architecture, including responsibility for enterprise data standards, models, and integration strategies. **Additional Information:** Candidates whose experience is limited primarily to software development, database administration, report development, ETL implementation, or data engineering delivery without demonstrated responsibility for enterprise data architecture, enterprise data modeling, architecture governance, and technology strategy may not meet the requirements of this position. **Applicant Attestation:** By answering "Yes" to any of the subsequent prescreening questions, I attest that I possess the stated experience and am able to perform the essential job functions associated with that experience. I understand that material misrepresentation, falsification, or omission of relevant information may result in disqualification from consideration, withdrawal of an employment offer, disciplinary action, or termination of employment. Review our Tips for Success when applying for jobs at DFPS, DSHS and HHSC. All active\-duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. For more information please see the Texas State Auditor’s Job Descriptions, Military Crosswalk and Military Crosswalk Guide at Texas State Auditor's Office \- Job Descriptions. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About This Role** ------------------- We’re looking for a Forward\-Deployed Engineer to solve technical problems for our customers and build the software they need to succeed with depthfirst. You’ll work directly with enterprise engineering and security teams to understand their needs and own delivery from initial discovery through production. Your work will span building customer\-facing features, developing integrations, and helping customers deploy and operate depthfirst in their environments. Depending on the problem, you might extend a product capability, build an API integration, debug an application issue, or work through a complex deployment constraint. You’ll implement solutions yourself and turn recurring customer needs into lasting improvements across our product and platform. We welcome engineers with different strengths. You might be a backend or full\-stack engineer who wants to work more closely with customers, or an infrastructure engineer with deep experience in cloud systems, Kubernetes, and networking. You don’t need to arrive with expertise in every area. We’re looking for engineers who take ownership, learn unfamiliar systems, and ship solutions. **You’re excited about this role because you will…** ---------------------------------------------------- * Build and ship customer\-facing features, APIs, and integrations that solve real customer problems. * Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, identify technical blockers, and define practical solutions. * Own delivery from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration. * Help customers integrate, deploy, and operate depthfirst within their existing systems and technical constraints. * Investigate problems across application code, integrations, and infrastructure, and implement fixes. * Turn solutions developed for individual customers into reusable product capabilities, tooling, and automation. * Communicate technical tradeoffs and progress clearly, keeping customer and internal teams aligned. **Qualifications** ------------------ * A strong engineering background in **at least one** of the following: + **Backend or full\-stack software engineering:** experience designing, building, and shipping production applications, services, APIs, or integrations. + **Infrastructure or platform engineering:** deep hands\-on experience deploying and debugging production systems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and networking, with experience developing software and tooling. * Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or Java, and experience writing, testing, and maintaining production code. * Ability to take an ambiguous problem, identify a useful solution, and carry it through to production. * Strong debugging skills and a willingness to work across unfamiliar systems. * Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with customers. Prior customer\-facing experience is helpful but not required. * Ownership, practical judgment, and the ability to move quickly while building reliable software. **Bonus Points For** -------------------- * Experience delivering customer\-facing features or owning technical engagements with enterprise customers. * Experience integrating software with enterprise APIs, authentication systems, and developer workflows. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, or enterprise deployment requirements. * Experience with AI platforms, developer tools, or security products. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive salary with meaningful equity. * Health, vision, and dental insurance. * Office lunch and dinner when working from our San Francisco office. * Direct impact on customer success and product direction. * The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and security. \- depthfirst is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. To all recruitment agencies: depthfirst does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to depthfirst employees. depthfirst is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

jobs.title: AWS Integration Developer
jobs.description: **AWS Integration Developer** **Location: Trenton, NJ Hybrid** **Duration: Contract** **Interview process:** screen with recruiter, screen with account manager, In person client interview **Job Summary** Must have these skills: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field please submit LinkedIn profile Experience designing, building, and maintaining integrations using AWS services including API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, and S3 * Experience integrating AWS\-hosted services with enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft * Experience authoring and maintaining OpenAPI/Swagger specifications * Ability to translate business requirements into API contracts and integration designs **Job Description** We are seeking an **AWS Integration Developer** to join our team in a **Hybrid** environment, working **3 days onsite** in support of the New Jersey Department of Children and Families. This is a **Full\-time Contract** position focused on designing, building, and supporting AWS\-based integrations, enterprise platform connectivity, and React\-based applications that support key agency initiatives, including the Family First Act (FFA) program. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain integrations on AWS using services such as API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, and S3 * Connect AWS\-hosted services with enterprise platforms such as MuleSoft and state systems of record * Implement secure, scalable, and observable integration patterns, including logging, monitoring, error handling, and retry logic * Author, review, and maintain API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger as the source of truth for integrations * Translate business requirements and design artifacts into well\-defined API contracts * Use API specifications to generate client code, mock services, and automated contract tests * Manage API versioning, documentation, and communication of changes across teams * Integrate federated authentication using SAML or OpenID Connect across APIs, services, and user\-facing applications for employee and applicant sign\-on * Account for marketplace spillovers, supply shifting between nearby areas or time periods, and interactions with other incentives. * Develop policies that direct spending toward periods when additional supply creates the most marketplace value, accounting for diminishing returns and non\-linear delivery outcomes. * Own models through production deployment, calibration, monitoring, and incident diagnosis. Build diagnostics that explain policy changes and surface model or data regressions. **We are excited about you because you have** --------------------------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience developing causal inference or causal ML systems, with a record of using the results to change production decisions. * A record of leading ambiguous projects across team boundaries, making technical tradeoffs explicit, and developing other engineers. * Strong statistical judgment about randomized experiments and observational estimation, including confounding, treatment overlap, uncertainty, and the limits of causal claims. * Experience with treatment effect estimation or dose\-response modeling and relevant methods such as doubly robust estimation, double machine learning, or off\-policy evaluation. jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\. **Summary** =========== As a Senior Solutions Engineer at Dust, you’ll serve as the technical bridge between Sales and prospective customers, demonstrating how our AI platform transforms the way teams work. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Partner with Sales to drive technical wins** ---------------------------------------------- * Act as a trusted technical counterpart to Account Executives throughout the sales cycle * Clearly articulate Dust’s value to both technical and business stakeholders * Build credibility and trust with customers by combining strong technical fluency with a consultative, customer\-first approach * Help shape the foundation of Dust’s global Pre\-Sales Solutions Engineering organization as one of our first US hires **Lead technical discovery and product evaluations** ---------------------------------------------------- * Run deep technical discovery to uncover high\-impact use cases aligned with customer workflows and business priorities * Design and deliver tailored, high\-impact product demonstrations grounded in real customer problems * Own the technical evaluation process end\-to\-end, from discovery and custom demos through hands\-on pilots and technical validation * Guide prospects through onboarding and help them deploy meaningful use cases during pilot phases **Build solutions that make AI tangible** ----------------------------------------- * Build lightweight prototypes, agents, workflows, or integrations that demonstrate practical applications of Dust * Develop deep expertise in Dust’s platform capabilities, AI workflows, and prompt engineering best practices * Help customers move beyond curiosity about AI into real operational impact inside their organizations * Translate complex AI with APIs, software integrations, and interconnected systems, and can quickly ramp on new technical concepts * You have experience building demos, prototypes, workflows, or lightweight technical solutions in pre\-sales or post\-sales environments * You can translate complex technical concepts into clear business value and adapt your communication style based on the audience * You’ve helped customers adopt and realize value from sophisticated software platforms, especially in technically complex environments * You actively explore generative AI workflows, prompt engineer e ownership end\-to\-end, from initial technical discovery through pilots, evaluations, and successful customer outcomes * You proactively identify gaps, propose solutions, and build what’s needed rather than jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems
jobs.description: **About E2B** ============= E2B is a fast\-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9\-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish. **About the role** ================== E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure. Every sandbox is a real virtual machine that has to start in well under a second, resume from a snapshot on a different host, and share a host with up to about 200 others without noticing them. Your job will be to build and own the Go service on every host that creates, pauses, resumes and tears down sandboxes, along with the Linux underneath it: host networking, memory and isolation. You'll work closely with our sandbox team in Prague, who own the Firecracker runtime, the guest kernel, sandbox storage and live migration, and with our infrastructure engineers, who put the platform together. We're hiring more than one engineer into this role, each with a different focus: some go deepest on Linux and how sandboxes run on the host, others on sandbox networking. Our runtime is open source at github.com/e2b\-dev/runtime, and the sandbox package is a good place to see what you'd work on. Responsibilities include: * Making sandboxes start fast and keeping them fast as the fleet grows to millions and later billions of sandboxes, with starts under 200ms * Evolving the architecture of the software that runs sandboxes on every host, so it can change without disrupting them * Making the sandbox lifecycle reliable under failure, so no sandbox is leaked or lost when a process or host dies * Keeping the host OS and kernel current across the fleet, rolling out upgrades without disrupting running sandboxes * Building the sandbox network: isolation, egress control and addressing for untrusted workloads * Enforcing resource isolation between sandboxes on shared hosts, so every sandbox gets the CPU, memory and I/O it was allocated * Building host\-level observability, so we understand what every sandbox costs the host it runs on * Being on call for the platform you build, alongside the rest of the platform team This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day. If you aren't afraid of going deep into the Linux kernel when a problem needs it, and words like eBPF, cgroups, network namespaces, nftables, conntrack, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting to you, we want to hear from you! **What we're looking for** ========================== * Experience building and operating systems software across a large production fleet: node agents, container or VM runtimes, schedulers, or similar * Strong Go, or strong Rust or C/C\+\+ and the willingness to pick up Go quickly; our services are in Go * Deep Linux knowledge: processes, CPU scheduling, memory management, cgroups and namespaces, and the network stack * Experience making software correct under failure: crash recovery, reconciling recorded state with what is actually running, and cleanup when a process or host dies * For a networking focus: Linux networking for multi\-tenant workloads, such as network namespaces, virtual interfaces, iptables/nftables and egress control * A performance mindset: you've shaved milliseconds off hot paths, profiled production systems under load, and treat p99 as a number you own * Excited to work in person from San Francisco * Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number. **Bonus points for:** ===================== * Experience with VM or container runtimes such as Firecracker, KVM, gVisor or runc, including memory management and snapshot and restore * GPU or accelerator infrastructure, passthrough or GPU\-as\-a\-service * Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling * OS\-level hardening, such as seccomp and Linux security modules * Running workloads on Kubernetes, which our fleet runs on * Contributions to the Linux kernel, Firecracker, CNCF or similar open source projects **What it’s like to work at E2B** ================================= We’re a fast\-growing startup with in\-person (4 days on\-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9\-figure revenue and work directly with top\-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI. We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in\-office employees. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

jobs.title: Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior
jobs.description: **At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross\-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.** **Join our Qrew!** EQT runs AI agents in production on Microsoft Foundry, working inside Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. Demand is compounding as domain experts across the business bring new agent ideas forward, and the platform underneath has to scale with it. We need an Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior to own that platform: secure, observable, affordable, and easy to build on. **The Role:** You own the foundation every agent runs on. Our AI Engineers build agents and the tools they use; you build and operate the layer beneath them: the Azure environment, the AI gateway, the tool registry, and the observability, evaluation, and guardrail systems that keep the fleet healthy. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role. You write the infrastructure as code, own the AI platform in production, and partner with Infrastructure to align to standards and deploy. You won't spend most of your time building agents, but you'll understand them well enough to make the platform fast and safe to build on. **Who Thrives Here:** * **You treat the platform as a product.** Your customers are engineers and business builders, and the best paved road is the one they choose to take. * **You automate the toil.** If you did it twice by hand, it's in code the third time. * **You think in least privilege.** Identity, secrets, and network boundaries are design inputs, not cleanup. * **You know what it costs.** You can say where the tokens and dollars go, and you tune before anyone asks. * **You're excited about where AI is going.** You want to build the platform that lets an organization run many agents well, not just one. **The Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Own our Azure infrastructure as code: author, review, and deploy modular templates across dev and production. * Operate Microsoft Foundry environments, model deployments, and our private Azure subscription as production infrastructure, including onboarding, upgrading, and retiring models. * Own the AI gateway on Azure API Management: routing and transformation policies, per\-consumer keys, rate limits, and onboarding new models and consumers. * Run the centralized tool registry: identity and authentication patterns, versioning, and reuse standards, so a tool built once serves every agent. * Build fleet\-wide observability: logging, compliance log collection, monitoring, alerting, and usage telemetry attributed by agent and user. * Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure that gates releases and continuously scores agents in production. * Own identity and access: Entra ID group\-based, least\-privilege RBAC, managed identities, just\-in\-time elevation, and drift detection against the code. * Own cost and performance: budgets and alerts, tagging, recurring cost reviews, and latency and token tuning across the fleet. * Set the guardrails and paved roads (spend limits, standard build patterns, templates) that let builders move fast without breaking things, and bring manually deployed services under code. * Own platform production support, partnering closely with Cyber, Infrastructure, Network, Salesforce, and data teams, and keep runbooks and documentation current. **Required Experience and Skills:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (computer science, engineering, information systems, or similar), or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 6\+ years in cloud platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or site reliability engineering, including 3\+ years running production workloads on Microsoft Azure. * Production infrastructure as code on Azure with Bicep, ARM, or Terraform: modular templates, parameterization, and multi\-scope deployments. * Azure identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and least\-privilege design. * Azure networking and security fundamentals: VNets, private endpoints, TLS, and locking down public endpoints. * CI/CD and software fundamentals: git, code review, deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python. * Observability on Azure: Log Analytics, Application Insights, and writing KQL. * Working knowledge of how LLM applications and agents work (model endpoints, tool calling, tokens, evaluation), enough to design a platform for them. * Clear communicator who documents well and can explain infrastructure tradeoffs to engineers and business leaders. **Preferred Experience and Skills:** * Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) or Azure OpenAI in production: model deployments, agents, evaluations, and the control plane. * Azure API Management policy authoring, including request and response transformation between model APIs. * Azure Container Apps and Container Registry, including hosting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar services. * Agent evaluation and monitoring tooling, and responsible AI guardrails such as PII handling, content filtering, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Governance at scale with Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and FinOps practices. * Integrating Azure services with Salesforce or Databricks Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate. Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. jobs.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking a Data Engineer to build and operate Snowflake and Informatica data pipelines for its Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS), also known as COdata. The system links education and workforce records from multiple agencies to support reporting on program participation, completion, equitable access, and wage outcomes. You’ll work with the Data Architect and a third\-party implementation partner to onboard new data sources, improve data quality, and take ownership of production pipeline operations. The transition starts with shadowing and jointly running feeds in January and February. The March target is to run two consecutive feed cycles independently and receive formal handover approval. Key responsibilities * Build and maintain data pipelines. Design, test, and deploy automated Informatica workflows and Snowflake SQL transformations that map partner agency data to the SLDS common data model. * Onboard agency data. Lead ingestion of annual postsecondary course data from the Colorado Department of Higher Education. Additional feeds may include postsecondary demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability data, as well as PSAT/SAT assessment results. * Link and reconcile records. Apply identity\-matching rules to connect incoming records to existing student and workforce profiles. Investigate match exceptions and resolve cross\-agency discrepancies. * Own production feed operations. Monitor scheduled jobs, troubleshoot failures, reload late or corrected files, reconcile row counts, and rebuild downstream tables and views. * Automate data quality and privacy controls. Validate file structure, completeness, duplicates, referential integrity, and business rules. Detect layout changes, maintain audit trails, and apply de\-identification and cell suppression rules where required. * Maintain the analytics layer. Build and tune Snowflake tables, views, and metrics. Support Tableau dashboard refreshes and prepare de\-identified outcome files for participating higher education institutions. * Test, release, and document changes. Use Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans to manage releases across development, test, UAT, and production. Maintain source\-to\-target mappings, data lineage, runbooks, test evidence, and release logs. Required qualifications Minimum requirement Snowflake ETL/ELT 5\+ years building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex data pipelines and transformations directly in Snowflake Informatica CDGC 1\+ year of hands\-on experience with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog for metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation Terraform 1\+ year provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud resources using infrastructure as code Azure DevOps Demonstrated experience building automated CI/CD pipelines for builds, tests, and deployments Git Expert proficiency with branching, pull requests, automated merge checks, and code reviews Preferred qualifications * Experience with public\-sector education or workforce data, especially statewide longitudinal data systems. * Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic or probabilistic identity matching across data sources. * Familiarity with FERPA, COPPA, state student and workforce data privacy requirements, and cell suppression standards. * Experience writing and executing structured test cases in Azure Test Plans. Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Benefits: * Referral program Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods costs less for our customers, and less for the planet. Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab\-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019\). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers. **About the role** You will be the first integration engineer on our US team. You will connect our customers’ transportation management systems (TMS) and broker platforms to our own partner TMS and our planning platform Saga, so that orders arrive automatically and status updates go back without manual work. You will build these connections yourself, and you will also set the templates and processes that make each new customer faster to onboard than the last one. ### **You will:** * Own each customer integration from start to finish: gather requirements, write the mapping specification, then build, test, launch and support it after go\-live. * Connect the main US TMS and broker platforms, such as SAP Transportation Management, Oracle Transportation Management, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, e2open, MercuryGate, C.H. Robinson Navisphere, Uber Freight and Arrive. * Map EDI transactions and application programming interface (API) payloads in JSON to our order data model. * Configure and run our EDI and integration platform (currently Boomi), and help shape how it evolves as we grow * Act as the technical contact for customer and trading partner IT teams during onboarding. * Set up monitoring, error handling and alerts, so failed messages are caught and fixed before they delay a shipment. * Write reusable mappings and documentation for each TMS you connect. * Work with our product and engineering teams in Sweden on the design of our integration platform and order APIs. * Partner with Sales in pre\-sales to scope prospect TMS needs and set onboarding timelines, while working closely with US Fleet Operations to align data flows with physical dispatch and quickly resolve live shipment blockers ### **We expect you to:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and supporting B2B integrations within freight, logistics, transportation management, or supply chain tech. * Enough technical know\-how to handle complex integration configuration, including scripting for data mapping and jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026\. Our team currently consists of 25 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting\-edge multimodal research into scalable, real\-world systems. **About the role** ------------------ We are seeking a Software Engineer to lead the client\-facing product for Glimpse. In this role, you will design and build the integration layer, including but not limited to API, web interfaces, and platform tools that external developers will use to interact with our multimodal models. You will also collaborate directly with research, infrastructure, and GTM teams to ensure smooth delivery of future model releases. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Craft the Front Door to AI:** Build, scale, and polish the Glimpse developer console, interactive model playgrounds, real\-time analytics, and seamless onboarding flows. * **Architect End\-to\-End Solutions:** Lead front\-end development while bridging backend services with a focus on multimodal data handling, streamed responses, visual outputs, and other platform features such as API key management, budget page, and docs. * **Drive Product \& Visual Design:** You’re the designer — spearhead the UX design for interaction with multimodal input, creating sleek wireframes and high\-craft UI that redefine how developers experience frontier AI. * **Revolutionize Developer Workflows:** Engage directly with our developer community to invent frictionless experiences that make integrating Glimpse effortless. * **Keep the Product Experience Healthy:** Build dashboards and tools to monitor product health and the endpoints it depends on. Be part of the first response when something customers rely on breaks. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * **Front\-End Expertise \& Full\-Stack Versatility:** Exceptional skills in modern web tech stack (e.g. React, TypeScript, Go gateway, Python services) and user experience design, combined with full\-stack fluency to build supporting API endpoints. * **Performance \& Security Sense:** You know how to keep a web app fast and safe. You’ve tracked down slow page loads or laggy interactions, and you handle sign\-in, API keys, and user uploads with care. * **Passionate Product Craftsman:** Proven track record of building developer\-facing tools, dashboards, or self\-serve platform experiences with strong taste and attention to interaction detail. * **Core Foundations \& Front\-End Reliability:** Solid grounding in API contracts, product lifecycle, failure modes, billing correctness, observability, and reliability, alongside experience keeping web interfaces reliable through monitoring and rapid debugging. * **Product and Design Ownership:** Comfortable owning a product surface end to end and making design decisions yourself, with good judgment about usability. * **High Agency:** Comfortable with ambiguity in a small team, able to balance speed against quality. **Nice to have** ---------------- * **Aesthetic Sense:** A strong eye for visual design, interaction detail, and craft.
