jobs.title: Senior Data Acquisition & Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Energy Recovery and Help Build a Sustainable Future** At Energy Recovery, we build products that help limit global temperature rise, reduce carbon emissions, provide safe drinking water for millions of people, and bring efficiency and sustainability to a range of industries. Our products help customers avoid approximately 19\.7 million metric tons of carbon emissions per year \- equivalent to removing over 4\.7 million cars from the road! In addition to innovating world\-class products that help our customers and the environment, our employees enjoy a diverse, collaborative work culture, as well as extensive company benefits that support the overall wellbeing of our staff. This includes everything from generous health plans and time off, paid family leave, subsidized lunches and company events, and opportunities for charitable giving and volunteering in the community. **What You Can Look Forward To:** Energy Recovery is seeking a Data acquisition \& Controls Engineer for an immediate, full\-time opening in San Leandro, CA. The role reports to the Engineering Manager of the Testing \& Validation team, within the New Technology and Product Development (R\&D) department. You will join a multidisciplinary R\&D team of engineers and technicians with diverse backgrounds, several of whom hold Master’s and PhD degrees. Together, the team develops new energy recovery products and technologies based on our proprietary isobaric pressure exchanger. This is a hands\-on, lab\-based role that combines product development, with a strong focus on data acquisition systems and test loop controls. To support product development \& enhancement, you will design, build and upgrade high\-pressure test loops, develop their control and data acquisition systems, and plan and run tests for validating their performance and reliability. ### **What You Will Do:** * Design, program and maintain LabVIEW/NI\-based control and data acquisition systems for R\&D and production test loops, including high\-pressure water (up to 3,000 psig / \~200 bar) and CO₂/refrigeration loops. * Implement closed\-loop control of VFD\-driven pumps, compressors and motors, control valves and electric heaters including PID tuning. * Design and implement safety interlocks, alarms and fail\-safe shutdown logic using hardwired safety relays/safety PLCs and software interlocks; support HAZOP and safety reviews. * Support Operations with production test loops: troubleshoot control and DAQ issues, implement upgrades, and develop controls and DAQ for new production test stands. * Plan and execute beta tests at customer sites: instrument products, set up secure remote data collection and monitoring (cellular routers, MQTT/cloud platforms), track performance, and report results and recommendations. * Take ownership of existing test system software and hardware; document, refactor and maintain LabVIEW code under source control. * Specify and select instrumentation and DAQ hardware (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration); maintain calibration records and quantify measurement uncertainty. * Create P\&IDs, electrical schematics and control panel layouts; build or oversee build of control panels in line with applicable electrical codes. * Support new product development through mechanical design and test setup builds: specify components and assemblies for pressure exchangers and test rigs, size pumps, valves, relief devices and filters for high\-pressure service (up to 3,000 psig / \~200 bar), and produce SolidWorks models, drawings and BOMs. Develop test plans, execute tests, analyze data and report results for new product development and product enhancements. * Partner with technicians, mechanical engineers, Operations, Sourcing and Business Units to deliver testing on schedule and within budget. * Perform other duties as assigned. ### **What You Bring to the Table:** * B.S. in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation \& Controls Engineering or a related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing control and data acquisition systems for test loops, test stands or industrial process equipment. 3\+ years with an advanced degree is acceptable. * Strong LabVIEW proficiency (LabVIEW Core 2 or equivalent proficiency preferred). * Experience with NI data acquisition hardware and software, such as CompactDAQ (cDAQ), CompactRIO (cRIO) and NI MAX. * Experience with PLC programming (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell or Siemens); HMI development experience desirable. * Experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus (RTU and TCP), OPC and MQTT (e.g., AWS IoT) desirable. * Experience with remote monitoring and management platforms and hardware, such as Teltonika RMS and Teltonika or Cradlepoint routers is a plus. * Experience with test instrumentation, including pressure and temperature transducers, flow meters, proximity probes and accelerometers and their calibration. * Experience with fluid flow loops and high\-pressure equipment along with designing and implementing safety interlocks, alarms and emergency shutdown systems. * Ability to read and create P\&IDs and electrical schematics; working knowledge of industrial power and control wiring (including 480V three\-phase). * Experience with the design or operation of fluid machinery such as pumps, turbines and compressors. * Working proficiency in SolidWorks or Onshape and Visio. * Willingness to travel to customer sites for field installation, instrumentation and beta testing. ### **What's in it For Me?** * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with options for family coverage * **Retirement Plans:** 401(k) plan with company matching to help you save for the future * **Paid Time Off:** Generous vacation policy, paid sick leave, and paid holidays to ensure a healthy work\-life balance * **Wellness Programs:** Mental Wellness Support with therapy and coaching in addition to an employee assistance program * **Fitness Perks**: Enjoy access to our on\-site gym with an on\-site trainer, yoga classes and gym reimbursement for remote employees * **Team Events:** Regular team\-building activities and social events to foster a positive work culture such as; ping\-pong tournaments, gratitude lunches, and summer BBQs * **Referral Bonus:** Earn up to $1,500 for referring friends * **Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA):** Pre\-tax savings for medical expenses, commuter, and dependent care, helping you manage out\-of\-pocket costs * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Financial support for continuing education, including courses and degree programs to help you advance your career * **Paid Parental Leave**: Generous paid leave for new parents to bond with their children and support family needs The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000/year with bonus opportunity, equity grant, and other perks. The stated range is the range that we reasonably believe to be the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and this range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in California. This range may be modified in the future. *We are an EOE/AA employer committed to workforce diversity.**No recruiters or phone calls.*

jobs.title: Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer
jobs.description: Everforth ECS is seeking a ***Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer*** to work ***Remotely.*** At ECS Federal, we're driven by a commitment to excellence and innovation in solving complex challenges. As a premier provider of advanced technology solutions and services, our mission is to secure and optimize the most critical commercial, government, defense, and intelligence projects across the country. Our team is composed of dynamic professionals who thrive in a collaborative and empowering environment, where our team members leverage the latest technologies and insights to make a real\-world impact. The Senior Vulnerability Management (VM) Engineer manages ECS Federal's enterprise VM program, supporting the full VM lifecycle from identification, validation, and prioritization through remediation tracking, exception management, reporting, and continuous improvement. Working closely with cybersecurity leadership, security operations, infrastructure, cloud, application, endpoint, and business stakeholders, this role ensures vulnerabilities are identified, assessed, tracked, and remediated in alignment with organizational risk priorities. As the primary program lead, the engineer drives governance, measures remediation performance, improves exposure reduction practices, and advances ECS Federal's threat exposure management maturity by translating complex vulnerability data into actionable, risk\-based remediation strategies across the enterprise. **Responsibilities** ==================== * **VM Lifecycle Management**: Manage the end\-to\-end VM lifecycle, including asset coverage, vulnerability discovery, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, exception handling, and closure verification. * **Threat Exposure Management**: Identify, analyze, and prioritize security exposures across enterprise infrastructure, cloud environments, endpoints, applications, identity platforms, and third\-party technologies. * **Vulnerability Scanning and Assessment**: Oversee vulnerability scanning activities, ensure scan coverage and accuracy, validate findings, and coordinate with technology owners to address coverage gaps or scanning issues. * **Risk\-Based Prioritization**: Prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability, asset criticality, threat intelligence, business impact, exposure context, and organizational risk tolerance. * **Remediation Coordination**: Partner with infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, application, and business teams to support timely remediation of vulnerabilities and security exposures by the responsible technology owners. * **Remediation Tracking and Governance**: Maintain vulnerability remediation plans, track progress against service\-level expectations, escalate overdue or high\-risk items, and provide visibility and governance across remediation owners. * **Exception and Risk Acceptance Management**: Manage vulnerability exception, deferral, and risk acceptance processes, ensuring exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time\-bound, and periodically reassessed. * **Reporting and Metrics**: Develop and maintain VM dashboards, scorecards, executive reports, and operational metrics that provide visibility into exposure trends, remediation performance, risk reduction, and program effectiveness. * **Tool Administration and Optimization**: Support the administration, configuration, tuning, and optimization of VM and exposure management platforms to improve data quality, reporting, and operational effectiveness. * **Asset and Coverage Alignment**: Collaborate with asset management, infrastructure, cloud, and endpoint teams to ensure VM activities align to accurate asset inventories and enterprise scope. * **Threat Intelligence Integration**: Incorporate threat intelligence, known exploited vulnerabilities, exploit availability, and adversary behavior into vulnerability prioritization and remediation decision\-making. * **Program Governance and Process Improvement**: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve VM standards, procedures, workflows, operating rhythms, and governance practices. * **Stakeholder Engagement**: Serve as the primary VM point of contact for technology teams, cybersecurity leadership, and business stakeholders. * **Audit and Compliance Support**: Provide vulnerability management evidence, reporting, and process documentation to support audits, assessments, regulatory requirements, and internal control reviews. *Salary Range: $120,000 \- $150,000* *General Description of Benefits* Requirements: * **Experience**: Minimum of 7 years of VM experience, including delivering, operating, or maturing enterprise VM programs. * **VM Expertise**: Demonstrated experience managing the full VM lifecycle in complex enterprise environments. * **Threat Exposure Management Experience**: Strong understanding of exposure management concepts, including vulnerability prioritization, attack surface visibility, exploitability analysis, and risk\-based remediation. * **Vulnerability Scanning Tools**: Hands\-on experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning and exposure management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, or similar technologies. * **Risk\-Based Remediation**: Proven ability to prioritize vulnerabilities using asset criticality, exploit intelligence, business context, compensating controls, and threat activity. * **Enterprise Infrastructure Knowledge**: Strong understanding of operating systems, network devices, cloud platforms, identity systems, endpoint technologies, databases, and enterprise applications. * **Remediation Coordination**: Experience working with infrastructure, cloud, application, endpoint, and business teams to drive remediation of vulnerabilities and security exposures. * **Metrics and Reporting**: Ability to develop vulnerability dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, scorecards, and executive\-level reporting that communicate exposure risk and remediation performance. * **Governance and Process Development**: Experience building or improving vulnerability management processes, standards, workflows, escalation paths, and exception management practices. * **Risk and Exception Management**: Experience managing vulnerability exceptions, risk acceptances, deferrals, compensating controls, and executive\-level risk discussions. * **Threat Intelligence Awareness**: Ability to incorporate known exploited vulnerabilities, exploit availability, adversary trends, and threat intelligence into remediation prioritization. * **Communication and Stakeholder Management**: Strong ability to communicate vulnerability risk, remediation priorities, and program performance to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. Req Benefits: Benefits \- Everforth ECS

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (AI Evaluation & Improvement)
jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Core Responsibilities** * Own the diagnostic loop for LLM\-based clinical services: take failure modes surfaced by clinical reviewers and product managers, form root\-cause hypotheses (prompt design, context assembly, retrieval, guideline encoding, model behavior, upstream data), and design experiments that isolate the cause. * Test candidate fixes — prompt and configuration variants, context changes, model alternatives — and verify improvements with structured evaluations, not anecdotes; confirm fixes don't regress other behavior. * Own the evaluation roadmap and quality bar for the team's AI services: which metrics gate deployment, how golden sets and regression suites grow, and what "good enough to ship" means in evidence. * Use and extend the team's evaluation platform: build golden sets and regression suites, define metrics (accuracy, guideline adherence, grounding/faithfulness), run and interpret eval batteries. Fluency in \*using\* modern eval tooling matters; the platform exists — extending it thoughtfully is in scope, rebuilding it is not. * Partner with clinical reviewers (medical directors) to turn review findings into labeled evidence and executable evaluation criteria; partner with product managers to prioritize which failure modes matter most. * Mentor others in evaluation methods and grow the evals function as it scales, including readiness to take direct reports as the team expands. * Support the annual clinical\-guidelines update cycle with regression evaluation as guidelines, prompts, and models change; ramp with the team's senior data scientists in Q4 2026\. * Document the diagnostic playbook: failure taxonomies, experiment templates, variant history — a method others can run, not a private intuition. This is a practicing role — the diagnostic loop is the job, at every level of seniority. * Handle clinical data (including PHI) according to organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of data science or applied machine learning experience, including shipping and maintaining models or AI systems in production. * 2\+ years of recent, hands\-on experience evaluating and improving LLM\-based systems: structured error analysis, prompt/configuration iteration, experiment design, metrics interpretation — as a practitioner, not only as a reviewer of others' work. * Demonstrated experience with LLM evaluation methods and tools — golden/regression sets, LLM\-as\-judge with validation, tracing and observability tooling. * Strong Python and solid data\-analysis skills (SQL a plus); comfort computing and reasoning about metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, and PPV. * Hypothesis\-driven working style: the instinct to isolate variables and prove a fix, rather than tweak and hope. * Strong written communication — findings and go/no\-go evidence must be legible to engineers, clinicians, and leadership. **Preferred Requirements** * Healthcare experience: utilization management, prior authorization, clinical documentation, or clinical/claims data; comfort reading clinical guideline and medical\-policy content. * Experience mentoring data scientists or leading small technical workstreams; interest in growing into people leadership as a function scales. * Experience working with clinical reviewers or other domain experts to convert expert judgment into labeled data and evaluation criteria. * Experience with LLM observability/telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry\-based tracing, Logfire, Langfuse, or similar). * Statistics or experimentation background (A/B testing, statistical significance, sample\-size reasoning). * Master's degree in a quantitative field. \#EvolentAi To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $120,000 \- 145,000\. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

engineering, or a related technical role. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience developing data transformation, validation, and automation workflows. * Hands\-on experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and processing large, complex datasets. * Experience integrating disparate data sources through APIs, structured data exchanges, and custom integration workflows. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data normalization, data quality management, and reconciliation techniques. * Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data formats, including JSON, CSV, XML, and relational databases. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable, sustainable solutions. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify meaningful insights. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Experience collaborating directly with customers or external stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve technical challenges, and deliver solutions. * Ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and balance immediate customer needs with long\-term technical scalability. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Customer Engineer, or Technical Consultant role supporting enterprise customers. * Familiarity with supply chain management, supply chain risk management (SCRM), third\-party risk management (TPRM), or supplier intelligence solutions. * Experience working with Bill of Materials (BOM), part\-level data, supplier master data, or manufacturing and procurement datasets. * Knowledge of supply chain risk factors, including critical mineral dependencies, supplier concentration, geographic exposure, and material provenance. * Experience with cloud\-based data platforms and infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Airflow, or dbt. * Experience developing automated data validation, monitoring, and exception\-handling frameworks. * Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST APIs, and data orchestration tools. * Experience leveraging AI/ML technologies, including large language models (LLMs), to automate data enrichment, entity resolution, or analytical workflows. * Experience supporting enterprise\-scale deployments involving complex data environments, multiple stakeholders, and evolving technical requirements. * Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance considerations when handling sensitive customer information. * Experience translating customer feedback and technical requirements into actionable product enhancements in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams. \#LI\-Hybrid Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Figure** Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain\-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure's on\-chain lend\-borrow marketplace. Figure's ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield\-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933\. Figure is the market leader in real\-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple\-A ratings from S\&P and Moody's on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance. We're proud to be recognized as one of Forbes' Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies. **About the Role** As a Senior Application Security Engineer at Figure, you will be pivotal in the security of our software from the first line of code through deployment. You'll own and set the direction for our application security program, build and scale our vulnerability management program, embed secure coding practices into engineering workflows, and help ensure security standards are met at every stage of the software development lifecycle. We're looking for a collaborative, hands\-on senior engineer with a strong background in reading and writing code. You'll partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, and IT to ensure our security processes are resilient, scalable, and seamlessly integrated into our workflows. **What You'll Do** * Own and evolve Figure's vulnerability management program, including triage, prioritization, tracking remediation, and reporting on risk reduction over time. * Collaborate with DevOps to integrate security gates at various points throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring automation and repeatability of secure deployments. * Manage third\-party penetration tests, including scoping, vendor coordination, and tracking remediation of findings. * Automate sources of toil, such as routine patching or dependency upgrades. * Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security design reviews for new features and services, partnering with engineering teams early in the design process. * Lead cross\-team initiatives that significantly improve our security posture while balancing speed and innovation. * Define and drive Figure's application security strategy and roadmap, including secure coding standards and security requirements for new services. * Mentor engineers across the organization and build a security champions program that scales secure development practices. * Evaluate, select, and own application security tooling and vendors. * Track program metrics and communicate application security risk to engineering and executive leadership. * Actively participate in incident response, on\-call rotations, and post\-incident reviews to continuously improve defenses. * Leverage AI to augment threat hunting, vulnerability scanning, and triage, using it to surface signal faster and reduce manual review load. * Design and build AI agents to perform in\-depth testing and analysis of our infrastructure and code. **What We Look For** * 6\-8\+ years in application security, product security, or a security\-focused software engineering role. * Strong coding ability in one or more languages used in modern web/backend development (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Kotlin) — enough to read unfamiliar code, build tooling and automation, and propose concrete fixes, not just file findings. * Hands\-on experience building or scaling a vulnerability management program, including triage, prioritization, and remediation workflows. * Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning) and tuning it for signal over noise. * Familiarity with software supply\-chain security and dependency vetting (e.g., SCA platforms, tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Socket, or comparable). * Deep knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, secure coding patterns, and common vulnerability classes, with the ability to teach them to other engineers. * Extensive experience leading threat modeling and security design reviews. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and the ability to drive remediation across teams without owning the code yourself. * Track record of leading application security initiatives end to end, from strategy and roadmap through rollout and measurable results. * Experience mentoring engineers and acting as a technical leader, including running or growing a security champions program. * Ability to communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and leadership. * Deep expertise in at least one area, such as authentication and authorization, cryptography, API security, or cloud\-native application security. * Relentless curiosity and persistence in investigating root causes and driving long\-lasting improvements. * Cloud security exposure (GCP a plus) and prior blockchain/Web3 security experience are pluses, not requirements. * Familiarity with security and compliance requirements in regulated financial services (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA) is a plus. * Hands\-on proficiency with AI\-assisted security tooling and a practical sense of its strengths and limits. * Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. * Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. * Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. **Salary** * Base Compensation Range: $112,320 \- $140,400/yr * 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly * Company equity in the form of RSUs This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer\-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans * Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits * Employer\-paid life and disability insurance * 11 observed holidays and PTO plan * Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave * Continuing education reimbursement Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice. Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. \#LI\-JR1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something. Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 1500\+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. lead incident response and write blameless postmortems. * Document runbooks and automate anything done twice. ### **Required qualifications** * 5\+ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering running production systems at scale. * 3\+ years operating Kubernetes in production, including cluster upgrades, networking (CNI, ingress) and persistent storage; experience on bare metal or self\-managed clusters, not only managed cloud offerings. * Strong Linux systems administration (RHEL/CentOS/Rocky or Debian/Ubuntu): kernel, networking, systemd, performance troubleshooting. * Hands\-on MySQL operations: replication topologies, backup/restore (XtraBackup or equivalent), failover, query and InnoDB tuning. Percona experience strongly preferred. * Hands\-on PostgreSQL operations: streaming replication, backups (pgBackRest/Barman), major version upgrades, vacuum and index maintenance. * Hands\-on MongoDB operations: replica sets, sharding, backups (mongodump/Percona Backup for MongoDB or Ops Manager), index design and WiredTiger tuning, upgrades. * Object storage experience: AWS S3 and at least one S3\-compatible system (Ceph RGW, MinIO or similar), including IAM/bucket policies, lifecycle management and large\-scale data migration. * Security fundamentals: hardening, secrets management, TLS/PKI, network segmentation, vulnerability management. Familiarity with PCI DSS controls. * Infrastructure as code and automation, plus scripting in Python or Bash. * Monitoring and observability: Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, PMM or comparable tooling; comfortable writing alert rules and dashboards. * CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance. * Clear written communication; comfortable working with a distributed team. * Willing to join an on\-call rotation. ### **Nice to have** * Solid experience with strace, tcpdump, and GDB * Ceph cluster administration (RBD, CephFS, RGW) beyond the S3 interface. * Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS) or Percona/PostgreSQL/MongoDB certifications. * Experience with ProxySQL, Orchestrator, Patroni or similar HA/proxy layers. * Memcached and Redis operations at scale. * CDN and DDoS mitigation (Cloudflare, Akamai or similar). * Experience modernizing legacy Perl/PHP platforms or supporting a migration to Python services. * GPU node operation for self\-hosted LLM inference. * Prior work in high\-traffic consumer web, media or payments environments. ### **Our environment** **Area** **What you’ll work with** Compute Bare\-metal and cloud Kubernetes clusters; Linux hosts Databases Percona MySQL 8\.0 fleet (\~300 servers, primary/replica); PostgreSQL (multiple clusters); MongoDB Storage Ceph, NFS, S3\-compatible object storage for large media libraries Monitoring PMM, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Slack alerting Caching Memcached, Redis, Varnish **Area** **What you’ll work with** Application stack Python (FastAPI), PHP, Perl; active migration to Python services Compliance PCI DSS; age\-verification and content\-moderation systems Team \~18 engineers plus QA and PM staff This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: ace has partnered with a prestigious, leading global hedge fund to appoint a Senior QA Automation Engineer to its Legal \& Compliance technology organization in New York. This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a test management one. You will design, build and run AI\-enabled automated test capability for the systems the firm relies on to meet its regulatory obligations. You will also establish how AI\-enabled compliance systems themselves are tested and evidenced. In\-scope systems include trade and communications surveillance, transaction and regulatory reporting, control room and information barriers, and adjacent compliance platforms. The role is deliberately not tied to one function. You will be deployed wherever the need is greatest: hardening a surveillance model release one quarter, assuring a reporting change against a regulatory deadline the next. You will be expected to get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar domains, work out what “correct” means from requirements and regulation, and turn that into rigorous, automated, auditable test coverage. You will work with a high degree of autonomy in a demanding, fast\-moving environment, where the expectation is delivery rather than management overhead. **Please note that this role requires presence in the client’s New York office five days per week. This is non\-negotiable.** **Responsibilities** ***Test engineering across compliance systems*** * Design and build automated test suites, covering unit, integration, regression, end\-to\-end and data validation, for compliance applications and data pipelines across multiple functions. * Engineer test frameworks and harnesses in Python for service, API and data\-layer testing, and in TypeScript/JavaScript where front\-end or UI testing is needed. * Validate high\-volume trade, order, position and transaction data at field level and record level. This includes reconciliation between source systems, enrichment layers and regulatory outputs. * Build synthetic and scenario\-based test data that exercises edge cases, such as complex instruments, lifecycle events, amendments, cancellations and late or out\-of\-sequence data, without exposing production data inappropriately. * Test surveillance logic and alert generation. Confirm that rule and model changes behave as intended and that their downstream impact on alert volumes and coverage is understood before release. ***AI\-enabled testing and AI assurance*** * Use large language models (Gemini on Google Cloud preferred) to interpret requirements, distinguish well\-formed from poorly formed requirements, identify coverage gaps, and generate candidate test scripts, test data and expected results, with a human in the loop and full traceability. * Design and orchestrate agent\-based test execution, including how individual agents are scoped, coordinated across a single test scenario, and constrained by entitlements so that no agent can reach or surface data outside its permitted scope. * Define and implement assurance approaches for LLM\-enabled compliance capabilities, such as communications surveillance, alert triage, document classification and extraction. This covers evaluation datasets, accuracy and tolerance thresholds, regression checks when a model or prompt changes, and tracking of drift and consistency. * Produce evidence of AI system behavior that will stand up to compliance oversight, internal audit and regulatory scrutiny, including versioning of models, prompts and evaluation results. ***Platform engineering*** * Contribute to the firm’s in\-house automated testing platform and extend it, driving its adoption across the applications in scope. * Integrate test execution with source control, pull\-request workflows, requirements management and CI/CD, so that coverage is derived systematically rather than assembled manually. * Own the infrastructure and environments for test tooling through a code\-first, infrastructure\-as\-code approach. ***Lineage, governance and assurance*** * Deliver end\-to\-end lineage from requirement and rule change through test script, execution, results and UAT evidence, with full versioning and auditability. * Produce test evidence that stands up to internal audit, compliance oversight and regulatory scrutiny. * Implement entitlements and access controls within test tooling so that no test process can reach or surface data outside its permitted scope. ***Ways of working*** * Move between compliance functions as priorities shift, building working knowledge of each domain’s data, rules and regulatory drivers. * Work directly with engineers, business analysts and compliance subject\-matter experts to turn requirements, including ambiguous ones, into precise acceptance criteria. * Raise automation standards across the teams you work with through code review, pairing and reusable components. **Requirements** ***Essential*** * Strong, current, hands\-on software engineering experience with a specialism in test automation, at the level of a software engineer who specializes in quality rather than a tester who scripts. * Advanced Python, covering test frameworks (e.g. pytest), service and API testing, and data manipulation at scale. * Strong SQL and experience validating large, complex datasets, including reconciliation between systems. * Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern UI test tooling (e.g. Playwright, Cypress). * Hands\-on experience applying large language models to real engineering problems in production, rather than proofs of concept, with a clear view on controls, traceability and data access. * CI/CD and infrastructure as code. GCP and Terraform are strongly preferred; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is an advantage. * Disciplined engineering practice: Git, branching strategies, pull\-request workflows, code review and repeatable release processes. * Experience testing systems in a regulated financial services environment, ideally capital markets. * A track record of taking automation into genuine production adoption and owning it thereafter. * The ability to learn a new domain quickly and work independently at pace, making day\-to\-day implementation decisions without direction. ***Advantageous*** * Experience building with Gemini on Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI), or comparable enterprise LLM platforms. * Experience evaluating or testing ML/LLM\-based systems, for example building evaluation sets, measuring precision and recall, testing for robustness, and handling outputs that vary between runs. * Exposure to one or more compliance technology domains: trade or communications surveillance; transaction and regulatory reporting (e.g. CAT, CFTC Part 43/45, SEC Regulation SBSR, EMIR, MiFIR); control room and information barriers; books and records. * Understanding of trade and order lifecycle data across asset classes. * Familiarity with model risk management expectations (e.g. SR 11\-7\) as they apply to AI in regulated environments. * Experience with event\-driven or streaming architectures (e.g. Kafka). **Benefits** Contract Length: 6 months, 3 months rolling Day rate: $1,000\-1,500/d, depending on experience

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer, East
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** Glean is seeking an Enterprise Solutions Engineer, East. **You will:** * Partner with Account Executives to navigate complex, multi\-stakeholder deal cycles with C\-level executives * Create and demo custom environments based off of customer industry and line of business * Run and manage a technical POC cycle * Perform customer facing activities including technical discovery calls * Lead security based conversations to make customers comfortable with Glean’s security posture * Work cross functionally with product and engineering to deliver customer request and be a voice of the customer * Develop ROI and business justification reports and presentations **About you:** * 5\+ years of sales engineering or solution consulting experience in a SaaS organization * Bachelor's degree in CS or a related field * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Highly motivated, driven and self\-starting individual * Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment * Clear examples of partnering with AEs to run technical deal cycles with Enterprise customers * A consultative approach with solving your customer’s business challenges and having a track record of successfully overcoming technical and security objections * Familiarity with any cloud environment (GCP, AWS, Azure) * Proficiency in Python or Java * Ability to configure, monitor and maintain API based integrations **Location:** * This role is remote (must be based in the Eastern US) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard OTE range for this position is $180,000 \- $230,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-REMOTE **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: At **Going**, we help people travel and experience the world. As a bootstrapped and profitable travel\-tech company with over 2\.5 million members, we’re building the most delightful and intelligent travel platform in everyone’s pocket. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Going, you'll be a key contributor to building, scaling, and improving the systems that power our deals, alerts, price drops and new member experiences, and help more people experience the world through travel. We're looking for an experienced, product\-minded engineer who is comfortable working across the stack but brings particular strength in backend development, especially Ruby on Rails. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to build new features, improve existing systems, and help shape technical decisions that support our long\-term growth. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of features from conception through delivery, whether that means designing APIs, improving data models, building backend services, or contributing to the frontend experiences our members interact with every day. We're a collaborative team that values autonomy, thoughtful engineering, and pragmatic solutions. We're looking for someone who can navigate ambiguity, balance technical quality with business needs, and help elevate the engineers around them. We're also evolving how we build. AI coding agents and LLM tools are becoming a bigger part of how we work, from spec to production, and we want engineers who are excited to help shape how we use them well: with strong judgment, a high quality bar, and care for our members' data. **In the short term, you will** ------------------------------- * Get up to speed on our codebases, architecture, engineering practices, and products, and ship to production early, using AI\-assisted tools where they help you learn and move faster. * Contribute to the design, development, and delivery of full\-stack features, with an emphasis on backend systems built with Ruby on Rails. * Collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Product, Design, and Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Design, build, and maintain APIs, database models, and backend services that support our web and mobile applications. * Contribute to frontend development using React and Next.js, helping deliver cohesive end\-to\-end experiences. * Help improve the accuracy, freshness, and reliability of the systems behind our deal, alert, and price drop experiences. * Refactor, test, debug, and improve existing systems, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions, bringing thoughtful recommendations and helping others navigate tradeoffs. **In the long term, you will** ------------------------------ * Take ownership of complex, end\-to\-end projects, helping guide technical direction from initial design through implementation and ongoing maintenance. * Become a trusted technical resource for our Ruby on Rails applications, APIs, and the broader systems that power Going. * Help improve the scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability of our backend infrastructure as our products and member base continue to grow. * Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems, reduce technical debt, and improve the developer experience. * Help build the internal tools, APIs, and safe, well\-permissioned access that let teams across Going (such as Member Success, Operations, and Data) automate more of their own work, with clear guardrails and human review. * Partner with engineers across teams to establish patterns, share knowledge, and advocate for engineering best practices, including how we use AI tools responsibly and the quality bar we hold AI\-assisted code to. * Mentor and support other engineers through collaboration, code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. * Bring creative, pragmatic solutions to challenging technical and product problems, balancing long\-term sustainability with the need to deliver value to our members. * Continue growing your technical expertise while helping cultivate a collaborative, curious, and accountable engineering culture. * Be on call from time to time. **Our Values** -------------- * **Champion travelers \-** We grow by delivering measurable value to members. * **Pilots, not passengers \-** We take ownership with a bias for action, urgency, and shared responsibility. * **Bet boldly \-** We tackle ambitious problems by making data\-driven bets. * **Start simple \-** We iterate quickly to quality. * **Make it magical \-** We spark the joy of travel through thoughtful moments of surprise and delight. * **Go further \-** We push a little harder and care a little more, especially when it matters most, because effort compounds over time. **What you know** ----------------- * You’re legally authorized to work in the Unite ous communication. * **Mentorship and shared ownership:** You enjoy helping other engineers grow, sharing your knowledge, and contributing to a team where everyone takes responsibility for delivering great work. * **Resilience and accountability:** You recognize that mistakes and challenges are part of engineering. You take ownership of outcomes, learn from setbacks, and help foster a culture of continuous improvement rather than blame. **Must Have's** --------------- * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through meaningful projects and technical contributions. * Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production applications using **Ruby on Rails**. * Experience building, designing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services. * Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, SQL queries, and performance optimization. * Experience with JavaScript and modern frontend frameworks, preferably React or Next.js. * Experience writing automated tests, debugging production issues, and maintaining reliable applications. * Familiarity with asynchronous processing and background job systems, such as Sidekiq. * Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and the tradeoffs involved in building and maintaining complex applications. * Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and frequent, incremental releases. * Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical projects while collaborating effectively with others. ### **Nice to have’s:** * Experience with React, Next.js, or TypeScript in production environments. * Experience with Redis, Sidekiq, and background job processing at scale. * Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, or cloud\-based infrastructure. * Experience modernizing legacy systems, improving application architecture, or incrementally refactoring large codebases. * Experience building and supporting APIs consumed by both web and mobile applications. * Familiarity with authentication, authorization, payment integrations, or subscription\-based products. * Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization. * Experience working on consumer\-facing products, growth initiatives, or experimentation platforms. * Experience building LLM\-powered features, evaluations of AI output quality, or agent tooling (such as MCP integrations) in production. * Experience with real\-time pricing, alerting, or data pipelines. **Why you might love working here** ----------------------------------- * The salary for this role is $148,732 \+ equity * 100% remote work environment * Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City. * Open vacation policy, with a 15\-day minimum * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance * 401(k) with a 5% match * $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend * Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave * Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co\-worker * Continuing education \& development reimbursement * Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day *We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. We accept you for who you are and consider everyone on an equal opportunity basis without regard to ancestry; age; appearance; color; gender identity and/or expression; genetics; family or parental status; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; mental, physical, or sensory disability; national, social or ethnic origin; past or present military service; sexual orientation; socioeconomic status; race; religion or belief; hair length; organ donor status. Going is an E\-Verify employer.* ‍*If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance for any part of the interview and employment process, please contact us at* *careers@going.com* *and let us know the nature of your request.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Transformation
jobs.description: About GoodLeap: GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best\-in\-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy\-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI\-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018\. GoodLeap is also proud to support our award\-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life\-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1\.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.### **Position Summary** GoodLeap's AI Transformation team partners with business units across the company to enable safe and effective AI adoption through tools, guidance, training, and custom solutions. As a Software Engineer on the team, you will build the AI solutions GoodLeap runs on: AI agents, Claude plugins and skills, evaluation frameworks, and integrations with enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, Databricks, Okta, and Salesforce. This role is primarily focused on AI solutions work, with crossover into our Salesforce (SFDC) team — you should expect to periodically pick up Salesforce platform work (integrations, automation, AI features inside SFDC) as business priorities require. ### **Essential Job Duties \& Responsibilities** * Build \& Ship AI Solutions – Design, build, and maintain AI agents, Claude plugins/skills, evaluation harnesses, and integrations with enterprise systems (Microsoft 365/Graph, Databricks, Okta, SharePoint). Own solutions end\-to\-end from prototype through production support. * Business Unit Partnership – Work directly with business units in consult and co\-develop engagements: gather requirements, prototype quickly, train users, and hand off or maintain solutions. * Salesforce (SFDC) Crossover – Support the Salesforce team as needed: platform integrations, workflow automation, and AI capabilities within the SFDC ecosystem. * Quality \& Operations – Write tests and evals, participate in code review, document solutions, and support the tools the team owns. ### **Required Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python * Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or AI\-assisted development tooling (e.g., Claude, MCP, agentic workflows) * Strong API integration skills; comfort working across third\-party enterprise systems * Cloud experience (AWS or equivalent) * Exposure to the Salesforce ecosystem (Apex, Flows, SOQL, platform APIs) a plus — willingness to work in it required * Strong communication skills; able to work directly with non\-technical business partners * Bias to action; comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration Base pay range (CA, WA, NJ, MA, DC, NYC) per year: $116,700 \- $145,100 Base pay range (all other US locations) per year: $106,100 \- $131,900 **Please note:** **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** **Additional Information Regarding Job Duties and Job Descriptions:** Job duties include additional responsibilities as assigned by one's supervisor or other managers related to the position/department. This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and other skills required for the position. The Company reserves the right at any time with or without notice to alter or change job responsibilities, reassign or transfer job position or assign additional job responsibilities, subject to applicable law. The Company shall provide reasonable accommodations of known disabilities to enable a qualified applicant or employee to apply for employment, perform the essential functions of the job, or enjoy the benefits and privileges of employment as required by the law. **If you are an extraordinary professional who thrives in a collaborative work culture and values a rewarding career, then we want to work with you! Apply today!** We are committed to protecting your privacy. To learn more about how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information during the application process, please review our **Employment Privacy Policy** and **Recruiting Policy on AI**. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Quantum Control, Quantum AI
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience designing embedded software, firmware, or device drivers. * Experience developing kernel drivers for hardware devices (e.g., NICs, PCIe devices, or hardware accelerators). * Experience reading and interpreting hardware schematics, datasheets, and register maps. * Experience with C, Linux kernel internals (memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization primitives), DMA engines, and cache coherency. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with embedded real\-time CPUs, real\-time Linux patches (PREEMPT\_RT), or bare\-metal development. * Experience with PCIe device drivers, enumeration, and bus controllers. * Experience with Yocto or Buildroot for creating custom Linux distributions. * Experience with hardware description languages (Verilog or VHDL) and FPGA constraints. * Experience with userspace I/O frameworks (e.g., DPDK, SPDK, or VFIO) for high\-performance applications. * Experience writing Linux subsystem drivers (e.g., V4L2, ALSA, or IIO). **About the job** ----------------- As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop low\-level software for electronics that control and readout our future quantum computers. You will collaborate with electrical engineers and FPGA/ASIC designers to bring custom hardware to life, ensuring drivers exploit full performance capabilities for scaled quantum processors. In this role, you will develop firmware and drivers delivered with Quantum's control and readout electronics. You will contribute to hardware\-software co\-verification, collaborating with architects and digital designers to understand functional requirements, design verification plans, and drive their execution. Additionally, you will participate in system architecture discussions and contribute to software system requirements. Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with the hardware team during pre\-silicon and post\-silicon phases to perform board bring\-up, verify register maps, and validate hardware behavior against specifications. * Integrate drivers into the broader software stack, including RTOS (if applicable), userspace libraries, and HALs. * Diagnose complex system\-level issues using JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and kernel debugging tools (ftrace, kgdb, crash). * Provide feedback to hardware designers on register interfaces and interrupt mechanisms to improve software programmability in future hardware revisions. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description: In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 1 year of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data. * 1 year of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 2 years of experience in the Payments industry, working on risk or fraud management. * Experience in querying and analyzing large sets of data. * Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Statistical analysis and Machine Learning libraries (e.g., R, Scikit\-learn,TensorFlow), Programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C\+\+), Large Language Models (LLMs) or Generative AI. * Demonstrated ability to identify workflow pain points, optimize, automate and scale processes. * Excellent problem\-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever\-changing environment. * Strong project and program management skills. **About the job** ----------------- Trust and Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that test the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products such as Play, Cloud, Pay, YouTube, Shopping, Fi. In this role, you will work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed with urgency. And you will take pride in knowing that every day you will be working hard to promote users’ trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. You will be responsible for restricting or preventing fraudsters and abusers to ensure a safe and secure payments environment for our users. You will be keen to identify and solve complex problems and have very strong investigative and technical skills to innovate and optimize our processes and tools. You will be proactive, motivated, organized, responsible, innovative and are able to work well in a changing, global, cross\-functional, and team\-oriented environment and demonstrate very strong technical know\-how, effective communication to get things done. You will also work with product and engineering teams to make sure that new products and features provide a good, safe experience for users. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $108000 \- $153000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Mitigate payment fraud and abuse to protect Google products and users. * Investigate fraud trends and design end\-to\-end risk management solutions. * Analyze payments data to build tools, signals, and system improvements. * Partner with engineering, product, and cross\-functional teams to launch mitigation strategies. * Ability to participate in the on call rotation schedule to manage high priority escalations that may occur outside of standard non work hours including weekends/holidays Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year The application window will be open until at least November 30, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Irvine, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages. * Experience deploying resources via Terraform or similar tools to automate the setup of agents, functions, or networking. * Experience building full\-stack applications that interact with enterprise IT infrastructures and developing external customer projects. * Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks like ReAct and self\-reflection. * Experience debugging agent logic and optimizing tool selection, including tracing conversation identifications (IDs) across microservices to identify and resolve failures in real\-time. * Experience connecting agents to enterprise knowledge bases and optimizing retrieval\-augmented Generation (RAG) chunking to prevent hallucinations. * Ability to travel up to 30% of the time as needed. * Track record of troubleshooting live, high\-traffic systems during critical windows. **About the job** ----------------- As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI, you will be the Agent Engineer and the primary driver for our customers' most critical AI initiatives. You will take initial conversational prototypes and transform them into production\-ready solutions, owning the end\-to\-end engineering lifecycle, including the transition from art of the possible to real\-world business value and scalable, secure AI systems. This is a high\-travel, role focused on leading technical delivery for conversational AI pilots and establishing the first customer user journeys (CUJs) for our largest customers at their sites. You will have an understanding of software engineering, Machine Learning operations, and cloud infrastructure.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. jobs.description: Overview: **THE ROLE** At Great Dane, we rely on makers and we’re calling on them to join our expanding team, the time has never been better to Embrace Your Great and work in an environment with the highest safety standards in the industry. The Position: The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for the development automation pipeline of all enterprise Java projects. They understand modern application development methodologies, tools, infrastructures, and work cultures. They promote industry standards and best practices which integrate Security and DevOps disciplines to accelerate delivery of secure, elastic and resilient application solutions. Responsibilities: **WHAT YOU’LL DO*** Application and infrastructure design from concept through development and implementation while ensuring scalability, performance and maintainability * Provides training, guidance, mentoring and leadership * Leads daily standup meetings, hold regular training or refresher workshops * Supervising and overseeing all technical aspects of all projects * Provides maintenance support and assist with updates to existing applications * Implements the application deployment strategy, including automation and CI/CD strategies * Oversee, design, and ensure appropriate source code management policies and practices are implemented and maintained. * Provides guidance of DevOps and hosting server infrastructure. * Interfaces with external vendor to coordinate integration of technologies * Take part in continuous training in company policies/procedures and industry regulations. * Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, encourage innovation and a culture of collaboration by experimenting with and learning new technologies. * Responsible for recruiting, hiring, performance reviews and career advancement of subordinate developer positions * Other duties as assigned. Programming languages: Java, SQL - Front\-end architecture components: JavaScript, JSON, ReactJs, MaterialUI - Event Streaming \& Messaging: Apache Kafka - Cloud Platforms \& Infrastructure: AWS - RDMS: Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB, Aurora PostgreSQL - Enterprise solution applications: ERP, CMS, CRM Server Architectures: Docker, Kubernetes, SpringBoot, Weblogic, Tomcat - * *Skills:* Strong working knowledge of modern web development, distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native application development, and relational databases + Comprehensive knowledge of software, application, systems, and network engineering principles + Ability to serve in an architectural role, designing scalable, resilient solutions for complex business and integration challenges + Ability to apply analytical and problem\-solving skills to resolve complex design, performance, and distributed system challenges + Ability to lead teams through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent initiatives with varying timelines + Ability to facilitate healthy technical debate and help team members resolve conflict constructively * *Travel*: Up to 10% **PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:*** Office and plant environment. * Keyboarding, lifting, standing, bending, walking. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **ABOUT GREAT DANE** With a history dating back to 1900, Great Dane has established itself as a transportation solutions leader of today – delivering innovative products and exceptional services that help our customers and employees succeed.
