jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We’re looking for talented professionals to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone’s fingertips. This position is classified as structured hybrid, with an expectation of three (3\) days per week working in the office and flexibility to work remotely on the remaining days. On\-site expectations may evolve over time to support business needs, with clear communication provided in advance. \<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\> **JOB DESCRIPTION** Location Requirement This position is open only to candidates who currently reside in one of the following approved locations: West Los Angeles, CA **About Green Dot** We're looking for talented professionals, anywhere in the United States, to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone's fingertips. Green Dot is a financial technology and registered bank holding company. Our platforms support millions of customers and enterprise partners, and they must run securely, reliably, and in compliance with banking and payment\-industry standards. **Role Overview** As a **Principal Site Reliability Engineer**, you will be the senior technical leader for reliability, release management, and database operations across Green Dot's cloud and hybrid platforms. You will set the strategy and standards for how we build, deploy, observe, and recover our services. You will own the end\-to\-end release process from code merge to production, and you will make sure our data tier (SQL Server, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and related data stores) is highly available, performant, and resilient. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact individual contributor role. It requires deep expertise in software and systems engineering, sound judgment in a regulated environment, and the ability to influence engineering teams across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** **Site Reliability Engineering** * Define and drive the SRE strategy, standards, and roadmap for availability, latency, scalability, and resilience across critical payment and banking services. * Establish and govern **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets** with product and engineering stakeholders, and report on reliability KPIs regularly to leadership. * Architect and maintain highly available, fault\-tolerant infrastructure across **Azure and AWS**, including multi\-region and disaster recovery (DR) designs. * Govern and improve the observability platform (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) with **Datadog** as the primary tool, supplemented by Prometheus/Grafana and native cloud monitoring (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch). * Lead **incident management**: act as Incident Commander for high\-severity events, run blameless post\-incident reviews (RCAs), and track corrective actions to completion. * Take part in and improve the on\-call rotation, including runbooks, alert quality, and escalation paths. * Make sure messaging and event\-driven systems (e.g., **Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ**) process messages efficiently, and monitor them for lag, dead\-lettering, and throughput. **Proactive Reliability \& Resilience** * Lead capacity planning, performance testing, and cost optimization for cloud infrastructure. * Reduce toil through automation and self\-service tooling. * Run chaos engineering, resilience testing, and DR/business continuity exercises to validate RTO/RPO targets. **Release Management** * Own the **enterprise release management process**: release planning, scheduling, release calendars, change windows, and go/no\-go decisions. * Design and implement predictable, automated deployment strategies (**blue/green, canary, rolling, feature flags**) across Dev, QA, UAT, Staging, and Production. * Architect, standardize, and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** in **Azure DevOps** and **GitHub Actions** (Jenkins where applicable), with automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates built in. * Drive **GitOps** practices (e.g., Argo CD) so that infrastructure and application deployments are declarative, version\-controlled, and auditable. * Lead **Change Advisory Board (CAB)** participation and change management, and make sure releases have the approvals, evidence, and audit trails needed for regulated environments (e.g., SOX, PCI DSS). * Define branching, versioning, and environment\-promotion strategies, and oversee rollback and hotfix procedures. * Coordinate cross\-team releases with Development, QA, Product, Security, and Operations, and communicate release status, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. * Track and improve **DORA metrics** (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, mean time to restore). * Maintain release documentation, release notes, and post\-release reviews in **Jira** and **Confluence**. **Database Reliability Engineering** * Act as the reliability lead for the data tier: **Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance, Cosmos DB**, and related stores (e.g., **PostgreSQL, Redis**). nd audits with evidence. * Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and lead adoption where they add measurable value. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * **10\+ years** of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Release Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering, with a record of running complex, high\-availability production systems. * **5\+ years** of hands\-on experience leading release management or CI/CD for multiple teams or services. * **5\+ years** of hands\-on database experience with **Microsoft SQL Server and/or Azure SQL**, and hands\-on experience with **Azure Cosmos DB**, including HA/DR, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting. * Deep expertise in **Azure** (required) and working knowledge of **AWS**. * Production experience with **Kubernetes (AKS/EKS)**, **Docker**, and **Helm**. * Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code and **GitOps**: **Terraform** (required), plus Ansible and Argo CD or similar. * Expertise with CI/CD tooling: **Azure DevOps** pipelines, **GitHub Actions**, and Git\-based workflows. * Expert\-level observability experience with **Datadog** or comparable platforms (logging, APM, metrics, alerting). * Strong scripting and automation skills in **PowerShell, Python, and Bash**; strong T\-SQL skills. * Experience with messaging and event bus technologies (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or similar). * Experience running incident response, RCAs, and on\-call programs. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineers and executives. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in **financial services, banking, payments, or fintech**, including working under PCI DSS, SOX, or similar regulatory controls. * Experience with progressive delivery or feature\-flag platforms. * Experience with caching technologies (**Redis**) and PostgreSQL. * Familiarity with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and Kubernetes security best practices. * Experience with .NET application environments and Windows Server/IIS as well as Linux. * Certifications such as **Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, CKA/CKAD, AWS Solutions Architect**, or ITIL. **\*\*Ability to work in the U.S. without sponsorship\*\*** **\*\*Ability to meet the location requirement outlined above\*\*** **POSITION TYPE** Regular**PAY RANGE** The targeted base salary for this position is $129,000 to $193,400 per year. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. \<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\> **We’re Here to Support You—Accommodations Upon Request** Green Dot is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, we encourage you to let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs in a way that respects your privacy and ensures equal opportunity. Our goal is to support every applicant in showcasing their talents and potential. **Work Authorization Requirement** At Green Dot Corporation, we value diversity and strive for fair and inclusive hiring practices. However, we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout the duration of employment, without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Important Notice on Application Accuracy** We value integrity in our hiring process. Please ensure that all information provided in your resume and application is accurate and authentic. Submissions found to be fraudulent or misleading will result in disqualification from consideration, and any offers extended may be rescinded.

jobs.description: **Flight Sciences Software Validation and Verification Engineer 2 in GAC Savannah** **Unique Skills:** **Background** -------------- Gulfstream is seeking an engineer to join our Flight Sciences team and help lead the charge in creating and delivering the world’s finest aviation experience. Within Flight Sciences, the Software and Performance Products team is responsible for implementing, verifying, validating and certifying flight\-critical onboard software, ensuring the necessary levels of reliability for safe aircraft operation. The scope encompasses both flight control systems software (that implement “fly\-by\-wire” control laws) and applications for aircraft performance prediction and flight mission planning, for use by the customers in operation. In this role, you will contribute to the full spectrum of those activities, working closely with multi\-disciplinary teams of development engineers, including laboratory and flight testing, engaged in the development of future Gulfstream aircraft and expanding current capabilities. *Candidates with additional applicable experience may be eligible for a higher\-level position (Technical Specialist I, Technical Specialist II or Technical Specialist III)* **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Perform tasks for the development and certification of safety\-critical onboard software that implements control laws in the aircraft control system (“fly\-by\-wire”). * Perform tasks for the development and certification of aircraft performance prediction and mission planning software. * Participate in the development and refinement of software requirements. * Apply model\-based design techniques to support software development. * Perform software testing for verification and validation, through desktop simulation, laboratory tests with “hardware in the loop” and flight test activities. * Update simulation models and automation scripts used in both software integration labs (SIL) and hardware integration labs (HIL). * Perform validation and verification activities to demonstrate software compliance with DO\-178C, DO\-331 and ARP4754, as required by certification entities (FAA, EASA and international certification institutions). * Enhance and expand software test framework and analysis tool suite. * Actively collaborate with teams across Flight Sciences, Labs, Flight Test, and other teams to meet those objectives. **Required Skills and Abilities** --------------------------------- * Experience programming with MATLAB and using Simulink to create models. * Proficient with Python scripting with Object Oriented principles and Class hierarchy. * Experience with automating tasks and processes. * Knowledge of software testing processes and standards. * Solid understanding of flight control fundamental principles, closed loop systems, and controller performance tuning. * Solid understanding of airplane flight characteristics, first\-principles analyses, and airplane performance methods. * Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills. * Strong coding skills and software development practices including using requirement management tools. **Preferred Skills and Abilities** ---------------------------------- * Knowledgeable of Systems Engineering principles of Requirements Management, Validation, Verification, Change Management, Process Assurance and Functional Integration. (ARP4754A \& DO\-178 experience desired) * Experience with Model\-Based Engineering development processes, particularly using MathWorks Simulink or similar. * Experience with aerospace system test development and result analysis, either in a simulation or integration test environment. * Experience building automated CI/CD pipelines to accelerate software delivery cycles. * Unix/Linux experience. **Education and Experience Requirements** ----------------------------------------- Bachelor's Degree Engineering or a related curriculum required or equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job. 18 months related Engineering experience. Experience credit will be considered for related advance degrees limited to 2 years for Master's and 4 years for PhD in field applicable to the job position. **Position Purpose**: Performs engineering work related to the investigation and the solution of technical problems associated with research, design, development, service and manufacture of Gulfstream aircraft.**Job Description** ------------------- Principle Duties and Responsibilities: Essential Functions: * Solves typical engineering problems within assigned discipline . * Provides technical assistance to engineering staff and contributes to completion of project milestones . * Responsible for a complex engineering assignment, or a full project of lesser complexity . * Follows established schedules while developing plans for engineering assignments . * Obtains appropriate level of supervisor approvals for work accuracy and adequacy . * Proficiently applies company/organization policies and procedures . Additional Functions: * Actively works to improve daily processes, and ensures all work meets customer requirements . * Maintains a current and up\-to\-date knowledge of developments and application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in assigned field of expertise . Perform other duties as assigned. Other Requirements: * The level of technical skills and abilities appropriate for this grade will be established by each discipline. * Applies knowledge to provide solutions to a variety of technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, using a combination of judgment with defined practices and procedures. * Failure to achieve results, or erroneous decisions or recommendations, may cause delays in program schedules and/or allocation of additional resources. * Ability to convey technical concepts in both written and verbal formats. * Contacts are primarily within the organization, with occasional customer contacts on routine issues. * Works under general supervision for routine tasks of minor complexity. * With supervision/mentorship, can coordinate the activities for lower level engineering staff. This job requires one to be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language. **Additional Information** Requisition Number: 234546 Category: Engineering Percentage of Travel: Up to 25% Shift: First Employment Type: Full\-time Posting End Date: 11/26/2026 Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans Gulfstream does not provide work visa sponsorship for this position, unless the applicant is a currently sponsored Gulfstream employee. jobs.description: **About Harry’s** Harry’s is a men’s grooming brand that offers high quality shave, body, hair, and skin care products at an exceptional value. Launched in 2013, Harry’s redefined the shaving experience and helped pioneer the earliest era of direct to consumer in the process. Since then, the brand has become the \#2 shave brand globally and expanded to offer products for every step in its customer’s routine. Harry’s is also on a mission to ensure guys have access to quality mental health care. To date, the brand has helped connect over 2 million men to quality mental health resources. Harry’s is part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category\-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,” the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date. We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day\-to\-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it. **About the team** ------------------ The Harry’s technology team builds and runs the digital commerce experience for one of the key brands in the Mammoth portfolio. We own the headless Shopify storefront end to end — the React Router/Hydrogen applications our customers shop on, the subscription experience that keeps them coming back, and the infrastructure that serves it all. We are a small, high\-leverage team operating in a long\-tail SaaS ecosystem: rather than building everything ourselves, we integrate best\-in\-class platforms and write the code that makes them work as one coherent experience. That means the engineering here is genuinely full\-stack and genuinely commercial — the work you ship shows up in conversion, retention, and revenue within days, not quarters. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Harry’s storefront team. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an engineer who has experience with **Headless Shopify builds** and consistently delivers high\-quality, independent work, incorporates best practices, and is starting to step up as an emerging leader on a small team. You’ll build and operate features across our headless Shopify architecture — storefront performance, subscription flows, experimentation, and the integrations that tie them together. You’ll take well\-scoped projects from requirements to production with little oversight, help teammates with their deliverables, and translate business needs into technical requirements. This role reports to an engineering manager and partners daily with Product, Growth, Retention, Creative, and Analytics. **What you will accomplish** ---------------------------- * **Deliver projects autonomously.** Own well\-scoped storefront features and projects in familiar technology, delivering on time with work that requires little validation or oversight. * **Ship high\-quality work.** Deliver secure, testable, maintainable, low\-defect, efficient code that incorporates best practices. * **Release with confidence.** Collaborate within a small team to release changes to production without impacting performance or reliability. * **Practice operational excellence.** Be fluent in the tools, techniques, and best practices the team uses for quality assurance and operational stability. Participate in On\-Call rotations after your first 90 days. * **Document what you build.** Create clear exemplars, frameworks, and technical documentation — design docs, runbooks, API documentation, code reviews, and incident write\-ups. * **Debug beyond your own code.** Identify and correct defects within the technologies you work in, from the React Router/Hydrogen application through third\-party platform integrations. * **Course\-correct quickly.** Recognize when an initial approach isn’t working and pivot to a better solution. * **Map business needs to technology.** Translate business requirements into technical requirements and recommendations, balancing short\-term and long\-term tradeoffs. * **Help the people around you.** Assist teammates with their deliverables, share what you know, and grow into technical leadership on the team. **This should describe you** ---------------------------- **Required** * Solid professional experience building and operating production e\-commerce ------- Our values describe the “how” of the job, and they matter as much as the technical work. At this level, that looks like: * **Look Left to Find Right.** You communicate a clear technical point of view, understand the views of others, and connect your work to the team’s goals and the broader business. * **Improve Always.** You learn continuously, pivot when you find a better approach, and share what you know with your teammates. * **Embrace the Mammoth.** You give and ask for clear, direct feedback, own your mistakes, and hold a high bar for the quality of your own work. * **All In All Together.** You help teammates with their deliverables, adjust as priorities change, and respect the expertise of cross\-functional partners. **Benefits and perks** * **Medical, dental, and vision coverage** * **401k match** * **Equity in Mammoth Brands** * **Flexible time off and working hours** * **L\&D stipend** * **4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years** * **20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood** * **Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop** * **Free products from our family of brands** *The Mammoth Brands' working model is in\-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Our beautiful* *70,000 square foot SoHo office* *is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday. Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!* We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture. jobs.description: ### Position Overview HighRes is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our team. We are looking for someone who thrives in both architecture and development tasks, with a passion for creating systems and driving the evolution of architecture. Our Cellario OS™ lab orchestration platform orchestrates instruments, workflows, and data, and serves as the open execution layer for AI Scientists, both autonomous agents and AI\-enabled researchers, returning traceable, trustworthy lab data. As a principal engineer you will be at the forefront of our application’s development lifecycle. Your role will encompass everything from planning, designing and building to testing. jobs.title: AI Engineer Team/Project Lead
jobs.description: We are looking for the right people\- people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. **The role:** As an AI Engineering Team/Project Lead on our Data \& AI team, you will work on a project team with two other engineers, leading the work of turning real engineering and operations workflows into agents that people across Halliburton rely on every day. You will build on our established agent platform, which spans Databricks and Azure, and extend it as you go. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with no direct reports. You will write code every day, set the technical direction for your team, and put working agents in people's hands. You lead by building, not by managing tickets or running status meetings. Success is measured by what is live and in use, not by plans and presentations. **What you'll do:** * Lead from the keyboard\- Work on a project team with two other engineers, write production code every day, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself. * Ship workflows that get used\- Lead your team in turning real engineering and operations workflows into production agents on our platform, from first conversation to daily use. * Own requirements and roadmap\- Work with business stakeholders and the people who do the work to define requirements, cut scope and keep a roadmap focused on what delivers the most value. * Set and review architecture\- Define the architecture for your team's agents, review designs and code, and hold a high bar for reliability, security and maintainability. * Connect agents to the business\- Use secure tool and data connectors (including MCP servers) to give agents governed access to Halliburton data and engineering applications. * Prove it works\- Use the platform's evaluation and tracing to show each agent is reliable, then track adoption and time saved in production. * Keep agents on track\- Build optimization routines and monitoring that catch drift, regressions and failures early, so agents keep operating as designed long after launch. * Raise the team's speed\- Make AI\-first development the norm on your team, using coding agents, shared templates and code reviews to help every engineer ship faster. * Own what you ship\- Fix what breaks and keep improving your team's agents based on real use. * Add to the platform\- When you hit a gap, contribute the template, connector or evaluation that closes it, so the next workflow ships faster. **Who you are:** * AI\-first by default\- You reach for an agent before you open a ticket. Your own workflow is already heavily automated, and you can show us how. * A builder with high agency\- You don't wait for a perfect spec. You get the smallest useful version live fast, then harden and expand it. * A leader who builds\- You earn trust through your code and decisions, not status meetings. * Allergic to repeated work\- When you see the same task done twice, you build a tool so nobody has to do it a third time. * Comfortable in the mess\- Legacy systems, messy data and shifting requirements don't slow you down. * Results over demos\- A demo is not the finish line. You measure success by evaluation results, adoption and demonstrated time savings for the business. * Fluent in business and code\- You turn business needs into a roadmap, then build it with your team. **What you'll need:** * Must have 6\+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated work. * Degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * Experience leading the technical work of a small engineering team (setting architecture, reviewing code and mentoring) while remaining a hands\-on contributor. * Track record of working directly with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into clear requirements and a delivery roadmap. * Strong Python, and comfort working across the stack (APIs, services, simple internal user interfaces). * Shipped LLM\-powered agents to real users, ideally multi\-agent systems rather than single prompt chains: tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, and prompt and context engineering. * Hands\-on experience with agent frameworks and protocols (for example LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol) — and the judgment to know when not to use one. * Experience testing non\-deterministic systems: building eval sets, automated scoring and regression checks. * Solid engineering fundamentals: Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers and cloud deployment. * Hands\-on Azure experience, such as Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Kubernetes Service or Container Apps, and Entra ID. **Nice to have:** * Databricks\- Mosaic AI Agent Framework / Agent Bricks, MLflow tracing and evaluation, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, Vector Search. * Developer tooling\- You have contributed to SDKs, internal platforms or shared libraries that other engineers use. * Total ownership\- You treat what you build as your own. You take it from idea to production and stay accountable for the outcome, not just your piece of it. * Open source\- Contributions to AI or developer tooling projects. * Energy or industrial exposure\- Helpful, not required. We will teach you the domain; we can't teach you to build. **What success looks like:** * First 30 days\- You know the platform and your team, and have agreed on the team's first workflow, its success measure and an initial roadmap with business stakeholders. * First 90 days\- Your team's first workflow is shipped and in regular use by the people it was built for, with a measured result such as hours saved. You wrote a meaningful share of the code. * First 6 months\- Your team has several workflows live and in daily use, stakeholders trust the roadmap, and the architecture and review standards you set help the team ship faster. **World Class Benefits:** At Halliburton, we're committed to providing you and your family with a comprehensive and affordable benefits package \- which means we offer support for your physical, emotional, financial and parental needs, both now and in the future. When you join our team, you'll have access to a wide range of resources designed to help you thrive at work and at home. By clicking here, you can review a summary of the benefits available once you join. **Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.** **Location** Houston, Onsite **Job Details** **Requisition Number:** 213139 **Experience Level:** **Job Family:** Engineering/Science/Technology **Product Service Line:** Global R\&D **Full Time / Part Time:** Full\-time **Compensation Information** Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. *Please Note: This posting is intended to collect candidate information for Halliburton’s talent pool, and is not considered an application. By completing the candidate profile, recruiters will have visibility to your information in order to contact you for a future related job opportunity. In addition to providing your information on this posting, we encourage you to create a Job Alert within our career site. The Job Alert allows you to select search criteria for positions that match your interest(s). Once positions are posted that match your search criteria, you will receive an email notification.*

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer- South
jobs.description: Company Summary: Hampton Lumber is a thriving family\-owned company aspiring to be North America's preferred source for responsibly\-sourced wood solutions. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, we operate ten sawmills across Oregon, Washington, South Carolina, and British Columbia. We also manage timberland and operate a wholesale and import/export division. Our mission is to grow, manufacture, and market renewable wood products and deliver innovative solutions for a more sustainable built environment. At Hampton Lumber, we accomplish this through our own operations as well as those of our affiliates—Trapa Forest Products, Idaho Timber, and RedBuilt. Our motto, "Find a better way every day," encapsulates our commitment to innovation and improvement across all operations. We are guided by our core values: * **Safety** – Prioritize safety across all operations. * **Integrity \& Authenticity** – Operate honestly and ethically while preserving our distinctive family\-owned brand. * **Responsible Stewardship** – Endeavor to balance and maintain economic, social, and environmental values in everything we do. * **Tenacity** – Embrace challenges with grit, determination, and a can\-do spirit. * **Continuous Improvement** – Strive to enhance our processes, products, and people. * **Customer Satisfaction** – Be nimble, responsive, and solutions\-oriented. * **Community Engagement** – Be a responsive, supportive, and respected member of the community. With over 80 years in the sawmill business, we are proud to have cultivated the knowledge and experience needed to grow and prosper, even in challenging times. We always look to the future and invest in our people, new technologies, and continuous improvement processes and techniques. Overview: Hampton Lumber is a family\-owned company that has been manufacturing lumber since 1942, and we are investing in the future. Our new, state\-of\-the\-art sawmill near Fairfax, South Carolina is now starting up, and nearly every piece of equipment in it is connected, from scanners and optimizers to cameras, kilns, and the business systems that run the operation. As our IT Infrastructure Engineer, you will be Hampton IT’s onsite technology partner at the mill and a full member of our corporate Infrastructure team. You will work with modern technology, have real ownership from day one, and see the direct impact of your work on a brand\-new operation. Hampton IT is an exciting place to be right now. Technology is moving faster than ever, and we are leaning in, putting data, automation, and AI to work wherever they create real value for the business. We are helping a company with more than 80 years of history run like a modern one, and unlike most IT jobs, you can walk out onto the mill floor and watch your work run. If you are naturally curious and love figuring out how things work, there is no better place to do it. We are looking for a strong IT generalist with a solid networking foundation. You will have an experienced IT team behind you, so you do not need to know everything. Empathy, clear communication, and the ability to explain the why behind IT standards matter as much as technical skill. Be Part of the Infrastructure Team* Share ownership of enterprise platforms (identity, Microsoft 365, endpoint, server, backup, and network) and take on assigned enterprise projects. * Document the site so the broader team can support it, and keep corporate IT informed about what is happening on site. Benefits Highlights: * Substantial company\-paid assistance for Medical and Dental insurance premiums; mental health coverage; cost effective co\-pays and deductibles * 401(k) with 5% annual company contribution and generous company matching contributions vested over three years * Paid time off, including nine paid holidays * Participation in the employee bonus program * Employee wellness program that includes free counseling sessions, financial and legal guidance, and more * Opportunities for paid training to support career advancement and personal development Responsibilities: **Own IT at the Mill*** Own the health and reliability of the site’s IT infrastructure: switching, wireless, firewalls, internet connectivity, onsite servers and edge compute, and network rooms. * Monitor, patch, and maintain site systems to Hampton standards, and keep site documentation current. * Handle hands\-on work such as cabling, rack installs, and device replacements for the broader Infrastructure team. **Support the Production Network*** Provide hands\-on build and support for the mill’s production (OT) network, working with the Electrical \& Controls Engineering team and the onsite PLC Superintendent. * Help support connected equipment such as optimizers, scanners, HMIs, and cameras, and the links between production and business networks. * Help maintain IT/OT segmentation and secure vendor remote access, and coordinate with equipment vendors and integrators. **Partner with the Mill and Represent IT*** Build tru isibility, and efficiency, and help turn them into supported solutions. **Own the Outcome for Every Site Issue*** Be the first call for anything technical at the mill. You won’t personally fix every printer, but you will make sure it gets fixed, staying engaged until the user is taken care of. * Keep site leadership and affected users informed during outages and production\-impacting incidents. * Experience with Fortinet, Cisco, or Meraki; OSPF and multicast; Microsoft Intune; and PowerShell. * Certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, CCNA, or Microsoft certifications. **What Success Looks Like*** Mill leadership and frontline teams see you as a trusted member of the mill team. * Site stakeholders bring IT in early on projects, equipment changes, and planned downtime. * The mill understands the reasons behind IT standards, and approved solutions replace workarounds. * Every site issue has an owner, and people feel taken care of regardless of who resolves it. * The mill can point to technology improvements that made a measurable difference, such as fewer delays, better visibility, or less manual effort Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, military, and industry experience. * 5\+ years in systems administration, network administration, or a similar IT generalist role * Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs and trunking, routing, DHCP, DNS, wireless, and firewalls. * Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting managed switches, firewalls, and fiber connectivity. * Hands\-on experience with Windows Server and Windows clients, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365\. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical topics to non\-technical audiences. * Comfort working independently and taking initiative, and willingness to learn industrial networks alongside controls engineers and electricians. * Ability to work safely on an industrial plant floor with required PPE, participate in on\-call, and travel; valid driver’s license. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or other operations\-focused environments, or as the primary IT resource at a remote site. * Experience supporting industrial (OT) networks and systems alongside controls engineers and PLC technicians; familiarity with Rockwell FactoryTalk systems and EtherNet/IP. * Understanding of IT/OT security concepts such as the Purdue model, ISA/IEC 62443, industrial DMZs, and secure vendor remote access. * This is a hybrid role. Working onsite at the mill 2–3 days per week is required, with the remaining days worked remotely More About Us: The timber and wood products industry is a vital part of many communities, and we’re excited to bring new opportunities to Allendale County, South Carolina. We are committed to supporting the local workforce, investing in training and development, and being active members of the communities where we operate. Many of our employees have built long, rewarding careers with us, and we look forward to welcoming new team members to our family. Learn more at Hamptonlumber.com, follow us on Facebook \& Instagram: @hamptonlumber EEO Statement: Hampton Lumber is an equal opportunity employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by law. Disability accommodation available: If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation in the application or hiring process, please contact the Human Resources Office for the location that you are applying. Women and minorities are encouraged to apply. jobs.description: Our team members are the key to our company’s success, and their health and well\-being, as well as that of their families, is very important to us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that allows our team members stay healthy, plan for their future and maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Benefits may vary with employment status. To see our fill list of Team Member Benefits please visit our career site: www.gotoworkhappy.com/benefits **Job Description:** At Seminole Hard Rock Support Services, we are on a mission to protect our guests, team members, and enterprise assets through world\-class cybersecurity practices. As the Network Cybersecurity Engineer, you will implement, operate, and continuously improve the network security controls that defend traffic in, out, and across the enterprise — from the campus and data center edge to SASE, cloud networks, and the applications they carry — turning architecture and policy into running, automated, measurable defenses. Reporting to the Director of Cybersecurity Engineering and Operations, this role requires a hands\-on, security\-minded engineer who bridges the worlds of network engineering, cloud operations, and cybersecurity. You will configure and tune the enterprise network security stack — secure access service edge, perimeter and edge defenses, network detection and response, and zero\-trust segmentation — and build the integrations and automations that connect it together across on\-premises environments and Microsoft Azure (primary), Amazon Web Services, and Google Cloud. This is a builder’s role, not an architecture role. You do not define standards from the sidelines; you take reference architectures and network security requirements and make them real: deploying and tuning controls, writing production\-grade automation, and instrumenting the telemetry that turns raw network events into actionable insight. Your networking depth lets you treat traffic as evidence, and your fluency with AI and large language models lets you accelerate detection, triage, and analysis of network data far beyond manual effort. You will work across campus, data center, edge, remote access, and cloud network domains, partnering with architecture, IAM, infrastructure, application, and SOC teams to ensure network controls are deployed consistently, operate reliably, and improve continuously across all Seminole Hard Rock business units. You measure your impact in risks reduced, incidents prevented, and manual effort eliminated through automation. **Responsibilities** **Secure Access \& Edge (SASE)** * Deploy, configure, and tune secure\-access service edge controls — secure web gateway, cloud firewall, CASB, and DLP policy — keeping coverage complete and policies current * Operate zero\-trust network access for workforce and third parties, replacing legacy VPN patterns with identity\-aware, least\-privilege application access * Operate the enterprise browser to enforce least\-privilege, isolated access to sensitive applications from managed and unmanaged endpoints via an enterprise browser platform * Tune SSL/TLS inspection, tenant restrictions, and egress policy to balance security, privacy, and application compatibility — including protocols sensitive to interception such as NTLM, Kerberos, and certificate\-pinned traffic * Manage traffic steering, forwarding, and PAC configurations so users land on the right control path from any location worldwide **Perimeter, WAF \& Application Edge** * Manage edge and perimeter defenses: web application firewall rules, DDoS mitigation, bot management, CDN and DNS policy for internet\-facing properties * Operate API security posture and runtime protection, discovering shadow APIs and closing authentication and data\-exposure gaps * Administer next\-generation firewall policy, NAT, and rule lifecycle across data center and property perimeters, driving rule hygiene and least\-privilege access * Harden DNS, certificate, and TLS posture at the edge in partnership with the PKI and infrastructure teams * Coordinate perimeter changes with franchise, property, and vendor networks so remote sites integrate securely without breaking authentication or application flows **Network Detection, Response \& Visibility** * Deploy and tune network detection and response, triaging anomalous east\-west and north\-south activity and feeding high\-fidelity findings to the SOC * Engineer network telemetry pipelines — flow data, DNS logs, proxy logs, firewall logs, packet metadata — that route, shape, and enrich data for cost\-effective analysis * Develop and tune network\-focused detections and SIEM content, mapping coverage to attacker techniques * Investigate network\-layer incidents end\-to\-end — from packet capture and flow analysis to proxy and firewall log correlation — isolating root cause under time pressure * Maintain authoritative visibility of network assets and attack surface, continuously reconciling what is connected against what is inventor  caught by pipelines, not people * Instrument metrics and dashboards that make network control coverage, detection efficacy, and remediation timeliness measurable **Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement** * Partner with Cybersecurity Architecture, IAM, infrastructure, application, and SOC/MSSP teams to deploy network controls consistently and resolve issues quickly * Support Cybersecurity Strategy \& Governance, audit, and privacy programs by automating evidence collection and continuous control monitoring for network controls * Document standards, runbooks, integration designs, and operating procedures so network controls are repeatable and supportable * Research, prototype, and pilot emerging network security tools and AI\-driven capabilities that improve detection, automation, and analyst efficiency * Participate in an on\-call rotation and incident response for a 24/7 gaming and hospitality environment **Qualifications \& Experience** * 3–5\+ years of combined experience in network engineering, network security engineering, or cloud networking, with at least 3\+ years focused on hands\-on network security engineering in enterprise environments * **Deep network engineering expertise**, with hands\-on experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting enterprise networks: routing and switching, firewalls, proxies, VPN/ZTNA, load balancing, DNS, and TLS/PKI * **Strong automation and software proficiency**, with hands\-on experience in Python, PowerShell, Go, or similar languages, and the ability to build custom network security tooling, integrations, and automation from scratch * **Practical experience applying AI/ML or large language models** to network data analysis, detection, triage, or automation * Strong working knowledge of SASE / SSE platforms (secure web gateway, ZTNA, CASB, DLP), WAF and DDoS mitigation, NDR, and API security * Hands\-on experience securing cloud networks on Microsoft Azure (required), with working experience in AWS and/or Google Cloud: virtual network design, cloud firewalls, private connectivity, and network security posture management * Deep networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, BGP/OSPF, DNS, DHCP, TLS/PKI, NAT, IPv6, packet analysis, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models * Experience integrating network security tools and data sources via API, with familiarity in SOAR playbook development and SIEM content engineering * Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to gaming and hospitality (PCI\-DSS, SOX, tribal gaming regulations, GLBA), preferred but not required * Relevant certifications preferred: Cisco CCNP Security, vendor certifications in next\-generation firewall and SASE/SSE platforms, Microsoft AZ\-700 or AZ\-500, AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, GIAC (GCIA, GDSA, GCLD), or equivalent; CISSP a plus **Professional Skills** * Translate network security requirements and architecture into deployed, automated controls that operate reliably and integrate cleanly into existing networks and workflows, without creating friction * Operate as a hands\-on engineer who personally builds, configures, tests, and ships high\-quality automation and integrations, measuring success in problems solved, not tickets closed * Troubleshoot methodically across physical, virtual, and cloud network layers — from packet captures to policy engines — isolating root cause under time pressure during incidents * Collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams: cybersecurity, network and infrastructure engineering, cloud, IAM, compliance, and the SOC * Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders, including property and franchise contacts * Thrive in an Agile, fast\-paced environment that values automation, rapid iteration, and measurable security outcomes over manual process * Demonstrate a builder’s mindset and a passion for using engineering and AI to make network security faster, more consistent, and more scalable

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Developer** **Independent Contractor \| Hybrid — Tucson, AZ \| Paid Development Project** **Are you an experienced software developer looking for the opportunity to create something from the ground up—and see it become a real commercial product?** Hartman Glass \& Mirror (HGM), an established specialty\-glass contractor in Tucson, Arizona, is seeking an exceptional independent software developer to lead the creation of a new, commercially marketable AI\-assisted dispatch and scheduling platform. We have the business, the operational experience, an existing technical partner, and a real\-world environment ready to test the product. **We're looking for the right developer to turn our vision into working software.** The Opportunity This is more than a typical programming assignment. You'll take a leading technical role in designing, developing, testing, and delivering an independent Windows\-based scheduling application intended for future licensing to other contractors. Our goal is a professional, reliable product that makes complex scheduling decisions easier for dispatchers. The system will analyze technician availability, skills, crew requirements, job priorities, travel considerations, customer preferences, and other scheduling constraints to recommend the **two best appointment options—with clear explanations.** The application's critical scheduling functions must operate offline. AI may provide additional assistance, but dependable optimization and practical functionality come first. What You'll Develop * A professional, intuitive Windows desktop dispatch application. * A powerful scheduling and constraint\-optimization engine. * An independent, locally hosted SQL database. * Smart job assignments based on availability, crew size, skills, workload, customer preferences, and travel. * A reliable, secure, multiuser application with backups and audit trails. * A documented API for connecting with existing business systems. * Software designed for commercial licensing, maintainability, and future expansion. Our vision is a **stand\-alone application without a mandatory cloud subscription**, capable of operating in real business environments. The Developer We're Looking For We are interested in highly capable, hands\-on developers with demonstrated experience in: * Windows desktop software development. * SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or comparable database architecture. * Scheduling algorithms, constraint optimization, or complex business logic. * Secure API development and software integration. * Offline\-capable, multiuser business applications. * Full software lifecycle development, including testing, documentation, and deployment. Experience with contractor\-management software, dispatching, field\-service scheduling, or commercial desktop products is especially valuable. **Formal credentials are welcome, but proven accomplishments matter more.** We want someone who can show us successful software they have personally developed and delivered. Work Arrangement — Hybrid / Tucson, Arizona **Most software development may be performed remotely.** Occasional in\-person meetings at our Tucson office will be needed for planning, demonstrations, workflow reviews, product testing, and important project milestones. * Day\-to\-day development may be performed remotely. * Meetings will be scheduled in advance whenever practical. * Applicants must be able and willing to attend occasional meetings in Tucson. * Meeting frequency and any applicable travel arrangements will be established before contracting. We welcome qualified developers from outside the immediate Tucson area who can accommodate these requirements. Why Work With Hartman Glass? **A real\-world development environment.** You'll have direct access to the business team responsible for using and testing the software. **Meaningful responsibility.** You'll lead the development of the new product—not simply perform isolated coding tasks. **An experienced technical partner.** You'll collaborate with our longtime software developer, who maintains our existing business systems and will lead integration changes on that side. **Direct communication with ownership.** We believe in open communication, practical decision\-making, and clearly defined responsibilities. **A paid, structured project.** We anticipate a compensated discovery/design phase followed by milestone\-based development, testing, integration, and delivery. **Commercial potential.** The finished product is intended to serve a broader contractor market, not just our own company. Compensation \& Project Structure This is a paid independent contractor opportunity. We are open to qualified developers proposing hourly or milestone\-based compensation. Scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, payments, software ownership, and source\-code/documentation handoff will be established through a mutually agreed written development contract. A reasonable mutual confidentiality agreement will be required before sharing nonpublic business or technical information. Ready to Build Something That Matters? **We are not looking for someone who only knows how to talk about AI. We are looking for someone who knows how to BUILD dependable software.** If you enjoy solving real operational problems, value quality work, and want to help bring a new software product to market, we'd like to hear from you. **Please include the following with your application:** * Examples of Windows desktop or commercial software you've personally developed. * Your experience with SQL databases, optimization, and system integration. * Your proposed approach to developing this type of application. * Your availability and hourly or milestone\-rate expectations. * Your location and ability to attend occasional meetings in Tucson. * Your approach to testing, documentation, and long\-term support. Links, screenshots, or demonstrations of publicly shareable projects are encouraged. **Hartman Glass \& Mirror \| Tucson, Arizona** *An established business. A genuine opportunity. A product worth building.* Pay: $20,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $182,750 – $278,500 • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About Agentic Engineering at Headway** Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. Agentic Engineering is one of three teams in Engineering Foundations, alongside Infrastructure Engineering and Eddy, Headway's internal AI platform. Not all engineering work is interesting. We want engineers to spend less time on repetitive maintenance and more time on work for our customers. AI tools change every few months, so we do not try to own one correct way to build. We find what works and make it the easy default. We build only the Headway\-specific parts that no vendor will build for us. We measure our work by business results, not by the number of tools we ship. When product teams ship faster, Headway can do more for patients, providers, and payers. Today, our work has three parts. Every engineer uses the best AI coding tools. Agents move a change from ticket to merged pull request. Engineers get new ways to understand and review code that they did not write line by line. **Principles that Guide Us** * Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapists to better solve the problems they're facing. * Ship small, learn fast: We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration. * Everything is a product: Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end\-users in mind. * Optimize for trust: We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes. **About this role** Help Headway's engineers go fast and have a blast as AI agents write more of the code. Find what slows product teams down, and build the agentic tools and habits that fix it. You will be a senior engineer on Agentic Engineering. Your users are other Headway engineers. You will work closely with the product teams that build for patients, providers, and payers. You will not wait for requests. You will go to the teams, start the conversation, and find the large themes behind their problems. Start with a business goal. For example, if Headway wants more patients on the platform, talk to the patient team. Find what slows them down, and help them go faster. The fix can be an agent workflow for a manual task that a team does every week. It can be context that teaches agents one part of our codebase. Sometimes a team only needs a tool that we already built. Then your job is to show the tool to them and help them use it. Some of the work is building. Some of it is teaching: demos, show\-and\-tells, and short guides that other teams can use. We measure your work by how much faster the teams around you ship, not by how much code you write. You will also help decide what our team builds next. **What you'll own** * **Product team partnerships.** Work with product teams to find the delays that cost the bu nding.** Help engineers understand code that agents write. Find new ways to explain, review, and show changes. * **Impact measurement.** Connect each tool to a business result. Measure throughput, time saved, and adoption. Stop work that does not show results. * **Team operations.** Share on\-call, code review, design review, and interviews with the team. **Tools we use** Cursor, Claude Code, and other AI coding agents · Eddy (our internal AI platform) · Python 3, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Temporal, Celery · TypeScript, React · Postgres, Redis · AWS, Terraform · Datadog · GitHub, Buildkite **Who you are** You are a senior engineer who uses AI to build every day. You use tools such as Claude Code or Cursor in your own work, and you made your own workflow better with them. For every project, you first ask who the customer is and what problem you solve for them. Your users are other engineers, and you go to them. You do not hesitate to message an engineer that you have never met. You are comfortable when the best answer changes every few months. When a better tool becomes available, you replace your own tool with it. **Experience we're seeking** * You have 5 or more years of software engineering experience, much of it on backend systems, platforms, internal tools, or developer tools. * You built internal or developer tools, and you got an organization to adopt them. You can explain how you got that adoption and how you measured it. * You built something real with LLMs or coding agents. You know where they fail, and you used evals, guardrails, or human checks to control those failures. * You write strong backend code in a large production codebase. Python is a plus. * You changed how a team works without being its manager. You did this through close partnership, trust, and changes based on feedback. **Nice to have** * Agent frameworks, workflow engines, or orchestration (Temporal or similar) * Context and retrieval systems, or LLM evals * CI/CD and test infrastructure * Teaching or enablement, such as workshops, internal guides, or champions programs * Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain **You'll love this role if you want to** * Help decide how a full engineering organization builds software with agents * Work each week with the engineers who use what you build * See a team change how it works because of something you showed them * Do work that helps make mental healthcare accessible and affordable **Comprehensive benefits:** --------------------------- Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave. We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. jobs.title: Senior Ai Engineer
jobs.description: Senior AI Software Engineer About Us Health Data Analytics Institute (HDAI) is a commercial\-stage HealthTech company. Our Intelligent Health Management System, HealthVision™, is a first\-in\-class enterprise solution leveraging real\-time predictive analytics and generative AI to deliver improved outcomes, efficiencies, and economics for health systems and value\-based care organizations. HDAI is located in Dedham, MA near the Dedham Corporate Center Commuter Rail station on the Franklin/Foxboro line (25 minutes from Back Bay and South Station, Boston) and I\-95/128\. Summary We are hiring a Senior AI Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Data Science and production software by owning our full AI/ML backend. This includes a high\-throughput predictive inference engine (scoring 580\+ patient risk models in real time) and generative LLM pipelines on Amazon Bedrock (powering clinical summaries and diagnostic discovery). You will work across the entire backend stack as priorities shift, developing deep domain expertise while ensuring complete system coverage. We expect you to use AI tools daily to multiply your output. Responsibilities * **Inference engine.** Own the system that scores patients against hundreds of predictive models in production. Understand the scaling concerns (580\+ models, memory pressure, compute efficiency) and drive architectural improvements. * **ML productization.** Work with Data Science to take model artifacts (coefficient files, scoring logic built in R) and ensure they run correctly in the production Python inference pipeline. Understand the underlying model logic and statistical outputs well enough to validate data and parity between the R development environment and production output. Build tooling that automates validation and reduces the manual reimplementation cycle. * **LLM applications.** Build and maintain production LLM integrations on Amazon Bedrock (Claude) for AI summaries, PDD, and conversational interfaces. Manage prompt lifecycle: design, versioning, testing, and evaluation. Handle the specific challenges of LLM applications in production: token management, output validation, evidence citation, structured output parsing, and graceful degradation. * **Production AI engineering.** Build and maintain production Python services on AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\). jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Primary Work Address: 19700 Helix Drive, Ashburn, VA, 20147 The Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Janelia Research Campus is a pioneering research center in Ashburn, Virginia, where scientists pursue fundamental questions in the life sciences. Our integrated teams of biologists, computational scientists, and tool\-builders innovate research practices and technologies to solve biology’s deepest mysteries. HHMI launched Janelia in 2006, establishing an intellectually enriching environment for scientists to do creative, collaborative, hands\-on work. We share our methods, results, and tools with the scientific community. **About the project** AI@HHMI is HHMI’s $500 million, 10\-year investment in AI\-driven science, embedding AI systems throughout every stage of research in labs across HHMI. HHMI is also partnering with frontier AI labs on scientific applications of AI (learn more). At the heart of AI@HHMI is the Foundational Microscopy Image Analysis (MIA) project. Our goal is to build one of the world’s most comprehensive multimodal 3D/4D microscopy datasets, and use it to power a vision foundation model that accelerates discovery across the life sciences. Our current focus is reconstructing connectomes at scale from expansion microscopy (ExM) data generated by High\-Throughput Connectomics, a sister AI@HHMI project. **About the role** You will develop and deploy production\-ready pipelines for segmenting and proofreading connectomes from expansion microscopy imaging across fly, zebrafish, and *Danionella*. You will scale reconstruction from individual datasets to hundreds or thousands of connectomes, working with large\-scale volumetric data on a compute cluster with around 800 GPUs. This role combines deep understanding of the underlying models with hands\-on engineering and careful attention to reconstruction quality. You will work closely with microscopists, cell biologists, neuroscientists, and computer scientists so that models hold up on large, real\-world data. Your home is Scientific Computing, a department of about 35 AI, data, and software engineers, where you will report to department leadership. Your day\-to\-day work is directed by the AI Scientist who leads the MIA AI@HHMI project, a team of seven scientists and engineers. This is primarily an individual\-contributor role, with potential opportunities to mentor junior engineers. **What you will actually do** * **Reconstruct connectomes at scale** using our pre\-trained segmentation models. * **Train and fine\-tune models** as new ground\-truth data becomes available. * **Evaluate rigorously.** Design and run rigorous model evaluations to measure and improve reconstruction quality. * **Optimize inference pipelines.** Increase reconstruction throughput on GPU clusters. * **Build proofreading workflows.** Build and support proofreading workflows (for example, integration with CAVE). * **Coordinate annotation.** Coordinate manual annotation and proofreading efforts to improve training and evaluation data. * **Release your work.** Release pipelines, models, and reconstructions to the broader scientific community, with a focus on reproducibility and downstream usability. * **Collaborate across disciplines.** Advise stakeholders on data strategy and best practices, and potentially mentor junior engineers. **What success looks like in your first year** * You’ve taken ownership of the production reconstruction pipeline and run it end\-to\-end on new ExM datasets. * You’ve measurably improved throughput or reconstruction accuracy against an agreed benchmark. * You’ve delivered high\-quality connectome segmentations that need minimal manual proofreading. **What we are looking for** * **Production over prototype.** You have trained and evaluated deep learning models (Transformers, U\-Nets) for three or more years, ideally on 3D image data. You have also deployed them, with workflow orchestration and high\-throughput processing on GPU clusters, using tools such as Kubernetes, Nextflow, or LSF. * **First\-principles thinking.** When a result moves, you can explain why. You know how architecture and regularization choices change performance, and you can design the experiment that tests your explanation. * **Fluent in the toolkit.** You write strong Python in PyTorch or JAX. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Document AI & Scientific Data Extraction
jobs.description: Description: Welcome to Interclypse, where innovation meets passion. At Interclypse, you will find more than a career – you will discover a vibrant ecosystem where your talents are celebrated, your ideas are embraced, and your potential is achieved. Every Interclypse team member can benefit based on their efforts and collectively benefit through the overall company’s success. To actualize this vision, Interclypse employs a growth mindset culture that empowers employees to rise in their careers by providing them with tools, mentorship, and a supportive environment to ensure long\-term success. Interclypse is building a team to support the National Institute of Standards and Technology in making scientific research data machine\-readable. The work turns figures, tables, and messy instrument output currently locked inside published reports into standardized, discoverable data that researchers across the semiconductor and advanced manufacturing community can actually use. This is measurement science. Extraction accuracy is reported monthly and has to hold up. Requirements: **Responsibilities:** * Build pipelines that detect, crop, and extract figures and charts from scientific documents, capturing captions and identifying axis labels and units through OCR and layout analysis * Develop algorithms that extract embedded tables from PDF and DOCX while preserving row and column structure and headers * Create a library of parsers that convert non\-standard formats such as instrument ASCII dumps, spreadsheets with complex or merged headers, and loose text files into clean, schema\-valid CSV * Implement schema validation and heuristic cleanup for missing values, merged cells, and trailing metadata, flagging ambiguous cases for expert review * Build review interfaces so domain scientists can validate extracted assets and correct OCR errors before ingestion * Deploy the tooling as microservices inside an existing web application and integrate with a downstream discovery portal * Report extraction and parsing accuracy metrics, and improve them **Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field * 4\+ years of advanced Python, specifically Pandas and OCR libraries * 4\+ years with OCR pipelines and table extraction logic * 4\+ years in data format normalization and schema validation * 4\+ years integrating microservices into web applications * Able to work on\-site in Gaithersburg, Maryland **Preferred Qualifications:** * Document layout analysis or document\-AI models such as table transformers and layout models * Scientific or laboratory instrument data * Django, MongoDB, Docker * Open\-source contribution;
