As a Senior Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Connected Commerce, Travel division, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. **Job Responsibilities:** * Designs and implements complex features and services within owned domains; collaborates with upstream/downstream teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions; contributes to API contracts, versioning, and backward compatibility. * Contributes to production readiness and operational excellence by helping define/meet SLOs/SLIs, improving observability (logs, metrics, traces), participating in incident response and post\-incident reviews, and delivering durable fixes and runbooks to reduce repeat issues. * Applies secure\-by\-default and resilient design patterns in day\-to\-day development (timeouts, retries with exponential backoff/jitter, circuit breakers, bulkheads, idempotency, graceful degradation). * Authors design proposals and participates in design reviews; partners with Architecture and peer teams to align designs and reduce integration risk. * Writes secure, concise, high\-quality production code and reviews/debugs code across backend and frontend as needed. * Engages in pair programming, rigorous code reviews, and reliable estimation; builds user\-facing experiences that meet established performance and accessibility standards. * Applies database rigor across SQL/NoSQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, and caching to improve latency and throughput. * Integrates firm\-approved, privacy\-safe AI assistants into development workflows to accelerate test generation, documentation, refactoring, and static analysis triage—with human\-in\-the\-loop review and CI quality gates. * Follows established AI governance and guardrails (prompt hygiene, secrets/PII protection, provenance expectations, objective acceptance criteria such as lint/coverage/SAST/DAST/performance checks) and provides feedback to improve standards. * Contributes to measurement of AI\-assisted workflows (e.g., cycle time, defect trends) without compromising security or reliability. **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:** * Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience delivering production systems in a team environment, including ownership of major features/components and end\-to\-end delivery within a squad. * B.S. in Computer Science/Engineering or related field (or equivalent practical experience). * Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot development, SQL, and event\-driven/messaging systems such as SNS, SQS, and Kafka. * Hands\-on experience with AWS and cloud\-native services (e.g., ECS/EKS/Lambda, API Gateway, RDS/DynamoDB/CassandraDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM). * Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 with the ability to contribute to, debug, and review user\-facing code when needed. * Hands\-on experience in system design, RESTful JSON API design, microservices, application development, testing strategy, and operational stability within large, distributed environments. * Hands\-on experience across the SDLC, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices. * Strong understanding of security and resiliency, including OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, secrets management, encryption in transit/at rest, and resilient integration patterns (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, bulkheads). * Ability to author and present design proposals, participate effectively in design reviews, and influence technical decisions through data and collaboration. * Demonstrated ability to provide strong code reviews, support pairing/mentoring, and raise engineering quality across the team. * AI\-assisted development: operational experience using approved AI assistants within development workflows with human review and CI quality gates, following established governance and objective acceptance criteria. **Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills** * Experience in TypeScript and React. * Travel or hospitality domain experience, especially with booking flows, inventory consistency, and resilient integrations. * Experience contributing to evaluation practices for AI\-assisted development or AI features (offline metrics, canarying, telemetry, drift detection), in partnership with senior engineers/architecture. * Familiarity with frontend performance and accessibility best practices, including diagnosing and fixing common issues. **ABOUT US** Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs. We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans **ABOUT THE TEAM** Our Consumer \& Community Banking Group depends on innovators like you to serve consumers, small businesses, municipalities and non\-profits. You'll support the delivery of award winning tools and services that cover everything from personal and small business banking as well as lending, mortgages, credit cards, payments, auto finance and investment advice. This group is also focused on developing and delivering cutting edged mobile applications, digital experiences and next generation banking technology solutions to better serve our clients and customers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III- Python / AWS / AI Enablement
jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. As a Software Engineer III\- Python / AWS / AI Enablement at JPMorganChase within the Asset \& Wealth Management Technology team, you will design and build scalable services and platforms that power investment and wealth solutions. You will work hands\-on across application code and cloud infrastructure, delivering reliable, secure, and well\-observed systems. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, data/AI partners, and control functions to enable modern AI capabilities (including MCP and AI tooling integrations) while maintaining high standards for engineering excellence and operational stability. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and deploy Python\-based microservices, APIs, and data\-driven applications supporting AWM business workflows and platforms. * Build and operate cloud\-native solutions on AWS (or equivalent cloud platforms), focusing on scalability, resiliency, performance, and cost awareness. * Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) and integrate AI tools to enable safe, consistent, and reusable model/application interactions and developer workflows. * Design, deploy, and operate cloud\-native platforms using Kubernetes (e.g., EKS) and Terraform for Infrastructure as Code, with strong CI/CD practices (e.g., GitHub Actions/Jenkins, Argo CD) and build event\-driven and streaming solutions leveraging SNS/SQS messaging, streaming services (e.g., Kinesis/MSK), and AWS Lambda to deliver scalable, automated integrations. * Leverage enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. * Apply knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define technical requirements, design patterns, and service interfaces; participate in architecture and code reviews. * Establish strong observability practices (logging, metrics, tracing), drive incident response readiness, and continuously improve operational excellence. * Contribute to secure engineering practices (authentication/authorization patterns, secrets management, dependency hygiene, and SDLC controls). * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of inclusion, ownership, and continuous improvement. **Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills** * Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience * Python development experience (building production services/applications). * Hands\-on experience with AWS or another major cloud platform (designing, deploying, and operating cloud workloads). * Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and experience using AI tools to build or integrate AI\-enabled features/workflows. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, APIs, testing, reliability, performance tuning, and code quality practices. * Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. * Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices (e.g., automated testing, artifact/version management, release strategies). * Strong communication skills and ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, and control stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills** * Java coding experience (e.g., maintaining or integrating with JVM\-based services). * Exposure to front\-end development and React (e.g., building small UI components, supporting full\-stack delivery). * Experience with containers and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes/EKS) and/or serverless patterns. * Familiarity with observability tooling and practices (metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs). **ABOUT US** JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management. We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. JPMorgan Chase \& Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans **ABOUT THE TEAM** J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals. Our Asset and Wealth Management division is driven by innovators like you who are driven to create technology solutions that make us work more efficiently and help our businesses grow. It's our mission to efficiently take care of our clients' wealth, helping them get, and remain properly invested. Our team of agile technologists thrive in a cloud\-native environment that values continuous learning using a data\-centric approach in developing innovative technology solutions.

jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top\-notch technology products. As a Senior Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial \& Investment Bank, Commodities team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. The Commodities Line of business is one of the early adopters of thepython\-based Athena platform. The Application layer of Athena is entirely in Python with heavy application of Graph. Athena uses an in\-house built object database called hydra. Commodities Transformation is about modernizing the Commodities Athena platform. To that end the first aim to modernize the Commodity Physical Inventory Management for the physical trading. This is to uplift the existing system (which is also in Athena) into a robust, scalable, and consistent state. This also entails to developing an intuitive User Experience using cutting edge technologies. This is a full\-stack development challenge. Job responsibilities * Problem solving – given a problem statement find out and evaluate alternatives, plan, and build quick POC, present it to broader team and stakeholders. * Lead a group of engineers to provide innovative engineering design and solution to various challenging problems. * Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems. * Adoption of AI in creative way in all phases of the projects and do effective AI drives Spec Based Design and Development. * Participate and develop to create an intuitive user experience at the front end. * Develops secure high\-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others. * Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems. * Improves experience for trading, operations developing intuitive user interfaces and performant back ends. * Work with QR (Quantitative Research) group as well as other technical partners in a collaborative environment. * Partner with many groups both upstream and downstream with varied priorities. Communication is the key here. * Drives and executes within the strategy of macro technology, of which commodities is one section (aligning with rates and FX technology peers) Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience. * Leadership skills – plan, delegate, resolve conflicts and lead a group of engineers through the different phases of the project, * Quick learning abilities – Athena is Graph based enterprise system. You need to learn Athena quickly to become productive in shortest possible time. * Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and advanced applied experience * Hands\-on practical experience in any enterprise system in developing robust backend codes. * Advanced in one or more programming language(s). (Python, C\+\+ and / or Java) . * Willingness to become proficient and develop in Python if not already a primary language. * Knowledgeable in automation and continuous delivery methods * Knowledgeable in the Software Development Life Cycle * Prior track record of delivery within risk management in financial services * Ability to collaborate with and influence other technology teams to deliver end to end solutions to the business in a constantly changing environment. * Adoption of AI into all levels of design, development and testing phase. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills* Full stack development skillset – some hands\-on experience in UI development is a plus. * Concept of Risk, Markets – any knowledge in commodities markets is a plus. * Expertise in python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy is a plus. **ABOUT US** JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting\-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you. The Data Engineer works within the Data \& Analytics organization as part of the Warehousing \& Pipelines team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, modernizing, and supporting enterprise data integration solutions that power operational processes, analytics, reporting, machine learning, and enterprise data initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with deep data platform expertise and is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data systems using modern engineering practices. This position offers opportunities for advancement for a well\-qualified, driven candidate. This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70\-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Birmingham, AL; Cedar Falls; IA; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO. This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H\-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an in\-person interview or onboarding requirement to verify your identity. **What you’ll be responsible for:*** Works within the Data \& Analytics team in the Warehousing \& Pipelines function, collaborating closely with DBAs, Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders. * Designs, develops, tests, deploys, and maintains batch and streaming data pipelines supporting payment processing systems with strict availability and performance requirements. * Develops data integration solutions using SQL, C\#, Python, PowerShell, and related automation technologies. * Develops and supports event\-driven architectures using Change Data Capture (CDC), Kafka, messaging platforms, and stream\-processing technologies. * Develops, maintains, and modernizes legacy data integration solutions, including SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), transitioning workloads toward code\-first, version\-controlled development practices. * Creates and maintains CI/CD pipelines for data integration, analytics, and data platform solutions. * Implements monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability capabilities for data platforms and pipelines. * Works with Data Architects and enterprise data governance teams to populate and maintain enterprise data warehouse, lakehouse, and analytical data platform solutions. * Tunes SQL queries and database interactions to reduce impact on source systems and improve application performance. * Optimizes data pipelines to improve throughput, scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency. * Produces and maintains technical documentation, architectural diagrams, operational runbooks, and deployment procedures. * Leverages AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity and code quality while independently validating, reviewing, and testing all generated code. * Participates in on\-call rotations and provides after\-hours support as required. * May perform other job duties as assigned. **What you’ll need to have:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering. * Minimum of 3 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or database development. * Experience developing solutions on relational database platforms such as SQL Server and/or MySQL. * Experience developing applications or services using C\# or similar object\-oriented programming languages. * Experience developing and supporting ETL/ELT and data integration solutions. * Experience working with source control systems such as Git and participating in code reviews and pull request workflows. * Experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker. **What would be nice for you to have:*** Experience modernizing legacy analytics platforms, OLAP solutions, or analytical workloads. * Experience with cloud services and data platforms in GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, Ansible, or similar technologies. * Experience building and supporting Kubernetes\-based applications and services. * Experience developing data lakes, lakehouses, and open table format solutions using technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi, Parquet, or similar platforms. * Experience operating under PCI DSS, SOC, financial services, healthcare, or similar regulatory frameworks. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team. **Why Jack Henry?** At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “*Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.”* It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally. We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders. **Culture of Commitment** Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders. **Equal Employment Opportunity** At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business \- and our society \- stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law. No one will be subject to, and Jack Henry prohibits, any form of discipline, reprisal, intimidation, or retaliation for good faith reports or complaints of discrimination of any kind, pursuing any discrimination claim, or cooperating in related investigations. **Please be aware that Jack Henry recruiters will only email you from our domain, jackhenry.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links, open attachments, or share personal information.** *Requests for full corporate job descriptions may be requested through the interview process at any time.*

jobs.title: Automation & AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Partner with business and technology leaders to identify, design, and deliver AI, automation, and integration solutions that create measurable business outcomes. Apply modern engineering practices to transform operational processes, augment employee capabilities, improve customer experiences, strengthen risk management, and increase organizational capacity. Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle from opportunity discovery through solution design, deployment, adoption, value realization, and continuous optimization while ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise governance standards. Help build responsible AI and automation that helps move the business forward! **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Position Specific Responsibilities*** **Business outcomes:** Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities where AI, automation, integration, or process improvement can create capacity, improve productivity, strengthen controls, enable revenue, or improve the customer and employee experience. * **End\-to\-end ownership:** Own solutions from discovery and requirements through design, build, deployment, adoption, measurement, ongoing support, and optimization. * **Hands\-on AI \& automation engineering:** Design and build applications, workflows, integrations, APIs, agents, and other automation solutions using modern engineering practices. * **AI experience:** Experience with generative AI, RAG, agentic workflows, Copilot/Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Platform, and related technologies would be valuable. * **Responsible and sustainable solutions:** Build solutions that are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with our security, risk, privacy, and governance expectations. * **Measurable value:** Success isn’t just delivering something that works technically. jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, Professional Services
jobs.description: About Kinaxis: **About Kinaxis** ----------------- Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because *People matter* at Kinaxis. In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, with a brand\-new HQ based in Kanata North in Ottawa. As one of Canada’s Top Employers, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today. At Kinaxis, we power the world’s supply chains to help preserve the planet’s resources and enrich the human experience. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries, with more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries. We are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers. About the team: **Location** This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada, Mexico or the US**About the team** ------------------ We are embedding AI directly into how we implement, assure and support Maestro, and we are growing our Professional Services AI Development capability. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will work side by side with consultants, Solution Architects and subject\-matter experts to find high\-value Maestro and delivery problems, build AI\-enabled solutions quickly, and scale the ones that work across our global Professional Services organization. This is a hands\-on, field\-embedded engineering role. You will take problems from observation through prototype, production, adoption and measurable impact. This is not a data science or AI strategy role. About the role: **What you will do** -------------------- * Build AI solutions for Professional Services: design, prototype and productionize AI agents, automations and reusable components for implementation quality and knowledge, blueprinting and configuration, risk identification, UAT planning, documentation, integration, data readiness and validation and solution performance diagnostics. * Turn expertise into scalable AI: learn how experienced practitioners make decisions, then encode that expertise into governed AI workflows, keeping human judgment in the loop. * Prototype with the field: work in short cycles (observe, prototype, pilot, measure, improve, scale), embedding with delivery teams to validate solutions against real Maestro solution and implementation scenarios. * Engineer production\-quality applications: build agent orchestration, retrieval and grounding, API and enterprise integrations, evaluation and regression testing, observability, security and release management. * Create reusable patterns: contribute to a common PS AI development foundation, including agent patterns, connectors, evaluation frameworks, development standards, CI/CD and implementation playbooks. * Measure business impact: work with PS project manager and leadership to baseline and track time to value, configuration effort, PS hours per deployment, rework, adoption, AI operating cost and customer outcomes. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * Strong Python development experience * Hands\-on experience building applications with large language models, including agentic workflows and orchestration * Retrieval, grounding and context engineering techniques * Azure or comparable enterprise cloud engineering, plus API and enterprise integration experience * Git and modern CI/CD practices * Experience evaluating and testing probabilistic AI systems * Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and enterprise security fundamentals * Practical experience with several of: Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Claude / Claude Code, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, tool/function calling, RAG, structured outputs and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows **Nice to have** * Experience in enterprise software implementation, supply\-chain technology, professional services, solution architecture, enterprise SaaS or business\-process automation * Kinaxis Maestro experience is a plus but not required. We value a strong applied\-AI engineer who can learn Professional Services and Maestro quickly. **Who you are** * Builder\-oriented: you prefer shipping working solutions to producing strategy decks * Field\-oriented: you are comfortable observing consultants and customers to find the real problem * AI\-native and pragmatic: you build in evaluation, feedback loops and guardrails, and know when conventional software is the better answer * Product\-minded and collaborative: you turn one\-off solutions into reusable capabilities and work with experts rather than replacing them * Outcome\-driven: you measure success by customer quality, delivery speed and efficiency **What success looks like** In your first 90 days, you will learn the delivery lifecycle and current AI architecture, become productive in our common development environment, and take at least one use case from problem definition to a working prototype with a measurable baseline. Within 6 to 12 months, you will own several production AI capabilities, contribute reusable components used across multiple agents, and help scale proven solutions across regions and delivery teams. Associate \- **\#Associate** Why join Kinaxis?: **Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more. **Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Yamaha, P\&G, Honda, and more. **Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. *People matter* at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team: * Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month) * Flexible work options * Physical and mental well\-being programs * Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes * Mentorship programs and training and career development * Recognition programs and referral rewards * Hackathons For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com. Kinaxis strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply to our welcoming community. We strive to make our website and application process accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend, Infrastructure Focus)

Kotlin is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement, and we expect you to ramp up on Kira's stack (Kotlin, Python) * Hands\-on experience scaling a system through real growth, such as taking users or requests from tens or hundreds of thousands to millions, not only operating mature large\-company services * Experience designing APIs and event\-driven systems (queues, messaging), with a practical approach to scalable architecture * Experience with relational databases (for example MySQL) and operating production systems on cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS) * A track record of owning a multi\-week feature or initiative, including design decisions, and a clear, specific story about its impact * AI\-enabled development as a real daily workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar), with good judgment about when to use AI and when to solve or review code yourself. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $165,000 \- $195,000, depending on relevant considerations like professional experience and related skill sets * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee premiums * Flexible PTO policy and company holidays * DoorDash credit for lunch daily * Wellhub Membership: 100% company\-paid access to premium gym networks (Orangetheory, SoulCycle), 60\+ wellness apps (Headspace, MyFitnessPal, Apple Fitness\+), and 1:1 coaching sessions spanning fitness, mental health, nutrition, and sleep * 401(k) matching * Dog friendly office ***Equal Employment Opportunity Employer*** *At Kira, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco; Boston **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Product Overview **About Liquid AI** ------------------- Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general\-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on\-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. Working closely with engineering and go\-to\-market teams, you’ll turn customer feedback into improvements that make Liquid easier to adopt and use. **What We're Looking For** for a fully specified ticket. * **You care about the whole product.** You think beyond whether a feature works in isolation to how customers discover, integrate with and rely on it. * **You balance speed and durability.** You make pragmatic tradeoffs, ship iteratively and strengthen the systems that customers depend on. **The Work** ------------ * Build and improve the Console and APIs developers use to access and integrate Liquid’s models. * Own customer\-facing workflows end to end, from onboarding and API access to ongoing usage and account management. * Improve experiences around usage, credits and billing, connecting clear product interfaces to reliable backend services. * Make the platform easier to understand and operate, including how customers encounter limits, errors and other service behavior. * Work directly with customers and internal partners to identify friction, prioritize opportunities and ship pragmatic solutions. * Use production signals and customer feedback to improve reliability and usability, and partner with inference engineers on issues that cross the product and model\-serving stack. **Desired Experience** ---------------------- **What you'll need:** * Experience building and shipping customer\-facing software, including production APIs or services used by external developers or customers. * Ability to own meaningful projects end to end, from an ambiguous problem through a production outcome. * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience designing, debugging and operating reliable production systems. * Product judgment: you can understand user needs, weigh tradeoffs and make decisions that improve the overall experience. * Clear communication and the ability to work across engineering and customer\-facing teams. **Helpful, not required:** * Experience building developer\-facing platforms, APIs or self\-serve products. * Experience working across frontend and backend systems to deliver a complete product experience. * Familiarity with AI model APIs or inference, and the developer workflows around integrating them. * Experience working in a small team or early\-stage product where requirements and priorities evolve quickly. **What Success Looks Like (Year One)** -------------------------------------- * You’ve taken meaningful Console and API improvements from customer problem to production, making it easier for developers to get started and build with Liquid. * You’ve improved the reliability and usability of critical customer\-facing workflows, addressing recurring friction and helping customers use the platform with confidence. * You independently identify and prioritize opportunities, working with customers and teammates to make sound product and technical decisions. * You’ve strengthened the team’s ability to ship and support the product through thoughtful design, collaboration and shared context. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Direct product impact:** Help shape the Console and API that connect customers to Liquid’s models, with ownership from the first customer conversation through production. * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location. * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company\-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location. * **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Architect - Network Communications
jobs.description: **Position Description** ------------------------ The Superior Court of Los Angeles County is the largest unified trial court in the United States. The Court’s 582 judicial officers and its dedicated workforce of over 4,600 full\-time employees serving across 36 facilities work purposefully and seamlessly to achieve the mission to provide equal access to justice to all of Los Angeles County. At the heart of the Los Angeles Superior Court is commitment and collaboration between team members who contribute professional skill sets and meaningful work experiences toward the goal of serving the community at large. Accessible career paths, a healthy work\-life balance, job stability, and comprehensive total rewards including generous pay and benefits, a robust public sector pension, and Court matched 401K/457 individual savings plans, are just some of the values that the Court offers to every member of its thriving workforce. Plan your future with the Los Angeles Superior Court – connect with us today. **ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY** The Court is launching an exciting recruitment for a visionary **Senior Enterprise Architect – Network Communications** who will help shape the future of the Court’s enterprise network. This role offers the opportunity to lead modernization efforts across the wide area network, data center and campus networks, wireless, application delivery, and hybrid cloud connectivity that link the Court’s 36 facilities. You will influence network engineering standards, guide long\-term network strategy, and collaborate with teams across the organization to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performing connectivity. Candidates will work with enterprise platforms—from Cisco routing, switching, and wireless to F5 application delivery, carrier Ethernet services, and Azure ExpressRoute—to support mission\-critical Court operations. This is a unique chance to drive engineering excellence, contribute to major WAN modernization and geo\-redundant data center initiatives, and help build the next generation of the Court’s network. If you are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and shaping enterprise\-level networks, we encourage you to apply and join our forward\-thinking team. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain enterprise network engineering standards, reference architectures, policies, and governance frameworks to ensure consistent, scalable, secure, and sustainable network practices across the Court. * Provide senior\-level technical leadership and engineering guidance to network engineering and operations staff, serving as a technical resource for complex network architectures, troubleshooting, technology implementations, and enterprise infrastructure decisions. * Mentor, coach, and train network engineering and technical staff through hands\-on instruction, technical workshops, knowledge transfer, and collaborative problem\-solving. Promote engineering best practices, strengthen internal technical capabilities, and support the professional development of less\-experienced engineers. * Analyze current\-state and future\-state network environments, including WAN, LAN, wireless, and data center fabrics, to develop engineering roadmaps that guide long\-term network investments, technology lifecycle management, and modernization initiatives. * Advise Court leadership, project teams, and stakeholders on network technology decisions, architectural strategies, risks, and opportunities to ensure alignment with organizational priorities, operational requirements, and long\-term platform sustainability. * Research and evaluate emerging network technologies and industry trends, including SD\-WAN, Cisco and Juniper networking solutions, network automation, AI\-driven network management, and zero trust networking, to identify opportunities that enhance operational efficiency, reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability. * Serve as the technical lead for enterprise network infrastructure projects, coordinating technical activities from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, testing, documentation, and operational transition. Develop technical project plans, implementation schedules, milestones, resource estimates, risk assessments, and deployment strategies to support successful project delivery. * Provide technical project coordination and engineering oversight for major infrastructure initiatives, including carrier circuit migrations, data center builds, courthouse network refreshes, SD\-WAN deployments, and network automation projects. Collaborate with project managers, internal technical teams, external vendors, and telecommunications carriers to coordinate implementation activities, resolve technical challenges, and minimize operational disruptions. * Assess network vendor products, carrier services, technical proposals, and emerging solutions to determine alignment with Court requirements. Conduct technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concept initiat  and private endpoints, with strong governance over routing, segmentation, connectivity resilience, and cost optimization. * Hands\-on experience with application delivery and core network services, including F5 BIG\-IP (LTM and DNS/GTM), global server load balancing, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, and enterprise wireless network design, implementation, and operations. * Working knowledge of network security architecture, including next\-generation firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto Networks), network segmentation, network access control, and zero trust principles, with a track record of partnering effectively with cybersecurity teams to implement secure and resilient network infrastructure. * Demonstrated expertise in network automation and orchestration, including the development and implementation of automated network provisioning, configuration management, compliance validation, software upgrades, and operational workflows. Experience leveraging Ansible, Python, Terraform, REST APIs, Git\-based version control, and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) to improve operational efficiency, enforce configuration standards, reduce manual intervention, and minimize configuration drift across Cisco, Juniper, and other enterprise networking platforms. * Experience with enterprise network management, automation, and orchestration platforms, including Juniper Mist AI, Juniper Apstra, Cisco Catalyst Center, and Cisco Nexus Dashboard, or comparable solutions. Ability to leverage centralized management, intent\-based networking, AI\-driven assurance, automated provisioning, fabric orchestration, and policy\-based configuration management to streamline network operations and improve infrastructure reliability. * Experience implementing network monitoring, observability, and automated assurance solutions, including configuration backup, change tracking, proactive fault detection, performance analytics, and automated remediation. Familiarity with network telemetry, SNMP, syslog, streaming telemetry, and API\-driven integrations to improve network reliability, operational visibility, and troubleshooting capabilities. * Demonstrated success establishing enterprise network engineering standards, leading vendor evaluations, developing technology modernization roadmaps, and driving automation\-first operational practices. Ability to influence executives, guide cross\-functional technical teams, manage strategic vendor relationships, and establish long\-term network architecture and infrastructure strategies. **APPLICANT SUPPORT \& INFORMATION** Applications must be submitted online. Before submitting your application, carefully review ALL the information detailed on our APPLICANT SUPPORT page linked HERE. Applicants with disabilities who require reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruitment process may submit a request for accommodation to the email provided below. For additional employment information, please click HERE (Download PDF reader). **WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING** This recruitment process may take up to 4\-6 weeks to complete. We will notify you of the outcome after each step of the recruitment process, detailed below: * **EVALUATION:** Qualifying evaluation of education, training and experience based upon submitted application and supplemental questionnaire. * **ELIGIBILITY:** Applicants who best meet job\-related qualifications will be placed on an eligible list which will remain active for approximately six (6\) months and may be invited to participate in a selection interview. Placement on an eligible list may not result in further consideration, only the most qualified candidates will be contacted for interviews. Other vacancies may be filled using this list. **Questions regarding this posting may be e\-mailed to** **Max Penate, Staffing Partner.** **Follow us on social media!** **X** **\|** **Instagram** **\|** **Threads** **\|** **YouTube** **\|** **Facebook** **\|** **LinkedIn** *Los Angeles Superior Court is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Annotation UI
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. **About the Role** ------------------ Mercor produces training data for frontier AI labs, and two kinds of workers produce it today: human experts (doctors, lawyers, engineers, analysts) who write tasks, write rubrics, and judge quality, and synthetic pipelines, swarms of AI agents that build environments, generate tasks, and iterate until they pass our quality bar. Today these two sides barely work together. Experts face friction: they write specs, wait on pipelines, and redo work when an agent gets it wrong. Pipelines under\-use the expert, whose judgment is our most valuable signal. And nobody owns the system between the two. This is a role for a senior engineer who ships products people use, understands the infrastructure underneath them, and can reason across product, agent pipelines, research, and the business at the same time. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define the interaction model between experts and agents: how an expert sees, steers, and corrects agent work, and how agents ask experts for input and use what they get. * Build the surfaces experts use every day inside Studio, our data platform. * Build the infrastructure that lets agents act on expert input in real time. * Own the metrics: expert time per unit of accepted data, share of expert input the pipelines use, and expert satisfaction and retention. * Work across product, synthetic pipelines, research, and go\-to\-market to connect what customers want, what experts need, and what makes data valuable for training models. * Set the bar for engineering quality and technical direction across the collaboration system. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 7\+ years of engineering experience building and shipping production products that people use. * Strong full\-stack product engineering skills, with a high bar for usability and empathy for end users. * Infrastructure experience: you can build both the surface and the pipes, including real\-time, high\-throughput, or pipeline\-based systems. * Ability to think across product, systems, and the business, and to understand where agent pipelines work and where they fail. * High ownership mindset; able to navigate ambiguity and drive projects from design through delivery. * Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical and product tradeoffs clearly. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows, or tooling for data labeling, annotation, or evaluation. * Experience building agentic systems or LLM\-powered products. * Familiarity with what makes data valuable for training and evaluating models. * Experience at top\-tier tech companies or fast\-scaling startups. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- * Nobody has solved how human experts and AI agents should work together to create data. This is a brand new product problem. * The system you build can become the operating system for expert work, well beyond training data. * Your work directly influences the training and evaluation of frontier AI models. * You'll shape the experience of thousands of experts and operators who use Studio every day. **Benefits:** * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid vacation and sick days * Parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free mental health services * $200 monthly wellness reimbursement * $1\.5K monthly meal stipend * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * Free Equinox membership * Up to $15K relocation bonus Mercor is an **Equal Opportunity Employer** and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Mercor does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by California or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, California, or local laws and ordinances. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. This Policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, discipline, termination, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. This Policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any employee or applicant based on any legally protected status. Compensation Range: $250K \- $400K

jobs.title: Senior AI-Native Engineer
jobs.description: **About the company** --------------------- Marshall Reddick Real Estate is an established real estate investment firm headquartered in Newport Beach, CA in business since 1979, with hundreds of employees. We're a vertically integrated real estate syndicator with investment funds, and we make our money owning real estate. Our business spans brokerage, property management, private lending and investment funds, with offices in California, Texas, Tennessee and Florida. We will never sell software, but we're very tech\-forward in how we run the business. We're hiring a senior AI\-native engineer to turn our product ideas and prototypes into production software and help form and shape our software department. Learn more at marshallreddick.com. We don't build software to sell. We build it to run our business. We use best\-in\-class third\-party platforms where they fit and build our own where they don't, and we're agnostic about the tool as long as it's the right one for the job. The roadmap is large and growing, and most of it is connecting, automating and getting more out of third\-party software through API integrations and MCPs. We are moving from a traditional software development lifecycle to a model where AI agents write, test and review code, and engineers direct, verify and approve the work. ### **The Role** You write, test and ship production code with AI agents every day. You work directly with our CEO and our forward deployed engineer, who set product direction and design. You own how it's built and getting it to production. **Who thrives here:** an energetic, passionate builder who loves investing and loves building with talented people. You'd rather ship than talk about shipping, you take ownership past the point where most people stop, and you pour real energy into the work. This is an intense, high\-output role with high upside, not a 9\-to\-5, Monday\-to\-Friday job. If you want a steady job you can coast in, this isn't it. * **Type:** Full\-time employee. Not consulting, not a contract, not fractional. * **Reports to:** CEO, working day to day with our forward deployed engineer * **Team:** You'll work alongside a product manager and a small engineering team. No direct reports. * **Time split:** about 80% building and 20% code review and helping teammates use AI tools. The work is 60% integrating and automating third\-party platforms and 40% building new software * **Location:** Newport Beach, CA. In office preferred, open to hybrid, not a remote role. ### **What You'll Do** * Rebuild our core website pages first: Mortgages, the Loan Application, the Investment Fund page and Homes for Rent * Connect HubSpot to our core systems, working with our HubSpot implementation partner * Finish the rest of the website * Automate property management and lending workflows across AppFolio and Lendr * Build small internal tools that help employees work faster * Improve operational efficiency and user experience in our existing software platforms * Move us to production releases every 2 weeks within 60 days of start date * Move us to weekly production releases within 120 days of start date * Build the AI cross\-model pipeline: specs first, tests before code, code by one model, review by another * Choose and migrate us to agent\-friendly code hosting, CI/CD and task tracking * Own architecture, security, code quality and production releases; business owners approve specs * Take prototypes from our product team to production * Work with outside partners, such as our HubSpot implementation partner, on integrations; build custom MCP servers for our third\-party platforms; and keep the stack current as models and tools improve ### **Building Our Agentic Stack** We're moving to an agentic tech stack, and this role leads that move. We're open to any products and tools, and we want you to help us choose them and build it with us. Today we run on Confluence, Jira, GitLab, a legacy PHP CRM, a React/TypeScript website and portals, and AWS. That's what we're moving away from. You'll integrate with platforms including HubSpot, AppFolio (Property Manager and Investment Manager), Lendr, DocuSign, SkySlope, and RingCentral, moving to Zoom. The new stack needs to cover: * Task tracking * Code hosting and CI/CD * An AI coding workbench * Models from more than one AI vendor * Testing * Error tracking and AI bug triage * Product usage analytics * A team hub * AI access to our business systems, read\-only for financial systems * Hosting You'll have real say in the tools, as long as the result stays AI\-first and cross\-model, with more than one model vendor writing, testing and reviewing code. ### **What You Need** * You have shipped production code built with AI agents in the last 6–12 months, and can show it * Integrating third\-party platforms through their APIs and webhooks, building custom MCP servers for them, and migrating data between systems cleanly * Finding operational efficiencies: automating manual work across departments, often with software we already pay for * Daily use of agentic coding tools * Experience with more than one model vendor, and a clear view of when to use which * Tests\-first habits and frequent small releases with CI/CD gates and feature flags * Comfortable in legacy PHP and modern React/TypeScript; AWS fundamentals * Track record of getting work all the way to production, not just built, with security fundamentals for apps that handle sensitive financial and investor data * Explains technical tradeoffs in plain English to a non\-engineer CEO, including when to buy instead of build **Nice to have:** MCP servers or team\-chat automations; error tracking, product analytics and automated testing tools; financial systems such as lending, payments or investor reporting; helping a team adopt AI tools; real estate, proptech or fintech. ### **Compensation** $200,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to $50,000, with new bonus targets set each year. Full benefits: health, dental, vision, 401(k) and PTO. Company\-paid AI tool subscriptions. Eligible to co\-invest in the company's real estate investments employee shares. ### **Our Hiring Process** We value what you've built and shipped just as much as your professional experience. Our hiring process is designed to evaluate your technical capabilities, approach to AI\-driven development, and alignment with our team. We value what you've built and shipped just as much as your professional experience. Our hiring process is designed to evaluate your technical capabilities, approach to AI\-driven development, and alignment with our team. **Here's what you can expect:** * **Initial Screening:** Be prepared to share an example of something you've shipped using AI agents within the last 6–12 months. * **Interview Process:** Meet with our forward deployed engineer, CEO, and an independent technical reviewer. * **Paid Work Trial:** Ship one real ticket through our engineering pipeline over the course of three days. * **Final Interview \& References:** Meet with our engineering team and complete reference checks. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

projects. * Support electrical system studies, system protection, load analysis, arc\-flash studies, long\-range planning, and construction work plans. * Install, program, test, troubleshoot, and environments. * Skilled in identifying system faults, trends, and sizing issues fleet\-wide. * Capable of independently troubleshooting and escalating operational or safety issues. * Excellent verbal jobs.description: In this role, you will be a member of the PyTorch Distributed team. The PyTorch team develops the open source software stack powering AI models and systems. jobs.title: Sr. OpenEdge Software Engineer - Remote
jobs.description: Mindex is looking for a Senior OpenEdge Full Stack Engineer to maintain and modernize a mature, business\-critical Progress OpenEdge platform, reporting to the engineering manager. You’ll own major areas of work, keep a critical production system stable while delivering new features, and help shape its incremental modernization. The ideal candidate is AI\-forward, uses AI\-assisted tools to navigate a large codebase and speed up delivery, and raises the bar for the team. **We welcome candidates from a variety of locations; however, all candidates should be open to occasional in\-person participation for business meetings, team events, or collaboration opportunities. Candidates located within approximately 35 miles of Rochester, NY may be asked to work from the office more frequently based on business or team needs.** **Compensation** $90,000 \- $140,000 **What You’ll Accomplish** * Own major areas of the OpenEdge platform end to end, from problem definition through design, delivery, and production support, keeping it stable while delivering new features. * Plan and carry out the platform’s incremental modernization with the engineering manager, balancing new architecture with day\-to\-day delivery. * Apply AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI DLC) to analyze and document existing code, refactor, generate tests, and support migration, and share effective workflows with the team. * Identify technical debt, assess its impact on delivery and risk, and make the case for prioritizing it alongside feature work. * Make and document design and architecture decisions for long\-term maintainability, and challenge established approaches constructively with evidence\-backed alternatives. * Partner with Product in backlog refinement to clarify requirements, estimate effort, and shape deliverable work, and collaborate with Product, CloudOps, and engineers to resolve dependencies. * Build automated tests that make changes safer, apply secure coding practices across application and infrastructure work, and contribute to CI/CD and observability for our cloud architecture. * Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, pairing, and mentoring. * Demonstrate an AI\-first mindset by effectively leveraging AI\-assisted tools and technologies to enhance productivity, accelerate problem\-solving, improve quality, automate routine tasks, and drive innovation in the delivery of solutions and services. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience developing and supporting production systems in an Agile environment. * Significant experience with Progress OpenEdge v12 and above, including object\-oriented ABL. * Proven, hands\-on daily use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, following structured practices like the AI DLC and rigorously evaluating AI output against engineering standards. * Hands\-on experience maintaining and modernizing monolithic applications through incremental migration, re\-architecting, service extraction, or cloud migration. * Experience designing n\-tier applications and RESTful APIs that separate business logic from presentation and data layers, with strong relational database design and data architecture expertise. * Frontend development experience with JavaScript or TypeScript. * Experience with automated testing, source control, code review, and CI/CD pipelines. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with PASOE administration, WebHandlers, ABLUnit, OpenEdge database management (backup/restore, tuning, TDE, replication), OpenTelemetry (OTEL), or OpenEdge Command Center (OECC) is a plus. * Experience with Angular or React, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, Docker, SOC 2 compliance and security\-first development, or Jira or Azure DevOps (ADO) is a plus. * Uses AI to augment expertise and decision\-making while maintaining ownership, accountability, and professional judgment for final work products and outcomes. * Identifies opportunities to use AI to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase business value. * Maintains awareness of emerging AI capabilities, tools, and best practices and proactively identifies opportunities to apply them in the workplace. * Demonstrates sound judgment in the ethical, secure, and compliant use of AI technologies while protecting confidential, customer, and company information. * BS degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Why Join Mindex?** For more than 30 years, Mindex has helped organizations solve complex business challenges through custom software, cloud, data, and AI solutions. jobs.title: Staff Cloud Engineer, ML Ops
jobs.description: **Join the Team Modernizing Medicine** At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. **A Culture of Excellence** When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: * **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work** * **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” * **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties * **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. **Ready to modernize medicine with us?** **Job Description Summary:** As a Staff MLOps Engineer at Modernizing Medicine, you’ll help bridge the gap between data science, machine learning engineering, and production systems. You’ll lead efforts to establish architecture and tooling that make it fast, reliable, and secure for our developers to build, deploy, and operate AI\-enabled applications at scale. You will drive core architectural patterns for model training, deployment, and lifecycle management, empowering self\-service capabilities across product and platform teams. Your work will directly shape the enterprise platform driving our next generation of AI\-driven clinical and operational products. **What You’ll Do** * Architect and help build and operate a scalable developer enablement platform for deploying AI/ML models into high\-throughput production applications, accelerating the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-enabled applications. * Define reusable patterns for model training, feature store integration, batch/real\-time inference, and pipeline orchestration using Databricks, Airflow, and cloud\-native services. * Ensure ML infrastructure is built on standardized IaC to ensure repeatable, multi\-environment deployments across AWS accounts. * Lead the evolution of serverless and containerized ML execution environments, migrating high\-scale serverless pipelines (AWS Lambda) to Kubernetes (EKS) microservices where appropriate. * Drive CI/CD and GitOps standards for automated model delivery, champion deployment strategies, and infrastructure\-as\-code automation. * Design comprehensive observability and monitoring capabilities using DataDog to track model drift, latency, error rates, and system health in production. * Implement LLMOps and AIOps frameworks to manage, deploy, evaluate, and monitor Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI solutions, leveraging MLflow for tracking, experiment management, and model registry. * Partner closely with Data Science, Product Development, and Security teams to ensure models and AI applications are secure, compliant, and cost\-efficient. * Apply security best practices to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship across MLOps and engineering teams, codifying best practices in system architecture and operational excellence. **What We’re Looking For** * 8\+ years of experience in DevOps, MLOps, Software Engineering, or Cloud Architecture with proven experience delivering and operating AI/ML systems at scale. * Deep expertise in Python and software engineering principles for production\-grade microservices, SDKs, and data pipelines. * Proven architectural experience with patterns across the full ML lifecycle: training, batch/real\-time inference, model registration, and application integration. * Strong proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda), and cloud infrastructure (AWS). * Hands\-on experience with ML and LLM frameworks such as MLflow, SageMaker, PyTorch, or Spark; experience with Databricks is a plus. * Mastery of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD/GitOps tooling. * Demonstrated capability in establishing enterprise observability standards using DataDog or similar platforms. * Strong leadership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills with a focus on developer enablement and mentoring. On\-call participation may be required to support production systems. If you're excited about bringing machine learning to life through clean code, automation, and infrastructure excellence, we want to talk. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: **United States** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, * 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. * Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, * Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, * Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, * Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, * Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles, * Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. **PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.
