jobs.title: ENGSWEP4 - Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Purpose in Every Position** Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI\-powered Global Work Platform, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185\+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere. **Where Your Work Moves the Needle.** At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work. **What Makes You a Great Fit** Pebl moves over a billion dollars across 180\+ countries to make sure each employee gets paid every cent on time. In order to achieve this, Pebl needs both a consistent money movement system to pay out payroll cross border, and a flexible invoicing system to facilitate Pebl customers with the exact amount they need to pay. Every country and every customer’s requirements are different, and so navigating complex global requirements, differing payment systems, and strong fraud rules are critical. The more compliant and transparent our system is, the more trust our customers can have that they are paying their employees on time and reliably. We’re a primarily backend focused team with fullstack capabilities, and are looking for someone to further bolster that expertise. We’re searching for a backend focused engineer that knows how to build reliable, scalable systems that can guarantee stable money movement rails, but also flexibly integrate across many global systems and their specific quirks. They’ll work closely with product and design to transform our new vision for fraud and payments into real features, and collaborate closely with other engineers on the team to really bring it to life. While backend will be the primary body of work, we also are looking for someone who works across the stack to build frontend features and enhance our dedicated frontend engineer’s capabilities. They should also prioritize simplicity and reliability in the face of unknown complexities, while also understanding when to make necessary, clear\-eyed tradeoffs to create business impact effectively. If that sounds like you, we’d love to have you on board. ***This role will require in\-office collaboration Monday\-Wednesday in our Palo Alto, CA office.*** **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Design and build stable systems and new features that allow Pebl’s EOR employees to reliably receive their paycheck through different global financial systems across 180\+ countries * Build experiences for our customers to transparently and painlessly pay their employees * Develop seamless 3rd party integrations with payment vendors that help enhance Pebl’s capabilities and abilities to pay our users * Build new ways for employees to engage with their paychecks, such as through AI agents, that are straightforward, reliable, but also secure. * Build the foundation for a more robust fraud and AML system. * Sharpen and delight the way our customers experience invoices to provide rich and robust data and insights **Let’s Connect If You Have** * 6\+ years of professional fullstack software engineering experience * 1\+ years of experience building backends and API frameworks for invoicing or financial systems, or 2\+ years building backends in domains that require the same uncompromising uptime or accuracy as payments * Strong command of Typescript for backend systems, paired with a foundational understanding of frontend API needs * Experience with AWS or similar cloud services, PostgresQL or similar RDBMS systems, and Kubernetes. * A general understanding of modern frontend frameworks, such as React and tailwind. While this is a primarily backend role, we expect 20% of the work to be frontend. * Proven experience working with designers and product managers to go from product requirements and wireframes to tangible and customer impacting features **Our Commitment to You** At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include: * **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge. * **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families. * **Health and Dental Insurance** – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones. * **Retirement Savings \+ Employee Incentive Plan** – Plan for the future while sharing our success. Please visit our career page for more information. **Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world. Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role.** PURE is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to help take our internal developer platform from a strong delivery foundation to a production\-grade operating platform. We are in a hardening phase prior to production launch, with meaningful opportunities to shape and build the capabilities that come next. You’ll report to, and work closely with, the AVP of Platform Engineering to build and evolve the product our teams build on. You'll treat the platform as a product: its users are engineers, its interface is a contract they build against, and its success is measured by how much they can do without us. Platform Engineering sits within PURE’s AI Engineering group, but this isn’t an AI role: dedicated AI engineers build the applications, and you’ll build the platform that they, and teams across IDEAS, run on. The platform’s build\-and\-release foundation is substantially in place: declarative service registration, versioned Terraform modules, and PR\-gated promotion of immutable artifacts across four environments. We run on ECS today, a deliberate choice that keeps our time on platform capabilities rather than cluster operations. The next chapter is making it production\-grade and enabling additional self\-service. This is a hands\-on execution role that values quality over speed: we build reliability in up front rather than relying on heroics later. You’ll own meaningful work early on, with decision\-making scope that grows over time, and your contributions will help define a platform that is still taking shape. **What you'll do.** * Own the platform’s HCP Terraform Stacks and modules end to end, shipping versioned, backward\-compatible releases so consuming teams can adopt new capabilities without disrupting what they already run. * Build and extend the reusable GitHub Actions workflows that take every service from commit to production, keeping promotion across environments safe and consistent. * Own the platform’s observability and reliability, recommend and implement the tools, standards, and practices that make reliability a property of the platform, so problems are caught early and rarely reach the teams who depend on it. * Build the self\-service experience: golden paths, automated onboarding, and the documentation that lets a new team ship. * Work directly with teams onboarding to the platform, treating their feedback as product input and turning recurring friction into platform features. * Own the quality gates every service inherits, building tests, scans, and policies into the platform so the right way is the default. * Contribute to how the platform’s compute layer, language support, and shared libraries evolve, evaluating options and bringing recommendations as the services and teams on it diversify. Make the platform measurable, from delivery performance through DORA to cost by service and business area, so the team can see where to invest next. * **What you'll need.** We are looking for a hands\-on platform engineer who has built and operated production infrastructure, not just provisioned it. You care as much about what happens after a deploy as before it, and you find satisfaction in making the right way the easy way for the teams you support. If a narrowly scoped role would bore you, this one won’t. The ideal candidate will bring: * 3\-5\+ years of experience in Platform Engineering or DevOps. * You've built or maintained something other engineers consume as a product, such as a module, library, workflow, or internal tool, and owned its interface: versioning, backward compatibility, documentation, and adoption. * Strong AWS proficiency at implementation depth with ECS/Fargate, ALB, and IAM, and working knowledge of the supporting services the platform depends on (CloudWatch, EventBridge, ECR, S3, Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store, Route 53, ACM). * Terraform: you’ve written and maintained reusable modules, not just consumed them. Experience with HCP Terraform or Terraform Cloud is a plus, and with HCP Terraform Stacks especially so. * GitHub Actions: you’ve built or maintained reusable CI/CD workflows. * Scripting skills in Python and/or Bash. * Experience with GitOps\-style delivery across multiple environments: PR\-gated deploys, immutable artifacts, and automated promotion pipelines. * Hands\-on experience designing observability (metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting) is a plus. * Kubernetes experience is welcome but not required; our platform runs on ECS. * Familiarity with ML or LLM infrastructure (for example, MLflow, model registries, AI gateways) is a plus. Experience in insurance or financial services is a plus. * **Why join PURE.** * Be the first hire on a platform team that is genuinely building something new, with a working foundation already in place and real influence over what comes next. * Work on infrastructure that matters: the platform underpins data, analytics, and ML/AI services that teams across PURE rely on, and every capability you build is inherited by every service on it. * Work on hard problems with room to explore, experiment, and build, guided by a high quality bar rather than unnecessary process. * Operate in a culture that takes curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship seriously, and that measures platform success by the velocity and stability it gives the teams who use it. * Join a well\-funded, growing IDEAS organization, working alongside colleagues driven by excellence and building the relationships and trust that great engineering depends on. * This is a remote position. The team tries to meet in person approximately 1\-2 times per year for department on\-sites (typically 3–4 days per trip, including travel), with optional opportunities to attend relevant industry or technology conferences. ‌ **What We Do** We're a member\-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices. We aim for our members to *love their insurance* . It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that our members never want to leave. **Who We Are** We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. From PURE, you can expect: *Opportunities to stretch and grow:* your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on\-the\-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards. *Clarity and kindness:* you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like. *Support in good times and bad:* we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree. *A community that cares:* we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life. **Who You Are** All of the strongest relationships are a partnership\- a two way street. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Growth Engineer (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description: **The Mission** --------------- More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2\.6 billion and 12\.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people. AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data. What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk. Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford\-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences. We run these experiments in an AI\-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature. It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised \~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3\.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way. The opportunity is generational. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Full-Stack AI Engineer/Researcher (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description: **The Mission** --------------- More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2\.6 billion and 12\.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people. AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data. What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk. Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford\-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences. We run these experiments in an AI\-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature. It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised \~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3\.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way. The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial. **Your Skills** --------------- Must be able to operate across the entire AI stack: evals, agentic harnesses, and models **Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: **Build the Path Forward** ========================== At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well\-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Frame open\-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well\-defined ML problems. * Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. * Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. * Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. * Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. * Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure\-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. * Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low\-latency inference and monitoring. **Who You Are** --------------- * An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field. * 2\+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry. * Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models. * Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization. * You've run your methods on real robot hardware. * You explain model results and their limits clearly, so planning, perception, and field teams know when to trust them. **Preferred** ------------- * C\+\+, and experience deploying models into a C\+\+ or ROS 2 production stack. * Motion planning, trajectory optimization, or collision checking. * Active perception, next\-best\-view or informative path planning, or 3D point cloud learning. * Uncertainty estimation and calibration, or Bayesian and information\-theoretic planning. * GPU inference optimization (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX). * Simulation and sim\-to\-real transfer (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). * Publications at RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, operational support. * Develop and enhance backend capabilities supporting known\-AI\-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure and Pindrop's broader voice intelligence capabilities. * Partner with Research and Research Engineering to integrate detection models, inference services, and ML\-driven signals into reliable, scalable production workflows, balancing detection effectiveness, latency, cost, and operational complexity. * Improve performance, concurrency, availability, fault tolerance, and infrastructure efficiency across jobs.description: **Job title:** Director, Engineering \- Quality Assurance**Reports to:** Chief Information Officer**Division:** Central Services**Location:** US or Waterloo**Grade:** 23 **About Priority Commerce:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. predictable delivery across Priority’s products. **Responsibilities:*** Defines and owns the enterprise QA strategy, roadmap, standards, and quality governance across all engineering teams and products. * Builds, leads, and develops a high\-performing QA organization of managers, QA engineers, and automation (SDET) engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning. * Directs the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) covering UI, API, integration, and regression performance, load, and capacity testing, and partners with Security to incorporate security testing (SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation) into the release process. * Establishes and reports QA metrics and KPIs (e.g., defect escape rate, defect density, automation coverage, test pass rate, mean time to detect/resolve, release quality) to engineering and executive leadership. * Owns defect management and triage processes, including severity/priority standards, root cause analysis, and closing the loop on production incidents with targeted regression coverage. * Embeds QA practices within Agile/Scrum teams and the SDLC, ensuring testability, clear acceptance criteria, and test planning from requirements through production. * Ensures testing practices, test data management, and release evidence support PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory and audit requirements. * Manages QA tooling, test environments, budget, and any outsourced or partner QA resources to deliver quality at scale and at an appropriate cost. * Collaborates cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, SRE, Application Support, Security, and Compliance to align quality goals with business priorities and customer outcomes. **What Success Looks Like:*** Customer\-impacting incidents and production defects attributable to escaped defects are measurably and consistently reduced. * Releases ship on a predictable cadence with automated quality gates in CI/CD, and teams trust the test suite to tell them when something is wrong. * Automation coverage of critical payment, funding, and user journeys grows steadily, while manual regression effort and cycle time decline. * Performance and load testing identify capacity and scalability risks before they reach production. * QA metrics and KPIs are visible, trusted, and used by engineering and executive leadership to make release and investment decisions. * Audits and customer assessments find well\-evidenced testing and change controls with no surprises. * The QA organization is viewed as a trusted partner that accelerates delivery rather than a bottleneck, with strong talent retention and a clear growth path for team members. **Candidate Requirements:**### **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10\+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, including 5\+ years in QA leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple teams. * Proven track record of building and scaling QA organizations and establishing QA strategy, standards, and processes across multiple products or teams. * Hands\-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured). * Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). * Experience leading performance/load testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, LoadRunner) and partnering on security testing practices. * Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the SDLC, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray). * Demonstrated ability to define, track, and report QA metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences. ### **Preferred** * Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated financial services environments. * Working awareness of PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and related compliance requirements as they apply to testing, test data, and change management. * Experience testing cloud\-native and distributed architectures (AWS JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\#) used for test automation. * Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level, CSTE, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM). **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results. **Compensation and Benefits:****Compensation range:** $233K\-$291K USD, $190K\-$257K CAD We invest in the whole employee \- personally and professionally. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About PrologMobile** Nobody in the global reverse supply chain for mobile devices knows exactly what they are buying or selling. PrologMobile fixes that. We are a device intelligence company: give us an IMEI or serial number, and our platform returns essential data points about that specific device, including carrier and SIM lock status, blocklist and financial risk, Find My iPhone and MDM locks, warranty, and whether it will work on a given carrier network. Carriers and MVNOs, insurers, device processors, ITADs, marketplaces, and wholesalers build our data into their trade\-in, resale, and claims workflows. Our customers use it to cut returns, prevent fraud, and price devices accurately. A few things that make us different: * Founders who lived the problem. Our founders have spent more than 20 years in the secondary device market and helped start the mobile device recycling industry in North America. * Real technical moats. We hold a US patent (11,711,755 B1\) and co\-developed the Device Compatibility service with the GSMA. We are active in CTIA and the GSA. * Work that matters. Every device that gets resold instead of scrapped stays out of a landfill. Our data touches the lifecycle of tens of millions of devices a year. * A small team. We are about a dozen people. There is no layer between you and the decision, the customer, or production. Our mission is to be the most trusted, most comprehensive device intelligence platform in the world. **About the role** We are hiring a senior engineer to join a small engineering team that ships quickly and holds a high bar. You will work across the whole platform: the customer portal, the public API, the data pipelines that normalize device data from OEMs and carriers, and the Azure infrastructure it all runs on. Two things define how we work, and they define this role: * AI\-assisted development is our default, not an experiment. We build with Claude Code every day. Our repository carries agent instructions, automated multi\-agent code review on every pull request, and a living catalogue of bug patterns we have learned from. We want someone who already works this way and can direct an AI agent the way a good lead directs a team: clear scope, hard questions, and verification of everything it produces. * Review is where quality comes from. When AI writes much of the code, the engineer's judgment matters more, not less. You will review human and AI\-written code, catch what looks right but is wrong, and prove fixes with tests that fail without them. You will also help shape our next chapter: a new Next.js frontend to replace our current server\-rendered UI. **What you will do** * Design, build, and ship features across an ASP.NET Core (.NET 10\) platform, from database migration to UI * Use Claude Code and similar agents to move faster, while owning the correctness of everything you merge * Perform thorough code reviews and raise the standard of the codebase over time * Write and maintain unit, integration, and UI automation tests * Design and tune SQL Server schemas, queries, and indexes on large, high\-volume tables * Build and maintain API integrations with various data sources * Deploy and operate services on Azure, and investigate production issues when they happen * Help plan and build the Next.js frontend * Take part in sprint planning and backlog refinement in Jira, and break ambiguous goals into shippable tickets * Work directly with customer success and leadership to understand what customers need **What we are looking for** Required * 8\+ years of professional software development, including 5\+ years with C\# and .NET * Strong ASP.NET Core experience (MVC and Web API) and solid object\-oriented design * Hands\-on, daily use of an AI coding agent, ideally Claude Code, on production code * A track record of rigorous code review, giving and receiving * Entity Framework Core with code\-first migrations, and strong SQL Server skills * Automated testing as a habit (we use xUnit) * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript * Git and pull\-request workflows * Self\-direction: you find the next most valuable thing, do it, and tell people what you did. You do not need to be managed day to day * Clear written and spoken English for work with the team and with customers * Authorization to work in the United States Nice to have * Next.js and React * Azure: App Service, Functions, SQL Database, Key Vault, Redis, Application Insights * Scrum or other agile experience, and Jira * Experience building or consuming high\-volume APIs * GitHub Actions and CI/CD * Background in mobile devices, telecom, insurance, or reverse logistics **Our stack** C\# and .NET 10, ASP.NET Core MVC and Web API, Entity Framework Core, Azure SQL, Azure App Service and Functions, Redis, SignalR, xUnit, GitHub Actions, Claude Code, Jira. Next.js is on the way. **Why PrologMobile** * Real ownership: your work reaches production and customers quickly * A team that treats AI tooling as a core engineering skill and invests in it * A greenfield frontend rebuild alongside a mature, revenue\-generating platform * Fully remote * Salary plus performance bonuses * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * Ongoing training benefits PrologMobile is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected class. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * C\#: 5 years (Required) * Next.js: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Provn is helping CampusEvolve recruit for the following role **About CampusEvolve:** CampusEvolve (campusevolve.ai) is a Seattle\-based, mission\-driven AI startup backed by the Gates Foundation, Schultz Family Foundation, and GitLab Foundation. Pathways is one tool for a person's whole pathway: from high school into a two\-year or four\-year program, a certificate, an apprenticeship, or the military, and on into work. People most often fall off a pathway in the gaps between programs, so Pathways is built to carry them across those gaps. Its retrieval layer covers more than 6,000 post\-secondary credential programs in Washington State, plus financial aid, career guidance, and basic\-needs resources like housing, food, and transportation. The north star is economic mobility, and at CampusEvolve, the mission is the culture. **About the role:** AI Engineering Lead builds Pathways, an AI\-native guide that helps people take real next steps toward education, careers, and economic security, and builds the team's ability to ship it with AI. This is a senior leadership role that's about 80% hands\-on building. You deliver the product rather than make sure it gets delivered, and you make engineering decisions, not recommendations. You'll lead three full\-time engineers, work closely with the Founder/CEO and CTO, and partner with a full\-time product manager and the VP of Community, who runs a network of 100\+ co\-design partners across K\-12, post\-secondary, and workforce programs. State agency partners are ready to roll out Pathways once it's engaging and safe, and you'll lead the engineering that gets it there. **What You'll Work On** Alongside the building, you keep engineering, product, partners, and leadership moving together, and you work directly with end users far more than most engineering leaders do. * Ship simple, mobile\-first AI experiences that turn real learner and job seeker problems into completed next steps, with deep context awareness, more agency for users, and handoffs to human advisors when they need one * Build AI\-native and multiply the team's output. Use coding agents yourself to ship working software fast, coach engineers in using them well, and help define the team's agentic development lifecycle: clear objectives and acceptance criteria, adversarial multi\-model passes on the spec, and a strong evaluation harness * Connect product analytics, AI evaluation, synthetic\-user tests, user research, and real task outcomes to fast release decisions, and show improvements with evidence * Create reusable conversation, planning, resource\-grounding, state, and action patterns that can be configured quickly for new personas, scenarios, localities, and partners * Take features through controlled production, owning architecture, data and state integrity, test automation, observability, performance, cloud cost, and release quality * Architect identity and access for learners, advisors, and partner institutions, including privacy\-preserving sign\-in, consent, delegated access, and role\-based authorization. Outside security and privacy specialists support hardening, reviews, and compliance, and you own integrating their work into the product * Be the technical voice with funders and state agency partners, including answering their hardest questions about safety and outcomes **What Success Looks Like** * Within the first months, Pathways reaches high school students after a few rapid cycles of engineering and hardening * Within six months, it serves thousands of high school users * Within twelve months, it's adapted for many personas, each tied to a real outcome such as enrolling in a post\-secondary program, starting an apprenticeship, or getting a job, on the way to about 100,000 users in Washington State * The team ships faster and with higher quality because of how you build and how you coach **Required Qualifications** We place more weight on what you've built, your impact on users, your production judgment, and your ability to raise the level of your teammates than on executive titles, pedigree, or years managing large teams. No degree required. * You've personally built and shipped LLM\-enabled applications used by real people, as a founder, founding engineer, staff or principal engineer, or deeply hands\-on engineering leader * Advanced fluency with multi\-model agentic development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), plus the ability to inspect, test, debug, and improve AI\-generated code * Practical experience with LLM orchestration and tool calling, retrieval and grounding, persistent context, APIs, reliable application state, and full\-stack cloud deployments * Strong product instincts. You can design for teenagers and adults with different levels of experience, find the friction, simplify, and move users from exploring to finishing a real step * The judgment to make an early product secure and scalable without overengineering it, from trust boundaries, authorization, and logging to error handling, regression testing, monitoring, and the limits of LLM decision\-making * You've mentored a small engineering team and improved its speed and quality. You earn engineers' respect through your own work, give honest, constructive feedback, and adapt your coaching for senior, mid\-level, and early\-career engineers * Mission\-driven. You want your work to have a direct impact on people's economic mobility, and you're energized by working with students, partners, and end users **Nice to Have** * Leadership experience at a startup, or time at an engineering organization working at the cutting edge of AI development * Building products for schools, public sector agencies, or other institutional partners * Presenting a product to funders or senior stakeholders and answering hard questions on the spot * Experience with student data privacy and with identity and access for users under 18 **Location** This role is fully remote within the U.S., and CampusEvolve doesn't have an office. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. CampusEvolve is unable to sponsor visas or accept H\-1B transfers. **Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Remote\-first, collaborative culture. Possible equity depending on experience and skills. **Estimated annual OTE:** $200k \- $275k.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Since opening our first self\-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the world’s largest owner and operator of self\-storage facilities. With thousands of locations across the United States and Europe and more than 170 million net rentable square feet, we are also among the largest landlords globally. Recognized as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute, Public Storage is a member of the S\&P 500 and FT Global 500\. Our common and preferred stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange. As the nation’s leading self\-storage provider, we are known for our iconic orange doors and our commitment to delivering simple, reliable storage solutions to millions of customers. **Job Description** Public Storage runs at a scale that makes the work interesting. More than 4,500 locations and growing, a national customer base, prices that move every day, and a footprint expanding across the U.S. and into Canada. Our Data and Analytics team sits with the business partners who own those decisions and works with them on the critical problems: pricing, promotions, marketing, operations, real estate acquisitions, and forecasting supply and demand. Our platform runs on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, and Terraform, along with dbt Cloud, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Looker, and modern CI/CD. We're a small, senior team that operates like a startup inside an S\&P 500 company. Short paths from idea to production, real ownership, and work that shows up in the business instead of in a slide deck. Join a full\-stack data team where a new engineer ships to production in weeks, not quarters. In this role you'll build and maintain the pipelines that support our customer teams and the analysts and data scientists who serve them, working with customer data every day. You'll be mentored on code\-first data engineering with Python, SQL, dbt, Airflow, and BigQuery, and on the engineering habits that separate a pipeline that works from a pipeline people trust. If you want a place where you learn quickly, own real surface area, and see your work used the same week you ship it, this is it. What You'll Do **Build and Run Pipelines** * Construct and maintain batch data pipelines from internal systems, third\-party APIs, and event streams into BigQuery * Develop transformations in dbt with tests, documentation, and sensible model layering * Author and maintain Airflow / Cloud Composer DAGs with retries, alerting, and dependency awareness * Ensure customer and business data in the lake and warehouse is timely, high\-quality, and well documented **Quality and Craft** * Write data quality tests and monitor freshness, volume, schema, and distribution * Follow engineering best practices: version control, code review, CI/CD, query optimization, and clear documentation * Handle customer data in line with our data governance, privacy, and access standards * Support MLOps workflows: feature refreshes, scheduled retraining jobs, and model input pipelines * Investigate and resolve pipeline failures, and write up what broke so it doesn't break the same way twice **Collaborate** * Work closely with analysts, data scientists, and customer teams to understand what they need from the data and deliver it * Partner with business and IT teams to onboard new source systems * Create and maintain architecture and systems documentation **Qualifications** Required * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field * 3\+ years of experience building data pipelines or deploying production code in a cloud environment (1\+ year with a Master's degree) * Proficiency in SQL, including relational data modeling and query tuning * Working proficiency in Python for data processing * Familiarity with a cloud analytical warehouse. BigQuery preferred, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks considered * Clear written and verbal communication Preferred * Hands\-on experience with dbt and with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster, or Prefect * Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub * Exposure to streaming or event\-driven data (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow) * Exposure to containerization and infrastructure as code, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform * Familiarity with BI and semantic layer tools, preferably Looker * Exposure to MLOps or machine learning infrastructure Skills \& Technologies * Languages: SQL, Python; Git\-based workflows and code review * Data stack: BigQuery, dbt, Airflow / Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage * Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (AWS or Azure equivalent considered) * Practices: data modeling, ELT design, data quality testing, data privacy and access controls, documentation **Additional Information** **Why This Role Will Excite You** * A modern, code\-first stack with no legacy on\-premise burden to carry * Mentorship from senior engineers who review your code and explain the why * Customer data that drives daily pricing and operating decisions at more than 4,500 locations * New pipelines to build from scratch as we expand into Canada **Workplace** * One of our core values is working as OneTeam. We believe in the value of in\-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days per week, with the option to use up to three flexible remote\-work days each month. \*\*Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F\-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real\-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600\+ sensors deployed across 25\+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission\-driven, high\-velocity team building dual\-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators. **Job Description** ------------------- The SmartMast is a sophisticated, vessel\-mounted edge computing platform running a dense software stack on NVIDIA Jetson hardware in maritime environments: salt air, vibration, intermittent connectivity, and real operational pressure. We need a Senior Embedded Linux / Platform Software Engineer who can own the software that runs at the tip of our spear. You will build and maintain the embedded Linux platform that integrates HD cameras, radar, SDR, AIS receivers, GPS, and thermal sensors into a unified, AI\-capable sensing system. You will work at the intersection of hardware bringup, ROS2\-based sensor middleware, edge inference pipelines, and the cloud connectivity layer that gets data from the vessel to our analysts in near real time. This is complex, meaningful work, and it ships to sea. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own and evolve the embedded Linux platform for SmartMast edge devices. * Integrate and maintain sensor interfaces across cameras, radar, SDR, AIS, GPS/GNSS, and thermal systems. * Build and maintain modular middleware and services (including ROS2\-based components) for reliable inter\-process and inter\-sensor communication. * Develop and optimize edge AI inference pipelines for detection, segmentation, and classification under real compute and bandwidth constraints. * Design and improve edge\-to\-cloud data paths for latency, resilience, and efficient bandwidth usage in constrained maritime networks. * Manage OTA update workflows for fleet\-deployed devices, including staged rollout validation and rollback strategies. * Debug production issues from field signals/telemetry, drive root\-cause analysis, and ship durable fixes quickly. * Partner closely with hardware, software, and operations teams to bring systems from lab to vessel deployment. * Lead PTZ camera integration decisions spanning lens selection, sensor convergence/alignment, and stabilization tuning, and translate those tradeoffs into measurable improvements in edge ML performance (detection, classification, tracking robustness). **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * 4\+ years of experience in software development for robotics, electronics, and embedded systems. * Over 4 years of proficiency in Python, C\+\+, and shell scripting. Rust is a bonus. * Solid experience with Linux, particularly the Ubuntu flavor. * Experience with robotics frameworks such as ROS/ROS2\. * Experience in mobile/embedded platform development, specifically with NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, and Yocto. * Familiarity with various sensors and hardware, including GPS, IMU, cameras, Radar, and weather sensors, as well as driver development for these devices. * Experience with industrial PTZ network cameras and video streaming technologies. * Hands\-on experience with sensor fusion techniques (Kalman/EKF, particle filters, or learned fusion approaches) across radar, EO/IR, and positioning data. * Expertise in developing and deploying AI/ML models for visual tasks, including detection, segmentation, and classification. * Experience with OTA update systems and device fleet management at scale. * Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including cloud\-native ingestion services. * Solid foundational networking skills, including diagnosing and resolving connectivity issues. * Experience with remote access management protocols like SSH and VNC. * Problem\-solving and results\-driven mindset. * Flexibility and resilience to thrive in a dynamic environment. Compensation Range: $200K \- $225K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics Simulation & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Multimedia Systems **General Summary:** **About Qualcomm Robotics** The Qualcomm Advanced Robotics Team is building the AI\-first stack for the next generation of general\-purpose robots — from AMRs and cobots to emerging humanoids — pairing heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU) with a full Robotics SDK, an integrated simulation platform, and AI operations infrastructure. With our high\-performance robotics SoCs, workloads that previously required the cloud now run on\-device, at the edge, at scale. **About This Team** We build AI infrastructure for modern robotics. The simulator is a central tool in it: a modern platform developed in\-house, built on high\-performance computing and open data formats such as OpenUSD, URDF, and glTF, intended to be best\-in\-class, and tuned for Qualcomm robotics SoCs and the robots they run on. The robots span the field — tabletop manipulation with robotic arms, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long\-horizon tasks that carry a robot through multi\-stage scenes requiring reasoning over many steps. This is a ground\-up software effort: runtime architecture, performance, clean APIs, and developer tooling. The simulator is a first\-class target on both developer workstations and cloud compute — interactive authoring and vectorized GPU environments locally, orchestrated headless jobs at scale in the cloud. We use it to train policies, generate synthetic data for robot foundation models, gate software releases in CI, run hardware\-in\-the\-loop against real silicon, and close the sim\-to\-real gap on deployed robots. We deliver jointly with Qualcomm’s AI operations workstreams, and a meaningful slice of the engineering sits where simulation plugs into the training, dataset, and deployment infrastructure they own. **The Opportunity** You will own significant pieces of a simulation platform on the critical path of Qualcomm’s robotics products — the runtime and its abstractions, the physics and rendering integrations, the training and data\-generation paths, the HIL and CI plumbing, or the developer experience that makes all of it usable by robotics engineers who are not simulation specialists — across robot arms, legged platforms, and mobile robots. This is first and foremost a simulation role — roughly 80% of the work is the simulator itself as a critical platform component. The remaining \~20% is AI infrastructure enablement: integrating simulation into the training, dataset, and deployment pipelines owned by the AI operations team, working with them rather than replacing them. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core simulator subsystems — scene representation and authoring, physics backends, sensor models, rendering — across the scenarios our robots work in: tabletop manipulation, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long\-horizon, multi\-stage tasks. * Profile and optimize simulation and training workloads — physics solvers, rendering, data pipelines — so interactive workstation sessions and training throughput at scale stay high. * Integrate and extend best\-in\-class open engines — GPU physics, USD/Hydra rendering, offline path tracing — behind clean, swappable interfaces. * Build high\-throughput paths for policy training and synthetic data generation: vectorized environments, GPU\-resident state, procedural scene variation, domain randomization, and ground\-truth labeling — consistent from an interactive workstation session to scheduled headless runs in the cloud. * Make simulation a release gate: scenario suites, deterministic replay, benchmarks, and metrics that catch regressions before they reach hardware. * Enable the continuous learning workflows that simulation feeds into, in partnership with the AI operations team: make simulation a first\-class, config\-driven stage in collect–merge–train–eval pipelines with reproducible run manifests and artifacts, so the same experiment runs locally and as containerized GPU jobs (Argo Workflows on Kubernetes) without the sim engineer owning the surrounding infrastructure. * Stand up hardware\-in\-the\-loop configurations: production robotics software running on Qualcomm silicon in communication with the simulator on the host workstation or cloud, and quantify where simulation and reality diverge — system identification, contact and actuator modeling, sensor noise, measured transfer results. * Partner with AI operations, perception, controls, and silicon teams, and own the design docs, reviews, tests, and APIs others depend on. **Who We Look For** * Strong software engineering fundamentals, with production code you can talk through in depth. * A working grasp of simulation as applied to robotics: rigid\-body dynamics, kinematics, coordinate frames, numerical integration, or sensor models. — or the aptitude to build one quickly; engineers from games, graphics, and ML infrastructure back achine learning for robotics: reinforcement learning at scale, imitation learning, robot foundation models and VLAs, PyTorch. * 3D graphics and scene pipelines: OpenUSD composition, PBR materials, real\-time and offline rendering, sensor simulation. * Robotics and distributed systems: ROS 2/DDS, URDF/MJCF, pub/sub and schema\-driven wire formats, containers, cluster orchestration, and CI/CD for compute\-heavy workloads. * Working fluency in the AI infrastructure around simulation — enough to integrate with it and partner effectively with the AI operations team (who own it), not to run it yourself: Kubernetes\-native workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows or similar), containerized GPU jobs and shared\-storage datalakes (NFS/PVC volumes), config\-driven experiment frameworks, checkpoint/resume semantics, and experiment tracking (TensorBoard, Weights \& Biases). * Effective leverage of modern AI tools as a core engineering skill: frontier AI models, AI coding and agentic workflows, AI\-assisted learning for ramping on new domains quickly, and building knowledge bases — personal or team — to accelerate on\-boarding and future work. jobs.title: GCP Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** RCH Solutions is a rapidly growing global provider of computational science expertise within Life Sciences and Healthcare. At RCH, our team rallies around a culture crafted for learning and achieving. We’re relentless in our pursuit for innovation and demanding of ourselves to deliver a ground\-breaking computing experience for our clients, so that they can deliver life\-saving science to humanity. **Core Values** At RCH, our Core Values are more than just words—they represent the threads that weave together the fabric of our culture. Used as a guide when interviewing new team members; as a barometer when evaluating our performance as individuals and teams, and even when deciding which customers to work with, RCH’s Values embody the behaviors upon which we measure our success and create a framework for our growth as people and professionals. Our Core Values:* Embrace Excellence: We strive for best\-in\-class delivery of innovation and service. * Be Accountable: Integrity, ownership and accountability are non\-negotiables. * Adventure Together: We are committed to fostering a culture that embraces continuous improvement. * Succeed as a Team: We believe harnessing the power of a team drives outcomes not achievable by individuals. * Boundaries and Balance: Work\-life balance is a core facet of our culture. If you share in our core values, then we encourage you to continue reading this posting as you may have found a great home for your career. **Job Description** RCH Solutions is seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud\-native services on Google Cloud Platform in support of research and bioinformatics workloads. The right candidate will develop microservices and web applications that put scientific computing directly in the hands of researchers and will build and maintain the workflow orchestration that runs bioinformatics pipelines at scale. You will function as a team member integrating cloud services, scientific applications, and upstream and downstream data systems into a coherent platform. Our ideal candidate is an experienced and talented engineer who is equally comfortable writing production code and reasoning about infrastructure, and who will be instrumental in transforming how computing services are leveraged to support our client's science. This role will involve driving architecture, roadmaps, and execution of projects that deliver GCP\-based platform services to scientific end users. You will develop and implement engineering best practices for customers and RCH applications teams; engaging in the fast\-moving realm of Life Sciences, prioritizing innovation. The cloud landscape and the bioinformatics tooling ecosystem are both continuously evolving, with new services and pipeline frameworks released constantly. You know how to distinguish hype from reality and are comfortable making recommendations that best suit our clients’ needs. **Responsibilities:*** Design, build, and deploy microservices and APIs on Google Cloud Platform to support scientific and bioinformatics workloads * Develop and maintain web applications that give researchers self\-service access to data, pipelines, and compute * Build, operate, and tune workflow orchestration for bioinformatics pipelines, including scheduling, error handling, and runtime and cost optimization * Integrate cloud services, scientific applications, and internal and third\-party data systems through well\-documented, maintainable interfaces * Ensure that all systems are compliant with company security standards and applicable regulatory requirements * Troubleshoot operational issues as they arise on supported platforms, and escalate to other IT units as necessary **Essential Qualifications:*** 3\+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering or software engineering, including production workloads on Google Cloud Platform * Experience designing and deploying microservices, including containerization and REST or gRPC API development * Experience with a workflow orchestration framework for scientific or data pipelines, such as Nextflow, Cromwell, Snakemake, or Airflow * Demonstrated systems integration experience connecting cloud services, applications, and external data sources * Web application development experience, either full stack or strong backend skills paired with working front\-end proficiency * Proficiency in Python and comfort working in a Linux environment * Excellent communication skills, including preparation of written documentation for IT colleagues and scientific end users * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Bioinformatics, or equivalent work experience **Preferred Qualifications:*** Hands\-on experience supporting bioinformatics or computational biology workloads, such as genomics and NGS pipelines, structural biology, or cheminformatics * Familiarity with GCP services including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage * Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform * Proficient in building Docker images * Experience with CI/CD for building and deploying containerized services * R, or other programming languages common in scientific computing * Has good knowledge of deploying or supporting GxP systems * Git, BitBucket, or other version control tools **Additional information** Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. If you join our team, you’ll have access to:* A competitive salary and bonus package based on experience. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance. * Company\-provided Life and Long\-Term Disability Insurance. * Company\-sponsored 401(k) Plan. * Team\-focused culture and unlimited opportunity for advancement. ***\*\*This is an onsite position and the candidate will be required to be onsite in our client facility in Collegeville, PA at least 3 days per week.*** ***\*\*Role is only open to applicants not needing sponsorship now or in the future, no third parties please.*** GsGonmNoRd

applicable regulatory requirements. * Transition support for modernized services to operational teams. * Provide engineering level troubleshooting and services restoration for operational issues as software preferred. * 5\+ years of professional experience in Solution Architecture or Cloud Infrastructure Deployment and support. * 5\+ years professional experience developing or administering compute solutions for Scientific / Research IT domains, Life Sciences being preferred. * Experience with POSIT products (Package Manager, Connect, Workbench) either in an end\-user or administrator capacity. * Experience developing scientific workflows on HPC systems using Nextflow * Extensive command\-line system administration experience: * User and group management * Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, LDAP, NFS, SMB * Building applications from source code, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting application\-level Linux and scientific software in line with industry best practices. * Installation of Linux operating system and fine tuning * Familiarity with leveraging and maintaining Linux package management systems * Intermediate OS level networking knowledge. * Experience using with scripting tools, automation tools, and configuration management tools * Ansible, Terraform and Cloud Formation experience preferred * Experience administering and integrating Scientific / Research applications. * Strong time\-management skills; able to complete projects in a timely manner, plan and prioritize tasks while keeping leadership and stakeholders updated regularly on status. * Excellent communication skills, including preparation of written documentation for IT colleagues and end users. * Proactive thinking skills to identify potential issues and solution options prior to incidents occurring. * Extreme attention to detail is needed to interface with multi different clients simultaneously. * Ability to understand and analyze complex technical problems and situations. * Candidates must be a passionate engineer with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the Scientific Computing sector. * Ability to work independently or with a team * Ability to take a project from start to finish with minimal supervision **Preferred Qualifications** RCH provides services and solutions for the unique challenges of Life Sciences advanced computing, and leverages teams with cross\-functional IT skills to meet these challenges. The ideal candidates for this role will have experience working with cross\-functional IT (Public Cloud skills being a plus) and sciences skillsets.* Experience with Python, R, or other related data science programming languages. * Experience working with databases and/or supporting. * Experience managing large amounts of data effectively. * Experience working with AI/ML technologies. * Experience with containerizing compute workload via Docker or Singularity. * Experience with Nvidia DGX systems. **Additional information** **Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. If you join our team, you’ll have access to:*** A competitive salary and bonus package based on experience * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Company\-provided Life and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Company\-sponsored 401(k) Plan * Company\-provided continuing education benefit * Team\-focused culture and unlimited opportunity for advancement ***\*\*This is an onsite position and the candidate will be required to be onsite in our client facility in Collegeville, PA at least 3 days per week.*** ***\*\*Role is only open to applicants not needing sponsorship now or in the future, no third parties please.*** tFpbl0A5RH

jobs.title: Client Success Engineer
jobs.description: **About Rebar** --------------- Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email. Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years. Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week. We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next. Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment. We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to. **About the Engineering Org** ----------------------------- The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are: * Everyone operates like an owner * Find a way * We win together That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams. As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one\-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it. You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand\-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers. You can think about this role almost as a forward\-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion. We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early\-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client\-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own customer data work * Build and maintain integrations * Handle customer API requests * Scope technical requirements with customers * Be the escalation path for technical issues * Turn one\-offs into product **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real\-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000\-row CSV with inconsistent columns. We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 2\+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client\-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code * Strong Python for scripting and data work * Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres) * Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks * Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders * Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with TypeScript and React * Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) * Experience with GraphQL * Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge) * Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry * Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction * Worked at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * **Salary**: Competitive base salary * **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience * **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Perks**: + Agentic tooling budget + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time) + Great culture in a high\-energy office This is a full\-time, on\-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square. Occasional travel for on\-site customer visits. *Equal Opportunity* *Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $165K

jobs.title: Software Eng - SDK Infrastructure (Associate)
jobs.description: ROC is a cutting\-edge developer of computer vision based biometric and video analytic technologies whose product portfolio includes industry leading AI/ML algorithms and a full\-stack computer vision platform. Founded in 2015, ROC is headquartered in Denver, CO. with offices in Morgantown, WV, and Grand Rapids, MI. With over 100 full\-time employees, ROC licenses software in support of a wide range of applications including financial services, law enforcement, military, and consumer electronics. We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to help build, test and ship the ROC SDK reliably across a wide range of platforms. In this role you will take ownership of the SDK’s build and release processing, keeping our CI/CD pipelines functioning, packaging releases across operating systems and automating manual steps so every release is faster and more reliable than the last. You will also help bring our models to edge devices by integrating, packaging, and validating them on neural processing units (NPUs) using vendor runtimes such as Qualcomm QNN and Apple Core ML. This is also a unique opportunity to work alongside scientists developing advanced computer vision algorithms. Please note that this position is strictly software engineering and will not include directly training or building machine learning models. This position is a great fit for someone who enjoys making systems work reliably across platforms and wants to build a strong foundation in C/C\+\+ and build infrastructure. Most work is performed in the Denver area, with occasional travel as needed. We encourage applications from students graduating in spring 2027 as well as experienced candidates who can join on that timeline. **The start date for this position is June 2027\.** **Responsibilities include:*** Own day\-to\-day operation of the SDK’s Buildbot CI: monitor builds, triage failures, and keep build workers healthy. * Package and release the SDK across supported platforms, including versioning, artifact verification, and release notes. * Automate manual steps in the build, test, and release process, and document what can’t be automated. * Develop, debug, and maintain features in the ROC SDK's C/C\+\+ codebase. * Help integrate machine learning models from research into the SDK. * Write and maintain unit tests, and help run and improve the test and accuracy evaluation frameworks. * Maintain and extend the SDK's language wrappers. * Integrate and maintain NPU inference backends in the SDK (e.g., Qualcomm QNN/SNPE, Apple Core ML), including converting models from research into NPU\-ready formats. **Required Skills and Experience:** * 0 to 3 years of experience in software engineering or a related field (including internships, research, or academic projects). * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or closely related field. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+, including debugging and writing clean, maintainable code. * Familiarity with version control tools such as Git. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment. * Problem\-solving mindset and willingness to learn. * Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate within a technical team. **Other Relevant Skills and Experience:*** Experience with CMake or other C/C\+\+ build systems. * Exposure to CI/CD tools and automated testing. * Experience with C/C\+\+ debugging and analysis tools such as GDB or Valgrind. * Experience with CUDA and writing high performance kernels * Exposure to building, packaging, or deploying models with ML inference runtimes such as Core ML, NPU, TensorRT, Qualcomm QNN, or SNPE. * Experience developing on Linux, as well as on macOS or Windows. * Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Basic knowledge of machine learning or computer vision concepts. **Compensation for this role includes:** * Competitive salary with opportunities for growth. * This position is eligible to participate in our annual performance bonus program and our equity incentive plan (restricted stock units). * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans. * 401(k) retirement plan with a 3% non\-elective employer contribution (ROC contributes 3% of your salary automatically, regardless of your individual contribution level). This is an exceptional opportunity for individuals eager to contribute to a cutting\-edge computer vision and machine learning company where you will collaborate with a team of experts to support state\-of\-the\-art products that serve a wide range of industries. ROC believes in a healthy work / life balance, and pays particular attention to employee needs and wellbeing. ROC provides employees with unlimited PTO, a flexible work schedule, and a hybrid work environment. Employees are dedicated and hardworking, but are encouraged to take time off to rest, reset, and focus on family and personal health. *ROC is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all races, colors, religions, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, national origins, identities, and protected veteran statuses. If you’re excited about this role and the impact you can make, we strongly encourage you to apply.* Applications for this role will be accepted until 12/09/2026\.
