jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Internal Tools
jobs.description: Healthcare is complex. We're here to change that. RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone. Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other. **At a Glance** --------------- RVO Health is looking for a Staff AI Engineer to build AI\-powered tools that save our internal teams time, reduce costs, and help enable new revenue opportunities. This is an exciting role on a highly focused and autonomous team doing meaningful greenfield work. You will be building production\-grade systems that people at RVO Health use every day. You will work directly with Content Operations, Editorial, Sales, and other departments to identify the highest\-impact opportunities, propose solutions, and ship software. This is a software engineering role first. You should be comfortable owning backend systems, APIs, and production architecture, with AI and agentic experience as the layer on top. The ideal candidate moves quickly without cutting corners on quality or security. You can translate a business workflow into a technical architecture, and you are just as comfortable running a discovery session with non\-technical stakeholders as you are writing code. When a use case or the underlying data isn't ready for a bigger build, you can scope a right\-sized first iteration and show the value. **Where You'll Be** ------------------- **Location: Charlotte Metro Area (Fort Mill, SC) \| Hybrid** We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we're in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish. Office address: 1101 Red Ventures Dr Fort Mill, SC 29707 **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and maintain AI applications on AWS using Bedrock and AgentCore (preferred), including APIs, MCP servers, backend services, and integrations that connect to tools and data teams already use * Run product discovery with stakeholders: clarify the problem, define scope and success metrics, and propose a right\-sized first iteration * Deliver quickly while meeting production standards for security, observability, and maintainability * As applicable, apply security and data\-privacy practices appropriate to a healthcare company (PII, PHI), and review others' code for vulnerabilities and risky AI behavior * Share best practices with peers and other engineering teams through code reviews, mentorship, and tech talks * Identify and mitigate risks related to AI outputs, data handling, and responsible use * Write and maintain documentation, runbooks, and onboarding material that helps the team scale what gets built **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 year building AI\-powered applications, preferably on AWS * Hands\-on experience with LLMs and the practical realities of prompt engineering in production * Experience with an agentic harness library (e.g. Strands) * Experience using Claude Code or similar tools for agentic coding * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and enterprise tools * Experience building tools on top of internal data * Solid engineering fundamentals such as version control, testing, CI/CD, and code review * Working knowledge of security and privacy requirements for sensitive data (HIPAA, PII/PHI) preferred * Strong communication skills, with a track record of working with non\-technical stakeholders to understand workflows, quantify impact, and translate them into technical requirements * Strong bias for action, proactively working to find opportunities and craft solutions **Pursuant to various state Fair Pay Acts, below is a summary of compensation elements for this role at the company. The following benefits are provided by RVO Health, subject to eligibility requirements.** * Starting Salary: $170,000 \- $200,000\* + *Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience* * Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision) * Life Insurance * Short and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts * Paid Time Off * Holiday Pay * 401(k) with match * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program * Pharmacy Benefits * Income Protection Plans * Pet Services Plans * Mental Health Support * Wellness Coaching * HSA\- Health Savings Account * Commuter Benefits * Gym \& Fitness Center Discount Program **Who We Are:** RVO Health is a health\-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group's Optum. Together, we've brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. We're the \#1 source for doctor search in the U.S. Every day, people turn to our brands in moments that matter to find reliable health information, connect with doctors, save money on prescriptions, and take meaningful action on their wellbeing. Employment at RVO Health is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodations@rvohealth.com . **We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.** \#LI\-Hybrid RVO Health Privacy Policy: https://rvohealth.com/legal/privacy

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote (US) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $204\.4K – $352K • Offers Equity The final compensation will depend on the location and level at which the candidate is hired. **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About Ramp Labs** ------------------- Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post\-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000\+ companies use to move money. **About the Role** ------------------ Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map\-reduce, long\-running fan\-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Decide how the jobs.description: **About Read:** --------------- Read AI is redefining how teams collaborate by bringing intelligence to every conversation. Our platform improves productivity across meetings, messages, and email and works with the tools teams already use, including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Slack. We believe meetings should produce clear outcomes—not more content to process. We’re building a product that helps people arrive prepared, participate effectively, understand what happened, follow through on what was decided, and carry the right context forward. Backed by $81 million from Smash Capital, Madrona, and Goodwater Capital, Read AI is growing quickly. If you want to shape the future of AI\-powered collaboration at a product\-focused startup, we’d love to meet you. **About the Role:** ------------------- Read AI is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Backend team. You will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling backend systems that power our AI\-driven productivity platform. You’ll work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, shipping code weekly and directly impacting millions of users. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python (FastAPI), SQLAlchemy, and AWS infrastructure. * Build features for data ingestion, third\-party integrations (e.g., Slack, HubSpot, Notion), authentication/authorization, and enterprise\-grade security and compliance. * Own well\-scoped features end to end, including design input, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring. * Collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and data scientists to deliver innovative solutions. * Contribute to code quality by giving and receiving thoughtful code reviews and following engineering best practices. * Participate in on\-call rotations and help improve the reliability and observability of backend systems. * Identify and implement improvements to system performance, scalability, and reliability as user and data volume grows. * Contribute to a culture of innovation, ownership, and customer\-centricity. **Requirements** ---------------- * 3\+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with a track record of shipping production code. * Proficiency in Python (or similar languages such as Java, C\+\+, or Node.js). * Experience building services on cloud platforms (preferably AWS). * Solid understanding of API design, plus working knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth2, JWT) and security best practices. * Exposure to CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform), and modern DevOps practices. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work well across technical and non\-technical teams. * Strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and eagerness to learn and grow. * Experience working in a startup or fast\-paced environment is a plus. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience with distributed systems or high\-scale data pipelines. This description reflects Read AI’s focus on rapid iteration, technical excellence, and building robust backend systems to support AI\-powered productivity tools for a growing user base. **Why Read AI?** ---------------- * **Innovative:** We’re set to bring AI to the masses by introducing technology designed to improve every interaction. * **Massive Impact:** AI’s greatest impact will be on the ability to allow people to do more, taking away mundane tasks and allowing them to focus on what matters the most. * **Growth Opportunities:** Read AI is the fastest growing AI\-copilot and meeting notetaker in history, and is on pace to be one of the fastest growing consumer AI companies in the world, adding more than 1MM new customers every month. The company raised Series A and B in 2024, and was noted as a Top Company To Watch in 2025 by Inc Magazine. * **Leadership:** Learn more about CEO and Co\-Founder David Shim in this Fortune Good Life profile from July 2025; CTO and Co\-Founder Rob Williams was recently anointed as one of the most disruptive leaders in AI; and Co\-Founder and VP Data Science Elliott Waldron goes behind\-the\-scenes on our patents and models in this tech brief. * **Collaborative Culture:** Work in a supportive and collaborative environment with a diverse and talented team.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Hyperscale Data Center (Level 4 & Level 6)
jobs.description: Electrical Engineer – Hyperscale Data Center (Level 4 \& Level 6\) **Number of Positions:** 2 Levels – L4 and L6 **Employment Type:** Contract\-to\-Perm **Work Arrangement:** 100% Onsite – 5 Days per Week **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering **Work Location:** Multiple U.S. Office Locations Job Locations Candidates must currently reside within 50 miles of one of the following Black \& Veatch offices: * Overland Park, KS * Ann Arbor, MI * Bloomington, MN * Canonsburg, PA * Cary, NC * Dallas, TX * Darien, IL * Denver, CO * Houston, TX * Orlando, FL * Phoenix, AZ * Tualatin, OR Job Summary Seeking qualified Electrical Engineering professionals at Level 4 (Staff/Mid\-Level) and Level 6 (Senior) to support the engineering and detailed design of large\-scale hyperscale data center projects. The ideal candidates will possess hands\-on experience in electrical power system design, Autodesk Revit, BIM modeling, and mission\-critical infrastructure. Candidates should have experience designing electrical distribution systems and preparing engineering deliverables for large\-scale data center facilities. Experience supporting hyperscale projects for major technology companies such as Meta, Google, Microsoft, AWS, or similar organizations is highly desirable. Key Responsibilities * Develop and deliver detailed electrical engineering designs for large\-scale data center environments. * Prepare and review electrical drawings, one\-line diagrams, schematics, power plans, and technical specifications. * Perform electrical power distribution design involving switchgear, transformers, protective relays, and related systems. * Develop and manage electrical design models using Autodesk Revit and BIM tools. * Prepare engineering calculations, technical studies, and reports. * Support electrical system redundancy, resiliency, and design risk assessments. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and field personnel. * Review technical drawings and BIM models to ensure design accuracy and compliance. * Coordinate project schedules, budgets, and engineering deliverables. * Support client meetings, technical reviews, and project discussions. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and designers, as applicable. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution. * Hands\-on Autodesk Revit experience – Mandatory. * Strong electrical power design experience. * Experience with electrical power distribution systems. * Knowledge of switchgear, transformers, protective relays, and electrical infrastructure. * Experience preparing electrical one\-line diagrams, schematics, power plans, and specifications. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Previous data center or mission\-critical engineering experience. Experience Requirements – Level 4 \& Level 6 **Level 4 – Staff / Mid\-Level Electrical Engineer** * Minimum 5\+ years of related engineering experience. * Hands\-on Revit experience. * Strong electrical power design background. * Experience supporting large\-scale data center engineering projects. * Hyperscale data center experience, preferably involving 40 MW\+ facilities. * Ability to support senior engineers in executing complex engineering designs. * PE license is a plus but not mandatory. **Level 6 – Senior Electrical Engineer** * Minimum 11\+ years of related engineering experience. * Advanced hands\-on Revit/BIM experience. * Strong background in hyperscale data center electrical design. * Experience with 40 MW\+ data center projects; 120 MW–180 MW\+ experience is highly desirable. * Ability to lead electrical engineering design projects. * Experience managing and mentoring approximately three engineers. * Strong client\-facing communication and project coordination experience. * Ability to manage project schedules, technical deliverables, and engineering resources. * Active PE license strongly preferred. Preferred Technical Skills * Autodesk Revit and BIM modeling. * Navisworks and BIM 360\. * AutoCAD. * ETAP power system analysis software. * Arc\-flash and electrical coordination studies. * Revit worksets, view templates, project phasing, and complex BIM families. * Hyperscale data center design experience. * Direct project exposure to Meta, Google, Microsoft, AWS, or similar hyperscalers. * Understanding of data center redundancy, resiliency, and tier rating systems. Important Eligibility Requirements * Candidates must reside within 50 miles of one of the listed Black \& Veatch office locations. * Must be available to work onsite five days per week. * Revit experience is mandatory. Candidates without hands\-on Revit experience will not qualify. * Bachelor's degree in Engineering is mandatory. * Genuine electrical power design experience is required. * Candidates with primarily lighting/MEP backgrounds and no substantial power design experience will not qualify. * Small data center experience alone may not meet the project requirements. Additional Information * Employment Type: Contract\-to\-Perm. * Work Arrangement: Full\-time onsite. * Travel: Generally expected to be 5% or less. * Interview Process: One virtual interview round. * PE license: Preferred, particularly for Level 6\. **Candidates will be evaluated and submitted for either Level 4 or Level 6 based on their qualifications and experience.** **Job ID: 37666642** Pay: $70\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance\-driven individuals a place where they can build a career \-\-\- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system. **Job Description:** At Regions, the Cyber Security Engineer supports applicable services for cloud applications, infrastructure, platform security, and related technologies within the Cyber Security organization. The engineer at this level is considered a subject\-matter expert (SME) utilizing extensive experience and technical knowledge and may lead complex projects as necessary. Primary Responsibilities Utilizes extensive knowledge in the design, implementation, and support of relevant cyber security technology solutions Provides technical administration to include troubleshooting support, break\-fix operations, patching, and other day\-to\-day activities for relevant applications Stays abreast of industry trends and investigates organizational objectives and needs, ensuring team mutual knowledge and awareness Reviews and maintains operational documentation and reports to support monthly trend analysis as well as project components Leads research, proof\-of\-concept, selection, and implementation of technology solution Conducts an advanced level of analysis of pros and cons and build vs buy options, offering opinion to management regarding disputes and contrasts Explores implementation of new technologies, solutions, and methods to improve business processes, efficiency, effectiveness, and value delivered to customers Leads the examination of technology vision, opportunities and challenges regarding security standards and the impact of the technology within the Cyber Security organization Develops and maintains relevant metrics, controls, and other governance administration related to cyber security technology Participates in on\-call rotation for the support of any relevant cyber security technologies Ensures compliance with risk management programs, rules and regulations, and cybersecurity practices; identifies opportunities for and supports process improvements; applies disciplined change management practices Assists management collaborating with other teams on projects, ensuring alignment with the goals and objectives of the Cyber Security organization Works jointly with management to assist in the development of technical skills and knowledge among team, ensuring the organization has adequate resources to ensure the safety and protection of Regions’ technology and assets Serves as a mentor to team members Acts as a role model in adhering to operational processes, standards, and procedures May serve as a leader in security incident response activities and post\-event reviews of security incidents May serve as the subject\-matter expert regarding design, implementation, and maintenance of relevant cyber security solutions to business areas, project teams, and vendors May lead complex projects as assigned by management This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay. Requirements High School Diploma or GED and ten (10\) years of related post\-secondary education and/or experience in Information Security and/or Information Technology Preferences Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Security, Information Systems Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field Experience within a Cyber and/or Information Security organization within the financial services industry Applicable technology and/or security certifications (e.g. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), CompTIA Security\+, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA), etc.) Skills and Competencies Ability to interpret and ensure compliance with applicable rules, regulations, and industry guidance Ability to prioritize conflicting demands Ability to work independently Advanced analytical and evaluative thinking capability Advanced knowledge of modern security tools and controls Advanced problem ring sensitive data (PII, PCI, PHI, confidential data) across hybrid, multi\-cloud and on\-premises environments. Strong understanding of data privacy and regulatory requirements including GLBA, PCI\-DSS, GDPR, CCPA and other applicable data protection frameworks. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Remote/Hybrid ***Job Overview*** Job Overview WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO claiR is Relativity's conversational AI experience, built for lawyers at the world's leading law firms. Running inside the Relativity aiR platform, claiR is an agentic surface into Relativity's petabytes of matter intelligence, letting users search, enrich, and generate work product from their data, with answers grounded in the matter's documents and backed by citations. The claiR team builds and ships this experience, from the AI and retrieval systems that reason across a matter to the web interface that lawyers and case teams use to explore their data and collaborate. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** This role offers an opportunity to grow as a full\-stack AI engineer on the team building claiR, the conversational AI experience lawyers use to ask questions, search, and draft from their matter data. You will work alongside the engineers and applied scientists who build claiR and gain direct exposure to how agentic features are designed, evaluated, and shipped. You will begin with well\-defined features across the stack and grow toward end\-to\-end ownership of agentic features. This Senior AI Engineer role is designed for a mid\-to\-high level engineer ready to grow quickly. The role reports to a Lead Engineer on claiR at Relativity and may be based remotely in the United States or in our Chicago office. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Build features across the full stack of claiR, including agent tools, prompt and context changes, services and API endpoints, and front\-end work in the claiR web app. * Work with applied scientists to extend claiR’s agentic functionality with new capabilities and features. * Write and extend evaluations, run them, and learn to interpret the results. Ship changes behind feature flags and monitor production outcomes. * Learn and practice a modern software development lifecycle from day one through small, frequent commits, feature\-flagged deployments, fast rollbacks, and best\-in\-class agentic engineering tools. * Fix bugs, improve reliability, and add tests while developing an understanding of how agentic systems fail. * Pair with Senior and Lead engineers on design and code reviews. Ask questions and document what you learn so others can benefit. * Take on increasingly ambiguous problems as you demonstrate readiness. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** **Required** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience or equivalent demonstrated ability, such as a strong open\-source track record, a shipped product, or substantial internship experience. * Working proficiency in Python and C\#, plus hands\-on experience building full\-stack web applications with a front end such as React, services, and a relational database using SQL. * Hands\-on experience building an agentic solution with LLMs, even at a small scale, such as an agent, a retrieval\-augmented generation application, or a tool\-using assistant. Ability to explain system prompts, tool calls, embeddings, and common failure points. * Basic familiarity with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, containers, and CI/CD. * Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and writing clean, tested code. * Clear written and spoken English and a preference for simple solutions over clever ones. **WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT** **Impactful Mission** * Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters. **Engineering at Scale** * Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data. **Cutting\-Edge Technology** * Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech. **Growth and Ownership** * Gain experience owning systems end\-to\-end across cloud and distributed environments. **Collaborative Culture** * Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. **Inclusive Environment** * Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $143,000 and $215,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Algorithms, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Computer Vision, Data Science, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Project Management, Software Engineering

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Spend Product
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. ##### **About the Spend Product Team** We build the system that gives companies real time visibility and control over every dollar they spend. Rippling Spend unifies corporate cards, reimbursements, procurement, bill pay, and travel into a single workflow that connects directly to accounting and payroll. Unlike point solutions that reconcile after the fact, we enforce policy, approvals, and accounting in real time. That lets finance teams operate proactively, and it creates a hard systems problem across payments, data consistency, permissions, and scale. If you like building deeply integrated platforms that replace fragmented tooling, this is the work ### **What We Build** We build the products that help companies control, automate, and gain real\-time visibility into every way money moves through the business, from cards and expenses to bill pay and travel. * **Corporate Cards:** Rippling Corporate Cards powers company spending through physical and virtual cards with built\-in controls, configurable limits, and policy enforcement. For engineering candidates, it’s a chance to work on payments infrastructure, risk systems, authorization flows, and high\-trust financial user experiences. * **Expense Management:** Rippling Expense Management helps employees submit expenses and helps finance teams review, approve, and reimburse them in a streamlined workflow. From an engineering standpoint, it brings together policy engines, approvals, mobile and web experiences, and deep integrations with payroll and accounting systems. * **Bill Pay:** Rippling Bill Pay gives companies a unified way to manage vendor invoices, approval chains, and outgoing payments. It’s a product area that combines document ingestion, workflow automation, financial operations, and money movement in a single system. * **Trave**l: Rippling Travel connects booking workflows with the rest of the spend stack so travel activity, approvals, and downstream reconciliation all live in one ecosystem. For engineers, it’s an opportunity to build across booking experiences, policy enforcement, compliance, and post\-purchase spend workflows. * **Procurement:** Rippling Procurement provides a centralized way for employees to request, approve, and manage purchases before money is spent. It brings together intake workflows, approval chains, vendor coordination, and purchase tracking into a single system. From an engineering perspective, it involves building flexible workflow engines, dynamic forms, vendor management systems, and deep integrations with bill pay, accounting, and policy enforcement to ensure spend is controlled from the very first request. * **Banking:** Rippling Banking enables companies to store, move, and manage their money with built\-in controls and real\-time visibility. It brings together accounts, transfers, cash management, and reconciliation into a single system tightly integrated with the broader spend stack. From an engineering perspective, it spans ledgering systems, money movement rails, compliance and risk controls, and high\-reliability infrastructure to ensure accuracy, security, and trust at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own the design and implementation of core backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities and complex business logic. * Ensure all systems are built for high\-volume scale, reliability, and security, making strategic decisions about infrastructure and data integrity. * Work seamlessly with product, frontend, and platform teams to translate feature goals into robust, high\-performance technical solutions. * Elevate the team's technical standards, lead code and design reviews, and mentor engineers on backend best practices. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Go, or a similar high\-scale backend language. * Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization of relational databases. * You have seen and contributed to systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale. * Strong understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals and experience with complex project delivery. * Exceptional communication skills with technical and cross\-functional stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 159,000 \- 278,250 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Agentic AI Systems Engineer to serve as an enterprise systems engineer for agentic AI within our Data, Analytics, and Insights – AI Innovation \& Engineering organization. This role shapes how agentic AI is adopted across a large, global enterprise: you will assess use cases end to end, decide where to buy, build, or extend, and design the target architecture that lets agents work safely across our business systems. You have a proven track record of making sound technology investment decisions, designing integrated enterprise platforms, and guiding solutions from concept through production at scale. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Serve as the architecture lead across a portfolio of agentic AI use cases, owning the technical specification, solution architecture, and delivery approach for each. * Lead buy vs. build vs. extend decisions for AI capabilities, evaluating vendor platforms, embedded AI features in existing enterprise applications (e.g., ERP, CRM, ITSM, productivity suites), and custom\-built solutions against total cost of ownership, time to value, differentiation, risk, and long\-term supportability. * Develop and maintain the enterprise Agentic AI / Orchestration reference architecture for agentic AI, including agent platforms, orchestration, tool and data access, identity, observability, and guardrails. * Define decision frameworks, architecture patterns, and reusable standards that help product teams choose the right approach consistently and reduce duplicated spend across functions. * Partner with AI Strategy, Product, Cybersecurity, Data \& Analytics, Procurement, and business stakeholders to rationalize the AI application portfolio and identify consolidation opportunities. * Lead technical vendor evaluations, proofs of concept, and architecture reviews; translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership. * Provide perspective on resource needs, cost models, and delivery risk, and advise stakeholders on sequencing and investment priorities. * Champion responsible AI by embedding governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements into every architecture decision. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Enterprise Architecture \& Buy vs. Build Strategy:** Apply structured methods (e.g., TOGAF, capability mapping, TCO and ROI analysis) to assess build, buy, partner, or reuse options, and document architecture decisions with clear trade\-offs. **Agentic AI Systems Design:** Architect AI agents that use tools and skills, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers, and design multi\-agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, or Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocols. **Platform \& Vendor Landscape:** Maintain a working knowledge of the agentic AI market, including hyperscaler agent platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks Agentbricks), SaaS\-embedded agents, and open\-source frameworks, and understand where each fits. **Enterprise Integration:** Design how agents securely access enterprise systems and data, including ERP, CRM, PLM, and ITSM platforms, through APIs, event\-driven integration, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines backed by vector and NoSQL stores. **System Architecture \& Security:** Design secure architectures for AI products that comply with enterprise data governance and security policies, including identity and access for agents, PII filtering, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. **Operations, Observability \& Cost:** Define standards for AI deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and cost management (LLMOps/FinOps), leveraging containerization, infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD on cloud platforms. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years in an enterprise or solution architecture role. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a similar discipline. * Demonstrated experience leading buy vs. build decisions and vendor selections for enterprise technology, including business cases and TCO analysis. * Hands\-on experience designing and deploying Generative AI solutions, RAG pipelines, and multi\-agent systems in production, regardless of the underlying cloud vendor. * 5\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience integrating with enterprise applications such as ERP (e.g., IFS Cloud, SAP), CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics 365\), or ITSM (e.g., ServiceNow). * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern API, integration, and event\-driven architecture patterns. * Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF) or cloud architect certification (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional). * Familiarity with AI governance and risk frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. * Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. **What We Offer** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision jobs.title: Semantic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Semantic AI Engineer to build the knowledge foundation that our enterprise AI agents depend on. This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on how agents remember, reason over, and share what the company knows. You will design and build a corporate knowledge graph that agents both draw from and contribute to, along with the agentic memory systems that let agents keep context across tasks, users, and time. You have a proven track record of modeling complex business domains, building production knowledge graphs or semantic layers, and connecting them to LLM\-based applications. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Design, build, and evolve a knowledge graph that represents Rockwell's people, products, customers, processes, systems, and data, and serves as shared context for AI agents across functions. * Design write\-back patterns that let agents contribute new facts, relationships, and learnings to the knowledge graph safely, with provenance, confidence, validation, and human review where needed. * Architect agentic memory for our agent platform, including short\-term (working) memory, long\-term episodic and semantic memory, and shared organizational memory, with clear policies for retention, summarization, and forgetting. * Develop ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic models with business and data owners, and keep business definitions consistent across analytics, BI, and AI tools. * Build ingestion and extraction pipelines that turn structured and unstructured enterprise content (documents, tickets, ERP and CRM records, engineering data) into graph entities and relationships using LLM\-assisted entity and relation extraction. * Implement GraphRAG and hybrid retrieval (graph traversal combined with vector and keyword search) to ground agent responses and reduce hallucinations. * Expose the knowledge graph and memory services to agents through standard interfaces such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and APIs. * Establish governance for the knowledge graph, including access control, data lineage, quality checks, freshness, and alignment with enterprise data governance and security policies. * Partner with stakeholders across the enterprise to prioritize knowledge domains and measure the impact on agent accuracy and usefulness. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Knowledge Graphs \& Semantic Modeling:** Design ontologies and graph schemas using property graph (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin) and/or RDF/OWL approaches, with query languages such as Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL. Apply entity resolution, schema alignment, and graph data quality techniques. **Agentic Memory:** Architect memory layers for AI agents, including working memory, episodic and semantic long\-term memory, memory consolidation and retrieval, and shared memory across multi\-agent systems, using frameworks such as LangGraph, Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Hindsight, LLMWiki etc. **Corporate Knowledge Graph for Agents:** Build a living, agent\-writable knowledge graph with provenance, trust levels, versioning, and conflict resolution so that knowledge produced by agents can be reviewed, trusted, and reused across the enterprise. **GraphRAG \& Retrieval:** Implement retrieval pipelines that combine knowledge graph traversal with vector search (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Redis) and embeddings to deliver accurate, explainable context to LLMs. **Semantic Layer \& Open Standards:** Understand semantic layers and metric definitions, and how open standards keep business meaning consistent as it moves between AI agents, BI platforms, and data tools. **Agent Integration \& Security:** Expose knowledge and memory services through MCP servers and APIs, with fine\-grained access control, PII handling, and audit logging that comply with enterprise governance and security policies. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or search and retrieval systems. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Knowledge Engineering, or a similar discipline. * Hands\-on experience building and operating a production knowledge graph in an enterprise setting. * Experience designing memory for LLM agents and multi\-agent systems in production. * Familiarity with Apache Ossie (incubating, formerly Open Semantic Interchange), the vendor\-neutral standard for exchanging semantic models and metric definitions across AI, BI, and analytics tools. * Familiarity with the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), the open specification for representing agent\- and human\-readable knowledge as markdown with YAML frontmatter, including its provenance, trust, and freshness conventions. * Experience with W3C semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and industrial information models such as ISA\-95 or the Asset Administration Shell. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with graph query languages (Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL). * Experience with LLM\-based information extraction, entity resolution, and evaluation of retrieval quality. * Experience with data catalogs and metadata platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, DataHub). * 3\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. * Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. **What We Offer** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com * We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:** * **Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority\- and woman\-owned enterprise in the U.S.** * **Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.** * **Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.** * **World\-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.** **Job Summary** =============== The Associate Solutions Engineer / Data Center Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting physical server infrastructure within lab and data center environments. This role supports the full server hardware lifecycle, including equipment installation and cabling, server configuration, out\-of\-band management, Linux administration, diagnostics, firmware management, hardware replacement, and production\-ready handoff. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working at a Linux command line and physically installing or troubleshooting enterprise server equipment, with the ability to identify and resolve issues across hardware, BMC, networking, storage, firmware, and operating system layers. **Role Description** **Server Hardware Management** * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise server hardware. * Diagnose failures involving CPUs, DIMMs, storage devices, RAID controllers, power supplies, network interface cards (NICs), GPUs, fans, and system boards. * Perform hardware swaps, component upgrades, firmware updates, and break/fix activities. * Review system health, hardware inventory, event logs, temperatures, power consumption, and component status. Work with enterprise GPU server platforms such as Dell XE Series, NVIDIA H200, Cisco UCS, or equivalent systems. * **Baseboard Management Controller (BMC)** * Configure and manage server BMC interfaces and out\-of\-band management using technologies such as Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, IPMI, and Redfish. * Configure BMC networking, credentials, firmware, remote consoles, virtual media, and power controls. * Use BMC logs and hardware telemetry to diagnose server faults. Perform remote power cycling, system configuration, and operating system installation when appropriate. * **Equipment Racking and Cabling** * Rack and unrack servers, switches, storage equipment, Power Distribution Units (PDUs), and related infrastructure. * Install rails, cable\-management hardware, and other rack components. * Perform structured copper and fiber cabling, including Ethernet connections and management networks. * Maintain accurate port, cable, rack\-unit, hostname, and asset labeling. * Follow rack elevation, power distribution, airflow, and cable\-management standards. Trace and troubleshoot physical connectivity issues throughout the rack infrastructure. * **Linux Administration** * Install, configure, and support Linux operating systems, including Ubuntu Server or equivalent distributions. * Troubleshoot Linux boot, kernel, storage, networking, service, and hardware\-related issues. * Perform system administration using SSH and command\-line tools. * Configure interfaces, IP addressing, DNS, routes, bonding, and VLAN\-related settings. * Use Linux utilities such as systemctl, journalctl, dmesg, ip, ethtool, lsblk, lspci, dmidecode, and smartctl. Create Bash or Python scripts to automate repetitive server\-management activities where appropriate. * **Behaviors and Competencies** ------------------------------ * **Problem\-Solving:** Can systematically identify, isolate, and resolve hardware, firmware, networking, storage, and operating system issues. * **Detail\-Oriented:** Can identify errors or inconsistencies in configurations, logs, cabling, labeling, and component status and make necessary corrections. * **Organization:** Can prioritize technical tasks, manage personal workflow, and maintain accurate infrastructure records. * **Follow\-Up:** Can independently track assigned work and technical issues through completion without requiring reminders. * **Communication:** Can clearly communicate technical issues, findings, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions to appropriate stakeholders. * **Documentation:** Can independently create and maintain accurate technical, infrastructure, and troubleshooting documentation. * **Collaboration:** Can work effectively with engineers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other technical resources. * **Results Orientation:** Can take ownership of assigned server infrastructure activities and drive work through successful validation and handoff. **Skill Level Requirements** **Required Skills** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting physical servers, data center infrastructure, hardware labs, or a comparable environment. * Strong knowledge of enterprise server hardware and component\-level troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with BMC and out\-of\-band management technologies, including IPMI, Redfish, Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, or comparable technologies. * Demonstrated experience racking, unracking, installing, and cabling server equipment. * Strong working knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting. * Understanding of TCP/IP networking, Ethernet, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and basic network troubleshooting. Ability to interpret hardware logs and systematically isolate hardware, firmware, network, storage, and operating system problems. * **Preferred Skills** * Experience supporting GPU or AI compute infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPU\-based servers. * Familiarity with high\-density or high\-performance computing environments. * Experience with IPMI tools, Ansible, Bash, or Python for server automation. * Experience with PXE/network\-based provisioning and automated Linux installation. * Familiarity with RAID, NVMe, SAS/SATA storage, and enterprise storage concepts. * Experience performing firmware and BIOS/UEFI configuration at scale. * Familiarity with server asset\-management or Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems. Linux certification such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) is a plus. * **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Ability to safely lift, install, move, rack, and unrack server and other rack\-mounted equipment in accordance with applicable workplace safety requirements. * Ability to perform hands\-on equipment installation, cabling, component replacement, and troubleshooting within lab and data center environments. * Ability to work independently on assigned infrastructure activities and escalate issues appropriately when additional support is required. * Ability to manage a server through the deployment lifecycle, including rack installation, power and network cabling, BMC configuration, firmware/BIOS setup, Linux installation, hardware and network validation, and production\-ready handoff. The estimated annual pay range for this position is $75,000 \- $150,000 which includes a base salary. The compensation for this position is dependent on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

Monitoring, Logging \& Observability * Implement structured logging, distributed tracing, and appropriate diagnostic instrumentation across frontend and backend services. * Ensure application errors, system failures, and performance issues can be identified and diagnosed efficiently. * Develop code that produces meaningful, actionable diagnostic information to support troubleshooting and incident resolution. * Maintain appropriate application telemetry to support operational monitoring and continuous improvement. * Collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to improve system observability and reduce time to identify and resolve production issues. Code Quality, Reviews \& Engineering Standards * Write clean, well\-structured, thoroughly tested, and maintainable code. * Participate actively in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and promoting engineering best practices. * Help establish and maintain a collaborative development environment that encourages technical knowledge sharing. * Document software functionality, technical decisions, dependencies, and implementation requirements. * Reduce technical silos by ensuring critical platform functionality is understood by multiple members of the Engineering team. * Contribute to consistent coding standards, development processes, and technical documentation. * Support continuous improvement of softwar  application and dependency vulnerabilities. * Knowledge of application performance optimization, debugging, profiling, and resource management. * Experience implementing structured logging, monitoring, and application tracing. * Proficiency with Git, peer code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD development workflows. * Experience working within established software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and communicate delivery risks. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, and consistently meet development commitments. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing and supporting high\-volume, transaction\-oriented SaaS platforms. * Familiarity with payment processing systems, financial technology, or payment gateway integrations. * Understanding of PCI DSS requirements and secure handling of payment\-related data. * Experience with cloud\-based application environments such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with microservices, containerization, and distributed systems. * Experience using application performance monitoring (APM), distributed tracing, and observability platforms. * Experience with frontend performance optimization and modern UI frameworks. * Familiarity with Agile development practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence. * Experience mentoring developers, conducting technical reviews, and promoting knowledge sharing across Engineering teams. What Success Looks Like The successful Senior Software Developer will consistently demonstrate the ability to: * **Deliver production\-ready software:** Develop complete, tested, secure, and maintainable features that meet established architectural requirements. * **Maintain strong security standards:** Proactively prevent vulnerabilities and protect sensitive platform and customer data. * **Optimize application performance:** Deliver efficient code that supports scalability, responsiveness, and reliable platform operations. * **Improve system observability:** Ensure application failures and performance issues can be quickly identified, diagnosed, and resolved. * **Promote engineering collaboration:** Reduce technical silos through effective documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. * **Demonstrate delivery accountability:** Meet commitments, communicate progress accurately, and escalate risks before they impact delivery. It requires adherence to architectural standards, disciplined testing, security awareness, proactive communication, and a commitment to delivering reliable solutions that support the business. Above all, the successful candidate will be someone who delivers high\-quality software, works effectively within a team, and contributes to the long\-term scalability, reliability, and profitability of the company. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance.. * Generous paid time off policy. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. * Flexible working hours and remote work options. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Atlas)
jobs.description: Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source\-to\-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems. Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest\-to\-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community. For more information, visit www.supplier.io. **The Opportunity** The Senior Full Stack Software Engineer builds and runs the customer\-facing application layer of Atlas, from the UI through the services and APIs behind it, and is the first technical responder when those applications need production support. You will own work end to end across the UI, the backend and day\-to\-day application support, so that the path from data to interface has an accountable engineer at every step. You will work in a small, fast\-moving team that is building Atlas greenfield while keeping critical customer\-facing services reliable. An AI\-forward team. We are AI\-forward and expect engineers to use LLM\-led development methodologies as a normal part of how they design, build, test and review software. We want someone with real experience working this way, who pairs it with sound engineering judgment (clear specs, careful review, thorough tests), and who can build ML and LLM\-powered features into Atlas using frontier models through their APIs. **What you will do** **UI** * Build and maintain the web interfaces for Atlas, including the Vendor Master intake experience, supplier profile capabilities, client reporting views and the internal review and labeling tool that feeds our matching model and more. * Turn product requirements and customer feedback into usable, accessible and performant interfaces, using shared, reusable components. * Write front\-end unit and integration tests, and partner with QA on end\-to\-end coverage. **Backend** * Design, build and maintain the services and APIs behind those interfaces (REST and GraphQL), including the customer\-facing API work for match, enrichment, authentication and entitlements. * Integrate machine learning and LLM capabilities into Atlas by calling frontier models through their APIs, including prompt design, evaluation, cost and latency management, and safe handling of customer data. * Design and maintain MongoDB data models and queries for the applications you own, and build integration points with the underlying data platform and matching engine, working with data engineering and architecture leads so the application layer stays aligned with the data model. * Design for security, performance and observability, and take new work through the established architecture review, design sign\-off and epic sizing steps. * Harden failure handling across services: retries, dead\-lettering, idempotent processing, and detection of stuck or partially processed batches. **Application support** * Act as the technical escalation point for the Atlas applications: triage, diagnose and fix production issues across the UI, API and data layers, working with Support, QA and DevOps. * Take part in the on\-call and incident rotation for Atlas applications, and lead root\-cause analysis and post\-incident follow\-up for the issues you handle. * Reduce repeat incidents by fixing underlying causes, adding monitoring and alerting, and improving release quality. * Write and maintain runbooks, architecture notes and support documentation so application knowledge does not sit with one person. **Team and delivery** * Work within our Agile SDLC: sprint planning, estimation, code review in GitHub, and release through GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. * Use LLM\-led development practices day to day, and help the team adopt effective habits for them, such as spec\-first prompting, review of generated code and test coverage. * Review code and mentor engineers around you on the systems you own. * Bring options and a recommended path forward whenever you raise a risk or gap. * Write maintainable code: break up very large modules, remove dead and legacy paths, and raise type coverage and test quality. **What you will need to succeed** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and running production web applications across both front end and back end. * Demonstrated experience using LLM\-led development methodologies in your daily work, such as AI coding assistants and agents and spec\- or prompt\-driven development, with the judgment to review, test and own what they produce. * Strong front\-end skills in a modern JavaScript or TypeScript framework such as React, Angular or Vue, including component design, state management and accessibility. * Strong backend skills in Python, with solid REST and GraphQL API design and authentication and authorization experience. * Hands\-on experience with MongoDB, including data modeling, querying and indexing. * Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, and time\-series metrics stores such as InfluxDB or TimescaleDB * Experience integrating ML or LLM capabilities into applications through frontier model APIs. * Experience building and deploying on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions, automated testing, CI/CD and code review. * Hands\-on application support experience: debugging live issues, reading logs and metrics, tracing and metrics collection and handling incidents calmly and methodically. * Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, QA, support and non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort with ambiguity: able to work in a greenfield, fast\-changing product without over\-engineering process. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with BigQuery. * Experience with Grafana for dashboards and alerting, and with other observability tools. * Experience with backend\-for\-frontend patterns and API gateway design. * Familiarity with Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD and KEDA * Experience with data\- or AI\-driven products, such as matching, classification or enrichment. * Experience in procurement, supplier data or other B2B enterprise software. * Experience with Jira and Confluence. **We do no accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment/search firms.** **AI Use Policy:** The use of artificial intelligence tools during your And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019\), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation. **Your Role at SafelyYou** As a Senior API Engineer at SafelyYou, you will be the technical lead responsible for designing, building, and operating our core backend services and platform infrastructure. You are expected to bring hands\-on experience building APIs, deep technical expertise, operate with minimal guidance, and proactively mentor other engineers while actively writing code and building our data and API platforms. **Key Responsibilities:** * Own the design, development, and operation of scalable APIs, microservices, and backend platform infrastructure using Python and AWS. * Lead the implementation, continuous improvement, and lifecycle of the External Data API, serving as the technical bridge between our internal data systems and our customers. * Contribute to and implement data governance practices including registries and data dictionaries, such as the Event Registry. The Role You'll set the technical direction for major parts of the platform and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls. You'll turn the platform vision into an architecture teams across Sage can build on and rely on, and set the engineering bar across squads. **Key Responsibilities** - Own the architecture for one or more core platform areas, such as orchestration, execution environments, agent identity and access, or the model gateway, from design through production. - Make and record key architecture decisions: service boundaries, contracts between components, technology choices and build\-versus\-buy, with options and trade\-offs written down. - Design the platform's trust model: isolation, least privilege, short\-lived task\-scoped access, evidence tied to exact code revisions, and safe failure handling, so autonomy can grow without growing risk. - Lead the hardest technical problems hands\-on: reliability, performance, security incidents, and scaling to many concurrent agent runs. - Set engineering standards for testing, observability, security, deployment and recovery, and make sure they're adopted, not just documented. - Work with architects and senior engineers from teams across Sage to turn their requirements into platform capabilities, and explain decisions back to them. - Partner with ML engineers on evaluation and model strategy, so infrastructure and agent quality improve together. - Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leadership across our distributed team. What You'll Own Technical direction and architecture for your platform areas, cross\-squad technical trade\-offs, and acceptance of engineering evidence before capabilities go live. You escalate product, security, legal or commercial policy questions with a clear recommendation. What We're Looking For Extensive engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture and technical strategy for large\-scale distributed or platform systems, and hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered or agent\-based systems in production. Technical Skills - Expert in distributed systems design: durable workflows, queues and async processing, idempotency, consistency, failure recovery and operating at scale. - Deep experience building cloud platforms (AWS preferred, or GCP/Azure): Kubernetes, containers, infrastructure as code, and multi\-account or multi\-tenant isolation. - Strong security architecture judgement: identity and access management, short\-lived credentials, secrets management, sandboxing, supply\-chain security and auditability. - Production experience with LLM systems: agents and tool use, context engineering, model routing, evaluation, and the ways they fail. - Proficient in one or more of Python, TypeScript, Go, Java or Rust, and still able to write, review and debug production code. - Experience defining API and event contracts, versioning and backward compatibility across teams. Leadership \& Ownership - A track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams and seeing it through to production. - Makes sound decisions under uncertainty, makes trade\-offs visible, and changes course when the evidence says so. - Exceptional written and verbal communication; can align engineers, architects, product and senior leaders around complex decisions. - Raises the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, examples and pairing. Mindset \& Collaboration - Growth mindset: curious, always learning and open to feedback. - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day, helping the whole organization build software better and faster. Nice to Have - Experience with durable workflow engines such as Temporal, or similar. - Experience with microVM or container sandboxing (for example Firecracker, Kata Containers or gVisor). - Built developer platforms, CI/CD or code\-review systems used across a large engineering organization. - Experience with policy engines (for example OPA or Cedar) and fine\-grained authorization. - Open\-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. What Success Looks Like in Your First Year - A small set of recorded architecture decisions guides the build without blocking teams. - Your areas reach production with clear SLOs, passed security reviews and proven recovery drills. - Teams onboarding to the platform adopt your capabilities with little custom work. - Engineers around you make more decisions confidently because standards and examples are clear. What to Expect - We value humility and collaboration. We're looking for people who work as part of a team, not in silos. - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond writing code, including tests, documentation and long\-term system quality. - We use AI tools heavily in our own work, and expect you to as well, with good judgement about when to trust them.

You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship. * **Even Better If…** =================== * Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks. * Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations. * Building an early\-stage product or working in a customer\-facing engineering role.
