jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck and rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: The Lead Data Scientist will lead the design, development, and productionization of advanced data science, machine learning, and AI solutions across enterprise, commercial, manufacturing, engineering, and vehicle\-data use cases. This role operates at the intersection of data science, machine learning, GenAI, and Scout's enterprise data platform, transforming complex business and engineering problems into scalable analytical solutions and measurable business outcomes. The Lead Data Scientist will partner with data engineers, AI engineers, software engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to take solutions from problem definition and experimentation through validation, production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. **Data Science \& Advanced Analytics** * Lead the translation of complex business and engineering problems into well\-defined data science, machine learning, optimization, forecasting, and predictive analytics problems. * Design and develop scalable models for classification, regression, forecasting, clustering, anomaly detection, recommendation, and optimization. * Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, feature selection, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimentation. * Establish appropriate baseline models, evaluation metrics, validation strategies, and acceptance criteria based on business objectives. * Apply techniques such as XGBoost, gradient boosting, ensemble methods, deep learning, NLP, and time\-series modeling where appropriate. * Apply statistical and experimental methods to distinguish correlation from meaningful drivers and support data\-driven decision\-making. * Evaluate model accuracy, robustness, explainability, bias, stability, and business impact before production deployment. * Define measurable business and operational KPIs and evaluate whether deployed models are producing the intended outcomes. * Translate analytical findings and model outputs into actionable recommendations for technical, product, engineering, and business stakeholders. **Machine Learning Engineering \&** **MLOps** * Build production\-grade ML solutions using Databricks ML, MLflow, Python, Spark/PySpark, and AWS/SageMaker. * Develop reusable ML pipelines covering data preparation, feature engineering, training, evaluation, registration, inference, and monitoring. * Use MLflow for experiment tracking, reproducibility, model lifecycle management, and model governance. * Partner with platform, AI, and DevOps engineers to establish CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment patterns for machine\-learning workloads. * Define model\-monitoring approaches for performance, drift, data quality, reliability, and operational health. * Establish retraining and model\-refresh strategies based on model performance, changing data patterns, and business requirements. * Optimize ML workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost. **Automotive, Manufacturing \& Engineering Analytics** * Apply data science to automotive and manufacturing problems involving vehicle, quality, plant, engineering, sales and planning, and connected\-data domains. * Develop predictive and analytical approaches for areas such as quality intelligence, anomaly detection, vehicle health, manufacturing performance, demand/v dation * Model explainability * Experiment design * Model performance monitoring * Experience building solutions using large, complex, heterogeneous datasets. * Experience taking ML solutions from prototype/POC through production deployment and operational support. * Strong analytical problem\-solving skills and ability to translate ambiguous business problems into measurable data\-science problems. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain model behavior and recommendations to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to mentor other data scientists and engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with GenAI, LLMs, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and AI agents. * Experience developing systematic LLM/model evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, latency, and cost. * Experience with MLflow Model Registry, automated ML pipelines, CI/CD, model monitoring, and ML observability. * Experience with time\-series, forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, or recommendation systems. * Automotive or manufacturing analytics experience, particularly with vehicle, plant, quality, engineering, warranty, or connected\-product data. * Experience working with enterprise data platforms and governed data products. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $160,000\.00 \- $192,500\.00 Internal leveling code: IC7 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: IT Security Engineer III/CyberArk

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Serko.ai
jobs.description: At Serko, we believe something incredible happens when people come face\-to\-face. That’s why we’re on a mission to engineer a frictionless, next\-generation business travel marketplace. We don’t just manage travel; we are leveraging advanced AI and cutting\-edge tech to eliminate the complexity of global movement. When you join Serko, you join a global collective of passionate technologists who show up as their true selves to build world\-class products. With established hubs across New Zealand, Australia, North America, India and China \- your code and ideas will impact millions of corporate travelers worldwide. If you're ready to challenge the status quo and build the future of travel tech, your next journey starts here. Working within a highly supportive team, you will shape the application experience layer—building the web apps, BFFs, and orchestration services that connect our platform directly to the customer. With light\-touch guidance, you will elevate the craft, accessibility, and quality of our user\-facing products. **Requirements** You are someone who understands the "why" behind the work, operates with high agency, and ships small, high\-impact changes frequently. **What you'll do** * Work closely with Product, Design and Engineering, modelling strong engineering standards and teamwork. * Understand the customer problem and success measure, and check that what you ship moves it. * Help shape work into small, shippable slices with requirements anyone, or any agent, could check. * Independently deliver well\-scoped features to production, in line with our stack and design system. * Implement designs faithfully and accessibly, including responsive behaviour and empty, error and loading states. * Build and extend the BFF endpoints your features need in Python. * Build AI and agent\-powered features for customers using our established patterns for streaming, latency, errors and non\-deterministic output. * Work agentically by default, giving agents clear tasks and context, writing tests from requirements first and verifying output before it ships. * Make reversible calls yourself; escalate anything that changes what ships or is costly to undo. * Lead small projects with coaching, planning the work, running stand\-ups and keeping stakeholders informed. * Deploy and support what you build, including on\-call and infrastructure changes with guidance, and instrument both system health and customer outcomes. * Contribute ideas that improve how the team works and what it ships. **What you'll bring** * Solid React/Next.js and TypeScript, and customer\-facing features shipped to production. * Working experience building APIs in Python or another backend language. * Accessibility fundamentals, including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, colour contrast and ARIA. * Plans and executes work effectively, balancing speed and quality and adapting when priorities shift. * Designs small, simple, maintainable solutions that avoid common security vulnerabilities. * Contributes to team technical discussions and recognises dependencies in the team's system. * Uses tests, metrics and dashboards to improve quality and reliability. * Deliberately builds understanding of the code you ship, so judgement grows alongside agentic productivity. * Supports peers through review and knowledge sharing, helps align the team around agreed approaches, and shows awareness of others' perspectives. * Own your growth, setting goals, seeking feedback and keeping a record of your impact. **Benefits** At Serko, we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work. This means you’ll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high\-quality and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact. Some of the benefits of working at Serko are: * A competitive base salary * Short Term Incentive Scheme * Focus on development: Access to a learning \& development platform, committed budget and opportunity for you to own your career pathways. * The pay range is between $130,000 \- $160,000 USD as a base salary offering annually.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Graph Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Socure?** --------------- Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **About the Job** ----------------- Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster. As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible. * Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial. * Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real\-time pipelines, low\-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load. * Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics. * Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements. * Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout. * Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations. * Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one. * Your toolkit:Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field * 7\+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent * Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost * Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production * Low\-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter * Graph or entity\-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus * Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability * ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent * Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross\-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority **What This Job is Not** ------------------------ * It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it. * It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed. * It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself. * It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. Areas of work: * **Agent runtime.** Stand up and operate the runtime that hosts agents and MCP servers, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime, together with serverless (Lambda) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. Define how a new agent or MCP server is packaged, deployed, versioned, and retired. * **Infrastructure as code.** Write and maintain the Terraform modules for the runtime, networking, gateways, and supporting services, so that a new environment, AWS account, or region is created from configuration. * **Gateway and access control.** Run the API gateway layer in front of agents and tools. Integrate Entra ID for user authentication, map Entra groups to the agents and tools each user can call, and implement token exchange so an agent calls downstream services with the requesting user’s permissions. * **Identity and secrets.** Design IAM roles and workload identity for agents and MCP servers, manage credentials for Snowflake and internal APIs through AWS Secrets Manager or equivalent, and automate rotation. * **CI/CD and observability.** Build the pipelines that test and deploy agents, MCP servers, and platform components. Instrument agent and tool calls with tracing, logs, and metrics so that latency, error rate, model usage, and cost can be reported per agent and per user group. * **MCP servers and integrations.** Build MCP servers and agent skills that connect agents to Snowflake, internal APIs, and scientific applications. Provide templates, a local development path, and documentation so that other teams can ship their own MCP servers and skills onto the platform without platform changes for each one. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, MCP servers, platform tooling, and CLI utilities. * Write and review Terraform for all platform infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate agent, serverless, and container workloads across AWS accounts and environments. * Maintain the access\-control model for agents and tools and review new integrations for how they handle identity, secrets, and data scope. * Work directly with scientists, application developers, and IT security to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Experience having built and run a shared internal platform used by other engineering teams, including its deployment path, support, and upgrades. * Strong AWS experience with both serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions or similar) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime is strongly preferred. * Strong Terraform experience, including module design and multi\-account deployments. * Experience with API gateways and access control using Entra ID (Azure AD), including OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows. * Experience with cloud identity and secrets management: IAM, workload identity, Secrets Manager or Vault, and credential rotation. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and observability for production services (tracing, structured logging, metrics, alerting). * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade services or tooling. * Experience building LLM agents in production, including tool use, prompt and context design, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool integrations that let LLM agents call internal APIs and data sources. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent) as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock is a plus. * Experience with Snowflake or SQL\-based data access from services is a plus. * Experience in a life sciences, chemistry, or drug discovery environment is a plus. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with engineers, scientists, and IT security. Primary Location: United States (Remote — working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern preferred; West Coast considered) collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. Optional benefits for full time employees include health, dental, and vision insurance, college loan assistance, and an employer matched retirement savings plan. Spectrix is not a placement agency.* *Spectrix is participating in the E\-Verify program of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (phone number: 888\-897\-7781, and website: www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify).* Pay: $48\.00 \- $58\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Are you authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or anytime in the future? * Have you built a shared platform that was utilized by multiple engineering teams that you were responsible for from end to end? * Do you have direct Agentic AI experience developing and managing a large number of users in a cloud\-based environment? * Do you have several years of Python development experience building production\-grade servides or tooling? * Do you have several years of hands\-on experience working with AWS with both serverless and container workloads? * Do you have relevant recent experience with Amazon Bedrock Agent core? * Do you have experience with API gateways and access control Entra ID (AzureAD), Oauth 2\.0, and OIDCflows? Experience: * Python programming: 7 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Manager, Enterprise AI Enablement
jobs.description: **Company Description** As a leader in Medicare health insurance distribution, Spring Venture Group guides people through one of their most important life decisions — finding the right insurance coverage. We are on a mission to be the most trusted partner for our customers and our people, enabling empowered decisions along the journey to health and financial well\-being. Spring Venture Group offers incredible culture, benefits, and fantastic income potential in a stable and successful work environment at a Medicare agency. This starts with a workplace that empowers people to do their best work. Come build a rewarding career and make a meaningful impact on peoples’ lives in an environment that values your determination. Join our diverse, inclusive team and get ready to crush your goals! **Job Description** **OVERVIEW** The Manager, Enterprise AI Enablement owns how business teams put AI to work and plays a critical role in the success of the Enterprise AI Enablement pillar of SVG's AI strategy. The role embeds with business teams, finds expensive or slow work, and turns the best opportunities into AI solutions that stay in use after handoff. The manager carries a problem from the business team through to a working solution. They decide what is worth doing, ship simpler agents, automations, dashboards, and hubs, and partner with engineers in Data and Technology when the work needs production engineering. The role also owns how employees use the enterprise AI platform and sets the standards that let non\-engineers build safely and effectively. **REPORTS TO** The Manager, Enterprise AI Enablement reports to the VP, Product \& Strategic Operations. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * Experience leading technical product, business systems, consulting, or hybrid product and operations work. * Demonstrated ability to redesign business processes and translate them into technical requirements and working solutions. * Hands\-on experience building agents, automations, dashboards, hubs, or prototypes using AI\-assisted development, low\-code, or agentic tools. * Working knowledge of modern LLM ecosystems, APIs, permissions, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake. * Ability to prototype quickly, test assumptions, simplify complex systems, and iterate from feedback. * Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including comfort leading through ambiguity. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** The essential duties for this role include, but are not limited to: *Functional Leadership* * Lead the priorities, operating cadence, and quality of the enterprise AI enablement function. * Keep the function's work on one prioritized portfolio. *Discovery and Prioritization* * Embed with business teams, starting with People, Carrier Relations, Sales Operations, and Strategic Operations. * Identify expensive or slow work, quantify the opportunity, and decide what gets built. * Redesign the workflow before automating it. * Hand each finished workflow to a named business owner and measure the result. *Building and Delivery* * Use AI tools to prototype and ship less\-complex agents, automations, dashboards, and hubs. * Partner with engineering on integrations, monitoring, and higher\-risk work. * Use a fast path for low\-risk work. Route higher\-risk work through Security, Data, Technology, Legal, and Compliance. *Platform and Enablement* * Own how employees use the enterprise AI platform: use cases, rollout, adoption, and value. * Maintain shared context and standards so non\-engineers can build safely. * Coach a small group of departmental builders. * Give leadership a simple view of what is in discovery, in build, launched, or stopped. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** * Business teams get agents, automations, dashboards, and hubs that employees adopt and keep using. AI becomes part of daily work in People, Carrier Relations, Sales Operations, Strategic Operations, and beyond. * Clear, measurable improvements in capacity, speed, quality, and employee experience. * A governance model that allows rapid experimentation on low\-risk work without giving up safety. * Work known for high trust, high output, and technical excellence. **BEHAVIORS** The SVG behaviors are listed below: * Be Aware (Emotional Intelligence) * Be Open \& Honest (Communication) * Be a Team Player (Teamwork and Collaboration) * Be Accomplished (Drive for Results) * Be the Example (Develop Self \& Empower People) * Be Forward Thinking (Strategic Thinking) * Be a Problem Solver (Continuous Improvement) **Qualifications** **Education/Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; or relevant work experience. * 7\+ years in product, business systems, consulting, operations, or a related role, with evidence of shipping a workflow a business owner kept using. **Skills/Specialties:** * *AI,Agentic Systems \& Rapid Prototyping:* Proficiency with AI Code editors and builders alongside automation platforms, hands on familiarity with major foundation models(OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and agent orchestration tools(LandChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or native tool\-calling/function\-calling APIs), experience designing reliable system prompts, implementing RAG, manging context workflow windows, and setting up basic eval loops. * *Data Architecture \& Integrations:* Working knowledge of data warehousing and querying \- specifically Snowflake, SQL, dbt, or similar platforms, ability to read API documentation, handle authentication, understanding Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), data privacy, PII masking, and enterprise security boundaries. * *Business Process \& Systems Architecture:* Ability to audit messy, manual operational workflows, identify bottlenecks, and re\-engineer the process before automating it. Writing clear PRDs, user stories, and system architecture diagrams that bridge non\-technical business pain points with technical execution. * *Leadership \& Organizational Navigation:* Experience with Stakeholder Alignment and Change Management \- driving actual adoption of new internal tools/agents through clear documentation, training, and intuitive UX. **Additional Information** * Competitive compensation Medical, Dental and Vision benefits after a short waiting period * 401k matching program * Generous paid time off program with an additional company break during the holidays * Annual Volunteer Time Off (VTO) and a donation matching program * Life Insurance Employee Assistance Program (health \& well\-being on and off the job) Rewards and Recognition * Maternity and Parental Leave Training program and ongoing support throughout your entire Spring Venture Group career * Diverse, inclusive \& welcoming culture * Optional enrollment options include HSA/FSA, AD\&D, Spousal/Dependent life insurance, Short Term/Long Term Disability, Travel Assist, and Legal plans Spring Venture Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Spring Venture Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, Officer - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description: **About the Role** State Street Investment Management’s Data, Analytics and AI Services team is seeking an AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to build, test, deploy, and measure agentic AI solutions that transform business workflows across the investment management organization. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who takes defined and scoped AI use cases from prototype to production, turning them into reliable, governed, and auditable AI agents that connect to enterprise data and applications. The successful candidate will address data readiness and integration challenges, build rigorous evaluation and auditability into every solution, and ensure deployed agents deliver measurable workflow improvements while meeting the strong governance, risk, and control standards of a regulated financial\-services environment. Working closely with the Senior Principal Architect for Agentic and MLOps Operations, business stakeholders, data and platform teams, and control partners, this role is an opportunity to be a founding member of a growing agentic AI engineering capability. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and deliver production\-grade agentic AI solutions, from prototype through deployment, that automate and enhance business workflows across the investment management organization. * Assess and address data readiness at the outset of each solution: profile, map, and validate source data; resolve quality and access gaps; and build pipelines, APIs, or semantic layers that make existing systems and data consumable by AI agents. * Develop agent logic, including prompts, retrieval, tool/API integrations, and orchestration, connecting agents to enterprise data sources and business applications. * Implement deterministic validation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval steps to ensure AI outputs are accurate and safe for business decisions. * Build end\-to\-end auditability into every solution capturing inputs, data sources, model versions, tool calls, outputs, and human approvals. Produce documentation and evidence for governance, risk, compliance, and audit reviews. * Create test sets and evaluation pipelines to verify accuracy, grounding, reliability, and resilience against edge cases and adversarial inputs such as prompt injection. * Partner with business users during user acceptance testing to validate that solutions deliver the intended workflow improvements, and refine solutions based on feedback. * Deploy, monitor, and maintain solutions via CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code, tracking quality, latency, cost, and business outcome metrics, and troubleshooting, tuning, and upgrading solutions in production. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience building AI/ML or LLM\-based applications (production experience preferred). * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production\-grade APIs, services, and integrations with enterprise systems. * Strong SQL and data engineering skills, including data profiling, quality validation, transformation, and pipeline development across structured and unstructured enterprise data sources. * Hands\-on experience building agentic AI solutions, including LLM tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and multi\-step orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, or similar. * Solid working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly Vertex AI, Gemini models, and BigQuery, along with core GCP compute, storage, networking, and IAM services. * Experience designing LLM evaluation and testing approaches, including test datasets, accuracy and grounding metrics, regression testing, and guardrails against prompt injection and unsafe outputs. * Experience building auditable AI systems, including decision traceability, audit logging, lineage of data and model versions, and records of human approvals. * Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), containerization, observability, and cloud security practices such as identity federation, secrets management, and least\-privilege access. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with business users through acceptance testing and to document solutions for technical, risk, and governance audiences. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Microsoft Azure and Entra ID, and building on Microsoft 365 data (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) via Microsoft Graph or Copilot extensibility. * Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise SaaS and data sources such as Salesforce CRM, Marketo, master data management (MDM), and cloud\-hosted or on\-premises systems, including via Model Context Protocol (MCP) or API enablement of legacy systems; familiarity with TypeScript or Java for building integrations and services. * Experience delivering AI solutions in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with model risk management, Responsible AI, data privacy, and investment management data. **Salary Range:** $70,000 \- $118,750 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. *Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long\-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid\-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance\-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.* *For a full overview, visit* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home* *.* **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. jobs.title: AI Developer (Austin)
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- WHO WE ARE: Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) connects people with careers across the state. While we are based in Austin on the north lawn of the Texas State Capitol, we have offices statewide. We're a Family Friendly Certified Workplace with great work\-life balance, competitive salaries, extensive opportunities for training and development, and fantastic benefits. This position is based at 1411 Brazos Street, Austin in the Information Technology Division. TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H\-1B, F\-1 (OPT/CPT), or H\-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. WHO YOU ARE: A Multi\-Language (Python/Java) Developer: You are a versatile engineer who thrives on using the right tool for the job. You have a strong background in Python for building modern, high\-performance web applications and integrating advanced AI APIs, combined with solid experience in Java to support enterprise\-level systems. A Legacy\-to\-Modern Bridge Builder: You aren't intimidated by legacy infrastructure. You are excited by the challenge of translating, modernizing, and migrating critical state workflows away from legacy mainframes (like COBOL and Natural) and rewriting them into robust, modern Java environments. An AI\-Driven Problem Solver: You are passionate about the intersection of software engineering and Artificial Intelligence. You want to apply your Python skills to design, build, and deploy the next generation of secure, agency\-wide AI utilities (such as high\-capacity transcription engines and division\-specific intelligent agents) that improve public service delivery. A Collaborative Communicator: You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams of developers, database administrators, and business leads. You can talk legacy mainframe logic with senior database engineers, and modern API architecture with AI developers, bringing people and systems together. WHAT YOU WILL DO: The AI Developer (Programmer V\-VI) performs highly advanced to supervisory (senior\-level) computer programming and systems analysis work for TWC. In this role, you will play a key part in connecting the agency’s technical ecosystem by securely integrating new applications with existing vendor solutions, ensuring optimal performance, compliance, security, and scalability. This work is performed under minimal supervision, with opportunities for considerable to extensive latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. You will split your focus between driving modern, Python\-based AI innovations and executing critical legacy system migrations into modern Java architectures. YOU WILL BE TRUSTED TO: * Develop Modern AI Solutions (Python): Partner with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and integrate secure, in\-house AI tools, high\-capacity transcription engines, and custom division\-level agents. * Modernize Legacy Systems (Java): Analyze existing business logic within mainframe systems (Natural/COBOL) and systematically refactor and rewrite those processes into clean, maintainable, and efficient Java code. * Build REST APIs \& Data Pipelines: Build and optimize secure REST APIs, web services, and data pipelines to connect frontend AI applications with core agency databases (such as Oracle and Google BigQuery). * Leverage Enterprise Cloud AI: Learn, utilize, and integrate generative AI SDKs and services from major cloud providers (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud) to build scalable, production\-ready solutions. * Maintain Agency Governance Standards: Ensure all software solutions strictly adhere to TWC policies, data privacy guidelines, accessibility standards (Section 508/Texas EIR), and strict cybersecurity protocols. * Own the SDLC: Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from initial concept and architectural design to deployment, maintenance, and technical documentation. * Provide Technical Direction: Offer guidance, peer reviews, and mentorship to other developers on the team to foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning. * Perform other duties as assigned. YOU QUALIFY WITH: * Programmer V: Five years of full\-time experience in data processing, computer science, computer programming, systems analysis, and/or related field. * Programmer VI: Six years of full\-time experience in data processing, computer science, computer programming, systems analysis, and/or related field. * Relevant academic credits may be applied toward experience qualifications for both of these levels. YOU ARE A GREAT FIT WITH: * Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Core Programming Proficiency: Hands\-on professional experience in both Python and Java. * Database \& Big Data Experience: Familiarity with enterprise cloud data platforms (such as Google BigQuery or AWS Redshift). * Cloud AI Platforms: Familiarity with major enterprise Cloud AI Platforms (such as Google Cloud Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Studio) and experience leveraging managed foundation models. * API Development: Proven experience building, consuming, and securing REST APIs and managing high\-capacity data pipelines. * Prompt Engineering: Proficiency in generative AI prompting, understanding prompt management techniques, and designing prompt templates for improved, consistent model outcomes. * Modern Tooling \& DevOps: Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, Git version control, and standard CI/CD / DevOps practices. * Mission \& Passion: A strong desire to continuously learn about emerging AI/ML technologies and apply them to solve highly complex, real\-world problems in the public sector. * Public Sector Experience: Professional experience working within, or contracting for, local, state, or federal government agencies, with a solid understanding of public sector operational and security standards. YOU GAIN: * A Family Friendly Certified Workplace \- Competitive salary: $8,000 \- $10,000/month (Depending on experience) * Defined Retirement Benefit Plan * Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts * Medical Insurance * Paid time off, including time for vacation, sick and family care leave * Additional benefits for active employees can be found at https://www.ers.texas.gov/Active\-Employees/Health\-Benefits VETERANS: Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser: https://hr.sao.texas.gov/Compensation/MilitaryCrosswalk/MOSC\_InformationTechnology.pdf HOW TO APPLY: To be considered, please complete a State of Texas Application for Employment and apply online at www.workintexas.com or on Taleo (Job Search). TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H\-1B, F\-1 (OPT/CPT), or H\-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. A position utilizing this classification will be designated as security sensitive according to the Texas Labor Code, Section 301\.042\. **Primary Location** -------------------- : United States\-Texas\-Austin**Work Locations** ------------------ : Austin:1411 Brazos 1411 Brazos St Austin 78701**Job** ------- : Computer Programmers**Organization** ---------------- : TWC Business Unit**Schedule** ------------ : Full\-time**Employee Status** ------------------- : Regular**Job Type** ------------ : Standard**Job Level** ------------- : Non\-Management**Travel** ---------- : No**Job Posting** --------------- : Nov 19, 2026, 12:00:00 AM Work From Home: No

jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Sophisticated Work. In a Great City. Making a Difference.** The State of Wisconsin Investment Board (SWIB) manages more than $178 billion in assets, including those of the fully\-funded Wisconsin Retirement System (WRS). SWIB operates at a level more often seen in top\-tier global asset managers than in typical public pension funds. SWIB is a home for top talent. Approximately 61 percent of SWIB’s investment professionals are Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) charterholders. The City of Madison, the state capitol and home of Wisconsin’s flagship university, makes regular appearances on lists of best places to live, eat, and play. SWIB offers a modern workspace, hybrid work options, and competitive compensation and benefits. Serving over 703,000 WRS beneficiaries, SWIB is driven by a clear mission: securing the financial future of those who serve Wisconsin. When you work at SWIB, you know your work matters. **Job Description:** **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled AI Enablement Engineer to join our team. The engineer will play a key role in advancing SWIB’s adoption of artificial intelligence by partnering with investment and operational teams to identify, develop, and deploy innovative AI solutions that improve business processes, increase efficiency, and enhance decision\-making. The engineer will report to the Data Services and Engineering Director and work directly with teams throughout the organization to translate complex business needs into prototypes, AI\-powered workflows, and production\-ready solutions. This role requires strong software engineering and data integration capabilities, hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies, and the ability to balance innovation with enterprise security, architecture, and governance standards. **Essential activities:** * Partner directly with front\-office and operations teams to identify AI opportunities, understand business processes, gather requirements, and deliver solutions aligned with investment and operational priorities. * Design, prototype, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications, assistants, and agentic workflows using platforms such as OpenAI Agent Workspace, Claude Cowork, and other emerging enterprise AI technologies. * Design, develop, and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) solutions that securely connect AI capabilities with enterprise data, applications, APIs, and business processes. * Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, frameworks, and integrations that accelerate solution delivery, promote consistency, and enable adoption across the organization. * Leverage programming languages such as Python and SQL to build AI applications, automate workflows, integrate enterprise data, and extend the capabilities of AI platforms. * Develop and implement AI evaluation, testing, observability, and monitoring capabilities to ensure solution accuracy, reliability, performance, and ongoing effectiveness. * Establish appropriate security controls, access management, human oversight, and risk mitigation practices for AI\-enabled solutions in alignment with enterprise architecture and governance standards. * Evaluate emerging AI platforms, models, tools, and capabilities. Conduct proofs of concept, assess technical feasibility, and recommend solutions based on business value, scalability, security, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges involving AI applications, model behavior, data integration, API connectivity, and workflow execution. * Promote responsible AI adoption by providing technical guidance, training, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer to business and technology teams. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of AI solutions, technical designs, integrations, evaluation results, operational procedures, and supporting architecture. * Support automated testing, version control, deployment, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices to improve the reliability and maintainability of AI solutions. Collaborate with technology, architecture, information security, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions comply with organizational standards and approved implementation practices. * **The ideal candidate:** * Demonstrates a proactive, innovative, and business\-focused approach to identifying opportunities where AI can deliver measurable value. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. * 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, application development, or related technical disciplines. * Hands\-on experience developing solutions using generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI\-enabled workflow automation. * Experience with enterprise AI platforms and tools such as OpenAI Agent Workspace, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Enterprise, or comparable technologies. * Experience developing and integrating solutions using Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs, and enterprise data services. * Strong programming experience with Python, SQL, and API\-based application development. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus. * Experience designing and implementing AI solutions using techniques such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration. * Experience implementing AI evaluation frameworks, automated testing, observability, and monitoring to assess model outputs, solution quality, and operational reliability. * Strong understanding of AI security, data privacy, access controls, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and responsible AI development practices. * Experience integrating applications with enterprise data platforms, databases, and cloud\-based services. * Experience developing, deploying, and supporting production applications using cloud providers such as Azure. * Experience with software development lifecycle principles, version control, CI/CD, and production support practices. * Ability to independently evaluate emerging technologies, rapidly develop prototypes, and transition successful solutions into maintainable production capabilities. * Ability to work directly with business stakeholders, understand complex workflows, and identify practical opportunities for AI\-driven improvements. * General knowledge of and interest in the investment industry. * Direct experience in financial services, investment management, or asset management is a plus. Experience with Snowflake, Azure AI services, and enterprise AI governance frameworks is a plus. * SWIB Offers: * Competitive total cash compensation, based on AON (formerly McLagan) industry benchmarks * Comprehensive benefits package * Educational and training opportunities * Tuition reimbursement * Challenging work in a professional environment Hybrid work environment * The position requires U.S. work authorization. Pursuant to our Hybrid Remote Work Policy, all staff have the flexibility to work remotely but are required to have a weekly presence in our offices, the frequency of which is dependent on their distance from office or the job position. Staff are not required to reside locally; however, we offer relocation reimbursement to the Dane County area per our policy. All SWIB employees are subject to SWIB’s Ethics Policy and Personal Trade Approvals Policy. These policies include restrictions on outside business activities and employment and have limits on personal trading. You may request copies of these policies from SWIB’s talent acquisition team and any questions can be answered by SWIB’s compliance team.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: The name Sotera Health was inspired by Soteria, the Greek goddess of safety, and reflects the Company’s unwavering commitment to its mission, Safeguarding Global Health®. Sotera Health Company is a leading global provider of mission\-critical sterilization and lab testing and advisory services for the healthcare industry. With a combined tenure across our businesses of nearly 200 years and our industry recognized scientific and technological expertise, we help to ensure the safety of millions of patients and healthcare practitioners around the world every year. Across our 64 facilities worldwide, we have over 3,000 employees who are dedicated to safety and quality. We are a trusted partner to more than 5,800 customers in over 50 countries, including more than 40 of the top 50 medical device companies and 9 of the top 10 pharmaceutical companies. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Maintenance Engineer is a “hands on” position that supports local Maintenance and Operations and will lead small growth and maintenance engineering projects for assigned facilities of Sterigenics in support of the business unit’s strategic plan. Responsibilities will be on the Ethylene Oxide (EO) sterilization plants. Routine support of approximately two EO plants will be required on an as needed basis. This role is responsible for asset reliability and life cycle management. This position provides a unique opportunity to directly execute, and project manage maintenance\-type projects or support other assigned project managers in their remote coordination of activities. With Equipment Reliability as a strategic priority, a strong interest and involvement with plant maintenance initiatives and projects will be key. A solid engineering education with mechanical and electrical experience will be fundamental requirements. Familiarity with Building and NFPA codes is considered highly beneficial as is a business insight. Experience and general knowledge of control system architecture, functionality and operations is considered desirable. The Maintenance Engineer will be expected to autonomously execute on responsibilities with course directions set by the Director of Engineering. The Maintenance Engineer will liaise regularly with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, EHS, OpEx, Purchasing, Legal and Finance as required. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Identify and correct any unsafe work conditions or practices * Reviews and documents processing equipment standards, control systems, support equipment and utilities * Responsible for establishing facility equipment lifecycle management strategies, maintenance CAPEX plans, asset reliability initiatives, work management processes, and critical spare parts programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize total cost of ownership * Execute delivery for small complexity projects (maintenance, continuous improvement) * Ensure good maintenance practices at the facilities by conducting assessments of equipment, machinery and building to ensure they are in good state of operation. This involves routine inspections to detect problems or identify potential problems * Responding to assistance requests from facilities by developing a plan for repairs with an estimated cost. This may include a change in design or in specifications of a system or subcomponents of a system. * Provide troubleshooting assistance for facility equipment and lead RCA process for equipment related breakdowns or quality concerns. * Ensure safety and compliance requirements and expectations are met for facility, equipment, and emission control systems. * Evaluate and monitor status of critical facility equipment performance (e.g., emission controls, sterilizers, and support equipment); provide recommendations for corrective/preventative actions using statistical analysis tools * Lead site Maintenance/Engineering shutdowns. * Participate in relevant internal and external audits and assessments. * Ensure proper use of our Change Control process. * Strong technical writing skills to develop applicable test documentation to support projects; for example, Installation/Operational Qualifications; Test Plans; Functional Specifications; User Requirements. * Ability to perform design review of 3rd party technical designs. * Represent Global Engineering, drive continuous improvement, support technical training of site staff. * Improve overall knowledge and expertise on facility, equipment, and systems to ensure overall business progression and success. * Work order management o Partner with site maintenance team to develop, prioritize, and optimize preventive, predictive and corrective work orders within EAM o Support facilities in establishing maintenance plans, job procedures, and work execution standards that improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime * Spare Parts and Asset Management o Develop and maintain critical spare parts strategies for key production, utility, emission control, and support equipment o Collaborate with Maintenance, Operations, and Procurement teams to optimize spare parts inventory levels, inventory accuracy, and stocking policies while minimizing operational risk o Utilize reliability and failure data to support spare parts forecasting, inventory planning, and asset replacement strategies * Maintain 24\-hour on\-call status for remote support. **Experience and Skills Required** Bachelor of Science in Engineering degree. Major in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering preferred. Minimum five (5\) years of relevant experience required. * Experience working in a process environment with in\-depth, hands\-on involvement. * Comfort in executing responsibilities within a highly matrixed organization. * Proven record of supporting field activities. * Ability to develop scope, schedule, budget and appropriately manage priorities. * Experience utilizing CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Systems) or EAM (Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) platforms such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo, Oracle, Infor EAM, or equivalent. * Knowledge of maintenance planning and scheduling practices, work management processes, spare parts optimization, and reliability\-centered maintenance methodologies. * Familiarity with asset criticality assessments, failure analysis, inventory management, and lifecycle cost analysis. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Experience in a regulated industry is a strong plus. * CMRP (Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional) certification is a plus. Working Conditions * Will work in the processing facility with a balance between field and office * Travel requirements of up to 40% within geographical region. * Must be medically approved to wear a respirator; must be able to tolerate exposure to high temperatures and high humidity (120F and 60% RH for 20 minutes) * Maintain 24\-hour on\-call status for remote support. **Pay \& Benefits** Pay: $106,000 to $171,500 annually, based on experience, qualifications, and skills. Sotera Health offers a competitive benefits package that includes: * Medical, Rx, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life Insurance, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts * 401(k) program with Company match that immediately vests * Paid holidays, vacation and sick time * Free financial planning assistance * Paid parental leave * Education assistance * Voluntary benefits including Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity and Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or protected veteran status. Sterigenics U.S. LLC takes affirmative action in support of its policy to employ and advance in employment individuals who are minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. We strongly encourage those from underrepresented groups to apply. VEVRAA Federal Contractor Sotera Health goes to market through its three best\-in\-class businesses – Sterigenics®, Nordion® and Nelson Labs®. Sterigenics is a leading global provider of outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and advanced applications markets. Nordion is the leading global provider of Co\-60 and gamma irradiators, which are key components to the gamma sterilization process. Nelson Labs is a global leader in outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries.

You will take on the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure software while balancing the need to maintain and scale existing systems with the need to deliver new capabilities for patients, clinicians, and partners. Your impact will extend well beyond the systems you build yourself. You will help teams make sound architectural decisions, establish reusable patterns and standards, address systemic technical risk, and mentor engineers across multiple teams, raising the bar on design, implementation quality, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering. **The Day to Day** * Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for one or more critical domains within Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's products and healthcare operations. * Partner with Product, Clinical, Data, Security, and Operations leaders to make sure we solve the right problems in the right order, with clear outcomes and measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%** Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **GROW WITH US:** Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no\-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry. **STAY AWESOME:** Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control\-IQ\+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human\-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com **A DAY IN THE LIFE:** A team member contributing to the design, troubleshooting, documentation, testing and debugging of software for the Company’s medical devices.**Embedded Software Engineer I's are also responsible for:** * Develops, modifies, and tests software units per corporate software process documents. * Contributes to software design specifications, interface descriptions, and other software documentations; may act as documentation owner for limited scope projects. * Contributes to software validation (write, dry run \& review) \& verification protocols. * In coordination with the Software Test team, participates in formal test execution. * Assists with developing unit tests. * Embraces the Design Control process by participating in design reviews and maintaining design history files. * Supports software testing with utility software or special purpose embedded software. * May lead projects of limited scope. * Assists with training of new team members. * Manages source code effectively using Source Code Management (SCM) tools, processes, and procedures. * Assists product development engineers in the diagnosis and replication of build and deployment issues. * Researches new technologies as needed. * Attends and may coordinate documentation for the Software Review Board (SRB). * Assists in analyzing returned products to determine root cause of failure. * Collects process metrics and lessons learned, reviews, and evaluates processes and work products and recommends improvements as appropriate. * Confirms completion of required training plan before assuming job responsibilities. * Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements. * Other responsibilities as assigned. **WHEN \& WHERE YOU’LL WORK:** **Remote:** This position is **primarily remote** and is open to candidates throughout the **United States**, with a preference for those located in **San Diego, California**. Equipment for the role will be provided, and training will be conducted remotely. **Schedule:** This position will work **Monday \- Friday** from **8:00 AM \- 5:00 PM** **PST**. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED:** **1\. Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** * Able to effectively convey information related to work product in one\-on\-one conversation or in a group. * Able to work effectively in a team environment. * Able to alter behavior and opinions in light of new information. * Able to assert own ideas and persuade others through effectively consolidating, evaluating, and presenting relevant information. * Experienced with MS Office. * Some knowledge of Good Documentation Practices (GDP) preferred. * Exposure to formal software test methodologies preferred. **2\. Minimum Certifications/Educational level:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Sciences or related field or equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience. * **For** **Embedded Software Engineers****:** experience in the “C” programming language preferred. **3\. Minimum Experience:** * Six months experience in the field of **embedded** software for medical devices or in a related area. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** The base hourly range for this position is between **$39\.23 \- $49\.09\.** Base pay will vary based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes incentive compensation, equity, and a robust benefits package. Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1\) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here! **YOU SHOULD KNOW:** Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre\-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders. **SPONSORSHIP:** Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:** At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well\-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers. **BE YOU, WITH US!** We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us. Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation.
