If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share! **APPLICATION DEADLINE:** The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications. Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow. \#LI\-HJ1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering - Infrastructure
jobs.description: We believe that difference sparks brilliance, so we welcome people and ideas from everywhere to join us in stretching what’s possible. At Tapestry, being true to yourself is core to who we are. When each of us brings our individuality to our collective ambition, our creativity is unleashed. This global house of brands – Coach and Kate Spade New York – was built by unconventional entrepreneurs and unexpected solutions, so when we say we believe in dreams, we mean we believe in making them happen. We’re always on a journey to becoming our best, but you can count on this: Here, your voice is valued, your ambitions are supported, and your work is recognized. A member of the Tapestry family, we are part of a global house of brands that has unwavering optimism and is committed to being innovative and wholly inclusive. Visit Our People page to learn more about Tapestry's commitment to equity, inclusion, and diversity. **Sr. Manager, Software Engineering – Infrastructure** *Infrastructure Automation \& AI Platforms* Do you want to change how infrastructure work gets done, not just automate more of it? We’re looking for a senior engineering leader to shape and deliver Tapestry’s infrastructure automation and AI roadmap, and to build a federated automation platform that lets domain teams across IT automate their own work using shared standards, reusable components and governance. This is a global role, spanning North America, Europe and Asia. You’ll be the engineering and portfolio lead for Infrastructure Automation and AI, partnering with the Director of Cloud Infrastructure across every infrastructure area: monitoring, FinOps, databases, file transfer and scheduling, datacenters, storage, disaster recovery, virtualization, virtual desktops and servers. Your job is to find the manual work, decide what to standardize and automate first, and lead delivery across internal teams, managed service providers and strategic partners to measurable results. At Tapestry, we have the freedom to express ourselves and run with our best ideas. Every individual in our global house has the opportunity to make an impact, learn and be part of our growing and unique story. As Sr. Manager, Software Engineering – Infrastructure, you will: **Own the roadmap and the results** * Shape the multi\-year infrastructure automation and AI strategy with the Director, and turn it into a written quarterly roadmap with sequenced milestones, dependencies, risks and a clear platform vision that ties individual projects together * Keep the roadmap current as a living document, commit to delivery dates, and report progress against them honestly * Raise risks and slippage early, with data, options and a recommended path, rather than at the deadline * Evaluate alternative approaches before committing, and bring formal proposals (objectives, design, approach, success criteria) for new initiatives and proofs of concept * Run the operating rhythm for the portfolio: intake, prioritization, status, value tracking and metrics * Drive common automation standards globally across North America, Europe and Asia, while allowing for regional requirements such as local regulations, data residency and support models **Transform processes across the organization** * Work across all infrastructure areas to map current processes, find the highest\-value opportunities, and prioritize by measurable outcomes such as hours returned, incidents avoided and risk reduced * Standardize before automating: lead as\-is and to\-be process mapping with domain owners so automation encodes a clean process, not a messy one * Establish and maintain a single, version\-controlled repository of process diagrams and automation designs that serves as the team’s source of truth * Target recurring operational work that crosses team boundaries and has no single owner, and drive permanent fixes **Build a federated automation platform** * Build and run a federated automation model in which domain teams build, test and ship their own automations on a shared platform of standards, reusable components, guardrails, a catalog and CI/CD pipelines, instead of queuing for a central team * Treat the platform as a product: define its users, measure adoption, and improve it based on feedback * Define the governance for federated automation, including ownership, review and approval paths, and set and enforce engineering standards for every automation: version control, peer review, automated and end\-to\-end testing before go\-live, monitoring after go\-live, and built\-in ITSM integration (incident and change records) * Own the reliability, security and lifecycle of the automation platform itself, including high availability, patching, secrets management and upgrades * Grow automation capability across teams through training, documentation, office hours and champions in each domain **Lead the move to AI and agentic automation** * Define and deliver the strategy for AI\-assisted and agentic automation in infrastru ends to be seen as original and value\-added in brainstorming settings. **Customer Focus** : Is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; gets first\-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services; acts with customers in mind; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect. **Dealing with Ambiguity** : Can effectively cope with change; can shift gears comfortably; can decide and act without having the total picture; isn’t upset when things are up in the air; doesn’t have to finish things before moving on; can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty. **Drive for Results** : Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom\-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results. **Interpersonal Savvy** : Relates well to all kinds of people, up, down, and sideways, inside and outside the organization; builds appropriate rapport; builds constructive and effective relationships; uses diplomacy and tact; can diffuse even high\-tension situations comfortably. **Learning on the Fly** : Learns quickly when facing new problems; a relentless and versatile learner; open to change; analyzes both successes and failures for clues to improvement; experiments and will try anything to find solutions; enjoys the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; quickly grasps the essence and the underlying structure of anything. **Our Competencies for All People Managers** **Strategic Agility** : Sees ahead clearly; can anticipate future consequences and trends accurately; has broad knowledge and perspective; is future oriented; can articulately paint credible pictures and visions of possibilities and likelihoods; can create competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans. **Developing Direct Reports and Others** : Provides challenging and stretching tasks and assignments; holds frequent development discussions; is aware of each person's career goals; constructs compelling development plans and executes them; pushes people to accept developmental moves; will take on those who need help and further development; cooperates with the developmental system in the organization; is a people builder. **Building Effective Teams** : Blends people into teams when needed; creates strong morale and spirit in their team; shares wins and successes; fosters open dialogue; lets people finish and be responsible for their work; defines success in terms of the whole team; creates a feeling of belonging in the team. Tapestry, Inc. is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and we pride ourselves on hiring and developing the best people. All employment decisions (including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, transfer, training, discipline and termination) are based on the applicant’s or employee’s qualifications as they relate to the requirements of the position under consideration. These decisions are made without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic characteristics, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, alienage, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally\-recognized protected basis prohibited by applicable law. **Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)** Tapestry, Inc. will provide applicants and employees with reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact Tapestry People Services at 1\-855\-566\-9264\. Visit Tapestry, Inc . **Base Pay Range** $155,000\.00\-$170,000\.00 Here are some of the benefits that we offer: Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, 401 (K), Paid Paternity and Maternity leave, Commuter Benefits, Disability insurance and Tuition assistance. Please click here for a complete list of U.S Corporate Compensation \& Benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. **About the Role** ================== Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. **Your Area of Focus** ====================== * **Data Modeling \& Shared Datasets:** Design, build, and maintain enterprise\-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. * **Metric Definition \& Semantic Layer:** Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. * **Self\-Service Enablement:** Build easy\-to\-use datasets that let non\-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. * **Platform Migration:** Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. * **Data Quality \& Testing:** Build automated tests and pull\-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. * **Performance \& Efficiency:** Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. * **Forecasting \& Machine Learning:** Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. * **Code Review \& Mentorship:** Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. * **Governance \& Documentation:** Follow data\-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. **Your Professional Qualifications** ==================================== * **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2\+ years hands\-on in dbt in production. * **SQL Fluency:** Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. * **Data Modeling:** Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. * **Tech Stack:** Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. * **Business Partnership:** Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. * **Software Mindset:** Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. * **Communication:** Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. * **Growth Mindset:** Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Semantic Layer:** Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. * **Domain Knowledge:** Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. * **Forecasting \& ML:** Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. * **Healthcare:** Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. * **Additional Tools:** Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. * **Certifications:** dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. **\#LI\-SS1 \#LI\-Remote** **About Tebra** =============== Tebra is the only all\-in\-one EHR\+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com. **Our Values** ============== **Start with the Customer** --------------------------- We get to know our customers \- and their patients \- and look at the world through their lens. **Keep It Simple** ------------------ Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. **Stay Entrepreneurial** ------------------------ We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. **Better Together** ------------------- We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. **Celebrate Success** --------------------- Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. **Perks \& Benefits** ===================== United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Costa Rica: To assist with all of life's needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. **Compliance \& Privacy Disclosures** ===================================== *NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.* *California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California\-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here:* *https://www.tebra.com/privacy\-policy/california\-supplemental\-notice/* *If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at* *talentacquisition@tebra.com* *and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.* *As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded.*

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Techniplas is a global supplier of sophisticated plastic components and design\-focused, multifunctional surfaces that are primarily for the automotive sector, as well as the industrial, consumer goods, medical and other markets. The company’s products follow industry trends like weight reduction and vehicle electrification, innovative operating concepts, high\-quality surface finishes, and an increasing focus on convenience and safety. The Techniplas Group runs 30 sites worldwide with production, sales and / or technology hubs and employs just under 4,000 members of staff. The company serves customers and platforms around the world, focusing on technological expertise and collaboration with customers in the fields of design and engineering. Techniplas has long\-term relationships with many of the world’s leading automotive and industrial OEMs. **SUMMARY OF POSITION:** We have an immediate opening for an experienced Quality Engineer committed to customer satisfaction. Reporting directly to the Quality Manager, you are an integral part of the team responsible for implementation and ongoing support of our quality systems. As a Tier 1 automotive supplier, compliance to the ISO 9001/TS 16949 and IATF 16949 Quality Standards is number one priority. The successful candidate is a problem\-solver who will work directly with our customers to resolve production quality issues. **JOB DUTIES \& ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Develops and maintains quality standards and quality procedures to satisfy company/customer requirements. * Responsible for the corrective action system and the development of corrective actions using 8\-D, 5 Why, and other problem\-solving tools, as well as providing timely response to internal and external customers. * Serves as the main contact with customers regarding quality\-related activities and issues. * Responsible for the preparation and accuracy of PPAP submissions to customers. * Participates in ISO / TS 16949 and IATF 16949 Internal and External audits. * Facilitates continual improvement activities. * Facilitates the development of control plans and ongoing updates as required. * Assists in the development and maintenance of PFMEA’s and process flow diagrams. * Supports Supplier Evaluation and Development activities as required. * Works in conjunction with project engineers on new project development, assisting in the following areas in accordance with ISO guidelines. * Develops new Inspection Instructions and methods of measurement for new jobs. * Performs statistical capability studies and develops statistical monitoring as required. * Evaluates process robustness. * Employs GD\&T techniques. * Establishes gauging requirements. * Attends new project review meetings as needed. * Performs general Quality Planning according to procedures. * Assists with pre\-production meetings, communicating quality related issues to production employees. * Provides recommendations for the disposition of nonconforming material. * Provides general support of the entire Quality System according to established standards and customer \& regulatory requirements. * Reports and analyzes company quality metrics and supports efforts to improve quality performance throughout the organization. * This list of duties and responsibilities is not all inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time. **QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, \& ABILITIES):** * Bachelor's degree and minimum of 3 years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment is required, or equivalent combination of education and/or experience. * Experience in the automotive industry strongly desired. * Participation in the implementation or maintenance of an ISO 9001:2000 or Quality System strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of ISO/TS 16949 quality standards helpful. * Plastics industry experience a plus. * Previous job experience working directly with customers on quality\-related issues. * Excellent communication, organizational, problem\-solving and follow\-up skills. * Strong attention to details. * Ability to work effectively as a team player in a diverse work group. * Proficient with computer systems including MS Office.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, IAM
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Temporal is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for Identity to help design, build, and operate the identity and access systems behind Temporal — a multi\-tenant SaaS platform. You'll work on the systems that authenticate users and workloads, authorize access to namespaces and APIs, and integrate with customer identity providers. You'll partner with Security, Product, and infrastructure teams to deliver "secure by default" capabilities while keeping the developer and operator experience strong. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and improve core parts of Temporal’s identity platform — authentication (OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, SAML), authorization (RBAC and policy\-based access), and workload identity — so customers and workloads can authenticate securely * Help keep the auth path fast and reliable to meet Temporal’s SLOs through caching, token handling, and revocation strategies * Integrate with enterprise identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace) and support user provisioning (SCIM), with attention to common identity threats such as token replay and privilege escalation * Partner with Security, Product, and platform teams to ship secure\-by\-default patterns and contribute to IAM lifecycle and audit practices * Write clear architecture and design docs, and contribute to the team's technical direction **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Solid hands\-on experience building and operating production identity or auth systems — OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, SAML, JWT, and token/key rotation * Good understanding of authorization models (RBAC, ABAC); familiarity with policy engines like OPA, Cedar, or OpenFGA is a plus * Experience operating distributed systems in production, including some on\-call responsibility * Proficiency in Go; experience with Python, Java, or Rust is a plus * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across security, product, and engineering teams **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Exposure to workload identity or short\-lived / federated credentials (SPIFFE/SPIRE, mTLS, WIF) * Experience with SCIM provisioning and enterprise SSO integrations * Contributions to identity OSS projects (Keycloak, Ory, Dex, OpenFGA, SPIRE) * Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) as they apply to IAM * Familiarity with Temporal or other durable\-execution engines, especially auth implications around workers and task queues * Experience designing customer\-facing API auth (scoped tokens, API keys, rotation) Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist. Compensation Range: $140\.8K \- $231K

jobs.title: Data Solution Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary****:** Tenaska is seeking a Data Solution Engineer to help transform our enterprise data management model from a traditional, manual approach into a modern, automated operating model powered by engineering practices and artificial intelligence. This role will sit at the intersection of data engineering and agentic automation. The ideal candidate will build intelligent solutions that range from data processing and management operations to agentic cataloging and quality assurance processes enabling teams across the organization to confidently leverage trusted data. The Data Solution Engineer will play a key role in designing, implementing and maintaining automated data operation frameworks and partnering with technical and business stakeholders to create and maintain a scalable, enterprise data ecosystem. **Essential Job Functions:** **Automate Data Governance Processes** * Develop AI agents and workflow automation solutions using AI coding tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and enterprise data sources. * Design and implement automated governance controls directly within data pipelines and platforms to ensure trusted, compliant, and high\-quality data reaches enterprise users and AI systems. * Develop Policy\-as\-a\-code functions using modern engineering practices, including version control, testing, and deployment processes. **Advance Metadata Management \& Data Discovery** * Build and maintain automated metadata management frameworks to improve data cataloging, lineage visibility and data product management. * Implement and enhance enterprise data catalog capabilities through active metadata management and automated discovery frameworks. **Improve Data Quality \& Reliability** * Build and jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Marketplace Quality Engineering
jobs.description: The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world's leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world's brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly. The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you're driven to solve meaningful challenges, we'd love to meet you. The Team: Marketplace Quality Engineering: Every second, our bidder evaluates millions of ad opportunities across thousands of publishers and supply paths. Not all of that supply is created equal — some of it is duplicated, some is structurally inaccessible, and some degrades advertiser outcomes. The Marketplace Quality Engineering team exists to make sure our platform is buying the right impressions, not just more impressions. We own the systems that assess, measure, and optimize supply quality across the programmatic ecosystem. Our work spans deduplication, supply path analysis, quality modeling, and the tooling that turns those signals into decisions at bid time. The problems are technically deep — think identity resolution across fragmented supply chains, statistical modeling to separate signal from noise, and real\-time decisioning at platform scale — and they have direct, measurable impact on both advertiser outcomes and platform economics. This is not theoretical work. When we ship a model update, spend distribution across the platform shifts. Our engineering decisions translate directly into tens of millions of dollars of measurable business impact. If you want to build systems where what you ship visibly matters, this is the team. You will work with C\# / .NET as a core strength, alongside Python and SQL where data and automation need it, and partner closely with product, data, and platform teams across time zones. Who you are: Our culture runs deeper than having fun together (though we do that well, too). We take pride in our engineers being trust\-builders, generous givers, scrappy problem solvers, and gritty pursuers of excellence. You do not need to meet every requirement below, but people who meet most of them tend to thrive in this role: * You are comfortable working on an agile, distributed team across time zones and continents. * You communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * You have a solid grasp of computer science and engineering fundamentals. * You have strong experience with distributed systems and data\-heavy backend work (services, pipelines, or both). * You are proficient in C\# / .NET. * You are productive with modern development tools: Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Rider, and Git. * You bring 7\+ years of software development or engineering experience. Nice to have (not required): GraphQL or REST API design, large\-scale data processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Spark), workflow orchestration tools (e.g. Apache Airflow), schema\-based data serialization, Kubernetes, Kafka, database engines (Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Aerospike, Vertica, Redis), microservices, Python for data work or automation, and experience working across large codebases with multiple teams. A wide range of technical opportunities is one of the best parts of engineering at The Trade Desk, which is why we do not expect you to know every technology we use on day one. What matters is that you learn quickly and solve complex problems with the right tools. What you know today matters less than how well you learn, adapt, and innovate. We are not looking for people who already have all the answers — we want engineers who can invent answers no one has thought of yet and frame the questions we have not yet asked. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. Please reach out to us at accommodations@thetradedesk.com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process. When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

jobs.description: **Job Description** Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary\-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open\-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject\-matter\-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest\-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1\.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release. The research team trains and evaluates the Thomson models to perform at a frontier level for professional workflows. We work with a range of large open\-weight models and use continual learning to improve them comprehensively, rather than pre\-training from scratch or doing narrow fine\-tuning. The training pipeline includes value alignment, data\-centric mid\-training on curated proprietary data, DPO, and reinforcement learning (RL) for product\-ready tasks. The evaluation group builds the measurement side: expert\-annotated legal and tax benchmarks, agentic systems, and human preference studies with subject\-matter experts. We regularly publish work that comes out of our training and evaluation efforts. We are hiring scientists at Senior and Lead level across three areas of emphasis. In your application, please tell us which one or two fit you best: * **Agentic reinforcement learning:** post\-training for agentic behaviour (planning, long\-context reasoning, tool calls, long\-horizon tasks inside real agent harnesses), multi\-turn RL and policy optimisation, reward modelling and training\-signal design. * **Model training:** continued pre\-training and post\-training of open\-weight models, DPO and RL, training data and reward design, forgetting and replay in continued pre\-training. * **Model evaluation:** benchmarks and targeted evaluations for complex legal and professional workflows, LLM\-as\-a\-judge and rubric design, human preference studies with legal experts, and evaluation results that inform training objectives. **Key Responsibilities** * Design new benchmarks, training datasets, rewards and training signals to improve the Thomson model family, including for tasks where ground truth is scarce, delayed or partly subjective. * Design rigorous experiments and diagnostics (for example ablations) that separate algorithmic effects from data, reward and system artefacts, and carry results into production models. * Build and extend the evaluation suite to understand Thomson's strengths and weaknesses, and use the results to inform training objectives and technical trade\-offs. * Work hand in hand with Research Engineers on our large\-scale training and evaluation infrastructure, and with subject\-matter experts in law, tax and other professional domains. * Coordinate with product teams and other model consumers to understand adoption requirements and drive integration. * Publish regularly at top\-tier ML and NLP venues and represent Thomson Reuters Labs in the research community. At Lead level: own a research agenda, turn emerging methods into a roadmap for our models, and mentor scientists and engineers. * **Required Qualifications** * PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Hands\-on LLM post\-training and/or evaluation experience, preferably at frontier model development scale, using Python and PyTorch. * A track record of research impact you can point to: publications at top\-tier venues (for example NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM) and/or work that shaped an LLM development cycle. * Experience working closely with researchers and cross\-functional stakeholders, including subject\-matter experts, to turn ideas into practical training or evaluation assets. * Excellent written and oral communication, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment. For Lead level: 3\+ years of research experience after the PhD, a record of leading a research agenda to published or deployed results, and of mentoring or supervising researchers. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with RL post\-training frameworks (NeMo\-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL) or evaluation frameworks (Inspect, lm\-evaluation\-harness). * Experience designing LLM\-as\-a\-judge or rubric\-based reward and evaluation pipelines and measuring their reliability. * Experience with Mixture\-of\-Experts or long\-context models. * Experience with law, tax or other professional, non\-verifiable domains, particularly grounding and citation. * Experience in experimental design and best practices for working with human data. Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale. * Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit! \#LI\-MW1 This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization. **What’s in it For You?** *  ole. jobs.description: **TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a full\-time Software Engineer I, SQL Development to join our team in Nashville, Tennessee.** **Summary:** This position is responsible for setting up, managing, and optimizing databases in support of enterprise and external web applications. creating database backup jobs/solutions, * Analysis of business and technical requirements to develop and enhance complex code. ##### **Desired Skills and Experience:** * Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to a constantly changing environment, * Reviewing SQL Code, recommending suggestions for system performance, * Knowledge of table partitioning, execution plans, running profilers, error handling, using DevOps, Azure, and Red Gate, * Publishing ER diagrams, data dictionaries, and system documentation, * Microsoft certification (related to databases). **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods of time. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Traversal** Traversal is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise. Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI\-generated code is accelerating that gap. Traversal is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high\-impact work. Today, Traversal operates in mission\-critical environments at some of the world’s largest enterprises, including PepsiCo, Nubank, Harvey, and DigitalOcean. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we’ve brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world\-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Traversal is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint Ventures, and Khosla Ventures. ### **The Role** The Traversal AI SRE agent's performance and accuracy are hugely dependent on the data it reasons over. When Traversal investigates a production incident at a Fortune 100 company, we rely on having the right data, in the right shape, in the right place, and at the right time, to deliver the best and fastest outcomes to our customers. This is the crucially important role of Traversal's Production World Model and petabyte\-scale data platform: hundreds of billions of log lines a day from a single customer, ingested at hundreds of megabytes per second, and queryable by the agent within minutes of being emitted. We're hiring a Principal Engineer, Data Platform, to own the technical direction of that platform. You'll define how data enters Traversal, how it's stored and queried, and how it's transformed into the derived products our agents and researchers rely on — across SaaS and BYOC deployments in some of the most demanding enterprise environments in the world. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you'll shape roadmaps and write the design docs that set the direction, write the code that proves it out, and raise the bar for the engineers who build alongside you. This is also a rare seat where data infrastructure meets frontier AI. The agent is the platform's most demanding customer, and AI Research is its closest partner. You'll see firsthand how an AI agent reasons over production data, and your decisions will directly shape how well it does. At our stage, a Principal Engineer doesn't work from a ticket queue. You'll work directly with leadership on what we build and why, sit in front of our largest customers, and learn how an enterprise AI company is built from the inside. ### **What You'll Do** * **Own the data platform architecture.** Define the long\-term architecture across our four data paths — direct push ingestion, scheduled pulls from third\-party observability platforms, non\-telemetry data, and transformation pipelines — including the interfaces, invariants, and evolution path that let them scale together. * **Set the storage and query strategy.** Decide what our storage layer looks like at 10–100x today's scale: time\-series, columnar/OLAP, and lakehouse tradeoffs; retention and cost; performance commitments for the agent's key queries. * **Serve the agent as a first\-class workload.** An AI agent is the platform's most demanding consumer. Design the query interfaces it depends on: performance commitments for its key tool queries, freshness guarantees for the data it reasons over, and safe sandboxing for the ad\-hoc queries an LLM will inevitably write. * **Build the data foundation for AI research.** Work side by side with our AI Research team to give the agent and its auto\-research loops the data they need: investigation history, evaluation datasets, and the derived signals that make the agent measurably better. You'll learn how a production AI agent is built, evaluated and improved, and you'll see your data decisions show up in its accuracy. * **Shape the company, not just the platform.** Work directly with engineering and company leadership on the technical roadmap and how it serves the business. Join architecture reviews and deployments with Fortune 100 customers. Bring what you learn from Product, Forward Deployed Engineering and Go\-to\-Market back into what we build. * **Build the orchestration and transformation backbone.** Lead the framework for scheduled, idempotent, observable jobs that ingest non\-telemetry context and produce derived data — materialized views, rollups, entity graphs, and LLM\-based summarization and enrichment that's cached ahead of investigations rather than computed during them. * **Own reliability, performance, and cost end to end.** Define and meet SLOs for availability, data freshness, and query latency; build systems that ship with their monitoring, runbooks, and safe rollouts; and lead the technical response when things break. * **Govern customer data.** Design redaction, tenant isolation, and data\-residency controls that satisfy the security and compliance teams of the world's largest banks, payment companies, and tech companies. * **Multiply the team.** Mentor senior engineers, and set standards and reference implementations that teams beyond Data Platform adopt. ### **What We're Looking For** * Senior\-level depth in building and operating data infrastructure in production (typically 10\+ years), including a track record of setting architecture for a data platform used by multiple teams. * Deep distributed\-systems expertise in streaming data, analytical storage, and query engines: Kafka (or equivalent), ClickHouse/Doris/Druid/Pinot, data lakehouse technologies, and building scalable and reliable multi\-tenant data systems. * Strong systems programming in Rust (our primary data platform language) or comparable experience in Go, plus comfort in Python. * Experience shipping on Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and AWS, ideally into environments you don't fully control (BYOC, on\-prem, or regulated customer clouds). * A record of leading multi\-quarter migrations and platform transformations through to adoption and deprecation, not just design. * You still write production code regularly, and can walk us through recent work you personally shipped. * Sound cost judgment: you reason about tradeoffs between performance, cost, durability, and simplicity with real numbers, and you know what your systems cost to run. * Clear technical writing and judgment: you can make a crisp tradeoff call, get alignment without authority, and hold your own in an architecture review with an enterprise customer. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience building the backend of an observability, logging, APM, or SIEM product. * Fluency with OpenTelemetry/OTLP and the data models and APIs of major observability vendors (Datadog, Splunk, Elastic, Prometheus, Dynatrace). * Experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Temporal) and data pipeline frameworks. * Experience building LLM\-powered data pipelines: enrichment, summarization, embeddings, and controlling their cost. * Background in data governance: PII redaction, data residency, and regulated industries such as financial services. * Contributions to open\-source data infrastructure. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and additional benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time, in\-person role in New York is $275,000 to $350,000 USD, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on location, level, and role. Individual compensation is determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Why You Should Join Us** If you've mastered data infrastructure and want to be at the center of AI, rather than next to it, this is the role. Traversal is a place to take on hard, meaningful problems with real ownership from day one. You’ll work alongside people who challenge you to grow, learn constantly, and help define a new category of infrastructure software. We think long term, move quickly, and hold a high bar without taking ourselves too seriously. We offer competitive salary and equity packages, health insurance, fertility benefits, a great tech setup stipend and flexible time off. Plus in\-office snacks, team happy hours and outings, an annual company offsite, and plenty of built in time to collaborate across teams. Traversal is fully in\-office, 5 days a week, based in New York near Madison Square Park. We have a collaborative, hard\-working culture and are energized by building the future of AI\-powered software maintenance.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. We are looking for a **Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform** to help design and build the next generation of the **Vision One Data Platform** . This is a highly technical, hands\-on role focused on creating a modern data foundation that enables Vision One engineering teams to discover, govern, access, transform, and analyze data across the platform. You will work at the intersection of **distributed databases, data engineering, data governance, semantic discovery, and self\-service analytics** . A key part of the role is enabling **dbt as a self\-service data transformation and modeling capability across Vision One OLTP databases** , while building the underlying architecture, governance, and data movement infrastructure required to do this reliably at scale. You will work closely with platform, product, security, and data engineering teams to establish common data standards and infrastructure that can be reused across Vision One. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the **Vision One Data Platform** , including data ingestion, replication, transformation, governance, discovery, and serving capabilities. * Build scalable data pipelines and **change\-data\-capture (CDC)** architectures using technologies such as **Datastream** and similar streaming/replication technologies. * Enable **self\-service dbt** across Vision One OLTP data sources, providing product teams with governed capabilities to transform, model, test, document, and expose their data without requiring the central data platform team to build every pipeline. * Establish patterns for safely extracting and replicating data from **OLTP and distributed SQL databases** into analytical and downstream data systems. * Design architectures around distributed SQL technologies such as **YugabyteDB, CockroachDB** , or similar platforms. * Work with technologies such as **Databricks** and modern analytical processing engines to support large\-scale data processing and analytics. * Build a comprehensive **data catalog and metadata foundation** that enables teams and AI agents to understand what data exists, where it comes from, what it means, and how it can be used. * Develop **semantic data discovery** capabilities that allow engineers, analysts, applications, and AI agents to discover relevant data based on business meaning rather than only database/schema names. * Establish data governance standards covering **ownership, lineage, schemas, quality, access control, retention, and lifecycle management** . * Develop reusable data platform primitives and APIs that product teams can consume as self\-service capabilities. * Build automated mechanisms for **data quality, schema evolution, lineage, observability, and freshness monitoring** . * Design for evolving product schemas and ensure the platform can accommodate continuous changes without creating excessive duplication or operational overhead. * Partner with security and platform engineering teams to establish appropriate **fine\-grained data access controls** across databases, schemas, tables, and data products. * Help establish the **source\-of\-truth architecture** for Vision One data while minimizing unnecessary data duplication. * Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to other data engineers and product engineering teams. Drive engineering standards around reliability, scalability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence. * **What You Bring** **Required:** * 4\-7 years of experience in data engineering, distributed systems, backend engineering, or a related field. * Strong experience designing and building **large\-scale data platforms and data pipelines** . * Deep understanding of **OLTP and OLAP architectures** and the tradeoffs between them. * Hands\-on experience with **CDC, data replication, and streaming architectures** . * Strong SQL expertise and experience working with relational databases at scale. * Experience with **distributed SQL databases** , such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner, or similar technologies. * Experience building data transformation workflows using **dbt** or similar data modeling frameworks. * Experience with modern analytical/data platforms such as **Databricks, Spark, Trino, Snowflake, BigQuery** , or equivalent. * Strong understanding of data governance concepts including **metadata, lineage, data quality, ownership, access control, and data catalogs** . * Experience designing systems that support **self\-service d owledge graphs, or ontology\-driven data discovery** . * Experience building platforms that expose data to **AI/agentic applications** . * Experience with data mesh, data products, or domain\-oriented data architectures. * Experience implementing **fine\-grained authorization** for data platforms. * Experience managing large\-scale telemetry, security, observability, or other high\-volume data. * Experience balancing **data quality, query performance, platform reliability, and infrastructure cost** . **What Success Looks Like** In this role, you will help establish a Data Platform where: * Vision One data can be **discovered through a common semantic layer** , rather than requiring teams to understand every underlying database and schema. * Product teams can use **dbt as a governed self\-service capability** across their OLTP data. * Data lineage, ownership, quality, and access policies are **built into the platform rather than managed manually** . * Data can move reliably from distributed OLTP systems into analytical and downstream systems through standardized CDC and streaming patterns. * Product teams can consume platform capabilities without repeatedly building their own ingestion, transformation, governance, and discovery infrastructure. * The platform provides a **trusted source of truth** while minimizing unnecessary copies of data. * The resulting data foundation can support not only traditional analytics and applications, but also **AI and agentic experiences across Vision One** . **Why Join TrendAI?** --------------------- TrendAI is a leader in AI security. We not only delivered the first open\-weight, cybersecurity\-focused large language model, but also the industry's first security companion agent evaluated directly by customers. Trend Vision One integrates endpoint, cloud, network, email, identity, AI application, and data security into a single, unified platform. In this role, you will help define how a security\-critical product is built — including how AI shapes the development process itself. You will partner with engineering leaders applying AI to that process, working in an environment where the bar on systems thinking, critical review, and security instinct has gone up, not down. **What We Offer You:** You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family. * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance * Life insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Pre\-partum, maternity, parental and medical leave * Mental Health Wellness Program * Adoption Assistance * Wellness Incentive * Pet Insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off * 14 Annual Holidays * Tuition Assistance Employee Resource Groups * We offer competitive compensation with bonus opportunity tied to company performance, along with room to enhance your skills through ongoing learning and broad technological opportunities. Achieving work\-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work. This role is not eligible for employer\-provided work visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for this employer without sponsorship. Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender. \#LI\-JL At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. jobs.title: Cyber Recovery Infrastructure Architect - Cloud Technologies
jobs.description: **Role description** **Cyber Recovery Infrastructure Architect \- Cloud Technologies** **The Role** Provide architecture and engineering leadership for secure, resilient, and recoverable cloud infrastructure, ensuring critical services can be restored following cyber incidents while meeting enterprise security, compliance, RTO, and RPO requirements. **What You’ll Do** * Own Cloud Cyber Recovery Architecture: Define reference architectures, standards, patterns, and technology roadmaps for recovery of critical workloads across Azure/AWS and hybrid\-cloud environments. * Design Secure Recovery Environments: Establish isolated/clean recovery environments incorporating Zero Trust, network segmentation, IAM, privileged access, secrets, certificates, immutable backups, and cyber\-recovery controls. * Engineer \& Automate Recovery: Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation for infrastructure provisioning, data restoration, network configuration, security controls, and application recovery to reduce manual effort and recovery time. * Manage Infrastructure Dependencies: Define recovery sequencing across identity, DNS/DHCP, networking, load balancers, storage/backup, databases, middleware, and monitoring to enable end\-to\-end application recovery. jobs.description: ### **General Information** Position Title Data Engineer Job Family Digital Technologies \& Information Duty Station(s) Home based Seniority Level Mid Level ICS Level ICS 10 Contract Type ICA \- LICA \- Specialist \- Regular Contract Level LICA 10 Posting Start Date 19\-Nov\-2026 Posting End Date 23\-Nov\-2026 Duration Until 30 July 2027 (subject to good performance, availability of funds, organizational requirements and project duration) ### **Job Highlight** An area of emerging interest in the humanitarian sector is data science and anticipatory action: asking what will happen in a particular humanitarian context and using available data and models to arrive at an answer. The Centre’s data science team has supported OCHA’s anticipatory action frameworks in a dozen countries, enabling humanitarian organisations to get ahead of shocks and mitigate their impact. After a successful pilot phase, OCHA is now looking at the modalities for scaling and mainstreaming anticipatory action, and the Data Engineer will support these efforts. ### **About the Region** The UNOPS Global Portfolios Office (GPO) brings together diverse expertise to help partners deliver impact worldwide. With hubs in New York, Geneva, and Vienna, and expert teams operating globally, GPO leads multi\-regional initiatives that advance sustainable development, climate action, and peacebuilding \- including in some of the world’s most challenging environments. By leveraging our collective expertise and global networks, GPO supports UNOPS’ strategic priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals across more than 130 countries. We work closely with major global partners \- including governments, international financial institutions, and UN agencies \- to deliver a wide range of services, such as project management, fund management, hosting services, and HR support. ### **About the Country/Multi\-Country Office** Not Required \- part of GPO/NYPO ### **Job Specific Context** UNOPS has signed an agreement with the United Nations to implement defined activities in support of the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) has a Centre for Humanitarian Data in The Hague, the Netherlands, which is focused on increasing the use and impact of data in the humanitarian sector. The vision is to create a future where all people involved in a humanitarian emergency have access to the data they need, when and how they need it, to make responsible and informed decisions. The Centre has four workstreams: data services (managing the Humanitarian Data Exchange platform), data responsibility, data literacy and data science. ### **Role Purpose** UNOPS is seeking to recruit a Data Engineer who has the skills and experience to develop data pipelines, tools and software to support the data scientists in the data science team. We are looking for a candidate who is familiar with the analytical methods used in the humanitarian sector, and can think strategically about how to use data to create value for crisis response. The right candidate has the skills and abilities to provide technical support to the broader team and contribute to shaping the development of the technical stack used by the Centre. They should also be self\-motivated and able to thrive in an international, multidisciplinary team. The incumbent of this position will be a personnel of UNOPS under its full responsibility. The Data Engineer will report to the Data Science Team Lead under the overall direction of the Lead for the Centre for Humanitarian Data. ### **Functions / Key Results Expected** The incumbent will be responsible for the following duties: * Understand the data workflow of the data science team and develop data pipelines to access the datasets typically used. * Design new tools and modules to be used for humanitarian action. * Maintain existing software packages and ensure consistency in the analytical tools used by the Centre. * Advise on the development of the tech stack used by the team. * Work with the other teams at the Centre to ensure coherence in the adoption of technology across work streams. ### **Skills** Analysis Services, Business Process Mapping, Data Architecture ### **Competencies** Develops and implements sustainable business strategies, thinks long term and externally in order to positively shape the organisation. Anticipates and perceives the impact and implications of future decisions and activities on other parts of the organisation. Treats all individuals with respect; responds sensitively to differences and encourages others to do the same. Upholds organisational and ethical norms. Maintains high standards of trustworthiness. Role model for diversity and inclusion. Acts as a positive role model contributing to the team spirit. Collaborates and supports the development of others. **For people managers only:** Acts as positive leadership role model, motivates, di ience is required. OR; * A first\-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent), preferably in mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science, statistics, economics or a related field, with 7 (seven) years of relevant experience is required. ### **Experience Requirements** **Required:** * Relevant experience is defined as programming experience in areas like data transformation, pipelines, processing and/or analytics. * Programming experience in Python/R and an understanding of developer tools is required. **Desired:** * Experience in data visualisation and geospatial analytics is desirable. * Knowledge or experience in the humanitarian or development sectors is desirable. * Experience with climate data and climate modelling is desirable ### **Language Requirements** **Language** **Proficiency Level** **Requirement** English Fluent Required ### **Additional Information** * UNOPS does not accept unsolicited resumes. * UNOPS will at no stage of the recruitment process request candidates to make payments of any kind. * Applications to vacancies must be received before midnight Copenhagen time (CET) on the closing date of the announcement. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. * Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the selection process, which may include various assessments. * UNOPS embraces diversity and is committed to equal employment opportunity. Our workforce consists of a wide range of nationalities, cultures, languages, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, and abilities. We strive to sustain and strengthen this diversity, fostering an inclusive working environment where all personnel are treated with respect and have equal access to opportunities. * UNOPS evaluates all applications based on the skills, qualifications and experience outlined in the vacancy announcement. We are committed to a fair and transparent selection process and welcome diverse perspectives, including those of women, indigenous and racialized communities, individuals of diverse gender identities and sexual orientations, and persons with disabilities. * We are committed to enabling all candidates to perform at their best during the assessment process. If you are shortlisted and require support or reasonable accommodation to complete any assessment, please inform our human resources team upon receiving your invitation. UNOPS has zero tolerance for sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA), sexual harassment, and other forms of abusive conduct, including discrimination, abuse of authority, and harassment. To uphold these standards, background checks are conducted for all final candidates to help ensure that individuals with a history of such conduct are not hired. By applying for a position with UNOPS, candidates acknowledge and consent to these verification processes. * **Terms and Conditions** * For staff positions only, UNOPS reserves the right to appoint a candidate at a lower level than the advertised level of the post. * For retainer contracts, you must complete a few mandatory courses (they take around 4 hours to complete) in your own time, before providing services to UNOPS. Refreshers or new mandatory courses may be required during your contract. Please note that you will not receive any compensation for taking courses and refreshers. For more information on a retainer contract here. * For more details on joining UNOPS, please click here. * All UNOPS personnel are responsible for performing their duties in accordance with the UN Charter and UNOPS Policies and Instructions, as well as other relevant accountability frameworks. In addition, all personnel must demonstrate an understanding of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in a manner consistent with UN core values and the UN Common Agenda. * It is the policy of UNOPS to conduct background checks on all potential personnel. Recruitment in UNOPS is contingent on the results of such checks.

Much of our software is now designed, written, and tested with AI agents. The most important skills in this role are critical thinking and engineering judgment: breaking problems down, giving agents clear direction, and deciding whether what comes back is correct, secure, and maintainable. **Key Duties and Responsibilities** * **Build and Integrate** * Design, build, test, and maintain features across our Salesforce and AWS\-based applications. * Build integrations and APIs that exchange data securely with partner systems. * Build data pipelines and reports that help programs track and measure their work. * **Cloud and Quality** * Build cloud services using infrastructure as code, designed to stay portable across providers. * Keep each partner organization's data separate, secure, and auditable. * Write automated tests, take part in code review, and automate deployments. * Monitor and improve reliability, performance, and cost. * **Working With Agents and People** * Direct AI agents through design, coding, and testing, and own every change that reaches production. * Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decisions. * Work with the Product Manager and program teams to understand needs and support partner onboarding. * Document systems so others can support and extend them. **Job Requirements /Technical Knowledge** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent the handling of sensitive data. * Strong critical thinking: breaks problems down, finds root causes, and makes sound trade\-offs. * Experience directing AI agents or assistants on software work, with the judgment to evaluate, correct, or reject what they produce. **Preferred** * Salesforce platform development (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow). * Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or OpenTofu. * Experience with regulated data or multi\-tenant applications. * Experience in health, human services, or nonprofit technology. **Compensation** * Commensurate with experience, education, jobs.title: Geotechnical Staff Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are: *At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at* *careers.teamues.com**.* Position Overview: We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented **Staff Engineer** to join our geotechnical engineering team. In this entry\-level role, you will support a variety of field and office activities, including site investigations, soil and rock data collection, laboratory coordination, and technical reporting. Working alongside experienced engineers and project managers, you'll contribute to evaluating subsurface conditions and assisting with the preparation of engineering documentation that supports infrastructure, environmental, and construction\-related projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong academic foundation in geotechnical or civil engineering, a collaborative attitude, and a desire to learn through hands\-on fieldwork and mentorship. This is a great opportunity for an early\-career professional to grow technical skills, gain field experience, and build a solid foundation in applied geotechnical engineering within a dynamic and supportive environment. Responsibilities: * Assist with geotechnical site investigations, including soil and rock sampling, borehole logging, field testing, and data collection to support project design and analysis. * Support the evaluation of subsurface conditions by analyzing field and laboratory data under the supervision of senior engineers. * Contribute to the preparation of technical reports and documentation by summarizing findings, preparing figures, and assisting in drafting recommendations. * Work collaboratively with project engineers and multidisciplinary teams to support design development and engineering assessments. * Assist with reviewing plans, specifications, and background data to help inform geotechnical evaluations. * Participate in field and laboratory testing programs to ensure data quality and integrity. * Support communication with internal teams, subcontractors, and vendors to facilitate coordination of field work and material procurement. * Help ensure project work is performed in accordance with applicable health, safety, and environmental standards. * Learn to use geotechnical engineering software and tools for analysis and reporting. * Support cost estimating and proposal development efforts by compiling data and assisting with documentation. * Maintain organized project records, logs, and data files in accordance with company standards. * Participate in quality assurance/quality control processes to support consistent and accurate deliverables. Job Responsibilities Note: *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. UES retains the right to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.*Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, Geology, or a related field. * 0–3 years of relevant experience in geotechnical engineering, field investigations, or construction materials testing (internship or co\-op experience welcomed). * Engineering\-in\-Training (EIT) certification preferred or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe. * Familiarity with geotechnical concepts, laboratory and field testing methods, and soil/rock behavior. * Exposure to engineering software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or geotechnical tools (e.g., PLAXIS, GeoStudio, LPILE) is a plus. * Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and working with project teams. * Basic understanding of construction methods, site safety, and environmental regulations is helpful. * Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail. * Willingness to work in both field and office environments and travel to project sites as needed. * Ability to work effectively as part of a team and demonstrate a proactive, collaborative mindset. Travel Requirements: * This position requires extensive travel, approximately up to 70% of the time, in support of business objectives and client engagements. jobs.description: **JOIN OUR TEAM TODAY** ----------------------- Universal Stainless \& Alloy Products, Inc., established in 1994, is headquartered in Bridgeville, PA, with plants in North Jackson, OH, Dunkirk, NY, and Titusville, PA. Universal Stainless produces semi\-finished and finished specialty steel long products and plate including stainless steel, tool steel, bearing steel, gear steel, and aircraft quality low alloy steels for use in a variety of industries. The Site Reliability Maintenance Engineer is a key player in Universal Stainless’ newly created Reliability Program. This position is located at North Jackson, OH. steelmaking experience preferred. * IBM Maximo EAM experience preferred. * Reliability\-centered maintenance experience. **Education:** -------------- * B.S. in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or relevant equivalent education.
