jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Engineer to join their team.** **About this Opportunity** As part of the university’s AI@UW Initiative, the eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Research Engineer with strengths in research applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI). As a member of the newly formed UW AI Corps within our broader eScience Institute team and the AI@UW initiative, the AI Research Engineer will participate in expanding campus\-wide opportunities at the intersection of AI, data science, and disciplinary domains through collaborative research, consultation, support of curriculum development, development of AI training programs and community building initiatives. The eScience Institute works with researchers and students in all fields across the University of Washington to answer fundamental and transformative questions. As the hub of data\-intensive discovery on campus, we lead a community of innovators in the techniques, technologies, and best practices of data science and AI. Positions within the AI Corps in the eScience Institute provide guidance and expertise to the University of Washington community, including students, post\-docs, staff and faculty on the best\-practices for, and appropriate application of ML, generative AI, and data science methods. In addition, they are expected to support researchers in developing AI workflows and provide guidance on selecting the appropriate tools and computational infrastructure to complete research tasks. These interactions may be structured around a set of programmatic and thematic activities that are core to the eScience Institute mission as well as developing technical tutorials and other university wide offerings. The AI Research Engineer contributes directly to projects with real\-world impact, solving complex research problems across disciplines using cutting\-edge AI techniques, and involves working with faculty, staff, and students from across the campus in a variety of formal and informal settings. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Research \& Technical Collaboration (40%)** * Collaborate with researchers across UW to advance research and scholarship rooted in AI and data\-intensive methods, proactively proposing and executing practical solutions to research challenges. * Build AI system workflows, pipelines, and infrastructure to support research teams. * Serve as the go\-to expert on AI tools, methods, and responsible use, advising on approaches that are technically sound, ethically grounded, and aligned with institutional values. Contribute to collaborative research outputs such as publications, reports, and open\-source tools that advance the field and amplify the Institute's impact. * **Teaching \& Community Engagement (40%)** * Develop and lead workshops, short courses, and training programs that foster AI literacy and support thoughtful integration of AI into research design and execution. * Support faculty and staff in the creation and use of AI in educational settings. * Create user\-facing resources including guides, tutorials, and code notebooks enabling researchers and students to learn and apply AI methods independently. * Participate in core Institute programs such as the Data Science \& AI Accelerator. * Collaborate with campus partners including academic departments, AI@UW (campus\-wide AI initiative), UW\-IT (UW Information Technology), and UW Libraries to advance shared goals around research innovation and responsible AI integration. Evaluate the effectiveness of educational offerings and iterate based on participant feedback and learning outcomes. * **Organizational Service (10%)** * Participate actively in core team meetings, planning activities, and Institute\-wide initiatives. * Provide weekly office hours open to the campus community Serve on standing and ad hoc committees contributing to shared governance and institutional health. * **Ongoing skill development (10%)** Dedicate time to independent study and hands\-on experimentation with emerging AI tools, models, and research methods relevant to the Institute's work. * **Required Qualifications** To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in a Research or Engineering Field * Four years of professional or educational experience using advance computational techniques. * **Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.** **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience with appropriate application of ML, generative AI, and data science methods in several research areas. Previous experience with collaborative open source software development. * **Application Requirement** Cover Letter Questions: * Describe a workshop, tutorial, or training you designed or led. How did you decide what to include, and how did you know whether people learned the material? * Tell us about an AI or data pipeline you built. What tradeoffs did you make, and what would you do differently today? Why does a role centered on supporting others’ research and learning appeal to you compared with a role focused on your own research agenda? * **Visa Sponsorship** This recruitment is open to applicants who will require employer sponsorship for an H\-1B or E\-3 visa. **Compensation, Benefits and Position Details** **Pay Range Minimum:** $103,200\.00 annual **Pay Range Maximum:** $120,000\.00 annual **Other Compensation:** * **Benefits:** For information about benefits for this position, visit https://www.washington.edu/jobs/benefits\-for\-uw\-staff/ **Shift:** First Shift (United States of America) **Temporary or Regular?** This is a regular position **FTE (Full\-Time Equivalent):** 100\.00% **Union/Bargaining Unit:** UAW Research **About the UW** Working at the University of Washington provides a unique opportunity to change lives – on our campuses, in our state and around the world. UW employees bring their boundless energy, creative problem\-solving skills and dedication to building stronger minds and a healthier world. In return, they enjoy outstanding benefits, opportunities for professional growth and the chance to work in an environment known for its diversity, intellectual excitement, artistic pursuits and natural beauty. **Our Commitment** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81 . jobs.title: Research Software Engineer III/IV
jobs.description: **Job no:** 542039 **Work type:** Staff Full\-Time **Location:** Main Campus (Gainesville, FL) **Categories:** Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence **Department:**14500000 \- IT\-RC RESEARCH COMPUTING **Classification Title:** Research Software Engineer III **Classification Minimum Requirements:** **RSE Level III:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and one year of experience. **RSE Level IV:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and seven years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, software engineering, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience. Applicants will be considered at the level for which they qualify. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required *experience* but does not negate the minimum degree requirement(s). **Job Description:** UF Information Technology (UFIT) is seeking a professional\-level Research Software Engineer to join Research Computing, a unit within UFIT. The applicant is expected to work at locations across the campus to work closely with faculty and their research teams on software engineering in computational, data processing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) projects in research and education. The final applicant will be considered at the level for which they qualify. UF Information Technology (UFIT) enables teaching, learning, research, and service on campus and across the region with state\-of\-the\-art enterprise IT systems, including SEC and SUS universities, and the opportunity to teach using HiPerGator. UF has been operating HiPerGator for close to a decade. It is the fastest supercomputer owned and operated by a university in the USA. HiPerGator has become a critical service for UF because of the growth of the community of researchers, faculty, students, and collaborators that UF Research Computing serves, not only in size but also in the breadth of research domains. The workloads running on HiPerGator cover a wide range of research disciplines, from physical science and engineering to medicine and drug discovery, as well as business, law, arts and humanities. The demand for HiPerGator’s computing power to carry out research in foundational and agentic AI has also dramatically increased with UF’s AI Initiative in all aspects of human activity. The University of Florida is seeking people who are looking for an exciting career supporting the research performed by world\-class faculty and their students and collaborators in their quest to solve the most challenging problems facing the world today. The people in these positions are part of a collaborative team that values innovative ideas and viewpoints, and they will be expected to work closely in faculty\-led teams on software engineering projects. This position will involve constant learning and professional development. If you think this environment is a match for you or an exciting challenge, you are encouraged to use the cover letter to explain why you are a good fit. Some key responsibilities and characteristics of this position are: * Learn through independent study, reading textbooks and research papers, and online learning materials about problem domains in which work is needed. * Design, program, document, debug, test, deploy, and maintain software for specific projects in diverse scientific and scholarly domains. * Follow best practices for software engineering and data science, large\-scale computing, AI, digital twin, and cybersecurity. * Often, software to be developed will be open source, new, or a contribution to an existing tool, library, or framework. * Act as a consultant and mentor on software engineering principles for the project team you are part of for a given project. * Contribute to papers and documentation to be produced as deliverables of the assigned project. * Optimize code for performance and maintainability. * Keep updated on new developments in software engineering techniques and tools that could improve research outcomes. Professional development opportunities: * Learn the underlying science for the software you are developing with the project team. * Access a community of professionals who are committed to providing excellent research computing support. * Take training through various options ranging from workshops and online training certif y\-building collaboration for our state, our nation, and our world. UF is in Gainesville, a city of approximately 150,000 residents in North\-Central Florida, 50 miles from Florida’s West Coast, 67 miles from the Atlantic Ocean, and within a 2\-hour drive to large metropolitan areas (Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville). The beautiful climate and extensive nearby parks and recreational areas afford year\-round outdoor activities, including hiking, biking, and nature photography. UF’s large college sports programs, museums, and performing arts center support various activities and cultural events for residents to enjoy. Learn more about what Gainesville has to offer at Visit Gainesville. **Exceptional Benefits** UF provides various leave programs based on an employee’s salary plan, including vacation, sick leave, holidays, personal leave days, and paid family leave. In addition to paid time off, the University of Florida offers a very competitive benefits package. **Expected Salary:** RSE III: $90,000\-$110,000; commensurate based on education and experience. RES IV: $110,000\-$130,000; commensurate based on education and experience. **Required Qualifications:** **RSE Level III:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and one year of experience. **RSE Level IV:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and seven years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, software engineering, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience. Applicants will be considered at the level for which they qualify. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required *experience* but does not negate the minimum degree requirement(s). **Preferred:** The ideal candidate will possess the following education, experience, and skills: * AI frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and MLOps platforms, etc * Building digital twins using NVIDIA Omniverse and one or more digital content creation software tools, such as Unreal, Unity, Maya, etc. * Physics\-based modeling using chemistry or materials codes, weather simulations, environment studies, etc. * Statistical modeling and data visualization * Parallel software design with MPI, OpenMP, pthreads, or CUDA * GPU computing environment * Deep Learning, image processing, natural language processing, generative AI, AI agent creation and deployment, and large AI models * For level III, applicants must have at least 3 years of software engineering experience, including at least one software project as lead engineer * For level IV, applicants must have at least 4 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 software projects as lead engineer **Special Instructions to Applicants:** **Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position.** **This is not a remote work position and is located in Gainesville, FL.** A Level 2 Criminal Background Screening is required. jobs.title: STEPS AI Application Developer
jobs.description: Posting Details **Job Title** STEPS AI Application Developer **Requisition Number** TE09585 **Department Name** 40421:UKI **Work Location** Lexington, KY **Salary Range** $75/hour **Type of Position** Temporary **Position Time Status** Part\-Time **Required Education** **Required Related Experience** **Required License/Registration/Certification** **Physical Requirements** Sitting and/or standing for extended periods of time; repetitive motion related to computer work **Shift** Day shift hours, up to 20 hours a week. \*This position is a primarily remote position, but will require an on\-campus presence at times (i.e. onboarding, meetings). **Job Summary** The AI Application Developer will work as part of the UK HealthCare Innovation team to rapidly design, build, test, and iterate AI\-enabled healthcare applications. The position will collaborate closely with product management, program management, technical staff, end users, and healthcare stakeholders to translate identified needs into functional prototypes and refine solutions through user feedback and validation. The developer will apply secure software\-development practices appropriate for healthcare environments, including requirements associated with HIPAA and protected health information. Successful prototypes may advance toward broader implementation within UK HealthCare or translation to external health systems, commercial partners, or startup companies. Key Responsibilities * Design and develop prototype AI\-enabled applications that address healthcare operational, clinical, administrative, and research needs identified by UK HealthCare Innovation project teams. * Embed within cross\-functional technology development teams, collaborating with product management, technology development, subject\-matter experts, clinicians, operational stakeholders, and other technical contributors to translate priority problem statements and unmet needs into functional applications according to milestones and deliverables established by the technology development team. * Rapidly build, test, and iterate prototypes using agile development practices, incorporating feedback from end users and stakeholders and product direction established by the Director of Product Management. Familiar with AI Native Development using Claude, Codex to rapidly deploy workable prototypes and TypeScript. * Evaluate and integrate AI technologies, including large language models, APIs, data services, and other emerging tools, selecting appropriate technical approaches based on project requirements, security considerations, performance, and feasibility. Ability to develop algorithms or machine\-learning models for audit use cases, such as spotting unusual billing patterns or durations. * Develop applications using secure, privacy\-conscious architecture and development practices appropriate for healthcare environments, including appropriate controls for protected health information (PHI), authentication and access, encryption, logging, auditing, data handling, and integration with approved technology environments. * Support HIPAA\-compliant development and deployment practices, working within UK HealthCare ITS teams to integrate privacy, security, data\-governance, and technology requirements when applications access, process, transmit, or store PHI. * Create and maintain technical documentation for application architecture, source code, integrations, data flows, configuration, testing, security considerations, and deployment requirements to support reproducibility and future development. * Develop and refine team\-wide software development standards and best practices for UKHCI’s growing technology development team, including coding conventions, version\-control and code\-review workflows, automated testing and CI/CD expectations, secure dependency and secrets management, and consistent use of separate environments with controlled deployment, access, configuration, data\-handling, monitoring, and rollback practices. * Conduct functional testing, troubleshooting, and performance evaluation throughout prototype development, identifying technical risks and resolving issues as products advance toward validation. * Support transition from prototype to scalable implementation after successful validation, including refactoring or adapting applications for broader deployment across UK HealthCare. * Collaborate with internal development resources and external technology/scaling partners when validated technologies require additional engineering, infrastructure, security, interoperability, or production capabilities. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
jobs.description: **The University of Mississippi — fondly referred to as Ole Miss — stands as a premier public research institution with a proud legacy of academic distinction. We are devoted to nurturing a vibrant, inclusive community where every member — student, faculty, and staff — can achieve their fullest potential.** **Job Summary:** The PharmE3D Lab at the University of Mississippi is seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to contribute to the development of a next\-generation AI\-driven self\-driving laboratory platform for pharmaceutical drug delivery, formulation and advanced manufacturing. This role will play a central part in building intelligent, autonomous R\&D pipelines integrating machine learning, robotics, and experimental design. **Job Description:** The successful candidate will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment spanning pharmaceutics, materials science, automation, and data science, contributing across a multi\-year phased innovation roadmap focused on building, scaling, and commercializing AI\-enabled drug development systems. **Key responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data infrastructure, pipelines, and cloud/HPC environments for experimental and manufacturing data. * Build and deploy AI/ML models for prediction, optimization, and decision\-making (e.g., Bayesian optimization, active learning, reinforcement learning). * Develop closed\-loop and semi/autonomous experimentation systems by integrating machine learning with laboratory automation and robotics. * Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams (pharmaceutics, robotics, data science) to design AI\-driven workflows, experimental strategies, and digital infrastructure. * Implement and refine model training, validation, and continuous learning pipelines, ensuring robustness, reproducibility, and scalability. * Develop tools for real\-time data analytics, experiment tracking, and decision support systems. * Contribute to workflow standardization, data governance, and best practices, including team training and onboarding support. * Support intellectual property development, including novel algorithms, workflows, and applied AI innovations. * Validate system performance using KPIs and benchmarking and optimize models for real\-world deployment. Contribute to technology transfer, industry partnerships, and commercialization efforts, including preparation of production\-ready AI systems. * **Minimum Qualifications** * Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Chemical/Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences/Engineering, or a related field is required by the time of the appointment. * Strong expertise in machine learning and statistical modeling in healthcare related fields. * Proficiency in programming (Python required; experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit\-learn). * Experience with data engineering, databases, and cloud computing platforms. * Knowledge of experimental design, optimization algorithms, or scientific computing. Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams. * **Preferred** * Experience with autonomous labs, robotics integration, or cyber\-physical systems. * Background in pharmaceutics, materials science, or chemical processes. * Experience with MLOps, model deployment, and scalable AI systems. Track record of publications, patents, or applied ML innovations. * **Familiarity with** * Active learning / Bayesian optimization * Reinforcement learning Digital twins or simulation environments * **Application Procedures** Applicants should provide a cover letter outlining qualifications for the position and interest in AI\-driven labs, Curriculum Vitae (CV), representative publications or project portfolio (if applicable), and the name and contact information of three references through The University of Mississippi’s online employment site at https://careers.olemiss.edu. UM conducts background investigations for applicants being considered for employment. Background investigations include a criminal history record check, and when appropriate, a financial (credit) report or driving history check. *Join the Ole Miss Family — Build Your Legacy Here!*

jobs.description: Posting Information **Department** Emergency Medicine\-411201 **Career Area** Information Technology **Posting Open Date** 11/18/2026 **Application Deadline** 12/02/2026 **Open Until Filled** No **Position Type** Permanent Staff (EHRA NF) **Working Title** Data Engineer \& Analytics Specialist **Appointment Type** EHRA Non\-Faculty **Position Number** 20079511 **Vacancy ID** NF0010208 **Full Time/Part Time** Full\-Time Permanent **FTE** 1 **Hours per week** 40 **Position Location** North Carolina, US **Hiring Range** $91,500 \- $95,000 **Proposed Start Date** 12/14/2026 Position Information **Be a Tar Heel!** A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world\-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn. One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community. University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** for numerous retail, restaurant and performing arts discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates on select campus events. UNC\-Chapel Hill offers full\-time employees a **comprehensive benefits package**, paid leave, and a variety of health, life and retirement plans and additional programs that support a healthy work/life balance. **Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit** Our mission is to improve the health and well\-being of North Carolinians and others whom we serve. We accomplish this by providing leadership and excellence in the interrelated areas of patient care, education and research. Patient care: We promote health and provide superb clinical care while maintaining our strong tradition of reaching underserved populations and reducing health disparities across North Carolina and beyond. Education: We prepare tomorrow’s healthcare professionals and biomedical researchers from all backgrounds by facilitating learning within innovative and integrated curricula and team\-oriented interprofessional education to ensure a highly skilled workforce. Research: We develop and support a rich array of outstanding health sciences research programs, centers and resources. We provide infrastructure and opportunities for collaboration among disciplines throughout and beyond our university to support outstanding research. We foster programs in the areas of basic, translational, mechanistic and population research. **Position Summary** The Data Engineer \& Analytics Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing data integration processes and database solutions that support organizational data needs. This position manages data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, develops database objects for web applications, oversees data linkage initiatives, and provides analytical datasets to support public health research and operational decision\-making. The role collaborates with internal stakeholders and researchers to advance the organization’s data strategy and support key public health initiatives. **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements** Master’s or Bachelor’s and 0\-2 years’ experience; or will accept a combination of related education and experience in substitution. **Required Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience** * At least five years of experience with SQL Server, including development of views, stored procedures, tables, full\-text indexes, and other database objects. * At least three years of experience working with secondary health data for public health surveillance purposes, including NEMSIS 3\.3\.4 and/or NEMSIS 3\.5 emergency medical services data. * At least three years of experience working with a public health syndromic surveillance system. * At least three years of experience working with other data and messaging standards such as ICD, XML 1\.0/1\.1, and/or HL7\. * At least three years of experience with PowerShell. * At least two years of experience working with ETL tools such as SSIS. * At least two years of experience developing source\-specific data linkage methods. * Strong interpersonal skills and experience working with public health data users. **Preferred Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience** * Experience with Python, R, C\#, and/or SAS. **Special Physical/Mental Requirements** **Campus Security Authority Responsibilities** Not Applicable.

jobs.description: Posting Information **Department** Computer Science \- 318400 **Career Area** Research Professionals **Posting Open Date** 11/17/2026 **Application Deadline** 11/20/2026 **Position Type** Temporary Staff (SHRA) **Position Title** Research Software Engineer **Position Number** 20011957 **Vacancy ID** S028276 **Full\-time/Part\-time** Full\-Time Temporary **Hours per week** 40 **Work Schedule** Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 12:30 PM **Position Location** North Carolina, US **Hiring Range** $70\.00 per hour **Proposed Start Date** 11/30/2026 **Estimated Duration of Appointment** 6 months or longer Position Information **Be a Tar Heel!** A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world\-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn. One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community. University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** that include numerous retail and restaurant discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates for performing arts events. **Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit** The Department of Computer Science is a major teaching department at UNC Chapel Hill with over 30 tenured/tenure track faculty, four teaching track faculty, eight research faculty, and 18 adjunct faculty, who serve more than a thousand undergraduate students and hundreds of graduate students and postdoctoral fellows. Teaching and research activities are currently assisted by nearly 200 graduate students. Twenty\-four SHRA positions and eight EHRA\-NF positions, including technical and administrative personnel, support the infrastructure of the department. The Department’s driving research ideal is collaboration – as it has been since the founding of the department in 1964\. We believe that computer science’s greatest purpose is in working with other scientists to solve problems in their own disciplines. Therefore, we actively seek opportunities to generate new research with our colleagues and with scientists in other departments across campus, including in science, medicine, and the humanities. Numerous computer science faculty members have adjunct or joint appointments in other departments, lead large interdisciplinary research groups, and collaborate with colleagues from multiple universities across the Research Triangle, the United States, and even the world. **Position Summary** This Research Software Engineer position will develop software solutions for ongoing research projects for the Operating Systems, Security, Concurrency and Architecture Research (OSCAR) Lab in the UNC Computer Science Department. The OSCAR Lab investigates experimental system designs, primarily focused on operating systems, but past work has ranged from experimental hardware designs to mobile and wearable user interface design. The lab has a track record of building large prototype systems for realistic studies, as well as technology transfer through open source and commercialization of successful projects. This role will be primarily writing C and Rust code for the open\-source Gramine library OS. This position requires the specialized skills of low\-level kernel programming in C, x86 assembly, and Rust. An ideal candidate has experience working on hardware\-level trusted execution environments (TEEs), such as Intel’s SGX or AMD’s SEV\-SNP technologies; experience with writing hardware device drivers or file systems may also be transferrable. This position also requires interacting with scientists and engineers in other organizations, in support of technology transfer to the open\-source user community of Gramine. **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or closely related degree from an appropriately accredited institution and three years of experience in operations analysis and design, systems programming, or closely related area; or a * Bachelor’s degree from an appropriately accredited institution and four years of experience in operations analysis and design, systems programming or closely related area; or an Associate’s degree in Computer Information Technology, Computer Engineering Technology, or Networking Technology from an appropriately accredited institution and five years of experience in operations analysis and design, systems programming, or closely related area; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Journey level requires an additional one year of education or experience. * Advanced level requires an additional two years of education or experience. **Management Preferences** * Experience with Rust, C\+\+ and/or x86 assembly programming * Experience with device driver programming or other low\-level hardware features (Intel VT, SGX) * Experience with Open Source community building * Experience with mentoring students or junior engineers **Special Physical/Mental Requirements** **Campus Security Authority Responsibilities** Not Applicable.

jobs.title: Principal DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** We are looking for a highly technical, hands\-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team. In this role, you'll focus on building and improving security automation, strengthening our SaaS environment, and developing scalable solutions that enhance security operations across the organization. You'll leverage your programming and scripting skills, hands\-on operations experience, and understanding of APIs, IAM permissions, and security best practices to solve complex technical challenges. You'll analyze code, troubleshoot technical issues, and apply risk\-based thinking to identify vulnerabilities and implement effective security controls. This is a highly autonomous, engineering\-focused role where you'll have the opportunity to build security automations from the ground up, leverage AI to improve workflows, and solve challenging security problems. You'll work closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to streamline processes. **Our Core Technologies:** AWS (IAM, Security Services), Terraform, Python, Bash, REST APIs, AI/LLM Tools (Claude, AI Agents, MCP), Tines/SOAR, Sumo Logic, CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, Sublime Security, SIGMA/YARA, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, FleetDM/osquery, GCP, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365\. **What You'll Do:** * Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual processes. * Develop and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform. * Implement AWS security controls, including IAM policies and least\-privilege access. * Build secure integrations between systems using APIs and scripting. * Identify, investigate, and resolve security risks across cloud infrastructure and internal systems. * Use AI tools, agents, and MCP integrations to improve security workflows. * Troubleshoot issues across infrastructure, networking, and security tools. * Develop and improve security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities. * Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to implement security improvements. * Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen security and automate processes. **What We Look For:** * Strong programming, scripting, and automation skills across one or more languages. * Hands\-on AWS security experience, including IAM permissions and least\-privilege principles. * Strong Terraform skills, including independently writing and maintaining modules. * Solid understanding of APIs, authentication, and secure integrations. * Knowledge of security fundamentals, risk analysis, and cloud security best practices. * Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, and technical operations. * Experience using AI development tools while independently validating generated code. * Familiarity with AI agents, automation frameworks, or MCP integrations. * Ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems. * Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with Tines or other SOAR platforms. * Familiarity with CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, or Sublime Security. * Experience with Sumo Logic or similar monitoring tools. * Experience writing SIGMA or YARA detection rules. * Understanding of event\-driven architecture and enterprise IT systems. * Experience with Kubernetes and container security. * Knowledge of OWASP principles, including LLM/AI security. * Experience with FleetDM, osquery, or endpoint security tools. * Familiarity with GCP, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience with CI/CD pipeline security or software supply chain security. * Threat hunting or security investigation experience. * Exposure to security compliance frameworks. **What Will Make You Successful:** * You take ownership and work independently with minimal direction. * You identify problems and proactively develop solutions. * You are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies. * You use AI effectively without relying on it for every task, and are able to leverage your own knowledge and experience to challenge its assertions. * You communicate openly and collaborate well across teams. * You enjoy improving processes and making a measurable impact. **What We Offer You:** * Competitive salary ($170k\-230k) and stock option plan * Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance * Flexible PTO * Opportunities for professional growth and development * Paid parental leave * Health \& wellness initiatives

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** ------------ Upstart's Bank Technology team builds the internal platforms, security automation, and operational systems that enable Upstart Bank to operate securely, efficiently, and at scale. The team partners closely with stakeholders across risk, legal, compliance, security, and operations to create software solutions that support the bank's growth as a licensed financial institution. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across a growing portfolio of internal platforms and automation systems. You will drive architectural direction, solve complex technical challenges, and establish engineering patterns that enable the team to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for the bank's most critical operational functions. **How you'll make an impact** ----------------------------- * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of internal platforms, security automation systems, and workflow tooling that support Upstart Bank operations. * Establish scalable engineering patterns, technical standards, and system designs that enable long\-term platform growth and jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates) The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line\-of\-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists. In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System an Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge\-transfer progression (shadowing, co\-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer. 1\. Scope of Responsibilities Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model. Transformation \& Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect. Record Linkage \& Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross\-agency reconciliations. Production Pipeline Operations \& Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects. Data Quality \& Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de\-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout\-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes). Performance Optimization \& Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake. Quality Assurance, Code Review \& Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs. 2\. Activities Performed A. Ingestion \& Pipeline Development (client\-Led Feeds) CDHE Courses Data Ingestion: Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course\-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements. Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner. Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion. Postsecondary SES \& Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional): Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources. Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible\-use governance requirements. PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional): Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE. Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles. B. Knowledge Transfer \& Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027\) Shadowing \& Co\-running (Jan–Feb 2027\): Shadow 3rd party implementation partner engineers on day\-to\-day operations of existing data feeds (e.g., NSC, K\-3, CDEC, and Phase 1 feeds). Co\-run live feed cycles, handle data loading, execute record matching, and troubleshoot exceptions alongside 3rd party implementation partner. Readiness Gate Execution (Target: March 2027\): Run two consecutive feed cycles completely unaided to achieve formal operational hand\-over sign\-off. Full Production Operations (March 2027 Onward): Execute recurring feed schedules, rebuild downstream objects, reconcile row counts against source files, and triage failed jobs. Address ad\-hoc data inquiries and export requests from client leadership and partner agencies. C. Data Stabilization \& Analytics Layer Upkeep Stabilization Backlog Support: Resolve identified data reliability defects, run variations, and de\-duplication issues transitioned from the Phase 1 stabilization backlog. Analytics Layer Hardening \& Maintenance (April 2027 Onwar ions, and CI/CD promotion pipelines. 3\. Deliverables Created Technical Code \& Pipeline Artifacts Production ETL/ELT Pipelines: Fully developed, scheduled Informatica workflows and Snowflake SQL/transformation pipelines for CDHE Courses and existing operational feeds. Cleansing \& Validation Modules: Automated L1, L2, and L3 quality\-check rules and Informatica layout\-change detection routines in the RAW layer. Identity Matching \& Linkage Routines: Documented internal matching scripts linking new partner agency student/workforce records into longitudinal IDs. Analytics Layer Transformation Objects: Production views, tables, and metric models in Snowflake aligned with longitudinal reporting use cases . De\-Identified Data Extraction Scripts: Data extraction scripts that generate de\-identified, suppressed outcome files for participating IHEs per specification. Documentation \& Engineering Specifications ETL Pipeline Design Documents: Technical architecture and transformation specifications detailing source\-to\-target logic, schemas, and dependencies. Mapping \& Transformation Specifications: Contribution to enterprise data mapping documents aligning source fields to the SLDS common data model. Lineage Documentation \& Dependency Maps: As\-built data lineage records and dependency diagrams detailing object\-level upstream and downstream flows. Operational Runbooks \& Incident Procedures: Standard operating procedures for running feed cycles, handling late or malformed files, performing failover, and reconciling row counts. Governance, Testing \& Operational Reporting Azure Test Plans \& Execution Records: Fully documented test plans, test suites, manual test run results, and defect logs for all pipeline modifications prior to production promotion . Release Change Logs: Detailed audit entries for all client\-led production releases, detailing changes, rationales, linked Azure DevOps work items, test results, and deployment timestamps]. Feed Operation Run Logs \& Match Summaries: Run completion records, reconciliation totals, exception logs, and data\-quality summaries produced for agency loads. Required Qualifications \& Technical Experience Snowflake ETL/ELT: Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT data pipelines and transformation logic natively within the Snowflake platform. Informatica CDGC: Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience working with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC) for metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing Terraform to provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure and resources. CI/CD \& DevOps: Demonstrated proficiency implementing automated build, test, and release deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. Version Control: Expert proficiency with Git / version control workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, automated merge checks, code reviews). Preferred Skills \& Experience Prior experience working with public sector, longitudinal education, and workforce data systems (e.g., CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, National Student Clearinghouse). For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About The Role:** ------------------- We’re looking for a Software *Engineer* to join the *Vercel* Agent team. Our mission is simple: deploying on *Vercel* should feel like adding a seasoned *infrastructure* *engineer* to your team. The *Vercel* Agent investigates incidents before you see them, fixes failing builds, reviews *code* with deep *production* context, and answers questions about your *running* app with the authority of someone who has read the logs. Today, this work spans multiple shipped *products:* automated *code* review on every PR, *AI*\-driven investigation of *production* anomalies, an intelligent support agent that resolves the majority of customer issues without human intervention, and conversational *code* *generation*. We’re now unifying these into a single agent that appears pervasively across surfaces (like the *Vercel* dashboard, *Vercel* CLI, Slack, and many more), and is capable of multi\-step reasoning, *code* execution in sandboxed environments, and taking real actions on your behalf. jobs.description: * Design * New York City * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the role** ------------------ As a Software Engineer on Vercel’s Website team, you’ll build and own the software behind vercel.com and our public web experiences. Your work will span React and Next.js applications, shared libraries, APIs, and the services that power forms, analytics, content and more. You’ll work alongside engineers and design engineers to make our websites fast, accessible, reliable, and easier to build on. You’ll partner with marketing, data, security, and framework teams to turn business needs into maintainable software, investigate production issues, and improve the systems other teams use every day. We’re looking for someone who enjoys moving between the browser and the server, making architectural decisions with peers, and carrying work from an open\-ended problem through rollout and ongoing ownership. This is a hybrid role with 3 in\-office days per week in New York City. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and maintain full stack features and shared services for Vercel’s websites, including form submission, content integrations, and analytics. * Design APIs and data contracts that connect browser experiences with backend and third\-party services. Handle validation, retries, duplicate requests, and upstream failures. * Measure and improve loading, rendering, and navigation performance while preserving accessibility and accurate event tracking. * Turn repeated implementation work into reusable libraries, clear interfaces, documentation, and tools that engineers and coding agents can use independently. * Improve website security and privacy with the teams that own those requirements, including shared security policies and consent behavior. * Investigate production issues using logs, traces, and browser tools. Add meaningful verification and monitoring, and follow fixes through deployment. * Shape technical approaches with your teammates, ship changes in focused increments, and share responsibility for code review, migrations, and the long\-term health of the website. **What you need** ----------------- * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production web applications. * Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, with hands\-on experience shipping React and Next.js applications. * Experience writing server\-side application code, designing APIs, integrating external services, and reasoning about data flow and failure handling. * A practical understanding of browser behavior, web performance, accessibility, and how server rendering and caching affect a website. * Experience debugging production problems and choosing tests and instrumentation that give you confidence a change works. * The ability to turn ambiguous requirements into a scoped plan, explain tradeoffs, and carry the work through implementation and rollout. * A collaborative approach to technical decisions and code review. You can give useful feedback, incorporate other perspectives, and make your work understandable to the people maintaining it. * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools while understanding, reviewing, and validating the code you ship. **Bonus if you** ---------------- * Have built shared libraries, SDKs, developer tools, or infrastructure used by multiple applications. * Have worked on analytics, event pipelines, experimentation, forms, or consent systems. * Have experience with CMS integrations, technical SEO, or migrations in a large web codebase. * Have deployed applications on Vercel or contributed to open source. **Compensation \& Benefits:** ----------------------------- * Competitive compensation package, including equity. * Inclusive Healthcare Package. * Learn and Grow \- we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. * Flexible Time Off. * We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000 \- $294,000\. Actual salary will be based on job\-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. **Disclosures:** ---------------- * **Privacy:** Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. * **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high\-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full\-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations. You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company\-wide. Key Responsibilities include: * End\-to\-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full\-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi\-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back\-end integrations. * Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event\-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic. * Context \& Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re\-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture. * Runtime \& Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, synthetic test generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics. * Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components. * Strategic Discovery \& Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest\-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift. * Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade\-offs. **What we’re looking for...** You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Extensive hands\-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones. * A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full\-stack API integration and backend orchestration. * Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval\-driven development). * Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure). * Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing). * Demonstrated ability to interface directly   layer platforms. * Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool\-calling pipelines into production. * Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders. * Prior forward\-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top\-tier technology firms or hyperscalers. * Record of turning one\-off operational builds into enterprise\-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents. * Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large\-scale customer care operations. * Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense \+ sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management. * Advanced full\-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer\-based models). * Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross\-validation methods suited to temporal data. * Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $81,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Junior System Administrator
jobs.description: Position Title \- Junior System Administrator Department \- Information Technology Location \- Chicago, Illinois This is an onsite role in Chicago, Illinois. US work authorization is required. **About VIATechnik** VIATechnik is on a mission to lead the built environment in creating a better future, today. We are one team of digital experts around the globe. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed architects, engineers, tradespersons, researchers, and business leaders. Together, we empower clients through high\-quality, high\-velocity experiences that consistently improve outcomes across the design, construction, and operations of buildings and infrastructure. **Role Overview** Our architects, engineers, and VDC specialists work in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD every day on some of the industry's largest projects. When an account locks, a license will not check out, or a new hire's laptop is not ready, project time is lost. As our Junior System Administrator, you will keep the accounts, devices, network, and design software behind that work running smoothly. You will join our Information Technology team in Chicago, handle first\-line support, and administer Microsoft services and our network with guidance from senior system administrators. Your work gives every VIATechnik employee a secure, reliable setup from day one and frees our senior team to focus on bigger infrastructure and security projects. **Employee Value Proposition** Purpose \- Your work directly supports digital experts delivering BIM, digital twins, and software for the firms shaping the world's most ambitious projects. When you fix something, a project team gets back to work. Growth \- You will build hands\-on skills in a modern Microsoft environment and in Autodesk licensing and deployment at scale, with senior administrators teaching you infrastructure, security, and automation along the way. This role is built as a path toward System Administrator. Motivators \- You will see the results of your work the same day, have room to suggest better ways of doing things, and work alongside people who love solving problems and learning new tools. **Major Performance Objectives** * Own the daily first\-line ticket queue within 60 days and resolve at least 70 percent of tickets at first line by day 90\. * Run onboarding and offboarding end to end within 90 days, so new hires are ready to work on day one and access is removed promptly when someone leaves. * Become our go\-to first\-line resource for AutoCAD, Revit, and Navisworks within six months, cutting escalations by 30 percent and documenting at least 15 common fixes. * Help maintain device compliance and MFA enforcement across all users and endpoints, with regular reporting to senior IT staff. * Maintain an accurate, up\-to\-date inventory of IT assets and network devices. **Critical Subtasks** * Triage and resolve tickets in our ITSM system, putting production\-blocking issues first and escalating complex problems with clear notes. * Manage mailboxes, groups, and licenses, keeping license assignments accurate as people join and leave. * Administer identity and access, including security policy enforcement and documented, auditable access changes. * Configure enrollment, compliance policies, and app deployment, including pushing Autodesk software and plugins to workstations. * Prepare devices for new hires and recover, wipe, and reassign hardware from departing employees, tracking each asset through its lifecycle. * Work directly with architects and engineers on Autodesk installation, licensing, and performance issues, often against a project deadline, and bring in vendors or senior staff when needed. * Help maintain our access points, switches, and controllers and respond to network alerts in the office. **Role Is a Strong Fit for You If** * You have spent one to three years in IT support or systems administration and enjoy being the person who gets someone back to work. * You have managed users, licenses, and devices. * You stay calm when a busy engineer needs help right now, and you explain fixes in plain language. * You write things down, so the second time a problem shows up it takes half as long to solve. * You are curious about design software like Revit and AutoCAD and want to learn how it is deployed and licensed at scale. **Key Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * One to three years of experience in IT support or systems administration. * Hands\-on knowledge of Microsoft services. * Experience with network devices. * Understanding of IT security concepts and compliance requirements. **Culture and Situation Fit** VIATechnik is a results\-driven team of architects, engineers, and technologists who put themselves in our clients' shoes and solve hard problems on fast\-moving projects. Our IT team works the same way. You will thrive here if you are curious, ask good questions, stay steady under pressure, and care about getting issues fixed for good. This is an onsite, hands\-on operational role focused on tickets, devices, accounts, and direct user support, with plenty of routine requests alongside the harder problems. It does not own infrastructure strategy or security policy. If you want to work only on large projects or prefer to work without guidance from senior staff, this role will not be the right fit. **Win\-Win Statement** We need a dependable, curious Junior System Administrator who keeps our people, devices, and design software running so our teams can deliver for clients. In return, you get real experience with a modern Microsoft stack and Autodesk environments at scale, mentorship from senior IT staff, and a clear path toward System Administrator. You grow your career, and we gain an IT operation our people can count on. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual pay for this position is $70,000 – $85,000, and the role is eligible for bonuses. The actual salary offer may be different as we carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, location, and experience. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off and holidays; other benefits.
