jobs.title: Assistant Professor - Artificial Intelligence in Civil and Environmental Engineering
jobs.description: * 538604 * Blacksburg, Virginia * Civil \& Environmental Engineering * Teaching \& Research Faculty * College of Engineering **Job Description** The Charles E. Via, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Virginia Tech invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor position from candidates with demonstrated expertise in developing, adapting, or applying artificial intelligence (AI) methods to address substantive civil and environmental engineering challenges. This open search welcomes candidates across all sub\-disciplines: construction engineering and management; environmental and water resources engineering; geotechnical engineering; structural engineering and materials; sustainable land development; and transportation infrastructure and systems engineering. The successful candidate will establish an externally funded research program and mentor students; contribute to undergraduate and graduate education that integrates AI with engineering fundamentals and professional practice; and contribute to departmental and professional service. Example research directions include AI\-enabled sensing and monitoring, physics\-informed modeling, digital twins, autonomous experimentation, and intelligent design and decision support for the built and natural environments. We particularly welcome approaches that integrate AI with engineering fundamentals to accelerate scientific discovery and address complex engineering challenges. Virginia Tech is making significant institutional investments in artificial intelligence, positioning AI as a strategic research priority. These investments include the Sanghani Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics, the Institute for Advanced Computing, expanded high\-performance computing and GPU resources through Advanced Research Computing (ARC), and HokieAI, a university\-supported platform providing secure access to AI tools. Together with world\-class laboratory facilities and a substantial presence in the Washington, D.C., region, these resources create opportunities for interdisciplinary research, collaboration with industry and federal agencies, and AI\-driven innovation across the built and natural environments. The CEE Department has 52 tenured/tenure\-track faculty and 8 professors of practice. Eight faculty are recent early investigator award recipients, and numerous other faculty are recognized nationally and internationally. The department is home to 741 undergraduate students and 255 full\-time graduate students. The civil and environmental engineering graduate programs are currently ranked 8th and 5th, respectively, and the civil and environmental engineering undergraduate programs are ranked 10th and 7th, respectively, by U.S. News \& World Report (USN\&WR). Primary responsibilities include: * Develop and sustain an externally funded research program that develops, adapts, or applies AI methods to civil and environmental engineering challenges * Teach undergraduate and graduate courses supporting the department's educational mission, including AI applications across CEE program areas * Advise and mentor graduate and undergraduate students * Publish scholarly work and disseminate research to academic, practitioner and public audiences * Contribute service to the department, college, university and profession **Required Qualifications** * Doctoral degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline (such as computer science or electrical engineering), prior to the effective date of the appointment * Demonstrated research experience in developing, adapting or applying AI or machine learning methods to civil or environmental engineering problems, evidenced by peer\-reviewed publications or other substantive research outputs * A research plan in AI for civil and environmental engineering that could support external funding, as described in the research statement * Ability to teach undergraduate and graduate courses that integrate AI, computing, and data analytics with civil and environmental engineering, as described in the teaching statement * A strong record of academic accomplishments commensurate with rank, a proven ability to work collaboratively, and a commitment to interdisciplinary research and instruction **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience preparing or securing competitive external research funding, as PI, co\-PI or senior personnel * Experience applying AI methods to experimental, computational, field, or operational data from civil or environmental engineering systems * Experience with methods that combine AI with engineering knowledge, such as physics\-informed or hybrid models, uncertainty quantification, or interpretable models * Experience mentoring graduate or undergraduate students in research **Overtime Status** Exempt: Not eligible for overtime **Appointment Type** Regular **Salary Information** Commensurate with experience and qualifications. **Hours per week** 40 **Review Date** 1/4/2027 **Additional Information** The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check. **About Virginia Tech** Dedicated to its motto, *Ut Prosim* (That I May Serve), Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a hands\-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be leaders and problem\-solvers. A comprehensive land\-grant institution that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the world, Virginia Tech is an inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and professional students in eight undergraduate colleges, a school of medicine, a veterinary medicine college, Graduate School, and Honors College. The university has a significant presence across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C. area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous Extension offices and research institutes. A leading global research institution, Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research annually. Virginia Tech endorses and encourages participation in professional development opportunities and university shared governance. These valuable contributions to university shared governance provide important representation and perspective, along with opportunities for unique and impactful professional development. Virginia Tech does not discriminate against employees, students, or applicants on the basis of age, color, disability, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, ethnicity or national origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, or military status, or otherwise discriminate against employees or applicants who inquire about, discuss, or disclose their compensation or the compensation of other employees or applicants, or on any other basis protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and desire an accommodation, please contact co\-chairs **Eric Jacques (ejacques@vt.edu)** and **Linsey Marr (lmarr@vt.edu)** during regular business hours at least 10 business days prior to the event.

jobs.title: Transportation Engineer 2
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **About WSDOT** The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award\-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation! **The Opportunity** WSDOT is currently seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical professional to support the safe and efficient movement of people and goods throughout Washington State. In this role, you will help improve transportation safety and mobility by analyzing traffic operations, evaluating work zone traffic control, and developing cost\-effective enhancements to the highway system. Your work will contribute to effective traffic management, reliable transportation infrastructure, and the safe movement of the traveling public through construction and maintenance zones. By developing traffic design plans and supporting projects that meet current standards, you will help advance WSDOT’s mission to provide safe, reliable, and cost\-effective transportation options that strengthen communities and economic vitality. **What to Expect** Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, you will: * Analyze traffic operations using various analysis programs to compare design alternatives, document methods and assumptions, and conduct basic traffic analysis for all intersection types. * Prepare and review engineering reports, including Intersection Control Evaluations (ICE), Traffic Impact Analyses (TIA), Access Revision Reports (ARR), and Crash Analysis Reports (CAR), documenting findings, analysis results, and decisions. * Conduct traffic analysis and traffic counts from data collection through final analysis; analyze crash data, recommend countermeasures, and identify solutions to operational problems, including restriping, signing, minor physical changes, and signal timing revisions. * Prepare contract plans, specifications, and estimates for design and Low\-Cost Enhancement projects using computer\-aided design and drafting (CADD) systems; develop and correct plans and calculate and verify quantities for signing, illumination, traffic signals, and striping. * Conduct field reviews and site visits to collect and analyze data, verify existing traffic control measures for compliance and safety, and evaluate sight distance, queuing, delays, pedestrian and bicycle facilities, driveways, access points, utilities, striping, and roadway conditions against official plans. * Coordinate with project managers, maintenance, construction offices, local agencies, utility companies, electrical inspectors, manufacturers, and other stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and address traffic\-related project concerns. * Provide technical assistance to Project Development and Construction professional engineering (PE) offices on traffic\-related issues and support project development and implementation. * Participate in nighttime sign inventory reviews, ensure traffic counting equipment is properly installed and positioned, and perform other engineering duties as assigned to support the traffic engineering team. **Qualifications** To be considered for this opportunity, the following competencies are required: * **Foundational Engineering Knowledge:** Demonstrated understanding of civil, structural, geotechnical, or transportation engineering principles. Ability to apply engineering concepts to real\-world scenarios. * **Technical Interpretation and Analysis:** Skilled in reading, analyzing and interpreting contract plans, specifications, manuals, and other documents in accordance with project requirements and engineering standards. * **Communication and Interpersonal Proficiency:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to a variety of stakeholders, including engineers, contractors, and the public. * **Computer and Engineering Software Literacy:** Proficient in the use of engineering technology, including computer\-aided drafting (CAD) and other engineering software applications used for design, analysis, and documentation. Demonstrated ability to utilize computer programs to prepare plans, reports, spreadsheets, correspondence, specifications, and other engineering documents. * **License:** Valid driver's license and demonstrated ability to independently travel to and between project and meeting sites, safely operate state\-owned vehicles, and transport agency\-owned equipment and tools required to perform field duties. * **Service\-Oriented:** Demonstrates a willingness to take action to meet the needs of others. * **Growth Mindset:** Actively demonstrates a commit s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Security** All state employees are covered by the federal Social Security and Medicare systems. The state and the employee pay an equal amount into the system. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** If you are employed by a government or not\-for\-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **Holidays** Full\-time and part\-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year. **Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.* Full\-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday. Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave. Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. **Vacation (Annual Leave)** Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits. Updated 01\-07\-2026

jobs.description: **Location** ============ Remote, US **Scheduled Hours** =================== 40 **Position Summary** ==================== The Consortium for Brain Research and AI in Neurodegeneration (C\-BRAIN) is an academic\-industry consortium directed by Dr. Randall J. Bateman, Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis. C\-BRAIN brings together academic research institutions, pharmaceutical and biotech companies, technology partners, philanthropic organizations, and government agencies to develop AI\-powered tools to accelerate discovery in Alzheimer's disease and neurodegenerative disorders. Individual rates within the range will be determined by factors including one's qualifications and performance, equity with others in the department, market rates for positions within the same grade and department budget. **Questions** ============= For frequently asked questions about the application process, please refer to our External Applicant FAQ . **Accommodation** ================= If you are unable to use our online application system and would like an accommodation, please email CandidateQuestions@wustl.edu or call the dedicated accommodation inquiry number at 314\-935\-1149 and leave a voicemail with the nature of your request. jobs.description: **About WebBank** ----------------- WebBank (the “Bank”) is a Utah chartered Industrial Bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. As “The Bank Behind the Brand®”, WebBank is a national issuer of consumer and small business credit products through Strategic Partner (Brand) platforms, which include retailers, manufacturers, finance companies, software as a service (SaaS) and financial technology (FinTech) companies. The Bank is a leading player in the digital lending space, driving innovation in financial products through embedded finance with Strategic Partner platforms. WebBank engages in a full range of banking activities including consumer and commercial loan products, revolving lines of credit, credit cards, private\-label card issuance, auto\-refinancing and more. The Bank provides capital in the form of asset\-backed lending and other credit facilities to Strategic Partner platforms, credit funds, and other lenders with a targeted focus on specialty finance assets. The Bank is also a leading provider of commercial insurance premium finance products through its wholly owned subsidiary National Partners. **Job Summary** --------------- WebBank's engineering team is small, and every engineer owns their work from the first conversation with the business through production. We are looking for a senior full\-stack engineer to take ownership of our partner\-facing platforms. These are the applications our Strategic Partners use to work with the Bank. You will ship features, set the quality bar through code review and testing, make sure we know when something breaks before a partner does, and mentor newer engineers. **Our stack:** TypeScript, Node.js (Fastify), React, PostgreSQL (Aurora), SQL Server, AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, CloudFront), Terraform, Bitbucket Pipelines. **Primary Responsibilities (Job Duties)** ----------------------------------------- **You Will:** * Own one or more partner\-facing applications end to end, covering design, build, test, deploy and support. * Turn business needs into requirements and a technical design. Before you build, confirm stakeholder buy\-in, end\-user involvement and a plan for adoption. * Raise the team's engineering standards. Review pull requests, write unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests, and leave systems better documented than you found them. * Build the monitoring, alerting and logging our partner\-facing systems need. Your checks should catch broken behavior, not just dead servers. * Mentor junior engineers through pairing, design and code reviews and constructive feedback. * Work within the Bank's change\-management and security controls. jobs.description: **About this Role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Specialty Software Engineer (Cryptography Engineer) to contribute to a next\-generation Digital Asset Platform designed to solve the most critical challenge in institutional finance: achieving strict regulatory compliance without compromising transaction confidentiality. As a Lead Cryptography Engineer you will be responsible for architecting the core Key Management Service (KMS). You will sit at the intersection of applied cryptography, hardware security, and distributed systems, implementing threshold signing protocols inside attested execution environments. **Why Join Us?** * **Work on "Hard" Problems:** You aren't just calling crypto libraries; you are building a system where code meets hardware to solve fundamental trust problems in digital finance * **High\-Impact Engineering:** Your code will secure billions in institutional assets against nation\-state level threats and insider attacks * **Technical Autonomy:** You'll lead architectural decisions for the custody engine, defining how we leverage the latest in MPC and Confidential Computing **Responsibilities:** * **MPC Protocol Implementation:** Architect and implement high\-performance threshold Environments (TEEs)**, specifically targeting **AMD SEV\-SNP** and **Intel TDX** via Confidential Containers (CoCo) * **Attestation Framework:** Implement the **RATS (Remote ATtestation procedureS)** architecture (RFC 9334\) to ensure that no key share is released until the requesting node proves its hardware and software integrity to a Key Broker Service * **Hardware Security Integration:** Design "Cold Ceremony" workflows that integrate offline hardware tokens as offline Key Encryption Keys (KEKs) for disaster recovery and deep storage * **Secure Enclave Development:** Write and jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions** The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy's industry\-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real\-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real\-time trading decisions and mid\-to\-long\-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It's both challenging work and work with a purpose. **Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.** **Position Summary** In the Product Infrastructure and Operations group, we are accelerating the product vision by building solutions in a fun, collaborative, efficient, and adaptive team. As a Senior Backend Engineer focused on data integration, you will own how data is shared between systems at Yes Energy — across operational databases, our cloud data platform, internal applications, partners, and customers. Whether the right answer is database replication, change data capture, an API, or an event\-driven integration, you will choose the approach, build it, and make it reliable. Strong technical skills are only part of this role. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, collaborates well with teams across Yes Energy, and shows leadership by guiding technical decisions, mentoring others, and helping interview future teammates. For the right person, there is room to grow into a lead role over time. We are curious people who take pride in our work, value high\-quality communication, and strive to improve continuously. **Position Details** * Salary range: $116,129\- $185,806 * Location: Dedham, MA * Full\-time * Hybrid \- Will be required to work in the office 2\-3 days a week * Reporting to: Kirk Mitchener, Senior Director, Platform Technology **Primary Responsibilities** * Lead technical decisions on data integration through expertise and influence: propose standards, review designs, and share patterns other teams can reuse * Design, build, and operate integrations that share data between Yes Energy systems, partner platforms, and customer environments, choosing replication, change data capture, APIs, messaging, or scheduled data transfers as each problem requires * Design, build, and version REST APIs and data\-delivery services that expose energy data to internal applications and customers * Replace fragile point\-to\-point integrations with reusable, well\-documented patterns, and record the trade\-offs behind each decision in cost, latency, coupling, and operational burden * Partner with product, data engineering, operations, infrastructure, and customer\-facing teams to understand their data needs and turn them into well\-scoped work * Take part in interviewing candidates, and mentor and support teammates * Communicate plans, progress, and risks clearly to leadership and non\-technical stakeholders * Engage directly with cross\-functional stakeholders — product, domain experts, and occasionally customers — to shape the right solutions **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience) * 7\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated technical leadership (e.g., leading projects, setting technical direction, or mentoring others) * Strong programming skills in Python or another modern language; we value sound engineering judgment over expertise in any specific language * Advanced SQL and strong experience with relational database management systems such as SQL Server and Oracle, including query and performance tuning * Hands\-on experience with database replication or change data capture (e.g., SQL Server CDC, Oracle GoldenGate, Debezium, Fivetran, Snowflake Streams/Snowpipe) * Extensive experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs * Extensive experience developing for and working in cloud environments, Snowflake preferred * Experience interviewing engineering candidates or otherwise contributing to hiring * Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain technical decisions to non\-technical audiences and build working relationships across teams * Self\-directed and comfortable supporting the needs of multiple teams, systems, and products **Key Competencies / Preferred Qualifications** * **Collaboration \& Influence:** Builds strong working relationships with teams outside their own, aligns stakeholders with competing needs, and earns trust through follow\-through * **Effective Communication:** Writes clear design documents and decision records, and explains complex system choices to technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike * **Leadership:** Leads through expertise and initiative: mentors others, drives design discussions, raises the technical bar, and interviews thoughtf  with event streaming or messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Service Bus) or ETL/ELT tools (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) is a plus * **Energy Industry \& Customer Understanding:** Background in data\-intensive environments (e.g., equities/commodities trading) or a strong desire to learn the wholesale electric power industry **At Yes Energy, we value connecting directly with candidates. We kindly ask that third\-party recruiters and agencies not submit resumes, as we are not open to external recruiting partnerships.** **ABOUT YES ENERGY** **Overview** Yes Energy delivers real\-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Since its inception in 2008, Yes Energy has become a trusted and respected supplier of innovative and reliable solutions focused on the needs of power market analysts, traders, and trade managers. Yes Energy has a team of 400\+ amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand; and Bucharest, Romania. **Culture** Yes Energy has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Colorado, and we have the culture to prove it. At Yes Energy, we care about saying "Yes" to customers. We like to listen, learn, and develop our solutions in line with their needs. We think about customers as business partners, and when we help them be more successful … we are more successful, too. Around the office, our culture is driven by some pretty fundamental values that we're proud of: * We love innovation and solving tough challenges; We are "high standards people" who combine passion and pride with hard work and rewards of all kinds* \- in an ethic that is consistent across the company. We're team\-focused with a flat hierarchy* \- we work in small teams on well\-defined projects that directly impact the success of the business; * We play to the strengths and experience of each person while each of us also works along a continuum of roles adjacent to our focus area. This presents the challenge of maintaining a broad set of skills as well as an opportunity to learn and contribute in many ways. * We are constantly growing. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for senior software engineers who want to solve challenging technical problems, lead the development of systems at scale, and help shape what we build next. We work in an agile environment with two\-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As a senior engineer, you'll remain deeply involved in designing and building software while providing technical leadership to the engineers around you. You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to turn broader priorities into sound technical plans, guide projects through delivery, and help less\-experienced engineers continue to grow. We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join as an early member of our paid media engineering team. We work with multi\-location brands to drive meaningful engagement and conversion with local, personalized content while preserving brand integrity across thousands of locations. We do this by launching brand playbooks into localized, cross\-channel campaigns at every location, launched in one click and on brand by default. We serve many of the biggest brands and franchises on the planet and deliver data\-backed advertising results to their locations around the world. This team builds the platform behind every campaign: the ads infrastructure, the integrations with Meta, Google, TikTok, Yelp, and Apple Maps, and the AI agents that connect a marketing team's tools. We value building beautiful, easy\-to\-use products within a culture focused on speed, sustainability, and engineering without ego. This role is based in Covington, KY, just across the river from Cincinnati, where in\-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in\-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration. **What You'll Do** * Build the ads infrastructure that powers millions of dollars in ad spend across thousands of locations * Ship new platform integrations quickly, usually in days or weeks rather than months * Build enterprise\-ready AI agents and MCP servers that connect a marketing team's key tools in one shared workspace * Expand the platforms we support, including TikTok, Yelp, and Apple Ads * Craft short\-form video tools that help customers create and repurpose content * Build a predictive content engine that learns from customers' past social and ad performance to recommend and automate creative * Develop, deploy, and maintain core infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud with Docker, GitHub, and CI/CD * Serve as a technical leader for the team while continuing to contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of production software * Own complex development efforts from problem definition and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation * Design sound technical solutions, write and review technical designs, and guide architectural and implementation decisions within the team's systems * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities into technical plans, identify dependencies and risks, and help determine how the team should approach the work * Break complex technical initiatives into clear, manageable pieces and help guide engineers through successful delivery * Solve difficult technical problems independently and provide guidance when other engineers encounter challenges * Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement * Mentor and share knowledge with other engineers, helping less\-experienced teammates strengthen their technical skills and judgment * Lead production incident response and follow\-up, helping the team diagnose complex problems, restore service, and make improvements that prevent recurrence * Collabo ring standards * Model effective AI\-enabled engineering practices, experiment with new capabilities and workflows, and share successful approaches with other engineers **What You Have** * A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent college\-level education * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Hands\-on experience with generative AI models and tools (frontier models, AI agents, Codex, Claude, LangChain) and the judgment to validate what they produce * A keen eye for quality and a drive to build software people use and love * Comfort operating in ambiguity and wearing multiple hats: front end, back end, DevOps, and talking to customers * A growth mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies * Enjoyment of working closely with an interdisciplinary team * A track record of leading significant technical projects and delivering complex production systems * Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and supporting the growth of less\-experienced team members * Experience supervising or managing software engineers, or demonstrated readiness to take on direct\-report responsibilities * Deep technical judgment and a strong foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms * Experience designing software systems, evaluating competing approaches, and communicating technical decisions clearly to other engineers * The ability to remain deeply hands\-on while also guiding the technical work of others * Experience diagnosing difficult production problems and leading technical incident response * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working across engineering teams and with Product or other business partners * Fluency with Node.js (Typescript), React, MySQL, Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Node.js, Java and Go) * Experience recruiting, interviewing, or evaluating software engineers * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to critically evaluate their output as part of a responsible engineering workflow * Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools * Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment \#LI\-JB2 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Taxonomy, AI Data Modeling, MLOps, YouTube Business
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus. Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in data engineering, data modeling, or building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines and distributed data warehouses. * 3 years of experience writing production code in Python or a general\-purpose programming language, and with SQL for data analysis. * Experience building or scaling text classification, natural language processing (NLP), or machine learning data pipelines. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline or equivalent professional experience. * Experience designing ontologies, versioned taxonomies, semantic layers, or metadata management platforms for large\-scale unstructured text, transcript, image, or video datasets. * Experience optimizing ML vs. LLM compute unit economics using vector embeddings, lightweight classifiers, evaluation golden sets, and AI coding tools. * Experience building APIs or architecting data models from the ground up. **About the job** ----------------- Much of the organization's most valuable signal sits in high\-volume unstructured data, including support call transcripts, partner feedback, images, and video metadata. Today, extracting insights often relies on fragmented spreadsheets and costly per\-document Large Language Model (LLM) inference. As a Senior Data Engineer in Technical Solutions, you will build the data foundation and metadata infrastructure that enables business teams and AI agents to understand YouTube's creator, partner, and support operations. You will replace ad\-hoc workflows with durable, deterministic infrastructure: versioned taxonomies and ontologies, vector\-embedding classification pipelines optimized for compute unit economics, and governed semantic data layers that allow stakeholders and AI tools to query business concepts accurately. Working across global engineering, analytics, and operations teams, you will own solutions end to end from scoping and data modeling through evaluation and production deployment. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $156000 \- $226000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, version, and govern business taxonomies, ontologies, and metadata frameworks that establish shared ground truth for analysts, operational tools, and AI agents. * Build scalable text and multimodal classification pipelines using vector embeddings, lightweight ML models, and LLMs to convert unstructured transcripts and feedback into deterministic signals. * Define accuracy benchmarks, build human\-labeled evaluation golden sets, and monitor production pipeline quality and compute unit economics. * Architect relational and semantic data layers in distributed warehouses so business users and LLM tools can query concepts reliably in plain language. * Partner with executives, engineers, analysts, and vendor teams to scope ambiguous problems, author design documents, and ship end\-to\-end production systems. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: DevOps/Platform Engineer Lead (Hands-on)
jobs.description: ### **About Dawn** Dawn started with a realization: every security stack is missing a crucial layer. Identity tools know who you are. Data tools know what you have. Nothing in between can tell whether the access that just happened was legitimate. The breach doesn’t start with a break\-in. It starts with a login, and the missing layer is where it goes unnoticed. That’s why Dawn exists. We are the Access Intelligence Platform, the first to unite identity and data and fill that layer, for every human, machine and AI agent, with a human in the loop on purpose. We’re growing our team, and how you build matters as much as what you know. We’re looking for people who are: * Curious about the problems everyone else has decided are unsolvable, and restless until they’re solved * Rigorous in the standard they hold themselves to, because being right matters more than being loud * Owners of the outcome, who would rather ship something real this week than something perfect that never arrives Because a missing layer doesn’t build itself. And first light is the best time to arrive. ### **Job Description** We're looking for a hands\-on DevOps/Platform Engineer Lead to own the entire infrastructure lifecycle of our GCP\-based multi\-tenant SaaS platform — fully managed and multi\-region. You'll be our **first in\-house DevOps hire**: you'll join the core team at an early stage of development and take over infrastructure that is run today by an outsourced team, with the foundation already built to infrastructure\-as\-code best practices. You'll own it from there — hardening and scaling the platform — and you'll anchor the in\-house DevOps team we're building, helping us hire, grow, and lead it. This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role where you'll make foundational decisions that shape the platform for years. **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * Background in **security or B2B SaaS** products * **10\+ years** DevOps/SRE/Platform Engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a senior/lead capacity * Strong **GCP** experience (GKE, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Memorystore) * Proficiency with **Terraform** (modules, state management, workspaces) * Production **Kubernetes** experience with Docker, KEDA, Helm * **CI/CD** pipeline design (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Artifact Registry) * **PostgreSQL** administration (HA, backups, performance tuning) * **Networking** (VPCs, firewalls, load balancers, DNS) * **Monitoring** and observability (Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Prometheus, Grafana) * **Security** best practices (Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, IAM) * **Multi\-tenant SaaS** architecture experience ### **Nice to Have** * GCP Professional certifications (Cloud Architect, DevOps Engineer) * **Compliance frameworks** (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) * **BigQuery** and data pipeline experience * **Python/Bash** scripting * **GPU infrastructure** on GKE (node pools, scheduling, driver and quota management, cost control) * **AI/agent workload infrastructure** (inference serving, autoscaling for bursty LLM traffic, egress controls for tool calling) * **Temporal** or similar workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows, Airflow) ### **Responsibilities** **GCP Foundation \& Networking** — Configure organization structure, IAM policies, VPC architecture, and firewall rules **Kubernetes \& Container Orchestration** — Manage GKE clusters with Workload Identity, implement KEDA queue\-based autoscaling, design RBAC and namespace isolation, configure deployment health checks and Artifact Registry **Database Infrastructure** — Provision Cloud SQL with HA and backups, configure BigQuery for analytics, deploy Memorystore Redis **Message Queue Architecture** — Design Pub/Sub topics with priority queues, configure ordering keys and dead letter queues **CI/CD Pipeline** — Set up Terraform state management, Cloud Build triggers, and blue\-green deployments **Security \& Compliance** — Implement Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, Cloud Armor, and multi\-tenant isolation **Monitoring \& Observability** — Build dashboards, configure distributed tracing, design alerting hierarchy **Disaster Recovery \& Operations** — Configure cross\-region DR, automate failover, create incident runbooks **AI/Agent Workload Infrastructure** — Provision and scale GPU node pools, run inference and agent workloads in production, and keep their cost and tenant isolation under control **Cost Management** — Set up billing exports, budget alerts, and per\-tenant cost tracking **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Work From Home * Stock Option Plan

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Network Engineer to serve as Gifthealth's primary technical authority for enterprise networking, accountable for the reliability, performance, security, scalability, and lifecycle of the network across our offices, pharmacy fulfillment and automation sites, colocation data center, and cloud environments. This position plays a key role in supporting the IT Engineering department and reports to the Director of IT, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. This is a build\-and\-run role: the Network Engineer designs and operates routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, and WAN connectivity; owns carrier, colocation, and cloud interconnect services; defines the physical infrastructure requirements that Facilities and contractors build to when we open or expand a location; and documents all of it in our systems of record. Part of the IT Engineering team, this role is the escalation point for IT Operations on complex network issues. Routine administration and standardized changes are delegated to IT Operations where appropriate, using procedures the Network Engineer establishes, in close partnership with Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering, Security, Facilities, and Operations. **Key Responsibilities** * **Network Architecture \& Design:** + Designs, implements, and maintains the enterprise network: routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, remote access and zero\-trust connectivity, and site networking, with high availability and tested failover across gateways, circuits, and sites. + Designs and maintains network segmentation between corporate, pharmacy production, operational technology, guest, and vendor environments while ensuring secure connectivity and minimizing disruptions to production operations. + Owns network addressing architecture, including subnet allocation, VLAN standards, and IP address management, in coordination with Systems Administration, which operates DNS and DHCP. + Reviews proposed network changes, infrastructure deployments, and vendor connectivity requirements for compliance with established architecture, security, and operational standards. + Conducts or coordinates enterprise wireless site surveys and designs access point layouts for offices, warehouses, and production floors, including coverage for handheld scanners and operational devices. + Leads design and migration for platform refreshes; maintains network hardware and software lifecycle plans, including capacity forecasting, end\-of\-support tracking, refresh planning, firmware currency, and CVE remediation within maintenance windows. * **Carrier, Colocation \& Cloud Connectivity:** + Owns cloud interconnect circuits (AWS Direct Connect or equivalent), BGP peering and redundancy, and colocation cross\-connects, cabinets, and remote hands; partners with Cloud Infrastructure Engineering on cloud\-side routing and private networking. + Orders and provisions ISP and dedicated circuits for new and existing sites (surveys, LOAs, demarc, turn\-up); drives carrier and colocation escalations to resolution and maintains backup provider options. * **Site Build\-Outs \& Physical Infrastructure:** + Authors and maintains Gifthealth standards for structured cabling, telecom rooms (MDF/IDF), racks and cabinets, bonding and grounding, and cable pathways; defines network power, UPS runtime, and environmental requirements and coordinates with Facilities and qualified contractors to implement them. + Produces network layouts and floor\-plan markups for new locations, expansions, and remodels, and represents IT with landlords, construction project managers, and Facilities so network requirements are captured early. + Scopes statements of work, obtains quotes, and technically evaluates and oversees low\-voltage and network installation contractors, including onsite safety expectations, acceptance testing, and as\-built review; defines requirements and validates deliverables for electrical work managed by Facilities; brings acquired or newly leased sites up to Gifthealth IT standards. + Designs and supports network connectivity for pharmacy automation, conveyors, controls and PLC cabinets, industrial compute, time clocks, digital signage, and physical security systems; coordinates layouts, integration requirements, and maintenance windows with Operations, Safety and Security, and automation vendors whose equipment has strict network and downtime requirements. * **Monitoring, Resilience \& Security:** + Implements and maintains network monitoring and performa aster recovery design. (Required) + Knowledge of structured cabling standards (TIA/BICSI), telecom room design, rack and cabinet standards, bonding and grounding, cable pathways, and power and cooling fundamentals for network spaces. (Required) + Knowledge of enterprise wireless design, survey methods, and RF troubleshooting. (Required) + Knowledge of cloud networking in at least one major platform (AWS preferred), zero\-trust frameworks, and ITSM, change management, and documentation standards. (Required) + Network, firewall, and routing configuration, capacity planning, and performance analysis skills. (Required) + Demonstrated application of the above Qualification + Architecture design, documentation, and diagramming skills, including network layouts and floor\-plan markups using Lucidchart, Visio, or similar tools. (Required) + Vendor and service provider coordination and incident response skills. (Required) + Ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues quickly and own them through resolution. (Required) + Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives, Facilities, Operations, landlords, and contractors. (Required) + Ability to manage multiple priorities across several sites, design scalable architectures, and lead infrastructure initiatives from design through delivery. (Required) + Preferred: low\-voltage contractor scoping and oversight; network access control (802\.1X, RADIUS, certificate\-based authentication); software\-defined networking; network automation using scripting (Python, Ansible); CAD proficiency; load balancing; hybrid cloud networking architecture. **Work Environment** * **Location**: Hybrid, based in Columbus, Ohio, with regular onsite time at Gifthealth's central Ohio locations. * **Schedule**: 8:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. Monday through Friday. Participates in scheduled after\-hours maintenance and cutovers and provides advanced escalation support for critical network incidents in accordance with established IT incident response and on\-call procedures. * Travel: occasional overnight travel to Gifthealth locations outside central Ohio, typically tied to site build\-outs, installations, and vendor walkthroughs. * Settings: offices, pharmacy production floors and warehouses, telecom rooms, a colocation data center, and active construction sites. * Meetings: regular meetings with IT, Security, Facilities, and Operations teams, and with carriers, colocation and hardware vendors, automation vendors, construction project managers, and installation contractors. **Key Essential Functions** * Must be able to work on a computer for extended periods and attend virtual meetings * Must be able to work in telecom rooms, warehouses, production floors, and construction areas wearing required PPE; lift and carry up to 50 pounds; rack and mount equipment; and use ladders and lifts * Must hold a valid driver's license and be able to travel between Gifthealth locations, including occasional air travel **Employment Classification** **Status:** Full\-time **FLSA:** Exempt **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply! **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

LLM pipelines and agentic applications. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets to support LLM application development, including data curation, preparation, and quality validation for model inputs and model responses. * Working familiarity with RESTful and event\-driven API patterns including asynchronous workflows, service boundaries, and integration of enterprise data sources to expose LLM and agentic capabilities. * Practical understanding of containerization and orchestration concepts for packaging and deploying LLM applications in cloud environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS etc.). * Understanding software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation. * Familiarity with Data Monitoring and Data Observability in cloud environments (OpenTelemetry, Azure Application Insights, etc.). * Exposure to CI/CD and operationalization practices for AI systems, including model and workflow deployment, versioning, environment promotion, and release support in cloud or containerized environments. **Soft Skills and Additional Attributes for Success** * Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including risk and compliance. * technologies evolve. * Collaborative and cross\-functional, working closely with engineering and product teams. * Bachelor's degree preferred. * 2\+ years of applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles. * Partner with Development, Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and project leadership teams to deliver high\-value AI capabilities. * Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi\-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor, etc.). * Familiarity with LLM fine\-tuning approaches including instruction tuning and preference optimization, with an understanding of when fine\-tuning is
